One strategy would be to use this method to produce preliminary estimates, with a full trial conducted thereafter, if indicated.

10.1002/hec.2973.abstractZh: 本文旨在描述并试验一种实用方法，以利用调查数据估算护理服务的增量成本效益。主要挑战在于估计反事实情况，即如果患者没有接受该级别的服务，他们的生活质量会如何。文中提出了一种生产函数方法，旨在区分数据中因服务使用而导致的护理相关生活质量的变化与其他因素的影响。存在的问题是，相关需求因素也会影响服务的使用量，因此任何缺失的因素都可能造成内生性偏差。工具变量估计可以缓解这个问题。该方法被应用于一项针对老年人的调查，该调查以家庭护理为研究对象，作为概念验证。在分析中，我们能够利用具有预期形式且具有稳健估计诊断结果的调查数据，估算出生活质量的生产函数。该方法的实际优势显而易见，但也存在局限性。其计算复杂度较高，且存在误设定和结果偏差的风险，尤其是在使用工具变量估计时。一种策略是使用该方法得出初步估计结果，然后根据需要进行全面试验。

abstract.text: Gender differences in drinking patterns are potentially important for public policies, especially policies that rely extensively on higher alcohol taxes and prices. This paper presents a systematic review of alcohol prices and gender differences in drinking and heavy drinking by adults and young adults. Starting with a database of 578 studies of alcohol demand and other outcomes, 15 studies are reviewed of adult drinking including discussion of samples, measurement issues, econometric models, special variables, and key empirical results. A similar discussion is presented for eight studies of drinking by young adults, ages 18-26 years. Four conclusions are obtained from the review. First, adult men have less elastic demands compared with women. Second, there is little or no price response by heavy-drinking adults, regardless of gender. Third, although the sample is small, price might be important for drinking participation by young adults. Fourth, the results strongly suggest that heavy drinking by young adults, regardless of gender, is not easily dissuaded by higher prices. Policy implications, primary study limitations, and suggestions for future research are discussed.

10.1002/hec.2974.abstractZh: 性别差异在饮酒模式上可能对公共政策具有重要意义，尤其是那些依赖提高酒精税和价格的政策。本文系统回顾了酒精价格以及成人和年轻人饮酒及过度饮酒的性别差异。基于包含578项关于酒精需求及其他相关结果的数据库，本文对15项关于成人饮酒的研究进行了分析，包括样本选择、测量问题、计量经济模型、特殊变量以及关键实证结果。对于8项关于18-26岁年轻人饮酒的研究，也进行了类似的讨论。通过回顾得出四个结论：首先，成年男性的需求弹性低于女性；其次，无论性别如何，过度饮酒的成年人对价格反应很小或没有反应；第三，尽管样本规模较小，但价格可能对年轻人参与饮酒行为具有重要影响；第四，研究结果强烈表明，无论性别如何，年轻人过度饮酒行为并不容易被更高的价格所抑制。文章还讨论了政策启示、主要研究的局限性以及未来研究的建议。

abstract.text: This paper investigates long-term home care utilization in Europe. Data from the first wave of the Survey on Health, Ageing and Retirement (SHARE) on formal (nursing care and paid domestic help) and informal care (support provided by relatives) are used to study the probability and the quantity of both types of care. The overall process is framed in a fully simultaneous equation system that takes the form of a bivariate two-part model where the reciprocal interaction between formal and informal care is estimated. Endogeneity and unobservable heterogeneity are addressed using a common latent factor approach. The analysis of the relative impact of age and disability on home care utilization is enriched by the use of a proximity to death (PtD) indicator built using the second wave of SHARE. All these indicators are important predictors of home care utilization. In particular, a strong significant effect of PtD is found in the paid domestic help and informal care models. The relationship between formal and informal care moves from substitutability to complementarity depending on the type of care considered, and the estimated effects are small in absolute size. This might call for a reconsideration of the effectiveness of incentives for informal care as instruments to reduce public expenditure for home care services.

10.1002/hec.2977.abstractZh: 本文研究了欧洲长期家庭护理的利用情况。利用首次进行的“健康、老龄化与退休调查”（SHARE）中关于正式护理（包括护理服务和有偿家务帮助）和非正式护理（由亲属提供的支持）的数据，来研究这两种护理类型的概率和数量。整个研究过程采用一个完全同时方程系统来建模，该模型采用双变量两部分模型的形式，并估计了正式护理与非正式护理之间的相互作用。通过共同潜在因子方法解决了内生性和不可观测的异质性问题。通过对死亡临近度指标的分析，进一步丰富了关于年龄和残疾对家庭护理利用影响的认知。所有这些指标都是家庭护理利用的重要预测因素。特别是在有偿家务帮助和非正式护理模型中，死亡临近度指标显示出显著且强烈的影响。正式护理与非正式护理之间的关系从可替代性转变为互补性，具体取决于所考虑的护理类型，且估计出的效应在绝对值上较小。这可能需要重新考虑对非正式护理的激励措施作为减少公共支出用于家庭护理服务的工具的有效性。

abstract.text: Despite growing adoption of pay-for-performance (P4P) programmes in health care, there is remarkably little evidence on the cost-effectiveness of such schemes. We review the limited number of previous studies and critique the frameworks adopted and the narrow range of costs and outcomes considered, before proposing a new more comprehensive framework, which we apply to the first P4P scheme introduced for hospitals in England. We emphasise that evaluations of cost-effectiveness need to consider who the residual claimant is on any cost savings, the possibility of positive and negative spillovers, and whether performance improvement is a transitory or investment activity. Our application to the Advancing Quality initiative demonstrates that the incentive payments represented less than half of the £ 13 m total programme costs. By generating approximately 5200 quality-adjusted life years and £ 4.4 m of savings in reduced length of stay, we find that the programme was a cost-effective use of resources in its first 18 months.

10.1002/hec.2978.abstractZh: 尽管绩效付费（P4P）计划在医疗保健领域的应用日益广泛，但关于此类计划成本效益的实证研究却非常有限。我们回顾了以往为数不多的研究，并批评了所采用的评估框架以及考虑的成本和结果范围过于狭窄。随后，我们提出了一个新的、更为全面的评估框架，并将其应用于英格兰首个针对医院的绩效付费计划。我们强调，评估成本效益时需要考虑剩余索赔者是谁、正负溢出效应的可能性，以及绩效提升是临时性的还是长期性的投资行为。将这一框架应用于“提升质量计划”中，我们发现激励性支付金额仅占总项目成本1300万英镑的一半以下。通过为参与者节省约5200个质量调整生命年，并减少住院时间，使项目在最初18个月内实现了成本效益。

abstract.text: Advances in technology and subsequent changes in clinical practice can lead to increases in healthcare costs. Our objective is to assess the impact that changes in the technological intensity of physician-provided health services have had on the age pattern of both the volume of services provided and the average expenditures associated with them. We based our analysis on age-sex-specific patient-level administrative records of diagnoses and treatments. These records include virtually all physician services provided in the province of Ontario, Canada in a 10-year span ending in 2004 and their associated costs. An algorithm is developed to classify services and their costs into three levels of technological intensity. We find that while the overall age-standardized level and cost of services per capita have decreased, the volume and cost of high technologically intensive treatments have increased, especially among older patients.

10.1002/hec.2979.abstractZh: 技术进步的到来以及临床实践的相应变化可能导致医疗成本的上升。我们的目标是评估医生提供的医疗服务在技术强度方面的变化对服务量及其相关平均支出的年龄分布所产生的影响。我们的分析基于加拿大安大略省10年间（截至2004年）关于诊断和治疗的患者级别行政记录，这些记录几乎涵盖了该省所有由医生提供的医疗服务及其相关成本。我们开发了一种算法，将服务及其成本分为三个技术强度等级。研究发现，虽然服务的人均年龄标准化水平和成本有所下降，但技术密集型治疗的服务量和成本却有所上升，尤其是在老年患者中。

abstract.text: Willingness to pay (WTP) values derived from contingent valuation surveys are prone to a number of biases. Range bias occurs when the range of money values presented to respondents in a payment card affects their stated WTP values. This paper reports the results of an exploratory study whose aim was to investigate whether the effects of range bias can be reduced through the use of an alternative to the standard payment card method, namely, a random card sort method. The results suggest that the random card sort method is prone to range bias but that this bias may be mitigated by restricting the analysis to the WTP values of those respondents who indicate they are 'definitely sure' they would pay their stated WTP.

10.1002/hec.2980.abstractZh: 从条件价值评估调查中得出的支付意愿值容易受到多种偏差的影响。范围偏差是指，向受访者展示的支付金额范围会影响他们实际表达的支付意愿值。本文报告了一项探索性研究的结果，该研究旨在探讨是否可以通过使用另一种替代标准支付卡方法——即随机卡片排序法，来减少范围偏差的影响。研究结果表明，随机卡片排序法同样容易受到范围偏差的影响，但通过将分析范围限制在那些表示“绝对确定”愿意支付所声明金额的受访者的支付意愿值上，可以一定程度上减轻这种偏差。

abstract.text: The Medicare prescription drug program (Part D) standard benefit includes deductible, initial coverage, coverage gap and catastrophic coverage phases. As beneficiaries enter each phase, their out-of-pocket medication costs change discontinuously. The benefit cycle restarts on 1 January of the next year. Taking advantage of variation in drug coverage, we study how individuals reinitiate discontinued medications in response to the non-linear price schedule. Because some beneficiaries who receive low-income subsidies (LIS) have zero or fixed small copayments throughout the year, we perform a difference-in-difference analysis by using the LIS group as a comparison. We find that individuals delay reinitiating important medications in December and are significantly more likely to reinitiate in January than in other months. Although we find some evidence that reinitiation is lower in the final months of the year, it is mostly driven by those who face higher prices due to the coverage gap. Our study suggests that individuals respond more to the current price of medications and do not anticipate future prices as well as theory would suggest.

10.1002/hec.2981.abstractZh: 医疗保险处方药计划（D部分）的标准福利包括免赔额、初始覆盖、覆盖缺口和灾难性覆盖阶段。随着受益人进入每个阶段，他们的自付药物费用会发生变化。福利周期在下一年的1月1日重新开始。我们利用药物覆盖的差异，研究个体如何重新启用已中断的药物，以应对非线性的价格安排。由于一些获得低收入补贴的受益人在一年中几乎没有或只有固定的小额自付费用，我们通过使用低收入补贴组作为对照组，进行了差异-差异分析。我们发现，个体在12月会推迟重新启用重要药物，而在1月重新启用药物的可能性明显高于其他月份。尽管我们发现一年中最后几个月的重新启用频率较低，但这主要是由于那些因覆盖缺口而面临更高价格的人。我们的研究表明，个体对当前药物价格的反应更为敏感，并不像理论所预测的那样预期未来的价格变化。

abstract.text: In this paper, we estimate a copula-based bivariate dynamic hurdle model of prescription drug and nondrug expenditures to test the cost-offset hypothesis, which posits that increased expenditures on prescription drugs are offset by reductions in other nondrug expenditures. We apply the proposed methodology to data from the Medical Expenditure Panel Survey, which have the following features: (i) the observed bivariate outcomes are a mixture of zeros and continuously measured positives; (ii) both the zero and positive outcomes show state dependence and inter-temporal interdependence; and (iii) the zeros and the positives display contemporaneous association. The point mass at zero is accommodated using a hurdle or a two-part approach. The copula-based approach to generating joint distributions is appealing because the contemporaneous association involves asymmetric dependence. The paper studies samples categorized by four health conditions: arthritis, diabetes, heart disease, and mental illness. There is evidence of greater than dollar-for-dollar cost-offsets of expenditures on prescribed drugs for relatively low levels of spending on drugs and less than dollar-for-dollar cost-offsets at higher levels of drug expenditures.

10.1002/hec.2982.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们估计了一个基于copula的双变量动态障碍模型，用于检验成本抵消假设。该假设认为，处方药支出的增加会被其他非药物支出的减少所抵消。我们采用所提出的方法对医疗支出面板调查的数据进行分析，这些数据具有以下特点：(i) 观察到的双变量结果是零与连续正值的混合；(ii) 零值和正值都表现出状态依赖性和时间间的相互依赖性；(iii) 零值和正值之间存在同时性关联。零点的点质量采用障碍法或两部分方法进行处理。基于copula的方法在生成联合分布时具有吸引力，因为同时性关联涉及非对称依赖性。本文研究了四类健康状况的样本：关节炎、糖尿病、心脏病和精神疾病。有证据表明，在药物支出相对较低的情况下，处方药支出的增加会带来超过一美元对一美元的抵消效果；而在药物支出较高的情况下，这种抵消效果则小于一美元对一美元。

abstract.text: We estimate the relationship between mental health drug prescriptions and the level of labor market activity in the USA. Based on monthly data from the National Ambulatory Medical Care Survey of physicians and aggregated by US census regions, we find that the number of mental health drug prescriptions (those aimed at alleviating depression and anxiety) rises by about 10% when employment falls by 1% and when unemployment rises by 100 basis points, but only for patients in the Northeast region. This paper is one of the first to look at compensatory health behavior in response to the business cycle.

10.1002/hec.2983.abstractZh: 我们估算了美国心理健康药物处方与劳动力市场活动水平之间的关系。基于医师国家门诊医疗调查每月的数据，并按美国人口普查区域进行汇总，我们发现，当就业率下降1%或失业率上升100个基点时，用于缓解抑郁和焦虑的心理健康药物处方数量会增加约10%，但这一现象仅发生在东北部地区的患者中。本文是首批研究商业周期对补偿性健康行为影响的论文之一。

abstract.text: The choice of income-related health inequality measures in comparative studies is often determined by custom and analytical concerns, without much explicit consideration of the vertical equity judgements underlying alternative measures. This note employs an inequality map to illustrate how these judgements determine the ranking of populations by health inequality. In particular, it is shown that relative indices of inequality in health attainments and shortfalls embody distinct vertical equity judgments, where each may represent ethically defensible positions in specific contexts. Further research is needed to explore people's preferences over distributions of income and health.

10.1002/hec.2984.abstractZh: 在比较研究中，选择与收入相关的健康不平等指标往往取决于习惯和分析上的考虑，而较少明确考虑这些指标背后的垂直公平判断。本文利用不平等图谱来说明这些判断如何决定不同人群在健康不平等方面的排名。具体而言，文中指出，健康成就和不足的相对不平等指标体现了不同的垂直公平判断，每个指标在特定情境下可能代表具有伦理合理性的立场。需要进一步的研究来探索人们对收入和健康分配的偏好。

abstract.text: Congress passed the Emergency Medical Treatment and Active Labor Act (EMTALA) in 1986, guaranteeing a standard of medical care to anyone who entered an emergency room. This guarantee made default a more reliable substitute for medical insurance. I construct a tractable structural model of the medical insurance market and find that repealing EMTALA would increase the fraction of the population with insurance while decreasing its price.

10.1002/hec.2985.abstractZh: 美国国会于1986年通过了《紧急医疗救治和主动劳动法》（EMTALA），该法律为进入急诊室的所有人提供了标准的医疗服务。这一保障使得医疗保险成为更可靠的替代方案。我构建了一个易于分析的医疗保险市场结构模型，发现废除EMTALA会提高拥有保险的人口比例，同时降低保险价格。

abstract.text: Economic theory suggests that income growth could lead to changes in consumption quantity and quality as the spending on a commodity changes. Similarly, the volume and quality of healthcare consumption could rise with incomes because of demographic changes, usage of innovative medical technologies, and other factors. Hospital healthcare spending is the largest component of aggregate US healthcare expenditures. The novel contribution of our paper is estimating and decomposing the income elasticity of hospital care expenditures (HOCEXP) into its quantity and quality components. By using a 1999-2008 panel dataset of the 50 US states, results from the seemingly unrelated regressions model estimation reveal the income elasticity of HOCEXP to be 0.427 (std. error=0.044), with about 0.391 (calculated std. error=0.044) arising from care quality improvements and 0.035 (std. error=0.050) emanating from the rise in usage volume. Our novel research findings suggest the following: (i) the quantity part of hospital expenditure is inelastic to income change; (ii) almost the entire income-induced rise in hospital expenditure comes from care quality changes; and (iii) the 0.427 income elasticity of HOCEXP, the largest component of total US healthcare expenditure, makes hospital care a normal commodity and a much stronger technical necessity than aggregate healthcare. Policy implications are discussed.

10.1002/hec.2986.abstractZh: 经济理论表明，收入增长可能会导致消费数量和质量的改变，因为对某种商品的支出会发生变化。同样，由于人口结构变化、创新医疗技术的使用以及其他因素，医疗保健消费的数量和质量也可能随着收入的增加而上升。医院医疗支出是美国整体医疗保健支出中最大的组成部分。我们论文的新贡献在于，我们估计并分解了医院医疗支出的收入弹性，将其分为数量和质量两个组成部分。通过使用1999-2008年50个美国州的数据集，看似不相关的回归模型估计结果显示，医院医疗支出的收入弹性为0.427（标准误差为0.044），其中约0.391（计算标准误差为0.044）源于护理质量的改善，而0.035（标准误差为0.050）则源于使用量的增加。我们的新研究发现表明：(i) 医院支出的数量部分对收入变化的弹性较低；(ii) 几乎全部由收入引起的医院支出增加都来自护理质量的改变；(iii) 医院医疗支出作为美国整体医疗保健支出中最大的组成部分，其0.427的收入弹性表明医院护理是一种正常商品，并且比整体医疗保健具有更强的技术性需求。文中还讨论了相关政策意义。

abstract.text: Evidence suggests that maternal and offspring smoking behaviour is correlated. Little is known about the mechanisms through which this intergenerational transfer occurs. This paper explores the role of time preferences. Although time preference is likely to be heritable and correlated with health investments, its role in the intergenerational transmission of smoking has not been explored previously. This is the first paper to empirically test this. Data (2002, 2003, 2004, 2006 and 2008) from the Household, Income and Labour Dynamics in Australia are used. Estimates by using a pooled probit model show that there is not a direct effect of maternal time preference, measured in terms of financial planning horizon, on the likelihood that their offspring is a smoker. However, there is an indirect effect of maternal time preference. Sons of mothers that are smokers and have a shorter planning horizon are 6% more likely to smoke than if their mother had a longer planning horizon, and daughters of mothers that smoke with a shorter planning horizon are 7% more likely to smoke themselves than if their mother had a longer planning horizon.

10.1002/hec.2987.abstractZh: 有证据表明，母亲和子女的吸烟行为之间存在相关性。但关于这种代际传递的机制，目前了解甚少。本文探讨了时间偏好在其中的作用。虽然时间偏好可能是可遗传的，并且与健康投资相关，但其在吸烟的代际传递中的作用尚未得到研究。这是第一篇对此进行实证研究的论文。本文使用了澳大利亚家庭、收入和劳动动态调查在2002年、2003年、2004年、2006年和2008年的数据。通过合并概率模型进行的估计显示，母亲的时间偏好（以财务规划期限衡量）对子女成为吸烟者的可能性并没有直接影响。然而，母亲的时间偏好存在间接影响：如果母亲是吸烟者且财务规划期限较短，那么她的儿子吸烟的可能性比母亲财务规划期限较长时高出6%；而母亲是吸烟者且财务规划期限较短的情况下，她的女儿吸烟的可能性比母亲财务规划期限较长时高出7%。

abstract.text: Whereas sex ratios are likely to affect the likelihood of marriage, how sex ratios affect health and survival is underexplored. This study uses suicide as a measure of mental health and examines how suicides are affected by sex ratios. As women tend to marry men older than themselves, shrinking populations will lead to higher sex ratios (i.e., higher proportions of men) in the marriage market. Using data from Japan, I find that high sex ratios, both early-life and current, are correlated with higher male suicide rates, whereas female suicide rates are generally not affected. The results of this study have important implications for public health in countries where imbalanced sex ratios are a concern.

10.1002/hec.2988.abstractZh: 性别比例可能会影响婚姻的可能性，但性别比例如何影响健康和生存则尚未得到充分研究。本研究以自杀作为衡量心理健康的一个指标，探讨了性别比例对自杀行为的影响。由于女性往往与年龄较大的男性结婚，人口减少会导致婚姻市场上的男性比例上升。根据日本的数据，研究发现，无论是早年还是当前，较高的性别比例都与较高的男性自杀率相关，而女性自杀率则通常不受影响。这项研究的结果对于那些性别比例失衡问题较为严重的国家来说，对公共卫生具有重要意义。

abstract.text: Fires and burns are among the leading causes of unintentional death in the USA. Most of these deaths occur in residences, and cigarettes are a primary cause. In this paper, I explore the relationship between smoking, cigarette policies, and fires. As smoking rates decline, there are fewer opportunities for fires; however, the magnitude of any reduction is in question. Using a state-level panel, I find that increases in cigarette prices are associated with fewer residential fires and deaths. However, laws regulating indoor smoking are associated with more fires; in particular, restaurant and bar smoking bans are associated with an increase in fires at eating and drinking establishments. This increase is important given the growing popularity of smoking bans in the USA and around the world. As workplaces, schools, and businesses ban smoking and remove ashtrays, smokers who continue to smoke are left without safe options for disposal of cigarettes, leading to more opportunities for fires to start.

10.1002/hec.2990.abstractZh: 火灾和燃烧是美国非故意死亡的主要原因之一。这些死亡事件大多发生在住宅中，而香烟是主要诱因。本文探讨了吸烟、烟草政策与火灾之间的关系。随着吸烟率的下降，火灾发生的机会减少；然而，这种减少的幅度尚存疑问。通过州级数据面板分析发现，香烟价格上升与住宅火灾和死亡人数的减少有关。然而，针对室内吸烟的法律则可能导致火灾增加；特别是餐厅和酒吧的禁烟令与餐饮场所火灾的增加有关。鉴于美国及全球范围内禁烟令的日益普及，这种增加现象值得关注。随着工作场所、学校和企业禁止吸烟并移除烟灰缸，继续吸烟的吸烟者将失去安全的烟头处理方式，从而增加了火灾发生的机会。

abstract.text: We develop a model of alcohol consumption that incorporates the negative biological relationship between body mass and inebriation conditional on total alcohol consumption. Our model predicts that the elasticity of inebriation with respect to weight is equal to the own-price elasticity of alcohol, consistent with body mass increasing the effective price of inebriation. Given that alcohol is generally considered price inelastic, this result implies that as individuals gain weight, they consume more alcohol but become less inebriated. We test this prediction and find that driver blood alcohol content (BAC) is negatively associated with driver weight. In fatal accidents with driver BAC above 0.10, the driver was 7.8 percentage points less likely to be obese than drivers in fatal accidents that did not involve alcohol. This relationship is not explained by driver attributes (age and sex), driver behaviors (speed and seatbelt use), vehicle attributes (weight class, model year, and number of occupants), or accident context (county of accident, time of day, and day of week).

10.1002/hec.2991.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个酒精消费模型，该模型考虑了体重与醉酒程度之间的负面生物学关系，这一关系是基于总酒精摄入量而言的。我们的模型预测，醉酒程度对体重的弹性等于酒精的自身价格弹性，这与体重增加导致醉酒成本上升的观点一致。由于酒精通常被认为价格缺乏弹性，这一结果意味着随着个体体重增加，他们会消费更多的酒精，但醉酒程度会降低。我们对此进行了验证，发现驾驶员的血液酒精含量与体重之间存在负相关关系。在驾驶员血液酒精含量超过0.10的致命事故中，驾驶员肥胖的可能性比不涉及酒精的致命事故中的驾驶员低7.8个百分点。这种关系无法用驾驶员属性（年龄和性别）、驾驶行为（速度和安全带使用情况）、车辆属性（重量等级、车型年份和乘客数量）或事故背景（事故发生的县、时间和星期几）来解释。

abstract.text: Smoking rates in the country of origin were used to empirically examine whether immigrants converge toward natives' level of smoking prevalence with assimilation. Results show that assimilation is associated with a lower likelihood of ever quitting smoking for immigrants from countries with lower smoking rates relative to the USA and a higher likelihood for immigrants from countries with higher smoking rates, but for current or ever smoking, the estimated effects of assimilation are statistically insignificant. Although these findings demonstrate that health assimilation depends on the country of origin, the extent to which this pattern of assimilation is due to peer influence, differences in responsiveness to anti-smoking interventions such as taxes or smoke-free air restrictions, and/or other factors remains unclear because of the limitations of this study.

10.1002/hec.2992.abstractZh: 本研究通过原籍国的吸烟率数据，实证考察了移民在融入当地社会后，其吸烟水平是否会趋于与原住民一致。研究结果表明，对于来自吸烟率低于美国的国家的移民而言，融入当地社会会降低他们戒烟的可能性；而对于来自吸烟率较高的国家的移民来说，这种可能性则会增加。不过，对于当前或曾经吸烟的情况，融入当地社会所带来的影响在统计上并不显著。尽管这些发现表明健康融入程度取决于原籍国，但这一模式究竟是由同伴影响、对反吸烟措施（如税收或无烟区政策）的反应差异，还是其他因素所决定的，目前仍不清楚，因为本研究存在诸多局限性。

abstract.text: Between 1997 and 2007, smoking prevalence declined from 33% to 28% in Switzerland. Over the same period, funding for tobacco control activities significantly increased, resulting in the implementation of a large variety of national and regional interventions. In this paper, I exploit variation over time and across cantons of tobacco control expenditures to examine the impact of these policies on smoking decisions. I use retrospective smoking information from the Swiss Health Survey (2007) and find that tobacco control expenditures decreased the probability of smoking initiation among adolescents and young adults and increased cessation rates in the general population of smokers. I estimate that if funding had been kept at the 1997 level, there would have been 107,000 additional smokers in 2007.

10.1002/hec.2993.abstractZh: 在1997年至2007年间，瑞士的吸烟率从33%下降到了28%。同期，烟草控制活动的资金显著增加，从而实施了多种国家和区域性的干预措施。本文通过对比不同时间和各州在烟草控制方面的支出变化，来研究这些政策对吸烟决策的影响。我们利用瑞士健康调查（2007年）的回溯性吸烟数据，发现烟草控制支出的增加降低了青少年和年轻成年人的吸烟起始概率，并提高了普通吸烟人群中的戒烟率。据估计，如果资金保持在1997年的水平，2007年将有107,000名额外的吸烟者。

abstract.text: The literature on occupational health points to work pressure as a trigger of sickness absence. However, reliable, objective measures of work pressure are in short supply. This paper uses Danish day care teachers as an ideal case for analysing whether work pressure measured by the child-to-teacher ratio, that is, the number of children per teacher in an institution, affects teacher sickness absenteeism. We control for individual teacher characteristics, workplace characteristics, and family background characteristics of the children in the day care institutions. We perform estimations for two time periods, 2002-2003 and 2005-2006, by using generalized method of moments with lagged levels of the child-to-teacher ratio as instrument. Our estimation results are somewhat mixed. Generally, the results indicate that the child-to-teacher ratio is positively related to short-term sickness absence for nursery care teachers, but not for preschool teachers.

10.1002/hec.2994.abstractZh: 关于职业健康的研究指出，工作压力是导致员工缺勤的一个因素。然而，可靠、客观的工作压力衡量指标却较为匮乏。本文以丹麦日托教师作为研究对象，探讨以儿童与教师比例来衡量工作压力（即每名教师所负责的儿童数量）是否会影响教师的缺勤情况。我们控制了教师个人特征、工作场所特征以及日托机构中儿童的家庭背景特征。通过广义矩估计方法，以儿童与教师比例作为工具变量，对2002-2003年和2005-2006年两个时间段的数据进行了分析。研究结果并不一致。总体而言，结果显示儿童与教师比例与日托教师的短期缺勤呈正相关，但与幼儿园教师的缺勤情况无关。

abstract.text: Despite the goal of comparative effectiveness research (CER) to inform patient-centered care, most studies fail to account for the patient-centeredness of care that already exist in practice, which we denote as passive personalization (PP). Because CER studies describe the average effectiveness of treatments rather than heterogeneity in how individual patients respond to therapies, clinical or coverage policies that respond to CER results may undermine PP in clinical practice and generate worse outcomes. We study this phenomenon empirically in the context of use of antipsychotic drugs in Medicaid patients with schizophrenia using novel instrumental variable methods. We find strong support for PP in clinical practice and demonstrate that the average effects from a CER study cannot be replicated in practice because of the presence of PP. In contrast, providing physicians with evidence to further personalize treatment can produce significant benefits.

10.1002/hec.2996.abstractZh: 尽管比较有效性研究的目标是为以患者为中心的护理提供信息，但大多数研究未能考虑到实践中已经存在的以患者为中心的护理方式，我们将其称为被动个性化。因为比较有效性研究描述的是治疗的平均效果，而非个体患者对治疗的反应差异，所以基于比较有效性研究结果的临床或覆盖政策可能会破坏临床实践中的被动个性化，从而导致更糟糕的结果。我们在使用新型工具变量方法研究抗精神病药物在患有精神分裂症的Medicaid患者中的应用时，实证研究了这一现象。我们发现临床实践中存在强烈的被动个性化现象，并证明由于被动个性化的存在，比较有效性研究的平均效果无法在实践中得到复制。相反，为医生提供进一步个性化治疗的证据可以带来显著的好处。

abstract.text: By using a panel survey of Japanese adults, we show that smoking behavior is associated with personal time discounting and its biases, such as hyperbolic discounting and the sign effect, in the way that theory predicts: smoking depends positively on the discount rate and the degree of hyperbolic discounting and negatively on the presence of the sign effect. Positive effects of hyperbolic discounting on smoking are salient for naïve people, who are not aware of their self-control problem. By estimating smoking participation and smokers' cigarette consumption in Cragg's two-part model, we find that the two smoking decisions depend on different sets of time-discounting variables. Particularly, smoking participation is affected by being a naïve hyperbolic discounter, whereas the discount rate, the presence of the sign effect, and a hyperbolic discounting proxy constructed from procrastination behavior vis-à-vis doing homework assignments affect both types of decision making. The panel data enable us to analyze the over-time instability of elicited discount rates. The instability is shown to come from measurement errors, rather than preference shocks on time preference. Several evidences indicate that the detected associations between time preferences and smoking behavior are interpersonal one, rather than within-personal one.

10.1002/hec.2998.abstractZh: 通过一项针对日本成年人的面板调查，我们发现吸烟行为与个人的时间折扣效应及其偏差（如双曲线折扣效应和符号效应）之间存在关联，这与理论预测一致：吸烟行为对折扣率以及双曲线折扣效应的程度呈正相关，而对符号效应的存在则呈负相关。对于没有意识到自我控制问题的普通人来说，双曲线折扣效应对吸烟行为的积极影响更为显著。通过估算Cragg的双部分模型中的吸烟参与率和吸烟者的香烟消费量，我们发现这两种吸烟决策依赖于不同的时间折扣变量。具体而言，吸烟参与率受到作为双曲线折扣者的影响，而折扣率、符号效应的存在以及基于拖延行为构建的双曲线折扣代理变量则影响两种决策过程。面板数据使我们能够分析诱发折扣率随时间的稳定性变化。这种不稳定性是由测量误差引起的，而非时间偏好上的偏好冲击所致。多项证据表明，时间偏好与吸烟行为之间的关联是人际层面的，而非个人内部的。

abstract.text: The concept of 'value' typically includes a combination of cost and quality measures. Some approaches to incorporating value into payment systems treat cost and quality as separate dimensions, but policymakers have expressed interest in a single scalar index that combines cost and quality. Treating risk-adjusted cost as an input and multiple measures of quality as outputs, we examine whether data envelopment analysis input efficiency is associated with higher quality and lower cost in a sample of physician practices using 2008 US Medicare claims data from Colorado. The findings suggest that input efficiency might provide a useful scalar measure of value for a value-based payment system for physician services.

10.1002/hec.3000.abstractZh: “价值”这一概念通常包括成本和质量的组合。一些将价值纳入支付系统的做法将成本和质量视为独立的维度，但政策制定者对一种能够结合成本和质量的单一标量指标表现出兴趣。我们将风险调整后的成本作为输入，将多种质量指标作为输出，研究数据包络分析中的输入效率是否与更高的质量和更低的成本相关。本研究使用2008年美国科罗拉多州的Medicare索赔数据，对一组医生诊所进行了分析。研究结果表明，输入效率可能为基于价值的医生服务支付系统提供一种有用的价值衡量标准。

abstract.text: We used an administrative dataset covering approximately 90% of all Germans to investigate the determinants of regional differences in the utilisation of ambulatory services in the year 2008. There are great regional differences in Germany, in GP, specialist and psychotherapist consultations. By means of a regression model taking account of the spatial dependencies of the error terms, we can explain a considerable part of the variation in terms of differences in demography, health status and socio-economic features. In addition, we made use of data on pollutants, the supply of services and the number of hospital cases as explanatory variables, which all have a significant influence on utilisation but contribute considerably less to explaining the differences. Overall, we are in a position to explain 29-40% of the regional differences in ambulatory case numbers at the level of the 413 counties and 55-70% at the level of the 16 German states (Länder) by observable differences.

10.1002/hec.3001.abstractZh: 我们使用了一个涵盖约90%德国人的行政数据集，来研究2008年地区间门诊服务利用差异的决定因素。在德国，全科医生、专科医生和心理治疗师服务的利用方面存在显著的地区差异。通过采用考虑误差项空间依赖性的回归模型，我们可以解释部分因人口统计、健康状况和社会经济特征差异导致的利用差异。此外，我们还使用了污染物数据、服务供应数据以及医院病例数作为解释变量，这些变量对利用情况都有显著影响，但对解释地区差异的贡献则相对较小。总体而言，我们能够用可观测的差异来解释413个县之间门诊病例数的29-40%的差异，在16个德国州之间则能解释55-70%的差异。

abstract.text: Research assessing the relationship between government health expenditure and development assistance for health channeled to governments (DAHG) has not considered that this relationship may depend on whether DAHG is increasing or decreasing. We explore this issue using general method of moments estimation and a panel of financial flows data spanning 119 countries and 16 years. Our primary concern is how DAHG affects government health expenditure as source (GHES). We disaggregate the average effect of DAHG and separately identify the effects of increases versus decreases in DAHG. We find that a $1 year-over-year increase in DAHG leads to a $0.62 (90% confidence interval (CI): 0.15, 1.09) decrease in GHES, whereas a $1 year-over-year decrease in DAHG does not have an effect on GHES that is statistically different from zero (CI: -0.67, 1.17). Simulation shows that the displacement of GHES between 1995 and 2010 reduced total government health expenditure by $152.8 billion (CI: 46.9, 277.6). Moreover, the irregular disbursement of DAHG reduced total government expenditure by $96.9 billion (CI: 0.5, 212.4). Thus, this research shows that health aid is fungible and highlights the cost of displacement and erratic aid disbursement.

10.1002/hec.3016.abstractZh: 关于政府卫生支出与用于政府的卫生发展援助之间的关系的研究并未考虑这种关系可能取决于发展援助是增加还是减少。我们使用广义矩估计方法，并基于涵盖119个国家及16年的金融流量数据面板数据来探讨这一问题。我们的主要关注点是发展援助如何影响作为资金来源的政府卫生支出。我们分别分析了发展援助增加与减少对政府卫生支出的影响。研究发现，发展援助每年增加1美元，会导致政府卫生支出减少0.62美元（90%置信区间：0.15，1.09）；而发展援助每年减少1美元，对政府卫生支出的影响并不显著（置信区间：-0.67，1.17）。模拟结果显示，1995年至2010年间，政府卫生支出的变动减少了152.8亿美元的总支出（置信区间：46.9，277.6）。此外，发展援助的不规律分配还导致政府总支出减少了96.9亿美元（置信区间：0.5，212.4）。因此，本研究表明卫生援助是可以替代的，并强调了支出变动和不规律分配所带来的成本。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the relationship between personality traits and health behaviours in adolescence using a large and recent cohort study. In particular, we investigate the impact of locus of control, self-esteem and work ethics at ages 15-16 years on the incidence of health behaviours such as alcohol consumption, cannabis and other drug use, unprotected and early sexual activity and sports and physical activity. We use matching methods to control for a very rich set of adolescent and family characteristics, and we find that personality traits do affect health behaviours. In particular, individuals with external locus of control, low self-esteem or with low levels of work ethics seem more likely in engage in risky health behaviours.

10.1002/hec.3043.abstractZh: 本文通过一项大型且最新的队列研究，探讨了青少年时期人格特质与健康行为之间的关系。具体而言，我们研究了15-16岁个体的控制点、自尊和工作道德对饮酒、大麻及其他药物使用、无保护性行为、早期性行为以及体育和体力活动等健康行为的影响。我们采用匹配方法来控制一系列丰富的青少年和家庭特征，结果发现人格特质确实会影响健康行为。具体而言，具有外部控制点、低自尊或低工作道德水平的个体似乎更有可能从事风险较高的健康行为。

abstract.text: In difference in differences, a treatment is applied only to a qualified group at some time point. The qualification may be time-constant as in gender, or time-varying as in residential location. When the qualification is time-varying, there appear four groups: the newly qualified (in-movers), the already qualified (in-stayers), the newly disqualified (out-movers), and the already disqualified (out-stayers). A change in qualification may affect the response variable of interest even when the treatment effect is zero, which is an 'untreated moving effect'. Also, when the treatment effect is not zero, it may be different across the four groups. The conventional difference in differences fails to remove untreated moving effects and ignores the possible treatment effect heterogeneity across the groups. This paper shows how to account for untreated moving effects and proposes 'the effect on in-stayers' as the main effect of interest. Our proposal can be implemented with least squares estimator for panel models or with nonparametric methods. An empirical analysis is provided using Korean data for the effects of the basic elder pension on health-care expenditure.

10.1002/hec.3049.abstractZh: 差异中的差异是指仅对某个特定群体在某个时间点施加处理。这种资格认定可以是时间恒定的，如性别；也可以是随时间变化的，如居住地点。当资格认定随时间变化时，会出现四个群体：新获得资格者（迁移者）、已获得资格者（留居者）、新失去资格者（迁出者）以及已失去资格者（留居者）。即使处理效应为零，资格认定的变化仍可能影响感兴趣的响应变量，这被称为“未处理的迁移效应”。此外，当处理效应不为零时，这种效应在四个群体之间可能存在差异。传统的差异中的差异方法无法消除未处理的迁移效应，并且忽略了各群体之间可能存在的处理效应异质性。本文提出了如何考虑未处理的迁移效应的方法，并建议将“对留居者的影响”作为主要关注的效应。我们的建议可以通过最小二乘法估计器或非参数方法来实施。文中还使用韩国数据进行了实证分析，研究了基本养老金对医疗保健支出的影响。

abstract.text: This paper examines the existence of social interactions in malaria preventive behaviors in Sub-Saharan Africa, that is, whether an individual's social environment has an influence on the individual's preventive behaviors. We focus on the two population groups which are the most vulnerable to malaria (children under 5 years and pregnant women) and on two preventive behaviors (sleeping under a bednet and taking intermittent preventive treatment during pregnancy). We define the social environment of the individual as people living in the same region. To detect social interactions, we calculate the size of the social multiplier by comparing the effects of an exogenous variable at individual and regional levels. Our data come from 92 surveys for 29 Sub-Saharan countries between 1999 and 2012, and they cover approximately 660,000 children and 95,000 women. Our results indicate that there are social interactions in malaria preventive behaviors in the form of social multipliers effects of women's education and household wealth. The long-run effects of these characteristics on preventive behaviors at the regional level are larger than those apparent at the individual level.

10.1002/hec.3055.abstractZh: 本文探讨了撒哈拉以南非洲地区在疟疾预防行为中是否存在社会互动现象，即个体的社会环境是否对其预防行为产生影响。我们重点关注两个最易感染疟疾的人群群体——5岁以下的儿童和孕妇，以及两种预防行为：使用蚊帐睡觉和孕期间歇性预防治疗。我们将个体的社会环境定义为生活在同一地区的人群。为了检测社会互动，我们通过比较外生变量在个体和区域层面的影响，来计算社会乘数效应的大小。我们的数据来自1999年至2012年间对29个撒哈拉以南国家进行的92项调查，涉及约660,000名儿童和95,000名妇女。研究结果表明，在疟疾预防行为中存在社会互动现象，表现为女性教育和家庭财富的社会乘数效应。这些特征对区域层面预防行为的长期影响，比个体层面的影响更为显著。

abstract.text: Using discrete choice experiments (DCEs) to estimate health state utility values has become an important alternative to the conventional methods of Time Trade-Off and Standard Gamble. Studies using DCEs have typically used the conditional logit to estimate the underlying utility function. The conditional logit is known for several limitations. In this paper, we propose two types of models based on the mixed logit: one using preference space and the other using quality-adjusted life year (QALY) space, a concept adapted from the willingness-to-pay literature. These methods are applied to a dataset collected using the EQ-5D. The results showcase the advantages of using QALY space and demonstrate that the preferred QALY space model provides lower estimates of the utility values than the conditional logit, with the divergence increasing with worsening health states.

10.1002/hec.3066.abstractZh: 利用离散选择实验来估算健康状态的效用值，已成为传统的时间权衡和标准赌博方法的重要替代方案。使用离散选择实验的研究通常采用条件逻辑模型来估算基础效用函数。条件逻辑模型存在若干局限性。在本文中，我们提出了两种基于混合逻辑模型的模型：一种使用偏好空间，另一种使用质量调整生命年（QALY）空间，后者是从支付意愿文献中借鉴而来的概念。这些模型应用于基于EQ-5D收集的数据集。研究结果展示了使用QALY空间的优势，并表明相比条件逻辑模型，QALY空间模型能够提供更低的效用值估算结果，且随着健康状况的恶化，差异会进一步增大。

abstract.text: We investigate the welfare impact of parallel imports using a large panel dataset containing monthly information on sales, ex-factory prices, and further product characteristics for all 649 anti-diabetic drugs sold in Germany between 2004 and 2010. We estimate a two-stage nested logit model of demand, and on the basis of an oligopolistic model of multi-product firms, we then recover the marginal costs and markups. We finally evaluate the effect of the parallel imports' policy by calculating a counterfactual scenario without parallel trade. According to our estimates, parallel imports reduce the prices for patented drugs by 11% and do not have a significant effect on prices for generic drugs. This amounts to an increase in the demand-side surplus by €19 million per year (or €130 million in total), which is relatively small compared with the average annual market size of around €227 million based on ex-factory prices. The variable profits for the manufacturers of original drugs from the German market are reduced by €18 million (or 37%) per year when parallel trade is allowed, yet only one third of this difference is appropriated by the importers.

10.1002/hec.3068.abstractZh: 我们使用包含2004年至2010年间在德国销售的649种抗糖尿病药物的相关月度销售数据、出厂价格及其他产品特性的大型面板数据集，研究平行进口对福利的影响。我们采用两阶段嵌套逻辑回归模型来估计需求，并基于多产品企业的寡头垄断模型，进一步计算出边际成本和加价水平。最后，我们通过计算没有平行贸易情况下的反事实情景来评估平行进口政策的影响。根据我们的估计，平行进口使专利药品的价格降低了11%，而对仿制药价格的影响并不显著。这意味着每年需求侧盈余增加了1900万欧元（总计1.3亿欧元），这一数值相对于基于出厂价格计算出的平均每年2.27亿欧元的市场规模来说相对较小。当允许平行贸易时，原研药品制造商在德国市场的利润每年减少了1800万欧元（或37%），不过其中只有三分之一的利润被进口商获取。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the impact of sugar-sweetened beverages (SSB) taxes on consumption, bodyweight and tax burden for low-income, middle-income and high-income groups using an Almost Ideal Demand System and 2011 Household level scanner data. A significant contribution of our paper is that we compare two types of SSB taxes recently advocated by policy makers: A 20% flat rate sales (valoric) tax and a 20 cent/L volumetric tax. Censored demand is accounted for using a two-step procedure. We find that the volumetric tax would result in a greater per capita weight loss than the valoric tax (0.41 kg vs. 0.29 kg). The difference between the change in weight is substantial for the target group of heavy purchasers of SSBs in low-income households, with a weight reduction of up to 3.20 kg for the volumetric and 2.06 kg for the valoric tax. The average yearly per capita tax burden on low-income households is $17.87 (0.21% of income) compared with $15.17 for high-income households (0.07% of income) for the valoric tax, and $13.80 (0.15%) and $10.10 (0.04%) for the volumetric tax. Thus, the tax burden is lower, and weight reduction is higher under a volumetric tax.

10.1002/hec.3070.abstractZh: 本文研究了含糖饮料税对低收入、中等收入和高收入群体消费、体重及税收负担的影响，采用了近似理想需求系统和2011年家庭层面的调查数据。我们的研究的一个重要贡献是，我们比较了政策制定者最近提出的两种含糖饮料税：20%的定额销售税和每升20美分的体积税。通过两步程序考虑了被忽略的需求情况。研究发现，体积税导致的平均人均体重减轻幅度大于定额税（0.41公斤对比0.29公斤）。对于低收入家庭中大量购买含糖饮料的人群来说，体重变化的差异尤为显著，体积税导致的体重减轻可达3.20公斤，而定额税则为2.06公斤。对于低收入家庭而言，平均每年的人均税收负担为17.87美元（占收入的0.21%），而高收入家庭为15.17美元（占收入的0.07%）。体积税的平均税收负担为13.80美元（占收入的0.15%），低收入家庭为10.10美元（占收入的0.04%）。因此，在体积税下，税收负担较低，而体重减轻幅度则更高。

abstract.text: We examine patient socioeconomic status, the strength of the patient-doctor relationship and local area competition as determinants of the quality and price of GP services. We exploit a large-sample patient data set in Australia and its linkage to administrative databases. The sample contains over 260,000 patients and over 12,600 GPs, observed between 2005 and 2010. Controlling for GP fixed effects and patient health, we find no strong evidence that quality differs by patient age, gender, country of origin, health concession card status and income, but quality is increased by stronger patient-doctor relationship. Using a competition measure that is defined at the individual GP level and not restricted to a local market, we find that competition lowers quality. Price is increasing in patient income, whereas competition has a small impact on price.

10.1002/hec.3071.abstractZh: 我们研究了患者的社会经济状况、患者与医生关系的紧密程度以及当地市场的竞争情况，这些因素被认为是影响全科医生服务质量和价格的重要因素。我们利用了澳大利亚的一个大型患者数据集，并将其与行政数据库进行了关联分析。样本中包含超过260,000名患者和12,600名全科医生，数据观测时间跨度为2005年至2010年。在控制全科医生固定效应和患者健康状况后，我们发现患者的年龄、性别、原籍国、健康优惠卡状态以及收入等因素并不会显著影响服务质量。然而，较强的患者与医生关系确实提升了服务质量。此外，我们采用了一个在个体全科医生层面定义的竞争指标，发现市场竞争会降低服务质量。患者收入越高，价格也越高，而市场竞争对价格的影响则较小。

abstract.text: Research has shown that birth weight has a lasting impact on later-life outcomes such as educational attainment and earnings. This paper examines the role of health at birth in determining academic achievement in childhood, which may provide the link between birth weight and adult outcomes. Using three waves of the Child Development Supplement of the Panel Study of Income Dynamics data over 1997-2007, we build on the literature by employing the fetal growth rate as a proxy for net nutritional intake in utero and propose a nested error-component two-stage least squares estimator that draws on internal instruments from alternative dimensions of the multilevel panel data set. In particular, this alternative estimator allows us to exploit the information on children with no siblings in the sample, which comprise over 40% of the observations in our sample, as well as to obtain coefficient estimates for the time-invariant variables such as race and maternal education. This would not be feasible with the usual mother fixed effects estimation. We obtain modest but significant effects of both birth weight and the fetal growth rate on math and reading scores, with the effects concentrated in the low birth weight range. Infant health measures appear to explain little of the well-documented racial disparity in test scores.

10.1002/hec.3074.abstractZh: 研究表明，出生体重对后期的生活结果，如教育成就和收入有持久的影响。本文探讨了出生时健康状况在决定儿童学业成就中的作用，这可能为出生体重与成人结果之间的联系提供线索。利用1997-2007年间“收入动态面板研究”数据中的儿童发展补充数据，我们基于现有文献，将胎儿生长率作为子宫内营养摄入的代理变量，并提出了一种嵌套误差分量两阶段最小二乘估计方法。该方法利用了多层面板数据中的其他维度内部工具变量。特别是，这种替代估计方法允许我们利用样本中无兄弟姐妹的儿童的信息，这些儿童占样本观测值的40%以上，同时还能获得种族和母亲教育等时间不变变量的系数估计值。使用常规的母亲固定效应估计方法则无法实现这一点。我们发现，出生体重和胎儿生长率对数学和阅读成绩都有一定的影响，且这些影响主要集中在低出生体重范围内。婴儿健康指标似乎无法解释众所周知的种族间测试成绩差异。

abstract.text: This paper examines misclassification error in survey estimates of disability. The results suggest that a significant number of those with a disability fail to be recorded as such in the British Household Panel Survey. In addition, the probability of a false positive is estimated as being very close to zero in all socio-demographic groups. There is a strong bias in estimates of differences in rates of disability across groups but only a small effect on estimates of the difference in employment rates by disability status.

10.1002/hec.3080.abstractZh: 本文探讨了残疾状况调查估计中的错误分类问题。研究结果表明，在英国家庭面板调查中，有相当数量的残疾人士未被正确记录为残疾人士。此外，所有社会人口统计群体的假阳性概率均接近于零。在群体间残疾率差异的估计中存在显著偏差，但这一偏差对按残疾状况划分的就业率差异的估计影响较小。

abstract.text: To what extent does poor mental health affect employment outcomes? Answering this question involves multiple technical difficulties: two-way causality between health and work, unobservable confounding factors and measurement error in survey measures of mental health. We attempt to overcome these difficulties by combining 10 waves of high-quality panel data with an instrumental variable model that allows for individual-level fixed effects. We focus on the extensive margin of employment, and we find evidence that a one-standard-deviation decline in mental health reduces employment by 30 percentage points. Further investigations suggest that this effect is predominantly a supply rather than a demand-side response and is larger for older than young workers.

10.1002/hec.3083.abstractZh: 心理健康状况在多大程度上影响就业结果？回答这个问题涉及多个技术难题：健康与工作之间的双向因果关系、不可观测的混杂因素以及心理健康调查指标的测量误差。我们试图通过结合10波高质量面板数据和一个允许个体层面固定效应的工具变量模型来克服这些困难。我们重点关注就业的广泛边际效应，发现心理健康状况下降一个标准差会导致就业率下降30个百分点。进一步的研究表明，这种效应主要是供给方面的反应，而非需求方面的反应，并且这种效应在年龄较大的工人中更为明显。

abstract.text: This paper considers the relationship between social capital and health in the years before, at and after retirement. This adds to the current literature that only investigates this relationship in either the population as a whole or two subpopulations, pre-retirement and post-retirement. We now investigate if there are further additional subpopulations in the years to and from retirement. We take an information criteria approach to select the optimal model of subpopulations from a full range of potential models. This approach is similar to that proposed for linear models. Our contribution is to show how this may also be applied to nonlinear models and without the need for estimating subsequent subpopulations conditional on previous fixed subpopulations. Our main finding is that the association of social capital with health diminishes at retirement, and this decreases further 10 years after retirement. We find a strong positive significant association of social capital with health, although this turns negative after 20 years, indicating potential unobserved heterogeneity. The types of social capital may differ in later years (e.g., less volunteering) and hence overall social capital may have less of an influence on health in later years.

10.1002/hec.3088.abstractZh: 本文探讨了退休前、退休期间及退休后的几年内，社会资本与健康之间的关系。目前的相关研究通常只关注整个群体或退休前、退休后两个子群体之间的这种关系。我们进一步研究了退休前后几年内是否存在其他子群体。我们采用信息准则方法，从一系列潜在模型中筛选出最优的子群体模型。这种方法与线性模型的研究方法类似。我们的贡献在于展示了如何将这种方法应用于非线性模型，并且无需在已知固定子群体条件下估计后续子群体。我们的主要发现是，社会资本与健康之间的关联在退休时开始减弱，并在退休后10年内进一步减弱。我们发现社会资本与健康之间存在强烈的正相关关系，尽管在20年后这种关系变为负相关，这表明可能存在未观察到的异质性。不同年份的社会资本类型可能有所不同（例如，自愿服务的程度降低），因此总体社会资本对健康的影響在后期可能较小。

abstract.text: There are many technology platforms that bring benefits only when users share data. In healthcare, this is a key policy issue, because of the potential cost savings and quality improvements from 'big data' in the form of sharing electronic patient data across medical providers. Indeed, one criterion used for federal subsidies for healthcare information technology is whether the software has the capability to share data. We find empirically that larger hospital systems are more likely to exchange electronic patient information internally, but are less likely to exchange patient information externally with other hospitals. This pattern is driven by instances where there may be a commercial cost to sharing data with other hospitals. Our results suggest that the common strategy of using 'marquee' large users to kick-start a platform technology has an important drawback of potentially creating information silos. This suggests that federal subsidies for health data technologies based on 'meaningful use' criteria, that are based simply on the capability to share data rather than actual sharing of data, may be misplaced.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.10.004.abstractZh: 许多技术平台只有在用户共享数据的情况下才能带来收益。在医疗保健领域，这是一个重要的政策问题，因为通过跨医疗机构共享电子患者数据，可以节省成本并提高医疗质量。事实上，联邦政府对医疗信息技术项目的补贴标准之一就是该软件是否具有共享数据的能力。我们的实证研究发现，大型医院系统更有可能内部交换电子患者信息，但与其他医院外部交换患者信息的可能性较小。这种现象是由于与其他医院共享数据可能存在商业成本所驱动的。我们的结果表明，利用大型用户来推动平台技术发展的常见策略存在一个重要缺陷，即可能会形成信息孤岛。因此，基于“有意义使用”标准的联邦政府对健康数据技术的补贴，如果仅仅基于共享数据的能力而非实际的数据共享，可能是不恰当的。

abstract.text: Many U.S. states have passed legislation providing leave to organ and bone marrow donors and/or tax benefits for live and deceased organ and bone marrow donations and to employers of donors. We exploit cross-state variation in the timing of such legislation to analyze its impact on organ donations by living and deceased persons, on measures of the quality of the transplants, and on the number of bone marrow donations. We find that these provisions do not have a significant impact on the quantity of organs donated. The leave laws, however, do have a positive impact on bone marrow donations, and the effect increases with the size of the population of beneficiaries and with the generosity of the legislative provisions. Our results suggest that this legislation works for moderately invasive procedures such as bone marrow donation, but these incentives may be too low for organ donation, which is riskier and more burdensome.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.10.006.abstractZh: 许多美国州已经通过立法，为器官和骨髓捐赠者提供休假待遇，并为活体和已故器官及骨髓捐赠者提供税收优惠，同时也为捐赠者的雇主提供相关福利。我们利用各州在立法时机上的差异，来分析这些立法对活体和已故人士进行器官捐赠的影响，以及对移植质量的影响，以及骨髓捐赠数量的变化。我们发现，这些规定对器官捐赠数量并没有显著影响。不过，休假法律确实对骨髓捐赠产生了积极影响，且这种影响随着受益人群体的规模以及立法规定的慷慨程度而增强。我们的研究结果表明，这些立法对于像骨髓捐赠这样相对较为常规的手术是有效的，但对于风险更高、负担更重的器官捐赠来说，这些激励措施可能还不够有效。

abstract.text: This paper proposes a theory for the social evolution of obesity. It considers a society in which individuals experience utility from consumption of food and non-food, the state of their health, and the evaluation of their appearance by others. The theory explains under which conditions poor persons are more prone to be overweight although eating is expensive and it shows how obesity occurs as a social phenomenon such that body mass continues to rise long after the initial cause (e.g. a lower price of food) is gone. The paper investigates the determinants of a steady state at which the median person is overweight and how an originally lean society arrives at such a steady state. Extensions of the theory towards dietary choice and the possibility to exercise in order to lose weight demonstrate robustness of the basic mechanism and provide further interesting results.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.10.007.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种关于肥胖社会进化的理论。该理论假设一个社会环境中，个体从食物消费中获得效用，同时关注自身的健康状况以及他人对其外貌的评价。理论解释了在何种条件下，贫困人群更容易出现超重现象，即使食物消费的成本较高。同时，理论还揭示了肥胖作为一种社会现象是如何形成的——即使最初导致肥胖的原因（如食物价格下降）已经消失，体重仍会持续上升。文章进一步探讨了导致中等水平人群出现超重状态的稳定状态的因素，以及原本瘦削的社会如何达到这种稳定状态。该理论的扩展研究还涉及饮食选择以及通过运动来减肥的可能性，这些研究进一步证明了基本机制的稳健性，并提供了更多有趣的结果。

abstract.text: Greater patient cost-sharing could help reduce the fiscal pressures associated with insurance expansion by reducing the scope for moral hazard. But it is possible that low-income recipients are unable to cut back on utilization wisely and that, as a result, higher cost-sharing will lead to worse health and higher downstream costs through increased use of inpatient and outpatient care. We use exogenous variation in the copayments faced by low-income enrollees in the Massachusetts Commonwealth Care program to study these effects. We estimate separate price elasticities of demand by type of service. Overall, we find price elasticities of about -0.16 for this low-income population - similar to elasticities calculated for higher-income populations in other settings. These elasticities are somewhat smaller for the chronically sick, especially for those with asthma, diabetes, and high cholesterol. These lower elasticities are attributable to lower responsiveness to prices across all categories of service, and to some statistically insignificant increases in inpatient care.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.10.008.abstractZh: 更高的患者费用分担可以帮助减少与保险扩展相关的财政压力，因为这样可以减少道德风险的发生。但是，低收入参保者可能无法明智地减少医疗使用，因此，更高的费用分担可能会导致健康状况恶化，并通过增加住院和门诊护理的使用而引发更高的下游成本。我们利用马萨诸塞州 Commonwealth Care 计划中低收入参保者面临的自付费用变化来研究这些效应。我们分别估算了不同类型服务的需求价格弹性。总体而言，我们发现这一低收入群体的需求价格弹性约为 -0.16，与其他情况下高收入群体的弹性相似。对于长期病患者，尤其是哮喘、糖尿病和高胆固醇患者，这些弹性略低。这些较低的弹性可能是由于所有服务类别对价格的反应较低，以及住院护理的使用有所增加，但这种增加在统计上并不显著。

abstract.text: Nurse practitioners (NPs) and physician assistants (PAs) now outnumber family practice doctors in the United States and are the principal providers of primary care to many communities. Recent growth of these professions has occurred amidst considerable cross-state variation in their regulation, with some states permitting autonomous practice and others mandating extensive physician oversight. I find that expanded NP and PA supply has had minimal impact on the office-based healthcare market overall, but utilization has been modestly more responsive to supply increases in states permitting greater autonomy. Results suggest the importance of laws impacting the division of labor, not just its quantity.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.10.009.abstractZh: 在美国，执业护士和医师助理的数量已经超过了家庭医学医生，他们成为许多社区初级医疗服务的主要提供者。这些职业的快速发展伴随着各州在监管方面的显著差异，有些州允许自主执业，而另一些州则要求有严格的医师监督。我发现，执业护士和医师助理数量的增加对以诊所为基础的医疗保健市场整体影响甚微，但在那些允许更大自主权的州，患者的需求对供应增加的反应较为积极。结果表明，影响劳动分工的法律不仅体现在数量上，还体现在其重要性上。

abstract.text: Estimates of the value of a statistical life (VSL) establish the price government agencies use to value fatality risks. Transferring these valuations to other populations often utilizes the income elasticity of the VSL, which typically draw on estimates from meta-analyses. Using a data set consisting of 101 estimates of the income elasticity of VSL from 14 previously reported meta-analyses, we find that after accounting for potential publication bias the income elasticity of value of a statistical life is clearly and robustly inelastic, with a value of approximately 0.25-0.63. There is also clear evidence of the importance of controlling for levels of risk, differential publication selection bias, and the greater income sensitivity of VSL from stated preference surveys.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.10.010.abstractZh: 对统计生命价值（VSL）的估算用于确定政府机构评估死亡风险时所使用的价格。将这些估值应用于其他人群时，通常会利用VSL的收入弹性系数，而这一系数的估算通常基于元分析的结果。通过利用来自14项先前报告的元分析的101个VSL收入弹性估算数据，我们发现，在考虑潜在的发表偏倚后，统计生命价值的收入弹性系数明显且稳定地呈现非弹性特征，其数值大约在0.25到0.63之间。此外，还有明确的证据表明，控制风险水平、差异化的发表选择偏倚以及从陈述偏好调查中获得的VSL对收入的更大敏感性等因素的重要性。

abstract.text: We estimate a multi-sector model of nursing qualification holders' labour supply in different occupations. A structural approach allows us to model the labour force participation decision, the occupational and shift-type choice, and the decision about hours worked as a joint outcome following from maximising a utility function. Disutility from work is allowed to vary by occupation and also by shift type in the utility function. Our results suggest that average wage elasticities might be higher than previous research has found. This is mainly due to the effect of wages on the decision to enter or exit the profession, which was not included in the previous literature, rather than from its effect on increased working hours for those who already work in the profession.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.11.001.abstractZh: 我们建立了一个多部门模型，用于分析不同职业中持有护理资格的人员劳动力供给情况。通过结构模型，我们可以模拟劳动力参与决策、职业选择与班次类型选择，以及关于工作时间的决策，这些决策都是基于效用函数的最大化而得出的共同结果。模型中允许工作带来的效用因职业和班次类型而异。我们的研究结果表明，平均工资弹性可能高于以往的研究发现。这主要是由于工资对进入或退出该职业的决策产生了影响，而这一点在以往的研究中并未被考虑；而不是因为工资增加了已经在该职业中工作的人员的工作时间。

abstract.text: Prenatal exposure to the disruptions caused by the Korean War (1950-1953) negatively affected the individual socioeconomic and health outcomes at older ages. The educational attainment, labor market performance, and other socioeconomic outcomes of the subjects of the 1951 birth cohort, who were in utero during the worst time of the war, were significantly lower in 1990 and in 2000. The results of difference-in-difference estimations suggest that the magnitude of the negative cohort effect is significantly larger for individuals who were more seriously traumatized by the war. Whereas the 1950 male birth cohort exhibited significantly higher disability and mortality rates at older age, the health outcomes of females are unaffected by the war. Different aspects of human capital (e.g., health and cognitive skills) were impaired by in utero exposure to the war, depending on the stage of pregnancy when the negative shocks were experienced.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.11.002.abstractZh: 朝鲜战争（1950-1953年）期间，个体在孕期的遭遇对其晚年社会经济状况和健康水平产生了负面影响。1951年出生的队列中，那些在战争最严重时期处于孕期的个体，在1990年和2000年的教育水平、劳动力市场表现以及其他社会经济指标均明显低于其他群体。差异估计的结果表明，那些在战争中遭受更严重创伤的个体，其负面队列效应的影响更为显著。虽然1950年出生的男性队列在老年时的残疾率和死亡率明显较高，但女性的健康状况并未受到战争的影响。人类资本的各个方面（如健康与认知技能）在孕期遭受战争冲击时都会受到影响，具体程度取决于战争冲击发生时的妊娠阶段。

abstract.text: Scheduling births for non-medical reasons has become an increasingly common practice in the United States and around the world. We exploit a natural experiment created by child tax benefits, which rewards births that occur just before the new year, to better understand the full costs of elective c-sections and inductions. Using data on all births in the U.S. from 1990 to 2000, we first confirm that expectant parents respond to the financial incentives by electing to give birth in December rather than January. We find that most of the manipulation comes from changes in the timing of c-sections. Small birth timing changes, even at full-term, lead to lower birthweight, a lower Apgar score, and an increase in the likelihood of being low birthweight.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.11.003.abstractZh: 出于非医疗原因安排分娩在美国及世界各地已成为一种越来越常见的做法。我们利用儿童税收抵免政策所创造的自然实验，该政策对新年前后出生的婴儿给予奖励，以更好地了解选择性剖宫产和分娩诱导的全部成本。通过使用1990年至2000年美国所有分娩的数据，我们首先确认了准父母们会因经济激励而选择在12月而非1月分娩。我们发现，大部分影响主要来自剖宫产时间的变化。即使是微小的分娩时间变化，即使是在足月时，也会导致较低的出生体重、较低的Apgar评分，以及低出生体重的可能性增加。

abstract.text: Medicare continues to implement payment reforms that shift reimbursement from fee-for-service toward episode-based payment, affecting average and marginal payment. We contrast the effects of two reforms for home health agencies. The home health interim payment system in 1997 lowered both types of payment; our conceptual model predicts a decline in the likelihood of use and costs, both of which we find. The home health prospective payment system in 2000 raised average but lowered marginal payment with theoretically ambiguous effects; we find a modest increase in use and costs. We find little substantive effect of either policy on readmissions or mortality.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.11.005.abstractZh: Medicare持续实施支付改革，将报销方式从按服务收费转变为按病例支付，这影响了平均支付和边际支付。我们对比了两项改革对家庭健康服务机构的影响。1997年的家庭健康临时支付系统降低了两种类型的支付；我们的概念模型预测了使用率和成本的下降，而实际上我们也观察到了这种情况。2000年的家庭健康预期支付系统提高了平均支付，但降低了边际支付，其效果理论上存在不确定性；我们发现使用率和成本略有增加。我们发现这两种政策对再入院率和死亡率几乎没有实质性影响。

abstract.text: Social scientists continue to devote considerable attention to spillover effects for risky behaviors because of the important policy implications and the persistent challenges in identifying unbiased causal effects. We use the natural experiment of assigned college roommates to estimate peer effects for several measures of health risks: binge drinking, smoking, illicit drug use, gambling, having multiple sex partners, suicidal ideation, and non-suicidal self-injury. We find significant peer effects for binge drinking but little evidence of effects for other outcomes, although there is tentative evidence that peer effects for smoking may be positive among men and negative among women. In contrast to prior research, the peer effects for binge drinking are significant for all subgroups defined by sex and prior drinking status. We also find that pre-existing risky behaviors predict the closeness of friendships, which underscores the significance of addressing selection biases in studies of peer effects.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.11.006.abstractZh: 社会科学家继续关注风险行为的溢出效应，因为这些效应具有重要的政策意义，同时识别无偏见的因果效应也面临持续的挑战。我们通过分配大学室友的自然实验来估计几种健康风险指标的同伴效应：酗酒、吸烟、非法药物使用、赌博、有多个性伴侣、自杀念头以及非自杀性自伤行为。我们发现酗酒存在显著的同伴效应，而其他指标则几乎没有同伴效应的证据，不过有初步证据表明，吸烟的同伴效应在男性中可能是积极的，在女性中则可能是消极的。与先前的研究不同，酗酒的同伴效应在由性别和饮酒历史定义的各个子群体中都是显著的。我们还发现，已有的风险行为可以预测友谊的亲密程度，这强调了在研究同伴效应时解决选择偏差的重要性。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the effects of reducing subsidies for private health insurance on public sector expenditure for hospital care. An econometric framework using simultaneous equation models is developed to analyse the interrelated decisions on the intensity and type of health care use and private insurance. The framework is applied to the context of the mixed public-private system in Australia. The simulation projections show that reducing premium subsidies is expected to generate net cost savings. This arises because the cost savings achieved from reducing subsidies are larger than the potential increase in public expenditure on hospital care.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.11.007.abstractZh: 本文研究了减少私人健康保险补贴对公共部门医院护理支出的影响。本文采用联立方程模型的经济计量框架来分析关于医疗保健使用强度和类型以及私人保险之间的相互决策。该框架适用于澳大利亚混合公共-私人体系的背景。模拟预测表明，减少保费补贴预计会带来净成本节约。这是因为通过减少补贴所实现的成本节约大于公共部门医院护理支出的潜在增加。

abstract.text: While many of the measurement approaches in health inequality measurement assume the existence of a ratio-scale variable, most of the health information available in population surveys is given in the form of categorical variables. Therefore, the well-known inequality indices may not always be readily applicable to measure health inequality as it may result in the arbitrariness of the health concentration index's value. In this paper, we address this problem by changing the dimension in which the categorical information is used. We therefore exploit the multi-dimensionality of this information, define a new ratio-scale health status variable and develop positional stochastic dominance conditions that can be implemented in a context of categorical variables. We also propose a parametric class of population health and socioeconomic health inequality indices. Finally we provide a twofold empirical illustration using the Joint Canada/United States Surveys of Health 2004 and the National Health Interview Survey 2010.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.11.008.abstractZh: 在健康不平等测量中，许多方法都假设存在比率尺度变量，而大多数人口调查中提供的健康信息都是以分类变量的形式呈现的。因此，那些众所周知的不平等指数可能无法直接用于衡量健康不平等，因为这可能会导致健康集中度指数的数值出现任意性。在本文中，我们通过改变分类信息使用的维度来解决这个问题。我们利用了这种信息的多维度特性，定义了一个新的比率尺度健康状态变量，并提出了可以在分类变量背景下实施的位置随机优势条件。我们还提出了一类参数化的群体健康和社会经济健康不平等指数。最后，我们通过2004年加拿大/美国健康调查以及2010年全国健康访谈调查的数据，提供了双重实证验证。

abstract.text: Precise estimates of price elasticities are important for alcohol tax policy. Using meta-analysis, this paper corrects average beer elasticities for heterogeneity, dependence, and publication selection bias. A sample of 191 estimates is obtained from 114 primary studies. Simple and weighted means are reported. Dependence is addressed by restricting number of estimates per study, author-restricted samples, and author-specific variables. Publication bias is addressed using funnel graph, trim-and-fill, and Egger's intercept model. Heterogeneity and selection bias are examined jointly in meta-regressions containing moderator variables for econometric methodology, primary data, and precision of estimates. Results for fixed- and random-effects regressions are reported. Country-specific effects and sample time periods are unimportant, but several methodology variables help explain the dispersion of estimates. In models that correct for selection bias and heterogeneity, the average beer price elasticity is about -0.20, which is less elastic by 50% compared to values commonly used in alcohol tax policy simulations.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.11.009.abstractZh: 对价格弹性的精确估计对于酒精税收政策至关重要。本文通过元分析，纠正了平均啤酒价格弹性的异质性、依赖性以及发表选择偏差问题。从114项主要研究中获得了191个估计值。报告了简单均值和加权均值。通过限制每项研究的估计数量、作者限制样本以及使用作者特定变量来处理依赖性问题。使用漏斗图、修剪填充法和Egger截距模型来处理发表偏差问题。在包含计量经济学方法、主要数据以及估计精度调节变量的元回归中，同时考察了异质性和选择偏差问题。报告了固定效应和随机效应回归的结果。特定国家的影响和样本时间周期并不重要，但几个方法论变量有助于解释估计值的分散性。在纠正了选择偏差和异质性后的模型中，平均啤酒价格弹性约为-0.20，比酒精税收政策模拟中常用的数值低了50%。

abstract.text: This study assesses the impact of competition on quality and price in the English care/nursing homes market. Considering the key institutional features, we use a theoretical model to assess the conditions under which further competition could increase or reduce quality. A dataset comprising the population of 10,000 care homes was used. We constructed distance/travel-time weighted competition measures. Instrumental variable estimations, used to account for the endogeneity of competition, showed quality and price were reduced by greater competition. Further analyses suggested that the negative quality effect worked through the effect on price - higher competition reduces revenue which pushes down quality.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.11.010.abstractZh: 本研究评估了竞争对英国护理/养老院市场质量和价格的影响。考虑到关键的制度特征，我们使用理论模型来评估进一步竞争可能提高或降低质量的条件。研究使用了包含10,000家护理院的数据集。我们构建了基于距离/旅行时间加权的竞争指标。用于解释竞争内生性的工具变量估计显示，竞争加剧会导致质量和价格下降。进一步的分析表明，质量的负面影响是通过对价格的影响来体现的——更高的竞争会降低收入，从而导致质量下降。

abstract.text: In the United States, occupational regulations influence the work tasks that may legally be performed by dentists and dental hygienists. Only a dentist may legally perform most dental procedures; however, a smaller list of basic procedures may be provided by either a dentist or a dental hygienist. Since dentists and hygienists possess different levels of training and skill and receive very different wages, it is plausible that these regulations could distort the optimal allocation of skills to work tasks. We present simple theoretical framework that shows different ways that such regulations might affect the way that dentists and dental hygienists are used in the production of dental services. We then use a large database of dental insurance claims to study the effects of the regulations on the prevailing prices of a set of basic dental services. Our empirical analysis exploits variation across states and over time in the list of services that may be provided by either type of worker. Our main results suggest that the task-specific occupational regulations increase prices by about 12%. We also examine the effects of related occupational regulations on the utilization of basic dental services. We find that allowing insurers to directly reimburse hygienists for their work increases one year utilization rates by 3-4 percentage points.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.12.001.abstractZh: 在美国，职业规范影响着牙医和牙科保健员可以合法执行的工作任务。通常情况下，只有牙医可以合法执行大多数牙科手术；不过，一些基本手术可以由牙医或牙科保健员共同完成。由于牙医和牙科保健员在培训水平和技能上存在差异，他们的工资也各不相同，因此这些规范可能会扭曲技能在任务中的最优分配。我们提出了一个简单的理论框架，用以说明这些规范可能以不同方式影响牙医和牙科保健员在牙科服务生产中的使用方式。随后，我们利用一个大型的牙科保险索赔数据库，研究这些规范对一系列基本牙科服务价格的影响。我们的实证分析发现，各州以及随时间推移，可供某类工人提供的服务种类存在差异。我们的主要结果表明，针对特定任务的职业规范会使服务价格上涨约12%。我们还研究了相关职业规范对基本牙科服务使用率的影响。研究发现，允许保险公司直接报销牙科保健员的工作费用，可使一年的使用率提高3-4个百分点。

abstract.text: This paper analyses if privatisation of vocational rehabilitation can improve labour market opportunities for individuals on long-term sickness absence. We use a field experiment performed by the Public Employment Service and the Social Insurance Agency in Sweden during 2008-2010, in which over 4000 participants were randomly offered private and public rehabilitation. We find no differences in employment rates following rehabilitation between individuals who received rehabilitation by private and public providers. Also the average cost of rehabilitation was essentially equal for the two types of providers. This suggests that there are no large efficiency gains from privatising vocational rehabilitation.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.12.002.abstractZh: 本文分析了职业康复的私有化是否能改善长期病假人员的工作市场机会。我们采用了瑞典公共就业服务局和社会保险局在2008-2010年间进行的一项实地实验，该实验中超过4000名参与者被随机分配接受私营和公共机构的康复服务。研究发现，接受私营和公共机构康复服务的个体在就业率方面没有显著差异。此外，两种提供方式的康复平均成本基本相当。这表明，职业康复的私有化并不会带来显著的效率提升。

abstract.text: There is a prospect in the medium to long term future of substantial advancements in the understanding of the relationship between disease and genetics. We consider the implications of increased information from genetic tests about predisposition to diseases from the perspective of managing health care provision under a public health insurance scheme. In particular, we consider how such information may potentially improve the targeting of medical surveillance (or prevention) activities to improve the chances of early detection of disease onset. We show that the moral hazard implications inherent in surveillance and prevention decisions that are chosen to be privately rather than socially optimal may be exacerbated by increased information about person-specific predisposition to disease.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.12.003.abstractZh: 在中期到长期内，对疾病与遗传关系理解方面存在显著进展的潜力。我们从公共健康保险计划下管理医疗保健供应的角度出发，探讨了遗传测试所提供关于疾病易感性的更多信息所带来的影响。具体而言，我们探讨了这些信息如何可能改善医学监测（或预防）活动的针对性，从而提高疾病早期发现的几率。研究表明，由于监测和预防决策通常是私人最优而非社会最优的，而关于个人疾病易感性的信息增加可能会加剧这种道德风险。

abstract.text: Information on the quality of healthcare gives providers an incentive to improve care, and this incentive should be stronger in more competitive markets. We examine this hypothesis by studying Pennsylvanian hospitals during the years 1995-2004 to see whether those hospitals located in more competitive markets increased the quality of the care provided to Medicare patients after report cards rating the quality of their Coronary Artery Bypass Graft programs went online in 1998. We find that after the report cards went online, hospitals in more competitive markets used more resources per patient, and achieved lower mortality among more severely ill patients.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.12.004.abstractZh: 关于医疗保健质量的信息能够激励医疗服务提供者改进护理水平，而在竞争更为激烈的市场中，这种激励应该更为明显。我们通过研究1995年至2004年间宾夕法尼亚州的医院，来检验这一假设。这些医院位于竞争更为激烈的地区，在1998年报告卡开始记录冠状动脉旁路移植手术质量后，是否确实提高了为Medicare患者提供的护理质量。研究发现，报告卡上线后，位于竞争更为激烈地区的医院每名患者的资源投入更多，并且重症患者的死亡率也更低。

abstract.text: Information technology has been linked to productivity growth in a wide variety of sectors, and health information technology (HIT) is a leading example of an innovation with the potential to transform industry-wide productivity. This paper analyzes the impact of health information technology (HIT) on the quality and intensity of medical care. Using Medicare claims data from 1998 to 2005, I estimate the effects of early investment in HIT by exploiting variation in hospitals' adoption statuses over time, analyzing 2.5 million inpatient admissions across 3900 hospitals. HIT is associated with a 1.3% increase in billed charges (p-value: 5.6%), and there is no evidence of cost savings even five years after adoption. Additionally, HIT adoption appears to have little impact on the quality of care, measured by patient mortality, adverse drug events, and readmission rates.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.12.005.abstractZh: 信息技术已在多个领域与生产力增长相关联，而健康信息技术则是具有潜力改变整个行业生产力的创新领域的典型例子。本文分析了健康信息技术对医疗护理质量和强度的影响。利用1998至2005年的医疗保险索赔数据，通过分析3900家医院在一段时间内的采用情况，我估计了早期投资健康信息技术的效果。研究发现，健康信息技术的采用与账单费用增加1.3%有关（p值：5.6%），并且在采用后五年内并未显示出成本节约的效果。此外，健康信息技术的采用对护理质量的影响似乎很小，主要体现在患者死亡率、不良药物事件以及再入院率上。

abstract.text: The estimation of price elasticities of alcohol demand is valuable for the appraisal of price-based policy interventions such as minimum unit pricing and taxation. This study applies a pseudo-panel approach to the cross-sectional Living Cost and Food Survey 2001/2-2009 to estimate the own- and cross-price elasticities of off- and on-trade beer, cider, wine, spirits and ready-to-drinks in the UK. A pseudo-panel with 72 subgroups defined by birth year, gender and socioeconomic status is constructed. Estimated own-price elasticities from the base case fixed effect models are all negative and mostly statically significant (p<0.05). Off-trade cider and beer are most elastic (-1.27 and -0.98) and off-trade spirits and on-trade ready-to-drinks are least elastic (-0.08 and -0.19). Estimated cross-price elasticities are smaller in magnitude with a mix of positive and negative signs. The results appear plausible and robust and could be used for appraising the estimated impact of price-based interventions in the UK.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.12.006.abstractZh: 对酒精需求的价格弹性进行估算，对于评估基于价格的政策干预措施（如最低单位定价和税收政策）具有重要意义。本研究采用伪面板方法，基于2001/2-2009年的生活成本和食品调查数据，估算了英国非贸易渠道和贸易渠道的啤酒、苹果酒、葡萄酒、烈酒及即饮品的自身价格弹性及交叉价格弹性。通过构建由出生年份、性别和社会经济地位定义的72个子组组成的伪面板，从基础固定效应模型得出的估计结果均呈负值，且大多数具有统计学意义（p<0.05）。非贸易渠道的苹果酒和啤酒弹性最大，分别为-1.27和-0.98；而非贸易渠道的烈酒和贸易渠道的即饮品弹性最小，分别为-0.08和-0.19。估计的交叉价格弹性幅度较小，既有正值也有负值。这些结果具有合理性且稳健，可用于评估英国基于价格的政策干预措施的影响。

abstract.text: We analyze the effect of an individual insurance mandate (Medicare Levy Surcharge) on the demand for private health insurance (PHI) in Australia. With administrative income tax return data, we show that the mandate has several distinct effects on taxpayers' behavior. First, despite the large tax penalty for not having PHI coverage relative to the cost of the cheapest eligible insurance policy, compliance with mandate is relatively low: the proportion of the population with PHI coverage increases by 6.5 percentage points (15.6%) at the income threshold where the tax penalty starts to apply. This effect is most pronounced for young taxpayers, while the middle aged seem to be least responsive to this specific tax incentive. Second, the discontinuous increase in the average tax rate at the income threshold created by the policy generates a strong incentive for tax avoidance which manifests itself through bunching in the taxable income distribution below the threshold. Finally, after imposing some plausible assumptions, we extrapolate the effect of the policy to other income levels and show that this policy has not had a significant impact on the overall demand for private health insurance in Australia.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.01.001.abstractZh: 我们分析了个人保险强制令（Medicare Levy Surcharge）对澳大利亚私人健康保险需求的影响。通过行政所得税申报数据，我们发现该强制令对纳税人的行为产生了多种影响。首先，尽管没有私人健康保险覆盖的纳税人需要承担较高的税收罚款，但遵守该强制令的比例相对较低：在税收罚款开始生效的收入门槛处，拥有私人健康保险覆盖的人口比例增加了6.5个百分点（15.6%）。这种影响在年轻纳税人中最为明显，而中年人则对这种特定的税收激励反应最小。其次，该政策导致收入门槛处平均税率的突然上升，这极大地刺激了逃税行为，表现为应税收入分布中低于该门槛的部分出现聚集现象。最后，在做出一些合理的假设后，我们将该政策的影响扩展到其他收入水平，结果显示该政策对澳大利亚私人健康保险的整体需求并没有产生显著影响。

abstract.text: We investigate the impact of the implementation of Diabetes Management Programs with financial incentives in the Italian Region Emilia-Romagna between 2003 and 2005. We focus on avoidable hospitalisations for diabetic patients for whom GPs receive additional payments exceeding capitation. We estimate a panel count data model to test the hypothesis that those patients under the responsibility of GPs receiving a higher share of their income through ad-hoc payments, are less likely to experience avoidable hospitalisations. Our findings indicate that financial transfers may help improve the quality of care, even when they are not based on the ex-post verification of performance. The estimated effect indicates that, at sample averages, an increase of 100 Euros of the financial incentives paid to GPs (around 17% of the yearly payment received by GPs for diabetes programmes) is expected to reduce the number of diabetic ACSCs by 1%, around 100 cases when projected on the entire region.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.01.002.abstractZh: 我们研究了2003年至2005年间在意大利艾米利亚-罗马涅大区实施糖尿病管理计划并附带经济激励措施的影响。我们重点关注糖尿病患者的可避免住院情况，对于这些患者，全科医生获得的额外报酬超过了常规收费。我们采用面板计数数据模型来检验这一假设：即那些由全科医生负责、从专项支付中获得更高收入的患者，发生可避免住院的风险较低。我们的研究结果表明，即使这些经济激励措施并非基于事后绩效评估，它们也有助于提高护理质量。估计结果显示，对全科医生支付的激励金增加100欧元（约占全科医生每年糖尿病项目报酬的17%），预计可使糖尿病患者的可避免住院次数减少1%，在整个大区范围内大约减少100例住院病例。

abstract.text: In this paper, we identify and quantify the role of international migration in the propagation of HIV across sub-Saharan African countries. We use panel data on bilateral migration flows and HIV prevalence rates covering 44 countries after 1990. Controlling for unobserved heterogeneity, reverse causality, reflection issues, incorrect treatment of country fixed effects and spatial autocorrelation, we find evidence of a highly robust emigration-induced propagation mechanism. On the contrary, immigration has no significant effect. Numerical experiments reveal that the long-run effect of emigration accounts for more than 4 percent of the number of HIV cases in 15 countries (and more than 20 percent in 6 countries).

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.01.004.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们识别并量化了国际移民在撒哈拉以南非洲国家传播艾滋病病毒中的作用。我们使用了1990年后44个国家的双边移民流动和艾滋病病毒流行率的数据，通过面板数据分析。在控制未观测的异质性、反向因果关系、反射效应、对国别固定效应的错误处理以及空间自相关性后，我们发现移民传播机制具有高度稳定性。相反，移民则没有显著效果。数值实验表明，在15个国家中，移民的长期影响占艾滋病病毒病例数的4%以上（在6个国家中占比超过20%）。

abstract.text: This study investigates whether drinker-drivers attributes are associated with imperfect rationality or irrationality. Using data from eight U.S. cities, we determine whether drinker-drivers differ from other drinkers in cognitive ability, ignorance of driving while intoxicated (DWI) laws, have higher rates of time preference, are time inconsistent, and lack self-control on other measures. We find that drinker-drivers are relatively knowledgeable about DWI laws and do not differ on two of three study measures of cognitive ability from other drinkers. Drinker-drivers are less prone to plan events involving drinking, e.g., selecting a designated driver in advance of drinking, and are more impulsive. Furthermore, we find evidence in support of hyperbolic discounting. In particular, relative to non-drinker-drivers, the difference between short- and long-term discount rates is much higher for drinker-drivers than for other drinkers. Implications of our findings for public policy, including incapacitation, treatment, and educational interventions, are discussed.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.01.005.abstractZh: 本研究探讨饮酒者与驾驶者之间的特征是否与非完美理性或非理性行为有关。通过美国八个城市的数据分析，我们发现饮酒者与其他饮酒者在认知能力、对酒驾法律的无知程度、时间偏好率、时间不一致性以及自我控制能力等方面存在差异。研究发现，饮酒者在了解酒驾法律方面相对较为丰富，在三项认知能力测量指标中的两项上与其他饮酒者没有差异。此外，饮酒者在规划与饮酒相关的活动时显得更缺乏计划性，例如提前选择指定驾驶员，且更具冲动性。我们还发现了支持超线性折扣效应的证据。具体而言，与非饮酒者相比，饮酒者在短期与长期折扣率之间的差异更大。本研究还讨论了这些发现对公共政策的影响，包括限制饮酒行为、治疗措施以及教育干预等。

abstract.text: Can private sector participation (PSP) in the piped water sector improve child health? I use child-level data from 39 African countries during 1986-2010 to show that PSP decreases diarrhea among urban-dwelling, under-five children by 2.6 percentage points, or 16% of its mean prevalence. Children from the poorest households benefit most. PSP is also associated with a 7.8 percentage point increase in school attendance of 7-17 year olds. Importantly, PSP increases usage of piped water by 9.7 percentage points, suggesting a possible causal channel explaining health improvements. To attribute causality, I exploit time-variation in the private water market share controlled by African countries' former colonizers. A placebo analysis reveals that PSP does not affect respiratory illness, nor does it affect a control group of rural children.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.01.006.abstractZh: 私营部门参与自来水行业能否改善儿童健康？我利用1986年至2010年间39个非洲国家的儿童数据表明，私营部门的参与使城市居住的五岁以下儿童腹泻发生率降低了2.6个百分点，即平均患病率的16%。最贫困家庭的儿童受益最大。私营部门的参与还使7至17岁儿童的出勤率提高了7.8个百分点。重要的是，私营部门的参与使自来水使用率提高了9.7个百分点，这表明可能存在一种因果机制来解释这些健康改善。为了确定因果关系，我利用了非洲国家前殖民者控制的私营供水市场份额随时间的变化情况。安慰剂分析显示，私营部门的参与并未影响呼吸道疾病，也未对农村儿童对照组产生影响。

abstract.text: Self-reported data on health care use is a key input in a range of studies. However, the length of recall period in self-reported health care questions varies between surveys, and this variation may affect the results of the studies. This study uses a large survey experiment to examine the role of the length of recall periods for the quality of self-reported hospitalization data by comparing registered with self-reported hospitalizations of respondents exposed to recall periods of one, three, six, or twelve months. Our findings have conflicting implications for survey design, as the preferred length of recall period depends on the objective of the analysis. For an aggregated measure of hospitalization, longer recall periods are preferred. For analysis oriented more to the micro-level, shorter recall periods may be considered since the association between individual characteristics (e.g., education) and recall error increases with the length of the recall period.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.01.007.abstractZh: 自我报告的医疗保健使用数据是多项研究中的重要数据来源。然而，不同调查中自我报告的医疗保健问题的回忆期长度存在差异，这种差异可能会影响研究结果。本研究通过一项大型调查实验，比较了经历1个月、3个月、6个月或12个月回忆期的受访者，从注册记录与自我报告的住院数据之间的质量差异，来探讨回忆期长度的作用。我们的研究结果对调查设计提出了不同的启示，因为最佳的回忆期长度取决于分析的目的。对于住院情况的汇总测量，较长的回忆期更为合适。而对于更关注微观层面的分析，由于个体特征（如教育水平）与回忆误差之间的关联会随着回忆期长度的增加而增强，因此较短的回忆期可能更为合适。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the impact of informal caregiving on self-reported well-being. It uses a sample of 23,285 respondents of the first eleven waves of the Household, Income and Labour Dynamics in Australia (HILDA). We apply a relatively new analytical method that enables us to estimate fixed effects ordered logit to analyse subjective well-being. The econometric estimates show that providing informal care has a negative effect on subjective well-being. The empirical evidence of our paper could be helpful to inform policy makers to better understand the impact of caregiving and design the appropriate long term care policies and support services.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.01.008.abstractZh: 本文估计了非正式照顾对自我幸福感的影响。研究采用了澳大利亚家庭、收入和劳动动态调查（HILDA）前十一个波段的23,285名受访者作为样本。我们采用了一种相对新的分析方法，即使用固定效应有序逻辑回归模型来分析主观幸福感。计量经济学估计结果显示，提供非正式照顾对主观幸福感有负面影响。本文的实证结果有助于政策制定者更好地理解照顾行为的影响，并设计适当的长期照顾政策和支持服务。

abstract.text: Even with open enrollment and mandated purchase, incentives created by adverse selection may undermine the efficiency of service offerings by plans in the new health insurance Exchanges created by the Affordable Care Act.
