Using data on persons likely to participate in Exchanges drawn from five waves of the Medical Expenditure Panel Survey, we measure plan incentives in two ways. First, we construct predictive ratios, improving on current methods by taking into account the role of premiums in financing plans. Second, relying on an explicit model of plan profit maximization, we measure incentives based on the predictability and predictiveness of various medical diagnoses. Among the chronic diseases studied, plans have the greatest incentive to skimp on care for cancer, and mental health and substance abuse.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.01.009.abstractZh: 即使有开放的注册制度和强制购买要求，由逆向选择带来的激励因素仍可能削弱新医疗保险交易所中计划提供的服务的效率。根据《平价医疗法案》所创建的医疗保险交易所，我们基于五次医疗支出调查数据，对可能参与交易所的人的情况进行了分析，并采用两种方法来衡量计划的激励因素。首先，我们构建了预测比率，通过考虑保费在计划融资中的作用，改进了现有方法。其次，基于一个明确的计划利润最大化模型，我们根据各种医疗诊断的可预测性和预测性来衡量激励因素。在研究的慢性疾病中，计划对癌症、心理健康和物质滥用等方面的治疗存在最大的激励不足。

abstract.text: We examine how different welfarist frameworks evaluate the social value of mortality risk reduction. These frameworks include classical, distributively unweighted cost-benefit analysis--i.e., the "value per statistical life" (VSL) approach-and various social welfare functions (SWFs). The SWFs are either utilitarian or prioritarian, applied to policy choice under risk in either an "ex post" or "ex ante" manner. We examine the conditions on individual utility and on the SWF under which these frameworks display sensitivity to wealth and to baseline risk. Moreover, we discuss whether these frameworks satisfy related properties that have received some attention in the literature, namely equal value of risk reduction, preference for risk equity, and catastrophe aversion. We show that the particular manner in which VSL ranks risk-reduction measures is not necessarily shared by other welfarist frameworks.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.02.001.abstractZh: 我们研究了不同的福利主义框架如何评估降低死亡风险的社会价值。这些框架包括传统的、未加权重的成本效益分析——即“每统计生命价值”方法——以及各种社会福利函数。这些社会福利函数可以是功利主义的，也可以是优先主义的，适用于风险条件下的政策选择，既可以采用“事后”方式，也可以采用“事前”方式。我们研究了在个体效用和社会福利函数给定的条件下，这些框架对财富和基线风险的敏感性。此外，我们还探讨了这些框架是否具备一些文献中关注的特性，即风险降低的平等价值、对风险公平的偏好以及灾难厌恶。我们发现，“每统计生命价值”对降低风险措施进行排序的方式并不一定被其他福利主义框架所共有。

abstract.text: Dengue is the most rapidly spreading mosquito-borne viral disease in the world (WHO, 2009). During the last two decades, the dramatic rise in the number of dengue infections has been particularly evident in Latin American and the Caribbean countries. This paper examines the experimental evidence of the effectiveness of mobile phone technology in improving households' health preventive behavior in dengue-endemic areas. The main results suggest that repeated exposure to health information encourages households' uptake of preventive measures against dengue. As a result, the Breteau Index in treatment households, an objective measure of dengue risk transmission, is 0.10 standard deviations below the mean of the control group, which shows a reduction in the number of containers per household that test positive for dengue larvae. The estimates also show marginally significant effects of the intervention on self-reported dengue symptoms. Moreover, we use a multiple treatment framework that randomly assigns households to one of the four treatment groups in order to analyze the impacts of framing on health behavior. Different variants emphasized information on monetary and non-monetary benefits and costs. The main results show no statistical differences among treatment groups.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.02.002.abstractZh: 登革热是全球传播速度最快的蚊媒病毒性疾病（世界卫生组织，2009年）。在过去二十年里，拉丁美洲和加勒比地区登革热感染病例数量急剧上升。本文通过实验研究，探讨了手机技术在改善登革热流行地区家庭健康预防行为方面的有效性。主要结果表明，反复接触健康信息能够促使家庭采取登革热预防措施。结果显示，治疗组家庭的登革热风险传播指数比对照组低0.10个标准差，这表明每个家庭中检测出登革热幼虫的容器数量有所减少。估计还显示，干预措施对自我报告的登革热症状有轻微但显著的影响。此外，我们采用了多重处理框架，随机将家庭分配到四个处理组中，以分析框架对健康行为的影响。不同的变体强调了货币和非货币利益与成本的信息。主要结果显示，各处理组之间没有统计学上的差异。

abstract.text: This paper uses a sample of adoptees to study the genetic mechanisms underlying intergenerational associations in chronic health conditions. I begin by estimating baseline intergenerational models with a sample of approximately 125,000 parent-child pairs, and find that children with a parent who has a specific chronic health condition are at least 100% more likely to have the same condition themselves. To assess the role of genetic mechanisms in generating these strong correlations, I estimate models using a sample of approximately 2400 adoptees, and find that genetic transmission accounts for only 20-30% of the baseline associations. As falsification tests, I repeat this exercise using health measures with externally established levels of genetic determination (height and chicken pox), and the results suggest that comparisons of biological and adopted children are a valid method of isolating genetic effects in this sample. Finally, to corroborate these adoptee-based estimates, I examine health correlations among monozygotic twins, which provide an upper bound estimate of genetic influences, and find a similarly modest role for genetic transmission. I conclude that intergenerational health transmission is an important hindrance to overall socioeconomic mobility, but that the majority of transmission occurs through environmental factors or gene-environment interactions, leaving scope for interventions to effectively mitigate health persistence.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.02.003.abstractZh: 本文采用一组被收养者作为样本，研究慢性健康状况代际关联背后的遗传机制。首先，我使用约125,000对父母-子女样本来估计基线代际模型，发现具有某种慢性健康状况的父母的子女，自身患有相同疾病的概率至少高出100%。为了评估遗传机制在产生这些强相关性中的作用，我使用约2400名被收养者样本来估计模型，发现遗传传递仅占基线关联的20-30%。作为验证测试，我使用外部确定的遗传决定水平的健康指标（如身高和水痘）重复了这一研究，结果表明，比较生物学上的孩子和被收养的孩子是分离该样本中遗传效应的有效方法。最后，为了验证这些基于被收养者的估计结果，我研究了单卵双胞胎之间的健康关联，这提供了遗传影响的上限估计，发现遗传传递的作用同样较为有限。我得出结论，代际健康传递是阻碍整体社会经济流动的重要因素，但大部分传递是通过环境因素或基因-环境相互作用实现的，这为干预措施的有效实施提供了可能性。

abstract.text: Models of the determinants of individuals' primary care costs can be used to set capitation payments to providers and to test for horizontal equity. We compare the ability of eight measures of patient morbidity and multimorbidity to predict future primary care costs and examine capitation payments based on them. The measures were derived from four morbidity descriptive systems: 17 chronic diseases in the Quality and Outcomes Framework (QOF); 17 chronic diseases in the Charlson scheme; 114 Expanded Diagnosis Clusters (EDCs); and 68 Adjusted Clinical Groups (ACGs). These were applied to patient records of 86,100 individuals in 174 English practices. For a given disease description system, counts of diseases and sets of disease dummy variables had similar explanatory power. The EDC measures performed best followed by the QOF and ACG measures. The Charlson measures had the worst performance but still improved markedly on models containing only age, gender, deprivation and practice effects. Comparisons of predictive power for different morbidity measures were similar for linear and exponential models, but the relative predictive power of the models varied with the morbidity measure. Capitation payments for an individual patient vary considerably with the different morbidity measures included in the cost model. Even for the best fitting model large differences between expected cost and capitation for some types of patient suggest incentives for patient selection. Models with any of the morbidity measures show higher cost for more deprived patients but the positive effect of deprivation on cost was smaller in better fitting models.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.02.005.abstractZh: 关于个体初级护理成本决定因素的模型可以用来设定提供者的按人头付费，并检验公平性。我们比较了八种患者发病率和多发病指标预测未来初级护理成本的能力，并基于这些指标来检验按人头付费的合理性。这些指标来源于四种疾病描述系统：质量与结果框架中的17种慢性疾病；Charlson方案中的17种慢性疾病；114个扩展诊断集群；以及68个调整临床组。这些指标被应用于174个英国诊所的86,100名患者的记录中。对于同一种疾病描述系统，疾病数量及疾病虚拟变量的解释力相似。扩展诊断集群指标的表现最好，其次是质量与结果框架和调整临床组指标。Charlson指标的表现最差，但在仅包含年龄、性别、贫困程度及诊所效应的模型中仍有显著改善。不同发病率指标的预测能力在线性和指数模型中相似，但模型之间的相对预测能力随发病率指标的不同而有所变化。对于单个患者而言，按人头付费的金额会因成本模型中包含的不同发病率指标而有很大差异。即使对于最适合的模型，某些类型患者的预期成本与按人头付费之间的巨大差异表明存在患者选择的激励因素。包含任何一种发病率指标的模型都显示出贫困患者的高成本，但在更适合的模型中，贫困对成本的正向影响较小。

abstract.text: This paper provides new empirical evidence on the impact of parental health shocks on investments in children's education using detailed longitudinal data from Bosnia and Herzegovina. Our study controls for individual unobserved heterogeneity by using child fixed effects, and it accounts for potential misreporting of self-reported health by employing several, more precise, health indicators. Results show that co-living children of ill mothers, but not of ill fathers, are significantly less likely to be enrolled in education at ages 15-24. Moreover, there is some evidence that mother's negative health shocks are likely to raise the employment probability of children due to the need to cover higher health expenditures.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.02.006.abstractZh: 本文利用波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那的详细纵向数据，提供了关于父母健康冲击对儿童教育投资影响的新实证证据。我们通过使用儿童固定效应来控制个体未观测到的异质性，并采用更精确的健康指标来避免自我报告健康状况的潜在误报。研究结果表明，患有疾病的母亲的子女，而非患有疾病的父亲的子女，在15至24岁期间接受教育的可能性显著较低。此外，有证据表明，母亲的健康状况恶化可能会提高子女的就业概率，因为需要承担更高的健康支出。

abstract.text: To moderate the rate of growth of retiree health insurance costs, employers can modify plans and move retirees into less expensive plans. We examine policy modifications implemented by the North Carolina State Health Plan. We investigate whether incentives produce the desired plan elections and whether these changes, along with cost shifting, produce the expected reductions in cost growth. Using individual-level administrative data, along with aggregated data on expenditures for retirees, we estimate the effects of the introduction and subsequent repeal of a Comprehensive Wellness Initiative for non-Medicare eligible retirees, as well as increases in coinsurance and copayments and the introduction of a premium for all retirees. Over a third of non-Medicare retirees shifted into the least generous plan between June 2009 and December 2012. The level effects on annual costs and unfunded accrued liabilities were relatively modest, but growth rates were diminished. Increases in the retiree premiums reduced the state's projected costs.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.02.007.abstractZh: 为了控制退休人员健康保险费用的增长速度，雇主可以调整计划，将退休人员转移到费用较低的计划中。我们研究了北卡罗来纳州健康计划所实施的政策调整。我们调查了这些激励措施是否导致了预期的计划选择，以及这些改变以及费用转移是否实现了预期的成本降低效果。利用个人层面的行政数据，以及退休人员支出的汇总数据，我们评估了针对非Medicare资格的退休人员引入并随后废除全面健康计划的影响，以及增加共付额和自付额以及为所有退休人员引入保费的影响。在2009年6月至2012年12月期间，超过三分之一的非Medicare退休人员转投了费用较低的计划。这些调整对年度成本和未资助的累积负债的影响相对温和，但增长率有所降低。提高退休人员保费减少了该州的预计成本。

abstract.text: Evaluating Accountable Care Organizations is difficult because there is a great deal of heterogeneity in terms of their reimbursement incentives and other programmatic features. We examine how variation in reimbursement incentives and administration among two Medicaid managed care plans impacts utilization and spending. We use a quasi-experimental approach exploiting the timing and county-specific implementation of Medicaid managed care mandates in two contiguous regions of Kentucky. We find large differences in the relative success of each plan in reducing utilization and spending that are likely driven by important differences in plan design. The plan that capitated primary care physicians and contracted out many administrative responsibilities to an experienced managed care organization achieved significant reductions in outpatient and professional utilization. The plan that opted for a fee-for-service reimbursement scheme with a group withhold and handled administration internally saw a much more modest reduction in outpatient utilization and an increase in professional utilization.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.03.001.abstractZh: 评估责任护理组织是一项困难的任务，因为这些组织在报销激励措施和其他计划特性方面存在很大的差异。我们研究了两种医疗补助管理计划在报销激励措施和管理方面的差异如何影响医疗服务的利用和支出。我们采用准实验方法，利用肯塔基州两个相邻地区医疗补助管理规定的实施时间和地区差异来进行研究。我们发现，两种计划在减少医疗服务利用和支出方面的相对成功程度存在很大差异，这可能是由于计划设计的显著差异所致。其中，将初级保健医生的费用固定下来，并将许多管理职责外包给经验丰富的管理组织的计划，在门诊和专业医疗服务利用方面取得了显著减少。而采用按服务收费的报销机制，并自行处理管理的计划，则在门诊利用方面减少了较多，而专业医疗服务利用则有所增加。

abstract.text: We develop a model of premium sharing for firms that offer multiple insurance plans. We assume that firms offer one low quality plan and one high quality plan. Under the assumption of wage rigidities we found that the employee's contribution to each plan is an increasing function of that plan's premium. The effect of the other plan's premium is ambiguous. We test our hypothesis using data from the Employer Health Benefit Survey. Restricting the analysis to firms that offer both HMO and PPO plans, we measure the amount of the premium passed on to employees in response to a change in both premiums. We find evidence of large and positive effects of the increase in the plan's premium on the amount of the premium passed on to employees. The effect of the alternative plan's premium is negative but statistically significant only for the PPO plans.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.03.002.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个针对提供多种保险计划的公司的保费分摊模型。我们假设这些公司提供一款低质量计划和一款高质量计划。在工资刚性假设下，我们发现员工对每款计划的贡献是随着该计划保费的增加而增加的。另一款计划保费的影响则具有不确定性。我们使用《雇主健康福利调查》的数据来检验我们的假设。将分析范围限制在同时提供HMO和PPO计划的公司，我们测量了在两种计划保费发生变化时，保费被转嫁给员工的数量。我们发现，计划保费的增加对保费被转嫁给员工的数量有显著的正面影响。而另一种计划保费的影响则为负，但仅在PPO计划中具有统计学上的显著性。

abstract.text: We estimate the degree of supplier-induced demand for newborn treatment by exploiting changes in reimbursement arising from the introduction of the partial prospective payment system (PPS) in Japan. Under the partial PPS, neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) utilization became relatively more profitable than other procedures, since it was excluded from prospective payments. We find that hospitals have responded to PPS adoption by increasing NICU utilization and by more frequently manipulating infants' reported birth weights which in large part determine their maximum allowable stay in the NICU. This induced demand substantially increases the reimbursements received by hospitals.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.03.003.abstractZh: 我们通过分析日本引入部分预付费制度后报销政策的变化，来估算供应商对新生儿治疗需求的程度。在部分预付费制度下，由于新生儿重症监护病房的治疗被排除在预付费范围之外，其使用变得相对更有利可图。我们发现，医院为了适应这一制度，增加了新生儿重症监护病房的使用频率，并更频繁地调整婴儿报告的出生体重，而这些出生体重在很大程度上决定了婴儿在重症监护病房的最大停留时间。这种需求的增加显著提高了医院获得的报销金额。

abstract.text: Underage drinkers often use false identification to purchase alcohol or gain access into bars. In recent years, several states have introduced laws that provide incentives to retailers and bar owners who use electronic scanners to ensure that the customer is 21 years or older and uses a valid identification to purchase alcohol. This paper is the first to investigate the effects of these laws using confidential data from the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth, 1997 Cohort (NLSY97). Using a difference-in-differences methodology, I find that the false ID laws with scanner provision significantly reduce underage drinking, including up to a 0.22 drink decrease in the average number of drinks consumed by underage youth per day. This effect is observed particularly in the short-run and more pronounced for non-college students and those who are relatively younger. These results are also robust under alternative model specifications. The findings of this paper highlight the importance of false ID laws in reducing alcohol consumption among underage youth.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.03.004.abstractZh: 未成年人饮酒者常常使用虚假身份证件购买酒精饮料或进入酒吧。近年来，一些州出台了法律，鼓励使用电子扫描仪的零售商和酒吧老板确保顾客年满21岁并持有有效的身份证件才能购买酒精饮料。本文首次利用1997年青年纵向调查（NLSY97）的机密数据，研究这些法律的效果。通过差异-差异方法分析，我发现配备扫描仪的虚假身份证件法律显著减少了未成年人的饮酒行为，包括未成年人每天平均饮酒量减少了0.22杯。这种效果在短期内尤为明显，且对非大学生和年龄较小的未成年人影响更大。这些结果在替代模型假设下依然成立。本文的研究结果表明，虚假身份证件法律在减少未成年人酒精消费方面具有重要意义。

abstract.text: We study the impact of the 1918 influenza pandemic on short- and medium-term economic performance in Sweden. The pandemic was one of the severest and deadliest pandemics in human history, but it has hitherto received only scant attention in the economic literature--despite representing an unparalleled labour supply shock. In this paper, we exploit seemingly exogenous variation in incidence rates between Swedish regions to estimate the impact of the pandemic. The pandemic led to a significant increase in poorhouse rates. There is also evidence that capital returns were negatively affected by the pandemic. However, contrary to predictions, we find no discernible effect on earnings.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.03.005.abstractZh: 我们研究了1918年流感大流行对瑞典短期和中期经济表现的影响。这次大流行是人类历史上最严重、最致命的疫情之一，但迄今为止，经济学文献对其关注甚微——尽管它带来了前所未有的劳动力供应冲击。在本文中，我们利用瑞典各地区发病率的看似外生变化来估算大流行的影响。大流行导致贫困家庭率显著上升。还有证据表明，资本回报受到大流行的负面影响。然而，与预期相反，我们没有发现对收入有明显的影响。

abstract.text: A key question in the ongoing policy debate over cannabis' legal status is whether liberalizing cannabis laws leads to an increase in cannabis use. This paper provides new evidence on the impact of a specific type of liberalization, decriminalization, on initiation into cannabis use. Our identification strategy exploits variation in the timing of cannabis policy reforms and our estimation framework marries a difference-in-difference approach with a discrete time duration model. Our results reveal evidence of both heterogeneity and dynamics in the response of cannabis uptake to decriminalization. Overall, we find that the impact of decriminalization is concentrated amongst minors, who have a higher rate of uptake in the first five years following its introduction.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.03.006.abstractZh: 在关于大麻合法地位的持续政策辩论中，一个关键问题是，大麻法律的解禁是否会导致大麻使用量的增加。本文提供了关于一种特定类型的法律解禁——非刑事化——对大麻使用入门的影响的新证据。我们的识别策略利用了大麻政策改革时间的差异，而我们的估计框架结合了差异-差异方法和离散时间持续模型。我们的研究结果揭示了大麻使用对非刑事化反应的异质性和动态性。总体而言，我们发现非刑事化的影响主要集中在未成年人身上，在政策实施后的前五年内，未成年人的使用率更高。

abstract.text: Legal bar closing times in England and Wales have historically been early and uniform. Recent legislation liberalised closing times with the object of reducing social problems thought associated with drinking to "beat the clock." Indeed, using both difference in difference and synthetic control approaches we show that one consequence of this liberalisation was a decrease in traffic accidents. This decrease is heavily concentrated among younger drivers. Moreover, we provide evidence that the effect was most pronounced in the hours of the week directly affected by the liberalisation: late nights and early mornings on weekends. This evidence survives a series of robustness checks and suggests at least one socially positive consequence of extending bar hours.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.03.007.abstractZh: 英格兰和威尔士的酒吧营业时间历来较早且统一。最近的立法放宽了营业时间，目的是减少与饮酒相关的社会问题，从而“节省时间”。事实上，通过差异分析和综合控制方法的研究表明，这一放宽措施的一个结果是交通事故数量减少。这种减少主要集中在年轻司机身上。此外，我们有证据表明，这一效果在受放宽政策直接影响的时间段最为明显：周末的深夜和清晨。这些证据在一系列稳健性检验中依然成立，表明延长酒吧营业时间至少具有一个积极的社会影响。

abstract.text: We provide an analysis of the effect of physician payment methods on their hospital patients' length of stay and risk of readmission. To do so, we exploit a major reform implemented in Quebec (Canada) in 1999. The Quebec Government introduced an optional mixed compensation (MC) scheme for specialist physicians working in hospital. This scheme combines a fixed per diem with a reduced fee for services provided, as an alternative to the traditional fee-for-service system. We develop a model of a physician's decision to choose the MC scheme. We show that a physician who adopts this system will have incentives to increase his time per clinical service provided. We demonstrate that as long as this effect does not improve his patients' health by more than a critical level, they will stay more days in hospital over the period. At the empirical level, we estimate a model of transition between spells in and out of hospital analog to a difference-in-differences approach. We find that the hospital length of stay of patients treated in departments that opted for the MC system increased on average by 4.2% (0.28 days). However, the risk of readmission to the same department with the same diagnosis does not appear to be overall affected by the reform.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.03.008.abstractZh: 我们分析了医生薪酬制度对其医院患者住院时间和再入院风险的影响。为此，我们借鉴了1999年加拿大魁北克实施的一项重大改革。魁北克政府为在医院工作的专科医生引入了一种可选的混合补偿制度。该制度将固定的每日津贴与按比例降低的服务费用相结合，作为传统按服务收费制度的替代方案。我们建立了一个模型，用于分析医生选择混合补偿制度的决策过程。研究表明，采用该制度的医生会有动机增加每次临床服务的时长。我们进一步证明，只要这种效应不会使患者的健康状况恶化超过一个临界水平，患者在医院内的住院天数就会增加。在实证层面，我们采用差异-差异方法估算了医院住院期间转换的制度模式。研究发现，采用混合补偿制度的科室患者的住院时间平均增加了4.2%（0.28天）。然而，同一科室、相同诊断的患者再入院的风险似乎并未受到该改革的影响。

abstract.text: Despite the widespread provision of retiree health insurance for public sector workers, little attention has been paid to its effects on employee retirement. This is in contrast to the large literature on health-insurance-induced "job-lock" in the private sector. I use the introduction of retiree health insurance for public school employees in combination with administrative data on their retirement to identify the effects of retiree health insurance. As expected, the availability of retiree health insurance for older workers allows employees to retire earlier. These behavioral changes have budgetary implications, likely making the programs self-financing rather than costly to taxpayers.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.03.009.abstractZh: 尽管公共部门的工作者普遍享有退休健康保险，但对其对员工退休的影响却鲜有关注。这与关于私人部门健康保险导致的“工作锁定”现象的大量研究形成对比。我通过结合公共学校员工退休相关的行政数据，来研究退休健康保险的影响。正如预期的那样，为年长工人提供退休健康保险使得员工能够更早退休。这些行为变化对预算产生了影响，可能会使这些项目实现自筹资金，而不是给纳税人带来额外负担。

abstract.text: The dynamic evolution of health and persistent relationship status pose econometric challenges to disentangling the causal effect of relationships on health from the selection effect of health on relationship choice. Using a new econometric strategy we find that marriage is not universally better for health. Rather, cohabitation benefits the health of men and women over 45, being never married is no worse for health, and only divorce marginally harms the health of younger men. We find strong evidence that unobservable health-related factors can confound estimates. Our method can be applied to other research questions with dynamic dependent and multivariate endogenous variables.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.03.010.abstractZh: 健康和持续的关系状态动态变化给经济计量学带来了挑战，需要区分关系对健康的因果效应以及健康对关系选择的影响。通过新的经济计量策略，我们发现婚姻并不普遍对健康有益。相反，同居对45岁以上的男女健康都有好处，从未结婚对健康的影响并不负面，而离婚对年轻男性的健康影响较小。我们发现，不可观测的健康相关因素可能会混淆估计结果。我们的方法可以应用于其他具有动态依赖变量和多变量内生变量的研究问题。

abstract.text: Recent studies examining the effect of family income on child health have been unable to account for the endogeneity of income. Using data from a British cohort study, we address this gap by exploiting exogenous variation in local labour market characteristics to instrument for family income. We estimate the causal effect of family income on different measures of child health and explore the role of potential transmission mechanisms. We find that income has a very small but significant causal effect on subjective child health and no significant effect on chronic health conditions, apart from respiratory illnesses. Using the panel structure, we show that the timing of income does not matter for young children. Moreover, our results provide further evidence that parental health does not drive a spurious relationship between family income and child health. Our study implies that financial transfers are unlikely to deliver substantial improvements in child health.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.03.011.abstractZh: 近期关于家庭收入对儿童健康影响的研究未能解释收入的内生性。我们利用一项英国队列研究的数据，通过利用当地劳动力市场特征的外生变化来作为家庭收入的工具变量，以填补这一空白。我们估计了家庭收入对儿童健康不同指标的因果效应，并探讨了潜在传递机制的作用。研究发现，收入对儿童主观健康有非常小的但显著的因果效应，而对慢性健康状况则没有显著影响，除了呼吸系统疾病。利用面板结构，我们发现对于幼儿来说，收入的时间点并不重要。此外，我们的研究结果进一步证明，父母的健康状况并不会导致家庭收入与儿童健康之间的虚假关系。我们的研究表明，财务转移不太可能带来儿童健康的显著改善。

abstract.text: Little is known about how health insurance affects labor market decisions for young adults. This is despite the fact that expanding coverage for people in their early 20s is an important component of the Affordable Care Act. This paper studies how having an outside source of health insurance affects wages by using variation in health insurance access that comes from states extending dependent coverage to young adults. Using American Community Survey and Census data, I find evidence that extending health insurance to young adults raises their wages. The increases in wages can be explained by increases in human capital and the increased flexibility in the labor market that comes from people no longer having to rely on their own employers for health insurance. The estimates from this paper suggest the Affordable Care Act will lead to wage increases for young adults.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.03.012.abstractZh: 关于健康保险如何影响年轻成年人的劳动力市场决策，目前了解甚少。尽管为20岁出头的年轻人扩大保险覆盖范围是《平价医疗法案》的重要组成部分，但相关研究却很少。本文通过研究健康保险获取渠道的变化，探讨了拥有外部健康保险对工资的影响。利用美国社区调查和人口普查数据，我发现为年轻人提供健康保险确实能提升他们的工资。工资的增加可以归因于人力资本的提升，以及劳动力市场的灵活性增强，因为人们不再需要依赖雇主来提供健康保险。本文的估计结果表明，《平价医疗法案》将有助于提升年轻人的工资水平。

abstract.text: Most government employees have access to retiree health coverage, which provides them with group health coverage even if they retire before Medicare eligibility. We study the impact of retiree health coverage on the labor supply of public sector workers between the ages of 55 and 64. We find that retiree health coverage raises the probability of stopping full time work by 4.3 percentage points (around 38 percent) over two years among public sector workers aged 55-59, and by 6.7 percentage points (around 26 percent) over two years among public sector workers aged 60-64. In the younger age group, retiree health insurance mostly seems to facilitate transitions to part-time work rather than full retirement. However, in the older age group, it increases the probability of stopping work entirely by 4.3 percentage points (around 22 percent).

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.03.013.abstractZh: 大多数政府雇员都能享受退休健康保险，即使他们在达到医疗保险资格之前退休，也能获得团体健康保险。我们研究了退休健康保险对55至64岁公共部门员工劳动力供应的影响。研究发现，在55至59岁的公共部门员工中，退休健康保险使停止全职工作的概率在两年内增加了4.3个百分点（约38%），而在60至64岁的公共部门员工中，这一比例增加了6.7个百分点（约26%）。在较年轻的年龄段，退休健康保险似乎更多地促进了向兼职工作的过渡，而非完全退休。然而，在较年长的年龄段，它使完全停止工作的概率增加了4.3个百分点（约22%）。

abstract.text: Economic theory predicts that employer-provided retiree health insurance (RHI) benefits have a crowd-out effect on household wealth accumulation, not dissimilar to the effects reported elsewhere for employer pensions, Social Security, and Medicare. Nevertheless, we are unaware of any similar research on the impacts of retiree health insurance per se. Accordingly, the present paper utilizes a unique data file on respondents to the Health and Retirement Study, to explore how employer-provided retiree health insurance may influence net household wealth among public sector employees, where retiree healthcare benefits are still quite prevalent. Key findings include the following: Most full-time public sector employees anticipate having employer-provided health insurance coverage in retirement, unlike most private sector workers.Public sector employees covered by RHI had substantially less wealth than similar private sector employees without RHI. In our data, Federal workers had about $82,000 (18%) less net wealth than private sector employees lacking RHI; state/local workers with RHI accumulated about $69,000 (or 15%) less net wealth than their uninsured private sector counterparts.After controlling on socioeconomic status and differences in pension coverage, net household wealth for Federal employees was $116,000 less than workers without RHI and the result is statistically significant; the state/local difference was not.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.03.014.abstractZh: 经济理论预测，雇主提供的退休人员健康保险对家庭财富积累具有挤出效应，这与其他领域关于雇主养老金、社会保障和医疗保险的研究结果类似。然而，我们尚未发现关于退休人员健康保险本身影响的类似研究。因此，本文利用“健康与退休研究”的独有数据文件，探讨雇主提供的退休人员健康保险如何影响公共部门员工的净家庭财富，尤其是在退休人员医疗保健福利仍然普遍存在的公共部门。主要发现包括以下几点：大多数公共部门全职员工预期在退休时享有雇主提供的健康保险，这与大多数私营部门员工的情况不同。享有RHI的公共部门员工财富明显低于没有RHI的类似私营部门员工。在我们的数据中，联邦政府员工的净财富比没有RHI的私营部门员工少约82,000美元（占18%）；拥有RHI的州级/地方级员工净财富比没有保险的私营部门员工少约69,000美元（占15%）。在控制了社会经济地位和养老金覆盖差异后，联邦政府员工的净家庭财富比没有RHI的员工少116,000美元，这一差异具有统计学意义；而州级/地方级员工之间的差异则没有统计学意义。

abstract.text: The public health care systems in the Nordic countries provide high quality care almost free of charge to all citizens. However, social inequalities in health persist. Previous research has, for example, documented substantial educational inequalities in cancer survival. We investigate to what extent this may be driven by differential access to and utilization of high quality treatment options. Quasi-experimental evidence based on the establishment of regional cancer wards indicates that (i) highly educated individuals utilized centralized specialized treatment to a greater extent than less educated patients and (ii) the use of such treatment improved these patients' survival.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.04.001.abstractZh: 北欧国家的公共卫生体系为所有公民提供几乎免费的高质量医疗服务。然而，健康方面的社会不平等现象仍然存在。例如，先前的研究已经记录了癌症患者生存率的巨大教育差异。我们研究这种差异在多大程度上是由对高质量治疗选项的不同获取和利用所驱动的。基于区域癌症病房建立的准实验证据表明：(i) 受教育程度较高的患者比受教育程度较低的患者更倾向于接受集中式的专业治疗；(ii) 这种治疗方式的采用提高了这些患者的生存率。

abstract.text: This paper studies the cross-border health and productivity effects of alcohol taxes. We estimate the effect of a large cut in the Finnish alcohol tax on mortality, alcohol-related illnesses and work absenteeism in Sweden. This tax cut led to large differences in the prices of alcoholic beverages between these two countries and to a considerable increase in cross-border shopping. The effect is identified using differences-in-differences strategy where changes in these outcomes in regions near the Finnish border are compared to changes in other parts of northern Sweden. We use register data where micro level data on deaths, hospitalisations and absenteeism is merged to population-wide micro data on demographics and labour market outcomes. Our results show that the Finnish tax cut did not have any clear effect on mortality or alcohol-related hospitalisations in Sweden. However, we find that workplace absenteeism increased by 9% for males and by 15% for females near the Finnish border as a result of the tax cut.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.04.002.abstractZh: 本文研究了酒精税对跨境健康与生产力影响的效应。我们估算了芬兰大幅降低酒精税对瑞典死亡率、与酒精相关的疾病以及工作缺勤率的影响。这一减税政策导致两国之间酒精饮料价格出现较大差异，并显著增加了跨境购物行为。我们通过差异-差异策略来识别这一效应，即比较芬兰边境附近地区与瑞典北部其他地区在这些结果上的变化。我们利用了登记数据，将微观层面的死亡、住院和缺勤数据与全人口层面的人口统计和劳动力市场数据相结合。研究结果表明，芬兰的减税政策对瑞典的死亡率或与酒精相关的住院率没有明显影响。然而，我们发现，由于减税政策，芬兰边境附近的男性缺勤率增加了9%，女性则增加了15%。

abstract.text: Reference price systems for prescription drugs constitute widely adopted cost containment tools. Under these regimes, patients co-pay a fraction of the difference between a drug's pharmacy retail price and a reference price that is set by the government. Reference prices are either externally (based on drug prices in other countries) or internally (based on domestic drug prices) determined. We study the effects of a change from external to internal reference pricing in Denmark in 2005. We find that the reform led to substantial reductions in retail prices, reference prices and patient co-payments as well as to sizable decreases in overall producer revenues and health care expenditures. The reform induced consumers to substitute away from branded drugs for which we estimate strong preferences. The increase in consumer welfare due to the reform therefore depends on whether or not we take perceived quality differences into account in its calculation.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.04.003.abstractZh: 处方药参考价格体系是广泛采用的成本控制工具。在这些制度下，患者需支付药品零售价格与政府设定的参考价格之间的差额的一部分作为共同支付费用。参考价格可以是基于外部因素（如其他国家药品价格）确定的，也可以是基于国内药品价格确定的。我们研究了2005年丹麦从外部参考定价转向内部参考定价的影响。研究发现，这一改革导致零售价格、参考价格以及患者的共同支付费用大幅降低，同时生产者的总收入和医疗保健支出也显著减少。改革促使消费者从那些我们估计有强烈偏好的品牌药品转向其他药品。因此，由于改革而增加的消费者福利取决于在计算过程中是否考虑到了感知到的质量差异。

abstract.text: Increasing the adoption of generic drugs has the potential to improve static efficiency in a health system without harming pharmaceutical innovation. However, very little is known about the timing of generic adoption and diffusion. No prior study has empirically examined the differential launch times of generics across a comprehensive set of markets, or more specifically the delays in country specific adoption of generics relative to the first country of (generic) adoption. Drawing on data containing significant country and product variation across a lengthy time period (1999-2008), we use duration analysis to examine relative delays, across countries, in the adoption of generic drugs. Our results suggest that price regulation has a significant effect on reducing the time to launch of generics, with faster adoption in higher priced markets. The latter result is dependent on the degree of competition and the expected market size.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.04.004.abstractZh: 增加通用药物的采用有可能在不会损害制药创新的情况下提高医疗系统的静态效率。然而，关于通用药物采用的时机和扩散情况，目前知之甚少。此前没有研究实证分析过不同市场中通用药物的推出时间差异，或者更具体地说，是各国对通用药物的采用相对于第一个采用通用药物的国家的延迟情况。基于1999年至2008年间包含大量国家和产品数据的研究，我们使用持续时间分析来考察各国在采用通用药物方面的相对延迟情况。我们的研究结果表明，价格管制对缩短通用药物的推出时间有显著影响，在价格较高的市场中，通用药物的采用速度更快。这一结果取决于竞争程度以及预期的市场规模。

abstract.text: In this paper we discuss the prioritisation of healthcare projects where there is a concern about health inequalities, but the decision maker is reluctant to make explicit quantitative value judgements and the data systems only allow the measurement of health at an aggregate level. Our analysis begins with a standard welfare economic model of healthcare resource allocation. We show how - under the assumption that the healthcare projects under consideration have a small impact on individual health--the problem can be reformulated as one of finding a particular subset of the class of efficient solutions to an implied multicriteria optimisation problem. Algorithms for finding such solutions are readily available, and we demonstrate our approach through a worked example of treatment for clinical depression.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.04.005.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们讨论了在存在健康不平等问题的情况下，如何优先处理医疗项目的问题。由于决策者不愿做出明确的定量价值判断，且数据系统仅能测量整体的健康状况，因此我们需要一种新的方法。我们的分析基于标准的福利经济模型来研究医疗资源的分配问题。我们展示了在假设所考虑的医疗项目对个体健康的影响较小的情况下，如何将问题重新表述为寻找一组高效解决方案的子集，这些解决方案属于一个隐含的多标准优化问题。寻找此类解决方案的算法已经成熟，我们通过一个针对临床抑郁症的治疗案例来演示我们的方法。

abstract.text: We obtain estimates of associations between statin use and health behaviors. Statin use is associated with a small increase in BMI and moderate (20-33%) increases in the probability of being obese. Statin use was also associated with a significant (e.g., 15% of mean) increase in moderate alcohol use among men. There was no consistent evidence of a decrease in smoking associated with statin use, and exercise worsened somewhat for females. Statin use was associated with increased physical activity among males. Finally, there was evidence that statin use increased the use of blood pressure medication and aspirin for both males and females, although estimates varied considerably in magnitude. These results are consistent with the hypothesis that healthy diet is a strong substitute for statins, but there is only uneven evidence for the hypothesis that investments in disease prevention are complementary.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.04.006.abstractZh: 我们获得了关于他汀类药物使用与健康行为之间关联性的估计结果。使用他汀类药物与体重指数略有上升有关，肥胖概率也增加了20-33%。此外，男性使用他汀类药物还显著增加了中等程度的酒精摄入（例如，平均增加了15%）。然而，没有证据表明他汀类药物使用会导致吸烟量减少，而且女性的运动状况有所恶化。男性使用他汀类药物则与身体活动增加有关。最后，有证据表明，无论男女，他汀类药物的使用都增加了血压药物和阿司匹林的使用，尽管这些影响的幅度存在较大差异。这些结果支持了“健康饮食是他汀类药物的有效替代品”这一假设，但关于“预防疾病的投资是互补的”这一假设，目前证据并不一致。

abstract.text: This paper revisits the relationship between nurse staffing and quality of care in nursing homes using an instrumental variables approach. Most prior studies rely on cross-sectional evidence, which renders causal inference problematic and policy recommendations inappropriate. We exploit legislation changes regarding minimum staffing requirements in eight states between 2000 and 2001 as exogenous shocks to nurse staffing levels. We find that registered nurse staffing has a large and significant impact on quality of care, and that there is no evidence of a significant association between nurse aide staffing and quality of care. A comparison of the IV estimation to the OLS estimation of the first-difference model suggests that ignoring endogeneity would lead to an underestimation of how nurse staffing affects quality of care in nursing homes.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.04.007.abstractZh: 本文采用工具变量方法，重新审视了养老院护士人员配置与护理质量之间的关系。大多数先前的研究依赖于横截面数据，这导致因果推断存在困难，政策建议也不够恰当。我们利用2000年至2001年间八个州关于最低人员配置要求的立法变化作为护士人员配置水平的外生冲击。研究发现，注册护士人员配置对护理质量有显著且较大的影响，而护士助理人员配置与护理质量之间则没有显著关联。将工具变量估计结果与差分解模型的OLS估计结果进行比较后，我们发现忽略内生性会导致低估护士人员配置对养老院护理质量的影响。

abstract.text: We analyze the incidence of public-employee health benefits. Because these benefits are negotiated through the political process, relevant labor market institutions deviate significantly from the competitive, private-sector benchmark. Empirically, we find that roughly 15 percent of the cost of recent benefit growth was passed onto school district employees through reductions in wages and salaries. Strong teachers' unions were associated with relatively strong linkages between benefit growth and growth in total compensation. Our analysis is consistent with the view that the costs of public workers' benefits are difficult to monitor, contributing to benefit oriented, and often under-funded, compensation schemes.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.04.008.abstractZh: 我们分析了公共雇员健康福利的分配情况。由于这些福利是通过政治过程协商确定的，相关劳动力市场制度与私营部门的竞争基准存在显著偏差。实证研究表明，近期福利增长的成本约有15%通过降低工资和薪水转嫁给了学区员工。强大的教师工会与福利增长与总薪酬增长之间的紧密联系有关。我们的分析支持了这样一种观点：公共雇员福利的成本难以监控，这导致了以福利为导向的薪酬体系，且往往资金不足。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the effect that premiums in Medicaid have on the length of enrollment of program beneficiaries. Whether and how low income-families will participate in the exchanges and in states' Medicaid programs depends crucially on the structure and amounts of the premiums they will face. I take advantage of discontinuities in the structure of Wisconsin's Medicaid program to identify the effects of premiums on enrollment for low-income families. I use a 3-year administrative panel of enrollment data to estimate these effects. I find an increase in the premium from 0 to 10 dollars per month results in 1.4 fewer months enrolled and reduces the probability of remaining enrolled for a full year by 12 percentage points, but other discrete changes in premium amounts do not affect enrollment or have a much smaller effect. I find no evidence of program enrollees intentionally decreasing labor supply in order to avoid the premiums.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.05.001.abstractZh: 本文估计了Medicaid保费对计划受益人参保期限的影响。低收入家庭是否会参与医保改革以及如何参与，在很大程度上取决于他们面临的保费结构和金额。我利用威斯康星州Medicaid计划的结构不连续性，来研究保费对低收入家庭参保的影响。我使用了3年的参保数据来估算这些影响。研究发现，保费从每月0美元增加到10美元，会导致参保月份减少1.4个月，并使持续参保一年的概率降低12个百分点。然而，保费金额的其他变化对参保情况的影响较小。我没有发现参保者故意减少劳动力供应以逃避保费的情况。

abstract.text: We examine the effects of a policy change in the province of Quebec, Canada which greatly expanded insurance coverage for prescription medications. We show that the change was associated with a sharp increase in the use of stimulant medications commonly prescribed for ADHD in Quebec relative to the rest of Canada. We ask whether this increase in medication use was associated with improvements in emotional functioning or academic outcomes among children with ADHD. We find little evidence of improvement in either the medium or the long run. Our results are silent on the effects on optimal use of medication for ADHD, but suggest that expanding medication in a community setting had little positive benefit and may have had harmful effects given the average way these drugs are used in the community.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.05.002.abstractZh: 我们研究了加拿大魁北克省一项政策变化的影响，该政策大幅扩大了处方药的可保险范围。研究表明，这一变化导致魁北克省用于治疗注意力缺陷多动障碍的兴奋剂类药物的使用量显著增加，相对于加拿大其他地区而言。我们探讨了这种药物使用量的增加是否伴随着儿童注意力缺陷多动障碍的情绪功能或学业表现的改善。研究发现，无论是短期内还是长期内，这种改善的迹象都很少。我们的研究结果并未显示出对注意力缺陷多动障碍患者药物最佳使用的积极影响，反而表明在社区环境中扩大药物使用范围可能带来负面影响，因为目前这些药物在社区中的使用方式普遍都是如此。

abstract.text: Whereas a large literature has shown the importance of early life health for adult socioeconomic outcomes, there is little evidence on the importance of adolescent health. We contribute to the literature by studying the impact of adolescent health status on adult labor market outcomes using a unique and large-scale dataset covering almost the entire population of Swedish males. We show that most types of major conditions have long-run effects on future outcomes, and that the strongest effects result from mental conditions. Including sibling fixed effects or twin pair fixed effects reduces the magnitudes of the estimates, but they remain substantial.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.05.003.abstractZh: 已有大量文献表明，早期生活健康对成年后的社会经济成果具有重要影响，但关于青少年健康重要性的研究却相对较少。我们通过使用一个涵盖瑞典男性几乎全部人口的唯一且大规模的数据集，研究青少年健康状况对成年劳动力市场结果的影响，为相关研究做出了贡献。我们发现，大多数主要健康状况都会对未来的结果产生长期影响，其中心理健康状况的影响最为显著。即使纳入兄弟姐妹固定效应或双胞胎固定效应，估计值的大小也会有所减小，但这些影响仍然非常显著。

abstract.text: This paper tests whether in utero conditions affect long-run developmental outcomes using the 1918 influenza pandemic in Taiwan as a natural experiment. Combining several historical and current datasets, we find that cohorts in utero during the pandemic are shorter as children/adolescents and less educated compared to other birth cohorts. We also find that they are more likely to have serious health problems including kidney disease, circulatory and respiratory problems, and diabetes in old age. Despite possible positive selection on health outcomes due to high infant mortality rates during this period (18%), our paper finds a strong negative impact of in utero exposure to influenza.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.05.004.abstractZh: 本文通过1918年台湾流感大流行这一自然实验，探讨子宫内环境是否会影响长期发展结果。结合多个历史与当前的数据集，我们发现，在流感大流行期间出生的儿童/青少年身材较矮小，受教育程度也较低。此外，他们晚年出现严重健康问题的可能性更高，包括肾脏疾病、循环系统和呼吸系统问题以及糖尿病。尽管这一时期婴儿死亡率高达18%，可能对健康结果产生积极影响，但本文发现子宫内暴露于流感对健康的负面影响非常显著。

abstract.text: This paper estimates effects of early ADHD medication use on key human capital outcomes for children diagnosed with ADHD while using rarely available register based data on diagnoses and prescription drug purchases. Our main identification strategy exploits plausible exogenous assignment of children to hospitals with specialist physicians, while our analysis of health outcomes also allows for an individual level panel data strategy. We find that the behavior of specialist physicians varies considerably across hospitals and that the prescribing behavior does affect the probability that a given child is treated. Results show that children diagnosed with ADHD in pharmacological treatment have fewer hospital contacts if treated and that treatment to some extent protects against criminal behavior.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.05.005.abstractZh: 本文通过利用较为罕见的基于登记的数据，对早期使用ADHD药物对儿童人力资本关键成果的影响进行了估计。我们主要采用了一种合理的外部分配策略，将儿童分配到有专科医生的医院，同时我们对健康结果的分析也采用了个体层面的面板数据策略。研究发现，专科医生在不同医院的行为存在显著差异，而他们的开药行为确实会影响某个儿童接受治疗的几率。结果表明，接受药物治疗的ADHD患儿在住院次数上较少，且治疗在一定程度上能够预防犯罪行为。

abstract.text: The onset of a health condition during childhood impairs skill formation. A number of studies have investigated the long-lasting effects of poor health during childhood on later-in-life outcomes. However, this evidence ignores how parents respond to the onset of health conditions. Do their investments reinforce the health condition? Or compensate, or behave neutrally? If parents change their investments, the relationship between early health and later outcomes combines the biological effect and the investment responses. To address this question, I use within-sibling variation in the incidence of health conditions to control for selection from unobserved household heterogeneity. Parents invest, on average, 0.16 standard deviations less in children with mental conditions relative to their healthy siblings, using a measure of investment that includes time and resources. On the contrary, when children have a physical condition, parental investments do not differ across siblings. Results are robust to alternative measures of health conditions and the inclusion of child fixed effects.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.05.006.abstractZh: 儿童时期出现的健康状况会损害技能的形成。许多研究探讨了儿童时期健康状况不佳对后期生活结果的长远影响。然而，这些研究忽略了父母对健康状况出现的反应。他们的投资是加剧了健康状况，还是起到了补偿作用，还是表现出了中立态度？如果父母改变他们的投资方式，那么早期健康状况与后期结果之间的关系就会综合考虑生物学效应和投资反应。为了回答这个问题，我利用同辈中健康状况发生率的差异来控制未观察到的家庭异质性带来的选择效应。平均而言，父母在患有精神疾病的孩子身上投入的资源比在健康的兄弟姐妹身上少0.16个标准差，这里的投资包括时间和资源。相反，当孩子患有身体疾病时，父母的投资在兄弟姐妹之间并没有差异。这些结果在采用不同的健康状况衡量标准和纳入儿童固定效应后仍然保持稳定。

abstract.text: To test how practice interruptions affect worker productivity, we estimate how temporal breaks affect surgeons' performance of coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG). Examining 188 surgeons who performed 56,315 CABG surgeries in Pennsylvania between 2006 and 2010, we find that a surgeon's additional day away from the operating room raised patients' inpatient mortality by up to 0.067 percentage points (2.4% relative effect) but reduced total hospitalization costs by up to 0.59 percentage points. Among emergent patients treated by high-volume providers, where temporal distance is most plausibly exogenous, an additional day away raised mortality risk by 0.398 percentage points (11.4% relative effect) but reduced cost by up to 1.4 percentage points. This is consistent with the hypothesis that as temporal distance increases, surgeons are less likely to recognize and address life-threatening complications. Our estimates imply additional intraprocedural treatment intensity has a cost per life-year preserved of $7871-18,500, well within conventional cost-effectiveness cutoffs.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.06.001.abstractZh: 为了测试实践中断如何影响工人生产力，我们研究了时间中断对外科医生进行冠状动脉旁路移植手术（CABG）表现的影响。通过对2006年至2010年间在宾夕法尼亚州进行56,315例CABG手术的188名外科医生的研究，我们发现，外科医生离开手术室一天，患者的住院死亡率会增加高达0.067个百分点（相对效应为2.4%），但总住院费用则会降低高达0.59个百分点。在由高手术量提供者治疗的紧急患者中，时间距离最为可能是外生的因素，这种情况下，额外离开一天会使死亡风险增加0.398个百分点（相对效应为11.4%），但费用则降低至1.4个百分点。这一结果支持了这样的假设：随着时间距离的增加，外科医生更难以识别和处理危及生命的并发症。我们的估计表明，额外的术中治疗强度每延长一个生命年所需的费用为7871至18,500美元，这一费用完全符合传统的成本效益标准。

abstract.text: A major factor weighing down the long-term finances of state and local governments is the obligation to fund retiree benefits. While state and local government pension obligations have been analyzed in great detail, much less attention has been paid to the costs of the other major retiree benefit provided by these governments: retiree health insurance. The first portion of the paper uses the information contained in the annual actuarial reports for public retiree health plans to reverse engineer the cash flows underlying the liabilities given in the report. Obtaining the cash flows allows us to construct liability estimates which are consistent across governments in terms of the discount rate, actuarial method and assumptions concerning medical cost inflation and mortality. We find that the total unfunded accrued liability of state and local governments for the provision of retiree health care exceeds $1 trillion, or about ⅓ of total state and local government revenue. Relative to pension obligations discounted at the same rate, we find that unfunded retiree health care liabilities are ½ the size of unfunded pension obligations. We also find that using assumptions concerning the growth in health care costs that are arguably more realistic than those employed by most states actually reduces the size of the liability in most cases. Pushing in the opposite direction, we find that using plausibly more realistic mortality assumptions increases the size of liability. The second portion of the paper places retiree health care obligations into context by examining the budget pressures associated with retiree health on a continuing, largely pay-as-you go basis. We find that much of the projected increase in retiree health obligations as a share of revenue is the result of health care cost growth. On average, states could put their retiree health obligations into long-run fiscal balance by contributing an additional ¾ percent of total revenue toward the benefit each year. There is, however, wide variation across the states, with the majority of states requiring little in the way of additional financing, but some states requiring a significantly larger increase.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.06.002.abstractZh: 影响州和地方政府长期财务状况的一个重要因素是为退休人员福利提供资金的责任。虽然对州和地方政府养老金义务的详细分析已经很多，但对这些政府提供的另一项主要退休人员福利——退休人员健康保险的成本却鲜有关注。本文的第一部分利用公共退休人员健康计划的年度精算报告中的信息，逆向推导出报告中所述的负债的现金流。通过获取这些现金流，我们可以构建出在折现率、精算方法以及关于医疗费用通胀和死亡率的假设方面与不同政府一致的负债估算。我们发现，州和地方政府在提供退休人员医疗保健方面的未融资应计负债总额超过1万亿美元，约占州和地方政府总收入的⅓。与以相同比率折现的养老金义务相比，我们发现未融资的退休人员医疗保健负债仅为未融资养老金义务的½。我们还发现，使用比大多数州实际采用的更为现实的医疗费用增长假设，可以在大多数情况下减少负债的规模。相反地，使用更为现实的死亡率假设则会增加负债的规模。本文的第二部分通过考察与退休人员健康相关的预算压力，将退休人员医疗保健义务置于更广泛的背景下进行讨论。我们发现，退休人员健康义务在收入中的比例预计增加，很大程度上是由于医疗费用的增长所致。平均而言，各州可以通过将每年额外增加总收入的¾用于支付退休人员福利，来将其健康义务纳入长期财政平衡中。然而，各州之间存在很大差异，大多数州对额外融资的需求很小，而有些州则需要大幅增加资金投入。

abstract.text: An extensive multi-disciplinary literature examines the effects of learning one's HIV status on subsequent risky sexual behaviors. However, many of these studies rely on non-experimental designs; use self-reported outcome measures; or both. In this study, we investigate the effects of a randomly assigned home based HIV testing and counseling (HTC) intervention on risky sexual behaviors and schooling investments among school-age females in Malawi. We find no overall effects on HIV, Herpes Simplex Virus (HSV-2), or achievement test scores at follow-up. However, among the small group of individuals who tested positive for HIV, we find a large increase in the probability of HSV-2 infection, with this effect being stronger among those surprised by their test results. Similarly, those surprised by HIV-negative test results have significantly higher achievement test scores at follow-up, consistent with increased returns to investments in human capital.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.06.003.abstractZh: 大量跨学科的文献研究了了解自身HIV状况对后续风险性行为的影响。然而，许多这类研究依赖于非实验性设计，使用自我报告的结果测量方法，或两者兼用。在本研究中，我们调查了在马拉维，通过随机分配的居家HIV检测与咨询干预措施对学龄女性风险性行为及教育投资的影响。研究发现，在随访期间，HIV、单纯疱疹病毒（HSV-2）或学业成绩方面并未出现整体影响。然而，在那些HIV检测呈阳性的小群体中，我们发现HSV-2感染的概率显著上升，且这种效应在检测结果令人意外的人群中更为明显。同样，那些HIV检测结果为阴性但感到意外的人群，在随访期间的学业成绩也显著提高，这与人力资本投资带来的回报增加相一致。

abstract.text: This paper examines the short- and medium-term effects of the PensionDanmark Health Scheme, the largest privately administered health program for workers in Denmark, which provides prevention and early management of work-related injuries. We use a difference-in-differences approach that exploits a natural variation in the program rollout across collective agreement areas in the construction sector and over time. The results show only little evidence of an effect on the prevention of injuries requiring medical attention in the first 3 years after the program was introduced. Despite this, we find evidence of significant positive effects on several labor market outcomes, suggesting that the program enables some work-injured individuals to maintain their work and earnings capacity. In view of its low costs, the program appears to be cost-effective overall.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.06.004.abstractZh: 本文研究了丹麦最大的私人管理的工人健康计划——PensionDanmark健康计划在短期和中期的影响。该计划提供预防及早期管理工作相关伤害的服务。我们采用了差异-差异分析法，利用建筑行业集体协议区域以及时间上的计划实施差异来进行分析。结果显示，在计划实施后的前三年里，该计划对预防需要医疗处理的伤害几乎没有影响。尽管如此，我们发现该计划对多个劳动力市场结果产生了显著的积极影响，表明该计划使一些因工受伤的人能够保持工作能力和收入。鉴于其较低的成本，该计划总体上具有成本效益。

abstract.text: Assessing the welfare impact of consumer health advisories is a thorny task. Recently, Shimshack and Ward (2010) studied how U.S. households responded to FDA's 2001 mercury-in-fish advisory. They found that the average at-risk household reduced fish consumption by 21%, resulting in a 17%-reduction in mercury exposure at the cost of a 21%-reduction in cardioprotective omega-3 fatty acids. Based on a static assessment of the health costs and benefits Shimshack and Ward concluded that the advisory policy resulted in an overall consumer welfare loss. In this note, we propose a dynamic assessment that links the long-term cardiovascular health effects of the advisory to life-cycle consumption. We find that under reasonable assumptions the welfare loss might be much larger than suggested. Our analysis highlights the importance of accounting for dynamic effects when evaluating persistent changes in exposure to environmental health risks.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.06.005.abstractZh: 评估消费者健康建议对福利的影响是一项棘手的任务。最近，Shimshack和Ward（2010年）研究了美国家庭对美国食品药品监督管理局2001年关于鱼类含汞警告的反应。他们发现，平均而言，处于风险中的家庭减少了21%的鱼类消费，导致汞暴露减少了17%，但心脏保护性的ω-3脂肪酸摄入量则减少了21%。基于静态的健康成本与收益评估，Shimshack和Ward得出结论，该建议政策总体上导致了消费者的福利损失。在本篇论文中，我们提出了一种动态评估方法，将建议政策对长期心血管健康的影响与生命周期中的消费行为联系起来。我们发现，在合理的假设条件下，福利损失可能比预期要大得多。我们的分析强调了在评估环境健康风险持续变化时，考虑动态效应的重要性。

abstract.text: The separate identification of effects due to incentives, selection and preference heterogeneity in insurance markets is the topic of much debate. In this paper, we investigate the presence and variation in moral hazard across health care procedures. The key motivating hypothesis is the expectation of larger causal effects in the case of more discretionary procedures. The empirical approach relies on an extremely rich and extensive dataset constructed by linking survey data to administrative data for hospital medical records. Using this approach we are able to provide credible evidence of large moral hazard effects but for elective surgeries only.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.06.006.abstractZh: 在保险市场中，区分由激励、选择和偏好异质性引起的效应是许多争论的主题。本文研究了医疗程序中存在和变化的道德风险。主要的动机假设是，在更多自由裁量性的医疗程序情况下，预期的因果效应会更大。实证方法依赖于一个极其丰富且广泛的数据集，该数据集通过将调查数据与医院医疗记录的行政数据相结合而构建。利用这种方法，我们能够提供关于选择性手术中道德风险效应较大的可信证据。

abstract.text: Despite its salience as a regulatory tool to ensure the delivery of unprofitable medical services, cross-subsidization of services within hospital systems has been notoriously difficult to detect and quantify. We use repeated shocks to a profitable service in the market for hospital-based medical care to test for cross-subsidization of unprofitable services. Using patient-level data from general short-term hospitals in Arizona and Colorado before and after entry by cardiac specialty hospitals, we study how incumbent hospitals adjusted their provision of three uncontested services that are widely considered to be unprofitable. We estimate that the hospitals most exposed to entry reduced their provision of psychiatric, substance-abuse, and trauma care services at a rate of about one uncontested-service admission for every four cardiac admissions they stood to lose. Although entry by single-specialty hospitals may adversely affect the provision of unprofitable uncontested services, these findings warrant further evaluation of service-line cross-subsidization as a means to finance them.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.06.007.abstractZh: 尽管交叉补贴作为确保提供无利可图的医疗服务的监管工具具有重要意义，但在医院系统内对服务进行交叉补贴的识别和量化却非常困难。我们通过市场对医院医疗服务的盈利服务施加反复冲击，来检验无利可图的服务是否发生了交叉补贴。利用亚利桑那州和科罗拉多州普通短期医院在心脏专科医院进入前后患者的数据，我们研究了现有医院如何调整其提供的三项被认为无利可图的未竞争服务。我们的估计显示，那些最容易受到新医院进入影响的医院，其精神科、药物滥用和创伤护理服务的提供量减少了，比例约为每有四例心脏手术患者入院，就有一起未竞争服务患者入院。虽然单一专科医院进入可能会对无利可图的未竞争服务提供产生不利影响，但这些发现表明，进一步评估服务线交叉补贴作为融资手段的可能性是值得的。

abstract.text: The importation of foreign registered nurses has been used as a strategy to ease nursing shortages in the United States. The effectiveness of this policy depends critically on the long-run response of native nurses. We examine the effects of immigration of foreign-born registered nurses on the long-run employment and occupational choice of native nurses. Using a variety of empirical strategies that exploit the geographical distribution of immigrant nurses across US cities, we find evidence of large displacement effects - over a ten-year period, for every foreign nurse that migrates to a city, between 1 and 2 fewer native nurses are employed in the city. We find similar results using data on nursing board exam-takers at the state level - an increase in the flow of foreign nurses significantly reduces the number of natives sitting for licensure exams in more dependent states relative to less dependent states. Using data on self-reported workplace satisfaction among a sample of California nurses, we find suggestive evidence that part of the displacement effects could be driven by a decline in the perceived quality of the workplace environment.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.06.008.abstractZh: 引进外国注册护士已被用作缓解美国护理短缺的策略。这一政策的有效性在很大程度上取决于本土护士的长期反应。我们研究了外国出生的注册护士的移民对本土护士长期就业和职业选择的影响。通过利用移民护士在美国各城市的地理分布数据，我们发现存在显著的迁移效应——在十年期间，每有1到2名外国护士迁移到一个城市，该城市本土护士的就业人数就会减少1到2人。我们使用州级护理考试考生数据也发现了类似的结果——外国护士的流入显著减少了在依赖程度较高的州参加执照考试的本土护士数量，而在依赖程度较低的州则没有这种影响。通过对加州护士的职场满意度自我报告数据进行分析，我们发现部分迁移效应可能是由于职场环境质量的下降所引发的。

abstract.text: The paper estimates the effect of SO2 pollution on infant mortality in Germany, 1985-2003. To avoid endogeneity problems, I exploit the natural experiment created by the mandated desulfurization at power plants and power plants' location and prevailing wind directions, which together determine treatment intensity for counties. Estimates translate into an elasticity of 0.07-0.13 and the observed reduction in pollution implies an annual gain of 826-1460 infant lives. There is no evidence for disproportionate effects on neonatal mortality, but for an increase in the number of infants with comparatively low birth weight and length.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.06.009.abstractZh: 该论文估计了1985年至2003年间二氧化硫污染对德国婴儿死亡率的影响。为了避免内生性问题，本文利用了发电厂强制脱硫政策所创造的自然实验，以及发电厂的位置和盛行风向等因素，这些因素共同决定了各县的治理强度。估计结果显示，污染影响的弹性为0.07-0.13，而观察到的污染减少意味着每年可挽救826-1460名婴儿的生命。没有证据表明污染对新生儿死亡率有不成比例的影响，但确实增加了体重和身长相对较低的婴儿数量。

abstract.text: The HIV epidemic has dramatically decreased labor supply among prime-age adults in Sub-Saharan Africa. Using within-country variation in regional HIV prevalence and a synthetic panel, I find that HIV significantly increases the capital-labor ratio in urban manufacturing firms. The impact of HIV on average wages is positive but imprecisely estimated. In contrast, HIV has a large positive impact on the skill premium. The impact of HIV on the wages of low skilled workers is insignificantly different from 0, and is strongly dampened by competition from rural migrants. The HIV epidemic disproportionately increases the incomes of high-skilled survivors, thus increasing inequality.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.06.010.abstractZh: 艾滋病疫情在撒哈拉以南非洲的成年劳动力中造成了显著减少。通过利用国内不同地区的艾滋病流行率差异以及综合数据，我发现艾滋病显著增加了城市制造企业的资本劳动比率。艾滋病对平均工资的影响是正面的，但估计精度不高。相比之下，艾滋病对技能溢价的积极影响较大。艾滋病对低技能工人工资的影响几乎为零，并且受到农村移民竞争的强烈抑制。艾滋病疫情不成比例地增加了高技能幸存者的收入，从而加剧了不平等现象。

abstract.text: Employer-provided health insurance for public sector workers is a significant public policy issue. Underfunding and the growing costs of benefits may hinder the fiscal solvency of state and local governments. Findings from the private sector may not be applicable because many public sector workers are covered by union contracts or salary schedules and often benefit modifications require changes in legislation. Research has been limited by the difficulty in obtaining sufficiently large and representative data on public sector employees. This article highlights data sources researchers might utilize to investigate topics concerning health insurance for active and retired public sector employees.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.06.011.abstractZh: 为公共部门员工提供雇主提供的健康保险是一个重要的公共政策问题。资金不足以及福利成本的不断增加可能会影响到州和地方政府的经济偿付能力。私营部门的经验可能并不适用，因为许多公共部门员工受到工会合同或薪资安排的保护，而福利的修改通常需要立法上的变更。由于难以获取足够大且具有代表性的公共部门员工数据，相关研究受到了限制。本文强调了研究人员可以用来研究活跃和退休公共部门员工健康保险相关问题的数据来源。

abstract.text: Priorities for public health innovations are typically not considered equally by all members of the public. When faced with a choice between various innovation options, it is, therefore, possible that some respondents eliminate and/or select innovations based on certain characteristics. This paper proposes a flexible method for exploring and accommodating situations where respondents exhibit such behaviours, whilst addressing preference heterogeneity. We present an empirical case study on the public's preferences for health service innovations. We show that allowing for elimination-by-aspects and/or selection-by-aspects behavioural rules leads to substantial improvements in model fit and, importantly, has implications for willingness to pay estimates and scenario analysis.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.06.012.abstractZh: 在公共卫生创新方面的优先事项通常不会得到所有公众成员的同等重视。当面临多种创新选项时，一些受访者可能会根据某些特征来排除或选择某些创新。本文提出了一种灵活的方法，用于探索并适应这种行为情况，同时考虑偏好异质性。我们通过一个实证案例研究，探讨了公众对卫生服务创新的偏好。研究表明，允许基于特定特征进行排除或选择的这种行为规则，能够显著改善模型的拟合度，并且对支付意愿的估计和情景分析也有重要影响。

abstract.text: The rise of childhood obesity in less developed countries is often overlooked. We study the impact of body weight report cards in Mexico. The report cards increased parental knowledge and shifted parental attitudes about children's weight. We observe no meaningful changes in parental behaviors or children's body mass index. Interestingly, parents of children in the most obese classrooms were less likely to report that their obese child weighed too much relative to those in the least obese classrooms. As obesity rates increase, reference points for appropriate body weights may rise, making it more difficult to lower obesity rates.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.07.001.abstractZh: 在欠发达国家，儿童肥胖问题的上升往往被忽视。我们研究了墨西哥体重报告卡的影响。这些报告卡增加了家长的认知，并改变了家长对孩子体重的态度。然而，我们并未观察到家长行为或儿童体质指数的显著变化。有趣的是，在肥胖最严重的班级中，家长不太可能认为他们的肥胖孩子体重过重，相比之下，在肥胖最少的班级中，家长则更有可能这样认为。随着肥胖率的上升，适当体重的参考标准也可能提高，从而使得降低肥胖率变得更加困难。

abstract.text: Despite progress in air pollution control, concerns remain over the health impact of poor air quality. Governments increasingly issue air quality information to enable vulnerable groups to avoid exposure. Avoidance behaviour potentially biases estimates of the health effects of air pollutants. But avoidance behaviour imposes a cost on individuals and therefore may not be taken in all circumstances. This paper exploits panel data at the English local authority level to estimate the relationship between children's daily hospital emergency admissions for respiratory diseases and common air pollutants, while allowing for avoidance behaviour in response to air pollution warnings. A 1% increase in nitrogen dioxide or ozone concentrations increases hospital admissions by 0.1%. For the subset of asthma admissions - where avoidance is less costly - there is evidence of avoidance behaviour. Ignoring avoidance behaviour, however, does not result in statistically significant underestimation of the health effect of air pollution.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.07.002.abstractZh: 尽管在空气污染控制方面取得了进展，但人们对不良空气质量对健康的影响仍持担忧态度。各国政府越来越多地发布空气质量信息，以帮助弱势群体避免暴露。避免行为可能会扭曲对空气污染物健康影响的估计。然而，避免行为会给个人带来成本，因此并非在所有情况下都适用。本文利用英国地方当局层面的面板数据，研究了儿童因呼吸系统疾病而每日住院急诊次数与常见空气污染物之间的关系，同时考虑了针对空气污染警告采取的避免行为。二氧化氮或臭氧浓度每增加1%，住院次数就会增加0.1%。对于哮喘患者住院的情况——避免行为的成本较低——有证据表明存在避免行为。然而，忽略避免行为并不会导致对空气污染健康影响的统计上显著低估。

abstract.text: More and more states have passed laws that allow individuals to use marijuana for medical purposes. There is an ongoing, heated policy debate over whether these laws have increased marijuana use among non-patients. In this paper, I address that question empirically by studying marijuana possession arrests in cities from 1988 to 2008. I estimate fixed effects models with city-specific time trends that can condition on unobserved heterogeneities across cities in both their levels and trends. I find that these laws increase marijuana arrests among adult males by about 15-20%. These results are further validated by findings from data on treatment admissions to rehabilitation facilities: marijuana treatments among adult males increased by 10-20% after the passage of medical marijuana laws.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.07.003.abstractZh: 越来越多的国家通过了允许个人将大麻用于医疗目的的法律。关于这些法律是否增加了非患者中的大麻使用量，目前正进行着激烈的政策讨论。在本文中，我通过研究1988年至2008年间各城市的大麻持有者逮捕情况，从实证角度探讨了这个问题。我建立了固定效应模型，并考虑了各城市在水平和趋势上的差异。研究发现，这些法律使成年男性中的大麻逮捕率增加了约15-20%。进一步的数据分析也证实了这一结果：在医用大麻法律颁布后，成年男性接受大麻治疗的人数增加了10-20%。

abstract.text: This paper examines the trade-off between wages and employer spending on health insurance for public sector workers, and the relationship between coverage and hours worked. Our primary approach compares trends in wages and hours for public employees with and without state/local government provided health insurance using individual-level micro-data from the 1992-2011 CPS. To adjust for differences between insured and uninsured public sector employees, we create a matched sample based on an employee's propensity to receive health insurance. We assess the relationship between state contribution to the health plan premium, state-level healthcare spending, and the wages and hours of state and local government employees. We find modest reductions in wages are associated with having employer-sponsored health insurance (ESHI), although this effect is not precisely measured. The reduction in wages associated with having ESHI is larger among non-unionized workers. Further, we find little evidence that provision of health insurance increases hours worked.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2014.08.001.abstractZh: 本文探讨了公共部门员工工资与雇主在健康保险方面的支出之间的权衡关系，以及保险覆盖程度与工作时间之间的联系。我们的主要方法是通过1992-2011年CPS的微观数据，比较有和没有州/地方政府提供健康保险的公共部门员工的工资和工作时间趋势。为了调整有保险和无保险公共部门员工之间的差异，我们根据员工获得健康保险的倾向创建了一个匹配样本。我们评估了州政府对健康计划保费的贡献、州级医疗保健支出，以及州和地方政府员工工资和工作时间之间的关系。我们发现，拥有雇主赞助的健康保险（ESHI）会导致工资略有下降，尽管这一效应并未被精确测量。与非工会员工相比，拥有ESHI的员工工资下降幅度更大。此外，我们几乎没有证据表明提供健康保险会增加工作时间。

abstract.text: The least productive agents in an economy can be vital in generating growth by spurring technology diffusion. We develop an analytically tractable model in which growth is created as a positive externality from risk taking by firms at the bottom of the productivity distribution imitating more productive firms. Heterogeneous firms choose to produce or pay a cost and search within the economy to upgrade their technology. Sustained growth comes from the feedback between the endogenously determined distribution of productivity, as evolved from past search decisions, and an optimal, forward-looking search policy. The growth rate depends on characteristics of the productivity distribution, with a thicker-tailed distribution leading to more growth.

10.1086/674362.abstractZh: 在一个经济体中，生产力最低的企业通过促进技术扩散，能够成为推动经济增长的关键力量。我们构建了一个分析上可行的模型，其中增长是由处于生产力分布底部、模仿更高效企业的企业承担风险所带来的正外部性所创造的。不同性质的企业会选择生产或支付成本，并在经济体内寻找升级技术的方法。持续的增长来源于由过去的搜索决策所决定的生产力分布与最优的、具有前瞻性的搜索策略之间的反馈关系。增长率取决于生产力分布的特征，分布越厚尾，增长潜力就越大。

abstract.text: We analyze a model economy with many agents, each with a different productivity level. Agents divide their time between two activities: producing goods with the production-related knowledge they already have and interacting with others in search of new, productivity-increasing ideas. These choices jointly determine the economy's current production level and its rate of learning and real growth. We construct the balanced growth path for this economy. We also study the allocation chosen by an idealized planner who takes into account and internalizes the external benefits of search. Finally, we provide three examples of alternative learning technologies and show that the properties of equilibrium allocations are quite sensitive to two of these variations.

10.1086/674363.abstractZh: 我们分析了一个由多个主体组成的模型经济，每个主体具有不同的生产力水平。这些主体将时间分配在两项活动中：利用他们已有的生产相关知识生产商品，以及与他人互动以寻求新的、能提升生产力的想法。这些选择共同决定了经济的当前生产水平、学习速度以及实际的增长情况。我们为这个经济构建了平衡增长路径。此外，我们还研究了一个理想化规划者所选择的分配方案，该规划者考虑了搜索带来的外部收益，并将其内部化。最后，我们提供了三个不同学习技术的例子，并表明均衡分配的属性对这些变化中的两种变化非常敏感。

abstract.text: We develop a theory of capital controls as dynamic terms-of-trade manipulation. We study an infinite-horizon endowment economy with two countries. One country chooses taxes on international capital flows in order to maximize the welfare of its representative agent, while the other country is passive. We show that a country growing faster than the rest of the world has incentives to promote domestic savings by taxing capital inflows or subsidizing capital outflows. Although our theory of capital controls emphasizes interest rate manipulation, the pattern of borrowing and lending, per se, is irrelevant.

10.1086/674425.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种将资本管制视为动态贸易条款操纵的理论。我们研究了一个包含两个国家的无限期限 endowment 经济模型。其中一个国家通过征收国际资本流动税来最大化其代表代理人的福利，而另一个国家则保持被动状态。我们表明，一个发展速度超过世界其他地区的国家有动机通过征收资本流入税或补贴资本流出来促进国内储蓄。尽管我们的资本管制理论强调利率操纵，但借贷模式本身并不重要。

abstract.text: We study the impact of labor market frictions on asset prices. In the cross section of US firms, a 10 percentage point increase in the firm's hiring rate is associated with a 1.5 percentage point decrease in the firm's annual risk premium. We propose an investment-based model with stochastic labor adjustment costs to explain this finding. Firms with high hiring rates are expanding firms that incur high adjustment costs. If the economy experiences a shock that lowers adjustment costs, these firms benefit the most. The corresponding increase in firm value operates as a hedge against these shocks, explaining the lower risk premium of these firms in equilibrium.

10.1086/674549.abstractZh: 我们研究了劳动力市场摩擦对资产价格的影响。在美国企业的横截面数据中，企业招聘率增加10个百分点，其年度风险溢价就会下降1.5个百分点。我们提出了一个基于投资的模型，并考虑了随机的劳动力调整成本，以解释这一发现。招聘率较高的企业会扩大规模，从而承担较高的调整成本。如果经济出现冲击导致调整成本降低，这些企业将受益最大。企业价值的相应增加可以作为对这些冲击的对冲手段，从而解释了这些企业在均衡状态下风险溢价较低的原因。

abstract.text: This article proposes an efficient and incentive compatible dynamic auction for selling multiple complementary goods. The seller has reserve prices. The auctioneer announces a current price for every bundle of goods and a supply set of goods, every bidder responds with a set of goods demanded at these prices, and the auctioneer adjusts prices. We prove that even when bidders can exercise their market power strategically, this dynamic auction always induces them to bid truthfully, resulting in an efficient allocation, its supporting Walrasian equilibrium price for every bundle of goods, and a generalized Vickrey-Clarke-Groves payment for every bidder.

10.1086/674550.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种高效且激励相容的动态拍卖机制，用于销售多种互补商品。卖方拥有保留价格。拍卖师会公布每套商品的当前价格以及可供出售的商品组合，每个竞买者会根据这些价格提出自己需求的商品组合，拍卖师随后会调整价格。我们证明，即使竞买者能够战略性地运用市场力量，这种动态拍卖机制仍会促使他们如实出价，从而实现有效的资源配置。每套商品的价格都符合瓦尔拉斯均衡价格，而每个竞买者则获得广义的维克里-克拉克-格罗夫斯支付。

abstract.text: There is wide variation in the sizes of manufacturing plants, even within the most narrowly defined industry classifications. Standard theories attribute such size differences to productivity differences. This paper develops an alternative theory in which industries are made up of large plants producing standardized goods and small plants making custom or specialty goods. It uses confidential census data to estimate the parameters of the model. The model fits the data well. In particular, the predictions of the model regarding the effect of a surge of imports from China are consistent with what happened over the period 1997-2007.

10.1086/674633.abstractZh: 制造业工厂的规模存在很大差异，即使是在最狭义的行业分类中也是如此。传统理论认为这种规模差异是由于生产效率的不同造成的。本文提出了另一种理论，认为行业由生产标准化产品的大型工厂和制造定制或特殊产品的小型工厂组成。本文利用机密的人口普查数据来估计模型的参数。模型与数据非常吻合。特别是，模型对来自中国的进口激增影响的预测与1997-2007年期间的实际情况一致。

abstract.text: We estimate and test the restrictions of a collective model of household consumption, using z-conditional demands, in the context of a large conditional cash transfer program in rural Mexico. The model can explain the impacts of the program on the structure of food consumption. We use two plausible and novel distribution factors: the random allocation of a cash transfer to women and the relative size and wealth of the husband's and wife's family networks. Our structure does better at predicting the effect of exogenous increases in household income than an alternative, unitary, structure. We cannot reject efficiency of household decisions.

10.1086/674968.abstractZh: 我们估计并测试了家庭消费集体模型的限制条件，使用条件需求模型，在墨西哥农村一项大规模条件性现金转移计划的背景下进行研究。该模型能够解释该计划对食品消费结构的影响。我们采用了两个新颖且合理的分配因素：现金转移对女性的随机分配，以及丈夫和妻子家庭网络的相对规模和财富。我们的模型在预测家庭收入外源性增加的影响方面，表现得比另一种单一模型更为出色。我们无法否定家庭决策的效率。

abstract.text: We study the effect of constraints on chiefs' power on economic outcomes, citizens' attitudes, and social capital. A paramount chief in Sierra Leone must come from a ruling family originally recognized by British colonial authorities. In chiefdoms with fewer ruling families, chiefs face less political competition, and development outcomes are significantly worse today. Variation in the security of property rights over land is a potential mechanism. Paradoxically, with fewer ruling families, the institutions of chiefs' authority are more highly respected, and measured social capital is higher. We argue that these results reflect the capture of civil society organizations by chiefs.

10.1086/674988.abstractZh: 我们研究了约束条件对酋长权力、经济成果、公民态度和社会资本的影响。在塞拉利昂，最高酋长必须来自英国殖民当局认可的统治家族。在统治家族较少的酋长制度中，酋长面临的政治竞争较少，因此当前的发展成果明显较差。财产权在土地上的安全程度差异可能是其中的一个潜在机制。矛盾的是，随着统治家族的减少，酋长权力的制度受到更高的尊重，衡量出的社会资本也更高。我们认为，这些结果反映了民间社会组织被酋长所掌控的情况。

abstract.text: This paper distinguishes between the human capital and signaling theories by estimating the earnings return to a high school diploma. Unlike most indicators of education (e.g., a year of school), a diploma is essentially a piece of paper and, hence, by itself cannot affect productivity. Any earnings return to holding a diploma must therefore reflect the diploma's signaling value. Using regression discontinuity methods to compare the earnings of workers who barely passed and barely failed high school exit exams--standardized tests that students must pass to earn a high school diploma--we find little evidence of diploma signaling effects.

10.1086/675238.abstractZh: 本文通过估计高中毕业文凭所带来的收入回报，区分了人力资本理论与信号传递理论。与大多数教育指标（例如，一年的学校教育）不同，文凭本身只是一张纸，因此无法直接影响生产力。持有文凭所带来的收入回报，必须反映文凭的信号传递价值。通过回归不连续方法，比较那些勉强通过或勉强未通过高中毕业考试（学生必须通过这些考试才能获得高中文凭）的工人的收入情况，我们发现几乎没有文凭信号传递效应的证据。

abstract.text: I develop and estimate a structural equilibrium model of the college market. Students, having heterogeneous abilities and preferences, make application decisions subject to uncertainty and application costs. Colleges, observing noisy measures of student ability, choose tuition and admissions policies to compete for better students. Tuition, applications, admissions, and enrollment are joint equilibrium outcomes. I estimate the model using the NLSY97 via a three-step procedure to deal with potential multiple equilibria. I use the model to examine the extent to which college enrollment can be increased by expanding college supply and to assess the importance of various measures of student ability.

10.1086/675503.abstractZh: 我开发并估计了一个关于大学市场的结构均衡模型。学生由于能力与偏好存在差异，在面临不确定性和申请成本的情况下做出申请决策。大学通过观测学生能力的模糊指标，选择学费和招生政策以争夺优质学生。学费、申请、招生和注册是共同均衡的结果。我采用NLSY97方法，通过三步流程来估计模型，以处理潜在的多个均衡问题。利用该模型，我研究了通过增加大学供给来提高大学入学率的可能性，并评估了不同学生能力衡量指标的重要性。

abstract.text: Large cities produce more output per capita than small cities. This higher productivity may occur because more talented individuals sort into large cities, because large cities select more productive entrepreneurs and firms, or because of agglomeration economies. We develop a model of systems of cities that combines all three elements and suggests interesting complementarities between them. The model can replicate stylized facts about sorting, agglomeration, and selection in cities. It also generates Zipf's law for cities under empirically plausible parameter values. Finally, it provides a useful framework within which to reinterpret extant empirical evidence.

10.1086/675534.abstractZh: 大城市的人均产出比小城市更高。这种更高的生产率可能是由于更有才华的个体更倾向于选择大城市，或者因为大城市能够吸引更多有生产力的企业家和企业，或是由于集聚经济效应。我们建立了一个城市系统模型，将这三种因素结合起来，并发现它们之间存在有趣的互补性。该模型能够再现关于城市中的选择、集聚和排序的著名现象。此外，该模型还能在符合实证数据的参数值下生成Zipf定律。最后，该模型为重新解释现有的实证证据提供了一个有用的框架。

abstract.text: We study business cycle variation in individual earnings risk using a confidential and very large data set from the US Social Security Administration. Contrary to past research, we find that the variance of idiosyncratic shocks is not countercyclical. Instead, it is the left-skewness of shocks that is strongly countercyclical: during recessions, large upward earnings movements become less likely, whereas large drops in earnings become more likely. Second, we find that the fortunes during recessions are predictable by observable characteristics before the recession. Finally, the cyclicality of earnings risk is dramatically different for the top 1 percent compared with the rest of the population.

10.1086/675535.abstractZh: 我们利用美国社会保障局提供的机密且庞大的数据集，研究了个体收入风险中的商业周期变化。与以往的研究不同，我们发现特异性冲击的方差并不呈现反周期性。相反，冲击的左偏态特征具有强烈的反周期性：在经济衰退期间，收入大幅上升的可能性降低，而收入大幅下降的可能性增加。其次，我们发现经济衰退期间的情况可以通过经济衰退前的可观测特征来预测。最后，收入风险的经济周期性对于收入最高的1%人群与其他人群来说有着显著的不同。

abstract.text: We measure the capitalization of housing market externalities into residential housing values by studying the unanticipated elimination of stringent rent controls in Cambridge, Massachusetts, in 1995. Pooling data on the universe of assessed values and transacted prices of Cambridge residential properties between 1988 and 2005, we find that rent decontrol generated substantial, robust price appreciation at decontrolled units and nearby never-controlled units, accounting for a quarter of the $7.8 billion in Cambridge residential property appreciation during this period. The majority of this contribution stems from induced appreciation of never-controlled properties. Residential investment explains only a small fraction of the total.

10.1086/675536.abstractZh: 我们通过研究1995年马萨诸塞州剑桥市取消严格的租金管制这一未预料到的事件，来衡量住房市场外部性对住宅价值的影响。通过对1988年至2005年间剑桥住宅物业的评估价值和交易价格的数据进行汇总分析，我们发现租金管制取消后，未受管制区域的房产以及邻近未受管制区域的房产都出现了显著且稳定的价格上升。这一变化占当时剑桥住宅物业价值增长78亿美元的四分之一。其中，大部分增长来自未受管制区域的房产价格提升。住宅投资仅占总增长的很小一部分。

abstract.text: During the Age of Mass Migration (1850-1913), the United States maintained an open border, absorbing 30 million European immigrants. Prior cross-sectional work finds that immigrants initially held lower-paid occupations than natives but converged over time. In newly assembled panel data, we show that, in fact, the average immigrant did not face a substantial occupation-based earnings penalty upon first arrival and experienced occupational advancement at the same rate as natives. Cross-sectional patterns are driven by biases from declining arrival cohort skill level and departures of negatively selected return migrants. We show that assimilation patterns vary substantially across sending countries and persist in the second generation.

10.1086/675805.abstractZh: 在大规模移民时代（1850-1913年），美国保持开放边境，接纳了3000万欧洲移民。先前的研究发现，移民最初从事的职业收入低于本地人，但随着时间的推移，两者逐渐趋同。通过新收集的数据分析，我们发现实际上，平均移民在首次抵达时并未面临显著的职业收入损失，并且其职业晋升速度与本地人相当。这种跨-sectional模式是由移民群体技能水平下降以及负面选择的移民行为所驱动的。我们还发现，移民的同化模式在不同派遣国之间存在显著差异，并且这种趋势会延续到第二代移民身上。

abstract.text: We investigate the role of skill complementarities in production and mobility across cities. The nature of the complementarities determines the equilibrium skill distribution across cities. With extreme-skill complementarity, the skill distribution has thicker tails in large cities; with top-skill complementarity, there is first-order stochastic dominance. Using wage and housing price data, we find robust evidence of thick tails in large cities: large cities disproportionately attract both high- and low-skilled workers, while average skills are constant across city size. This pattern of spatial sorting is consistent with extreme-skill complementarity, where the productivity of high-skilled workers and of the providers of low-skilled services are mutually enhanced.

10.1086/676141.abstractZh: 我们研究了技能互补性在生产和城市间流动中的作用。互补性的性质决定了城市间技能分布的均衡状态。在极端技能互补性下，大城市的技能分布具有更厚的尾部；而在顶尖技能互补性下，则存在一阶随机优势。通过工资和房价数据，我们发现大城市的技能分布确实具有厚尾特征：大城市不成比例地吸引高技能和低技能工人，而平均技能水平则随城市规模保持不变。这种空间排序模式与极端技能互补性一致，即高技能工人的生产效率和低技能服务的提供者能够相互促进。

abstract.text: We model intergroup conflict driven by economic changes within groups. We show that if group incomes are low, increasing group incomes raises violence against that group and lowers violence generated by it. We then apply the model to data on Hindu-Muslim violence in India. Our main result is that an increase in per capita Muslim expenditures generates a large and significant increase in future religious conflict. An increase in Hindu expenditures has a negative or no effect. These findings speak to the origins of Hindu-Muslim violence in post-Independence India.

10.1086/676316.abstractZh: 我们构建了一种模型，用于分析由经济变化引发的群体间冲突。研究发现，如果群体收入较低，提高群体收入会加剧针对该群体的暴力行为，同时也会降低该群体自身引发的暴力行为。随后，我们将该模型应用于印度印度教与穆斯林之间的暴力事件数据。我们的主要结论是，穆斯林人均支出的增加会显著增加未来宗教冲突的发生概率；而印度教支出的增加则会产生负面效果或甚至无效果。这些发现揭示了印度独立后印度教与穆斯林暴力冲突的成因。

abstract.text: This paper considers when a firm's deliberately chosen name can signal meaningful information. The average plumbing firm whose name begins with A or a number receives five times more service complaints than other firms and also charges higher prices. Relatedly, plumbers with A names advertise more in the Yellow Pages and on Google, and doing so is positively correlated with receiving complaints. As the use of A names is more prevalent in larger markets, I reconcile these findings with a simple model in which firms have different qualities and consumers have heterogeneous search costs.
