10.1086/676333.abstractZh: 本文探讨了企业刻意选择的名称是否能够传递有意义的信息。名称以字母A或数字开头的普通管道维修公司，其服务投诉数量比其他公司多五倍，并且收费也更高。与此相关的是，名称中包含字母A的管道工在《黄页》和谷歌上的广告更多，而这种行为与收到投诉之间存在正相关关系。由于字母A的名称在较大市场中更为常见，我将这些发现与一个简单的模型进行了整合，该模型假设企业具有不同的特性，而消费者的搜索成本也各不相同。

abstract.text: We study the wealth accumulation of Indian state politicians using public disclosures required of all candidates. The annual asset growth of winners is 3-5 percent higher than that of runners-up, a difference that holds also in a set of close elections. The relative asset growth of winners is greater in more corrupt states and for those holding ministerial positions. These results are consistent with a rent-seeking explanation for the relatively high rate of growth in winners' assets.

10.1086/676334.abstractZh: 我们研究了印度国家政治人物的财富积累情况，通过分析所有候选人必须公开的信息来进行研究。获胜者的年度资产增长比落选者高出3-5%，在竞争激烈的选举中这一差距依然明显。在腐败程度较高的州以及担任部长职务的人中，获胜者的相对资产增长更为显著。这些结果支持了“寻租行为”作为获胜者资产增长较快原因的解释。

abstract.text: The paper presents a positive model of policy formation in federal legislatures when delegates engage in the strategic exchange of policy-relevant information. Depending on the type of policy under consideration, communication between delegates generally suffers from a bias that makes truthful communication difficult and sometimes impossible. This generates inefficient federal policy choices that are often endogenously characterized by overspending, universalism, and uniformity. Building on these findings, I develop a theory of fiscal (de-)centralization, which revisits the work of Oates in a world of incomplete information and strategic communication. Empirical results from a cross section of US municipalities are consistent with the predicted pattern of spending.

10.1086/676404.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个积极的政策形成模型，该模型假设联邦立法机构的代表之间进行政策相关信息的战略性交流。根据所考虑的政策类型，代表之间的沟通通常会受到某种偏见的影响，这使得真实信息的交流变得困难，有时甚至不可能进行。这种状况导致了联邦政策的低效选择，这些政策往往具有过度支出、普遍主义以及一致性等内在特征。基于这些发现，我提出了一个关于财政（去）中心化的理论，该理论重新探讨了在信息不完整和战略沟通环境下的Oates的研究。来自美国多个市镇的实证结果与预测的支出模式一致。

abstract.text: Investment of US firms responds asymmetrically to Tobin's Q: investment of established firms--"intensive" investment--reacts negatively to Q whereas investment of new firms--"extensive" investment--responds positively and elastically to Q. This asymmetry, we argue, reflects a difference between established and new firms in the cost of adopting new technologies. A fall in the compatibility of new capital with old capital raises measured Q and reduces the incentive of established firms to invest. New firms do not face such compatibility costs and step up their investment in response to the rise in Q.

10.1086/676405.abstractZh: 美国企业的投资对托宾Q值反应不对称：老牌企业的“密集型”投资对Q值反应消极，而新企业的“扩展性”投资则对Q值有积极且弹性的反应。我们认为，这种不对称性反映了老牌企业与新企业在采用新技术成本上的差异。新资本与旧资本的兼容性降低会提升托宾Q值，从而减少老牌企业的投资意愿。而新企业不会面临这样的兼容性成本，因此会在Q值上升时加大投资力度。

abstract.text: Cities are neither completely specialized nor completely diverse. However, prior research has focused almost entirely on the polar cases of complete specialization and complete diversity. This paper develops a model that can also generate the intermediate case of cities that feature the coagglomeration of some but not all industries, thus giving theoretical foundations to the analysis of business clusters. The analysis sharply challenges the conventional wisdom that the size and composition of cities are necessarily driven primarily by agglomerative efficiencies.

10.1086/676557.abstractZh: 城市既不是完全专业化的，也不是完全多样化的。然而，以往的研究几乎完全集中在完全专业化和完全多样化的极端情况上。本文提出了一个模型，该模型能够模拟城市中某些行业聚集而其他行业不聚集的中间状态，从而为商业集群的分析提供了理论依据。该分析显著挑战了传统观点，即城市的规模和构成必然是由聚集效率所驱动的。

abstract.text: We study a novel mechanism design model in which agents each arrive sequentially and choose one action from a set of actions with unknown rewards. The information revealed by the principal affects the incentives of the agents to explore and generate new information. We characterize the optimal disclosure policy of a planner whose goal is to maximize social welfare. One interpretation of our result is the implementation of what is known as the "wisdom of the crowd." This topic has become increasingly relevant with the rapid spread of the Internet over the past decade.

10.1086/676597.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个新颖的机制设计模型，在该模型中，代理人依次到达，并从一组具有未知奖励的行动中选择一个行动。委托人透露的信息会影响代理人探索和生成新信息的动机。我们描述了一种规划者的最优披露策略，其目标是最大化社会福利。我们的结果可以解释为实现了所谓的“群体智慧”。随着过去十年互联网的迅速普及，这一主题变得越来越重要。

abstract.text: We consider mechanism design in which message sets are restricted owing to communication costs, preventing full revelation of information. A principal contracts with multiple agents each supplying a one-dimensional good at a privately known cost. We characterize optimal mechanisms subject to incentive and communication constraints, without imposing arbitrary restrictions on the number of communication rounds. We show that mechanisms that centralize production decisions are strictly dominated by those that decentralize decision-making authority to agents, and optimal communication mechanisms maximize information exchanged directly among agents. Conditions are provided for these to involve gradual release of information over multiple rounds either simultaneously or sequentially.

10.1086/676931.abstractZh: 我们考虑了由于通信成本限制而限制信息集的机制设计问题，这阻碍了信息的完全披露。一个主体与多个代理人签订合同，每个代理人以私人知晓的成本提供一种一维商品。我们描述了在激励和通信约束下的最优机制，同时不对通信轮数施加任意限制。我们表明，集中生产决策的机制被那些将决策权分散给代理人的机制严格地所取代，而最优的通信机制则最大化了代理人之间直接交换的信息量。我们为这些机制提供了条件，使得信息可以在多个轮次中逐步释放，无论是同时还是依次进行。

abstract.text: We evaluate the impact on crime of a localized policing experiment that depenalized the possession of small quantities of cannabis in the London borough of Lambeth. We find that depenalization policy caused the police to reallocate effort toward nondrug crime. Despite the overall fall in crime attributable to the policy, we find that the total welfare of local residents likely fell, as measured by house prices. We shed light on what would be the impacts on crime of a citywide depenalization policy by developing and calibrating a structural model of the market for cannabis and crime.

10.1086/676932.abstractZh: 我们评估了在伦敦兰贝斯区实施对少量大麻持有行为进行非刑事化处理的局部警务实验对犯罪的影响。研究发现，非刑事化政策导致警方将精力重新分配到非毒品犯罪上。尽管该政策总体上降低了犯罪率，但我们发现当地居民的整体福利可能有所下降，这可以从房价的变化中看出。通过构建并校准一个关于大麻和犯罪市场的结构模型，我们进一步探讨了在全市范围内实施非刑事化政策对犯罪的影响。

abstract.text: We investigate the role of dynamic production inputs and their associated adjustment costs in shaping the dispersion of static measures of capital misallocation within industries (and countries). Across nine data sets spanning 40 countries, we find that industries exhibiting greater time-series volatility of productivity have greater cross-sectional dispersion of the marginal revenue product of capital. We use a standard investment model with adjustment costs to show that variation in the volatility of productivity across these industries and economies can explain a large share (80-90 percent) of the cross-industry (and cross-country) variation in the dispersion of the marginal revenue product of capital.

10.1086/677072.abstractZh: 我们研究了动态生产投入及其相关调整成本在塑造行业（及国家）内资本错配静态指标分散性中的作用。通过对涵盖40个国家的9个数据集的研究，我们发现，生产率的时间序列波动性较大的行业，其资本边际收益产品的横截面分散性也更大。我们采用带有调整成本的标准投资模型表明，这些行业和经济体中生产率波动性的变化可以解释资本边际收益产品分散性跨行业（及跨国）变化中的大部分（80-90%）。

abstract.text: Which and how many attributes are relevant for the sorting of agents in a matching market? This paper addresses these questions by constructing indices of mutual attractiveness that aggregate information about agents' attributes. The first k indices for agents on each side of the market provide the best approximation of the matching surplus by a k-dimensional model. The methodology is applied on a unique Dutch household survey containing information about education, height, body mass index, health, attitude toward risk, and personality traits of spouses.

10.1086/677191.abstractZh: 在匹配市场中，哪些属性以及有多少属性对代理人的排序是相关的？本文通过构建相互吸引力的指数来解答这些问题，这些指数汇总了关于代理人属性的信息。市场中每一方的前k个指数能够用k维模型最好地近似匹配收益。该方法被应用于一项独特的荷兰家庭调查，该调查包含了关于配偶的教育程度、身高、体重指数、健康状况、风险态度以及人格特征的信息。

abstract.text: Consumers purchase multiple types of goods but may be able to examine only a limited number of markets for the best price. We propose a simple model that captures these features, conveying new insights. A firm's price can deflect or draw attention to its market, and consequently, limited attention introduces a new dimension of cross-market competition. We characterize the equilibrium and show that having partially attentive consumers improves consumer welfare. With less attention, consumers are more likely to miss the best offers; but enhanced cross-market competition decreases average price paid, as leading firms try to stay under the consumers' radar.

10.1086/677253.abstractZh: 消费者会购买多种类型的商品，但可能只能考察有限数量的市场以寻找最优惠的价格。我们提出了一个简单的模型来捕捉这些特征，从而带来新的见解。企业的定价可以吸引或转移消费者的注意力，因此，有限的注意力引入了一个新的跨市场竞争维度。我们描述了均衡状态，并表明部分注意力集中的消费者能够提高消费者福利。当注意力减少时，消费者更有可能错过最优惠的报价；但增强的跨市场竞争会降低平均支付价格，因为领先企业会努力避免被消费者注意到。

abstract.text: This study explores the tension between the standard economic theory of preference and nonstandard theories of preference that are motivated by an underlying theory of framing. A simple experiment fails to measure a known preference. The divergence of the measured preference from the known preference reflects a mistake, arising from some subjects' misconception of the game form. We conclude that choice data should not be granted an unqualified interpretation of preference revelation. Mistakes in choices obscured by a possible error at the foundation of the theory of framing can masquerade as having been produced by nonstandard preferences.

10.1086/677254.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了标准经济理论中的偏好理论与由框架理论所驱动的非标准偏好理论之间的紧张关系。一个简单的实验无法准确测量已知的偏好。测量到的偏好与已知偏好之间的偏差反映了一种错误，这种错误源于部分受试者对游戏形式的误解。我们得出结论，选择数据不应被无条件地解释为偏好揭示的结果。在框架理论基础可能存在的错误所掩盖的选择中，错误可能被伪装成非标准偏好所产生。

abstract.text: Using rich data linking federal cases from arrest through to sentencing, we find that initial case and defendant characteristics, including arrest offense and criminal history, can explain most of the large raw racial disparity in federal sentences, but significant gaps remain. Across the distribution, blacks receive sentences that are almost 10 percent longer than those of comparable whites arrested for the same crimes. Most of this disparity can be explained by prosecutors' initial charging decisions, particularly the filing of charges carrying mandatory minimum sentences. Ceteris paribus, the odds of black arrestees facing such a charge are 1.75 times higher than those of white arrestees.

10.1086/677255.abstractZh: 通过利用从逮捕到判决过程中丰富的数据，我们发现初始案件特征和被告特征，包括逮捕罪名和犯罪历史，可以解释联邦判决中大部分严重的种族差异。然而，仍然存在显著的差距。总体而言，黑人面临的判决时间比同罪白人高出近10%。这种差异在很大程度上可以由检察官的初始指控决定来解释，尤其是那些涉及强制最低刑罚的指控。在其他条件相同的情况下，黑人被捕者面临此类指控的概率比白人高出1.75倍。

abstract.text: Research. NBER working papers are circulated for discussion and comment purposes. They have not been peer-reviewed or been subject to the review by the NBER Board of Directors that accompanies official NBER publications.

10.1086/678456.abstractZh: 研究。NBER工作论文是为了供讨论和评论而发布的。这些论文未经同行评审，也没有经过NBER董事会的审核，而官方NBER出版物则经过这一审核过程。

abstract.text: We study the end of race-based busing in Charlotte-Mecklenburg schools (CMS). In 2001, school boundaries in CMS were redrawn dramatically, and half of students received a new assignment. Using addresses measured prior to the policy change, we compare students in the same neighborhood that lived on opposite sides of a newly drawn boundary. We find that both white and minority students score lower on high school exams when they are assigned to schools with more minority students. We also find decreases in high school graduation and four-year college attendance for whites and large increases in crime for minority males. We conclude that the end of race-based busing widened racial inequality, despite efforts by CMS to mitigate the effect of segregation through compensatory resource allocation.

10.1093/qje/qjt026.abstractZh: 我们研究了夏洛特-梅克伦堡学区（CMS）中基于种族的校车服务的终结情况。2001年，该学区的学校边界发生了重大调整，一半的学生被重新分配到了新的学校。通过对比政策变更前的学生住址，我们发现位于新边界两侧的同一条社区的学生在高中考试中的成绩都较低。此外，我们还发现，被分配到有更多少数族裔学生的学校中的白人和少数族裔学生的高中毕业率和四年制大学入学率都有所下降，而少数族裔男性的犯罪率则大幅上升。因此，尽管CMS通过补偿性资源分配来减轻隔离的影响，但基于种族的校车服务终结仍然加剧了种族不平等。

abstract.text: Is monetary policy less effective at increasing real output during periods of high volatility than during normal times? In this article, I argue that greater volatility leads to an increase in aggregate price flexibility so that nominal stimulus mostly generates inflation rather than output growth. To do this, I construct price-setting models with “volatility shocks” and show these models match new facts in CPI micro data that standard price-setting models miss. I then show that these models imply that output responds less to nominal stimulus during times of high volatility. Furthermore, because volatility is countercyclical, this implies that nominal stimulus has smaller real effects during downturns. For example, the estimated output response to additional nominal stimulus in September 1995, a time of low volatility, is 55% larger than the response in October 2001, a time of high volatility.

10.1093/qje/qjt027.abstractZh: 在高波动性时期，货币政策在增加实际产出方面是否不如正常时期有效？本文认为，更高的波动性会导致总体价格灵活性的增加，从而使名义刺激措施主要引发通货膨胀而非产出增长。为此，我构建了包含“波动性冲击”的价格设定模型，并证明这些模型能够解释CPI微观数据中的新现象，而这些现象是标准价格设定模型无法解释的。此外，这些模型还表明，在高波动性时期，产出对名义刺激的反应较小。由于波动性具有反周期性，这意味着名义刺激在经济衰退期间的实际效果较小。例如，在1995年9月波动性较低时，额外名义刺激对产出的影响比2001年10月波动性较高时大55%。

abstract.text: The Voting Rights Act of 1965, called one of the most effective pieces of civil rights legislation in U.S. history, generated dramatic increases in black voter registration across the South. We ask whether the increase in black voting rights was accompanied by an increase in blacks’ share of public spending. We exploit a key provision of the act—removal of literacy tests at registration—for identification. Employing a triple-difference framework over a 20-year period, we find that counties with higher black population shares in former literacy test states saw greater increases in both voter turnout and state transfers than comparison counties in non–literacy test states, a finding that is consistent with models of distributive politics.

10.1093/qje/qjt028.abstractZh: 1965年的《投票权法案》被誉为美国历史上最有效的民权立法之一，该法案显著增加了南方黑人的选民登记数量。我们探讨的是，黑人投票权的增加是否伴随着黑人公共支出份额的上升。我们利用该法案的一项关键条款——取消选民登记时的识字测试——来进行分析。通过20年的数据对比，我们发现，在以前实行识字测试的州中，黑人人口比例较高的县在选民投票率和州政府转移支付方面都有更大的增长，这一发现与分配政治模型的结果一致。

abstract.text: We investigate the role of national institutions on subnational African development in a novel framework that accounts for both local geography and cultural-genetic traits. We exploit the fact that the political boundaries on the eve of African independence partitioned more than 200 ethnic groups across adjacent countries subjecting similar cultures, residing in homogeneous geographic areas, to different formal institutions. Using both a matching type and a spatial regression discontinuity approach we show that differences in countrywide institutional structures across the national border do not explain within-ethnicity differences in economic performance, as captured by satellite images of light density. The average noneffect of national institutions on ethnic development masks considerable heterogeneity partially driven by the diminishing role of national institutions in areas further from the capital cities.

10.1093/qje/qjt029.abstractZh: 我们在一个新的框架内研究了国家机构对非洲次国家发展的影响，该框架同时考虑了当地地理特征和文化-遗传特性。我们利用这样一个事实：在非洲独立前夕，政治边界将200多个民族划分到相邻的国家中，这些民族拥有相似的文化，居住在相同的地理区域内，却面临着不同的正式制度。通过匹配型分析和空间回归不连续方法，我们发现国家边界两侧的制度结构差异并不能解释不同民族之间的经济绩效差异，这一点可以通过卫星图像中的光密度数据来体现。国家机构对民族发展的平均影响为零，但实际上存在相当大的异质性，部分原因是由于国家机构在距离首都较远的地区的作用逐渐减弱。

abstract.text: In a pure-currency economy, money is the only durable object and people have private histories. In such economies, taxation is not feasible and in some of them trade is enhanced through the use of money. For economies of that kind in which a nondegenerate distribution of money, part of the state of the economy, affects trades and real outcomes, and in which trades affect the state at the next date, the conjecture is that there are transfer schemes financed by money creation that improve ex ante representative-agent welfare relative to what can be achieved holding the stock of money fixed.

10.1093/qje/qjt030.abstractZh: 在纯货币经济中，货币是唯一的持久物品，人们拥有各自的私人历史。在这种经济体系中，征税是不可行的，但在某些情况下，通过使用货币可以促进贸易。对于那些货币分配非退化、成为经济状态的一部分能够影响贸易和实际结果的经济体系，以及贸易在下一个时间点影响经济状态的体系来说，人们推测存在通过货币创造来融资的转移方案，这些方案能够改善代表代理人的福利，相对于固定货币存量所能达到的水平而言。

abstract.text: This article investigates the effect of bank lending frictions on employment outcomes. I construct a new data set that combines information on banking relationships and employment at 2,000 nonfinancial firms during the 2008–9 crisis. The article first verifies empirically the importance of banking relationships, which imply a cost to borrowers who switch lenders. I then use the dispersion in lender health following the Lehman crisis as a source of exogenous variation in the availability of credit to borrowers. I find that credit matters. Firms that had precrisis relationships with less healthy lenders had a lower likelihood of obtaining a loan following the Lehman bankruptcy, paid a higher interest rate if they did borrow, and reduced employment by more compared to precrisis clients of healthier lenders. Consistent with frictions deriving from asymmetric information, the effects vary by firm type. Lender health has an economically and statistically significant effect on employment at small and medium firms, but the data cannot reject the hypothesis of no effect at the largest or most transparent firms. Abstracting from general equilibrium effects, I find that the withdrawal of credit accounts for between one-third and one-half of the employment decline at small and medium firms in the sample in the year following the Lehman bankruptcy.

10.1093/qje/qjt031.abstractZh: 本文研究了银行借贷摩擦对就业结果的影响。我构建了一个新的数据集，该数据集包含了2008-2009年危机期间2000家非金融企业的银行关系及就业信息。文章首先实证验证了银行关系的重要性，这些关系意味着借款人更换贷款机构时会承担相应的成本。接着，我利用雷曼危机后贷款机构健康状况的波动作为信贷可获得性的外生变量来源。研究发现，信贷确实具有重要影响：在雷曼破产之后，与健康状况较差的贷款机构有关系的企业在获得贷款的可能性较低，即使借款，其利率也较高，且就业减少幅度也更大。与信息不对称引起的摩擦效应一致，这些效应因企业类型而异。在小型和中型企业中，贷款机构的健康状况对就业有经济和统计上的显著影响，但数据无法排除在大型或最透明的企业中这种效应不存在的假设。忽略一般均衡效应后，我发现，在雷曼破产后的那一年，信贷撤回占样本中小型企业就业下降的三分之一到一半。

abstract.text: The stability of the labor share of income is a key foundation in macroeconomic models. We document, however, that the global labor share has significantly declined since the early 1980s, with the decline occurring within the large majority of countries and industries. We show that the decrease in the relative price of investment goods, often attributed to advances in information technology and the computer age, induced firms to shift away from labor and toward capital. The lower price of investment goods explains roughly half of the observed decline in the labor share, even when we allow for other mechanisms influencing factor shares, such as increasing profits, capital-augmenting technology growth, and the changing skill composition of the labor force. We highlight the implications of this explanation for welfare and macroeconomic dynamics.

10.1093/qje/qjt032.abstractZh: 收入中劳动份额的稳定性是宏观经济模型中的一个关键基础。然而，我们发现，自20世纪80年代初以来，全球劳动份额显著下降，这一趋势在绝大多数国家和行业中均存在。研究表明，投资品相对价格的下降，通常归因于信息技术和计算机时代的进步，促使企业从依赖劳动转向依赖资本。即使考虑到其他影响要素份额的因素，如利润增加、资本增长技术以及劳动力技能结构的变化，投资品价格下降仍解释了劳动份额下降幅度的一半左右。我们强调了这一解释对福利和宏观经济动态的影响。

abstract.text: This article analyzes the effects of income taxation on the international migration and earnings of top earners using a Danish preferential foreigner tax scheme and population-wide Danish administrative data. This scheme, introduced in 1991, allows new immigrants with high earnings to be taxed at a preferential flat rate for a duration of three years. We obtain two main results. First, the scheme has doubled the number of highly paid foreigners in Denmark relative to slightly less paid—and therefore ineligible—foreigners. This translates into a very large elasticity of migration with respect to 1 minus the average tax rate on foreigners, between 1.5 and 2. Second, we find compelling evidence of a negative effect of the scheme-induced reduction in the average tax rate on pretax earnings of foreign migrants at the individual level. This finding can be rationalized by a matching frictions model with wage bargaining where there is a gap between pay and marginal productivity.

10.1093/qje/qjt033.abstractZh: 本文分析了所得税制度对国际移民以及顶尖收入者收入的影响，研究采用了丹麦的优惠外国人税收制度以及全国范围内的行政数据。该制度于1991年实施，允许收入较高的新移民在三年时间内享受优惠的单一税率。我们得到了两个主要结论：首先，与收入较低、因此不符合优惠条件的外国人相比，该制度使丹麦境内高收入外国人的数量翻了一番。此外，我们发现，该制度导致的平均税率下降对外国移民的税前收入产生了显著的负面影响。这一发现可以通过一个匹配摩擦模型来解释，该模型考虑了工资谈判中的差距，即实际收入与边际生产力之间的差距。

abstract.text: We study the long-run effects of one of the most ambitious regional development programs in U.S. history: the Tennessee Valley Authority (TVA). Using as controls authorities that were proposed but never approved by Congress, we find that the TVA led to large gains in agricultural employment that were eventually reversed when the program’s subsidies ended. Gains in manufacturing employment, by contrast, continued to intensify well after federal transfers had lapsed—a pattern consistent with the presence of agglomeration economies in manufacturing. Because manufacturing paid higher wages than agriculture, this shift raised aggregate income in the TVA region for an extended period of time. Economists have long cautioned that the local gains created by place-based policies may be offset by losses elsewhere. We develop a structured approach to assessing the TVA’s aggregate consequences that is applicable to other place-based policies. In our model, the TVA affects the national economy both directly through infrastructure improvements and indirectly through agglomeration economies. The model’s estimates suggest that the TVA’s direct investments yielded a significant increase in national manufacturing productivity, with benefits exceeding the program’s costs. However, the program’s indirect effects appear to have been limited: agglomeration gains in the TVA region were offset by losses in the rest of the country. Spillovers in manufacturing appear to be the rare example of a localized market failure that cancels out in the aggregate.

10.1093/qje/qjt034.abstractZh: 我们研究了美国历史上最雄心勃勃的区域发展计划之一——田纳西河谷管理局（TVA）的长期影响。以那些被国会提出但从未获得批准的计划作为对照组，我们发现TVA带来了农业就业的显著增长，而当该计划的补贴结束时，这种增长又逐渐消失。相比之下，制造业就业的增长在联邦转移支付终止后仍然持续一段时间——这一模式与制造业中的集聚经济现象相符。由于制造业的工资水平高于农业，这种转变使得TVA地区的整体收入在较长时间内得以提升。经济学家长期以来一直提醒人们，基于地方的政策所带来的局部收益可能会因其他地区的损失而抵消。我们开发了一种结构化的方法来评估TVA的总体影响，该方法适用于其他基于地方的政策。在我们的模型中，TVA通过基础设施改善直接影响国民经济，同时通过集聚经济间接影响国民经济。模型的估计表明，TVA的直接投资显著提高了全国制造业的生产力，其收益超过了项目的成本。然而，该计划的间接效应似乎有限：TVA地区的集聚经济收益被全国其他地区的损失所抵消。制造业的溢出效应似乎是局部市场失灵的罕见例子，这种失灵在总体上是被抵消的。

abstract.text: We present evidence from laboratory experiments showing that individuals are “last-place averse.” Participants choose gambles with the potential to move them out of last place that they reject when randomly placed in other parts of the distribution. In modified dictator games, participants randomly placed in second-to-last place are the most likely to give money to the person one rank above them instead of the person one rank below. Last-place aversion suggests that low-income individuals might oppose redistribution because it could differentially help the group just beneath them. Using survey data, we show that individuals making just above the minimum wage are the most likely to oppose its increase. Similarly, in the General Social Survey, those above poverty but below median income support redistribution significantly less than their background characteristics would predict.

10.1093/qje/qjt035.abstractZh: 我们提供了实验室实验的证据，表明个体存在“厌恶最后位置”的倾向。参与者在随机分配到分布的其他位置时，会拒绝那些可能使他们脱离最后位置的赌博行为。在修改后的 dictator 游戏中，随机分配到倒数第二位置的参与者最有可能将金钱给予比他们高一个等级的人，而不是比他们低一个等级的人。这种厌恶最后位置的倾向表明，低收入个体可能会反对再分配，因为再分配可能会更有助于他们下方的群体。通过调查数据，我们发现，收入略高于最低工资的个体最有可能反对最低工资的提高。同样，在 General Social Survey 中，那些处于贫困线以上但收入低于中位数的人群，对再分配的支持程度明显低于其背景特征所预测的幅度。

abstract.text: According to national accounts data, value added per worker is much higher in the nonagricultural sector than in agriculture in the typical country, particularly in developing countries. Taken at face value, this “agricultural productivity gap” suggests that labor is greatly misallocated across sectors. In this article, we draw on new micro evidence to ask to what extent the gap is still present when better measures of sector labor inputs and value added are taken into consideration. We find that even after considering sector differences in hours worked and human capital per worker, as well as alternative measures of sector output constructed from household survey data, a puzzlingly large gap remains.

10.1093/qje/qjt056.abstractZh: 根据国民经济核算数据，在典型国家中，非农业部门的劳动者人均增加值远高于农业部门，尤其是在发展中国家。从表面上看，这种“农业生产力差距”表明劳动力在不同部门之间的分配存在严重问题。在本文中，我们基于新的微观数据，探讨了在考虑更精确的部门劳动投入和增加值衡量标准后，这种差距在多大程度上仍然存在。研究发现，即使考虑到各部门劳动者工作时间和人均人力资本的差异，以及从家庭调查数据中得出的其他部门产出衡量标准，这种令人困惑的差距仍然存在。

abstract.text: We study a government program in Uganda designed to help the poor and unemployed become self-employed artisans, increase incomes, and thus promote social stability. Young adults in Uganda’s conflict-affected north were invited to form groups and submit grant proposals for vocational training and business start-up. Funding was randomly assigned among screened and eligible groups. Treatment groups received unsupervised grants of $382 per member. Grant recipients invest some in skills training but most in tools and materials. After four years, half practice a skilled trade. Relative to the control group, the program increases business assets by 57%, work hours by 17%, and earnings by 38%. Many also formalize their enterprises and hire labor. We see no effect, however, on social cohesion, antisocial behavior, or protest. Effects are similar by gender but are qualitatively different for women because they begin poorer (meaning the impact is larger relative to their starting point) and because women’s work and earnings stagnate without the program but take off with it. The patterns we observe are consistent with credit constraints.

10.1093/qje/qjt057.abstractZh: 我们研究了乌干达一项旨在帮助贫困和失业者成为自雇工匠、增加收入从而促进社会稳定的政府计划。乌干达冲突频发的北部地区，年轻人被邀请组成小组，并提交职业培训及创业项目的资助申请。资金随机分配给经过筛选的符合条件的小组。实验组每个成员可获得无监督的382美元资助。资助资金中，一部分用于技能培训，大部分用于购买工具和材料。四年之后，一半的实验组成员从事了技术熟练的贸易活动。与对照组相比，该计划使企业的资产增加了57%，工作时间增加了17%，收入增加了38%。许多参与者还将其企业正规化，并雇用了劳动力。然而，该计划对社会凝聚力、反社会行为或抗议活动没有产生影响。男女之间的效果相似，但女性的情况有所不同，因为她们起步时经济状况较差（这意味着相对于起点而言，效果更为显著），而且如果没有该计划，女性的工作和收入会停滞不前，而有了该计划后，她们的工作和收入才会有所提升。我们观察到的这些现象与信贷约束理论相符。

abstract.text: The unit values of internationally traded goods are heavily influenced by quality. We model this in an extended monopolistic competition framework where, in addition to choosing price, firms simultaneously choose quality subject to nonhomothetic demand. We estimate quality and quality-adjusted price indexes for 185 countries over 1984–2011. Our estimates are less sensitive to assumptions about the extensive margin of firms than are purely “demand-side” estimates. We find that quality-adjusted prices vary much less across countries than do unit values and, surprisingly, the quality-adjusted terms of trade are negatively related to countries’ level of income.

10.1093/qje/qju001.abstractZh: 国际贸易商品的单位价值深受质量的影响。我们在扩展的垄断竞争框架中对此进行了建模，企业除了选择价格外，还会在非齐次需求条件下同时选择质量。我们对1984年至2011年间185个国家的质量和质量调整价格指数进行了估算。我们的估算结果对企业广泛边际的假设敏感度较低，相比纯粹的“需求端”估算结果更为稳健。我们发现，质量调整价格在不同国家之间的变化幅度远小于单位价值的变化幅度，且令人惊讶的是，质量调整贸易条件与国家的收入水平呈负相关关系。

abstract.text: The investment decisions of small-scale farmers in developing countries are conditioned by their financial environment. Binding credit market constraints and incomplete insurance can limit investment in activities with high expected profits. We conducted several experiments in northern Ghana in which farmers were randomly assigned to receive cash grants, grants of or opportunities to purchase rainfall index insurance, or a combination of the two. Demand for index insurance is strong, and insurance leads to significantly larger agricultural investment and riskier production choices in agriculture. The binding constraint to farmer investment is uninsured risk: when provided with insurance against the primary catastrophic risk they face, farmers are able to find resources to increase expenditure on their farms. Demand for insurance in subsequent years is strongly increasing with the farmer’s own receipt of insurance payouts, with the receipt of payouts by others in the farmer’s social network and with recent poor rain in the village. Both investment patterns and the demand for index insurance are consistent with the presence of important basis risk associated with the index insurance, imperfect trust that promised payouts will be delivered and overweighting recent events.

10.1093/qje/qju002.abstractZh: 发展中国家小规模农民的投资决策受到其金融环境的影响。严格的信贷市场限制和不完善的保险机制可能会限制那些预期收益较高的活动的投资。我们在加纳北部进行了多项实验，将农民随机分配为接受现金补助、购买降雨指数保险或同时获得这两种方式的补助。对降雨指数保险的需求非常强烈，而保险的实施使得农业投资显著增加，同时农民在农业生产上的风险选择也变得更加大胆。限制农民投资的真正因素是未投保的风险：当农民能够获得针对主要灾难性风险的保险时，他们就能找到资源来增加农场投入。在后续年份，对保险的需求随着农民自身获得保险赔付的情况、其社交网络中其他人的赔付情况以及村庄近期遭遇的恶劣天气而显著增加。无论是投资模式还是对降雨指数保险的需求，都与存在重要的基础风险有关——即对于承诺的赔付能否兑现存在不充分的信任，并且过度关注最近的事件。

abstract.text: We find that regulators can implement identical rules inconsistently due to differences in their institutional design and incentives, and this behavior may adversely impact the effectiveness with which regulation is implemented. We study supervisory decisions of U.S. banking regulators and exploit a legally determined rotation policy that assigns federal and state supervisors to the same bank at exogenously set time intervals. Comparing federal and state regulator supervisory ratings within the same bank, we find that federal regulators are systematically tougher, downgrading supervisory ratings almost twice as frequently as do state supervisors. State regulators counteract these downgrades to some degree by upgrading more frequently. Under federal regulators, banks report worse asset quality, higher regulatory capital ratios, and lower return on assets. Leniency of state regulators relative to their federal counterparts is related to costly outcomes, such as higher failure rates and lower repayment rates of government assistance funds. The discrepancy in regulator behavior is related to different weights given by regulators to local economic conditions and, to some extent, differences in regulatory resources. We find no support for regulator self-interest, which includes “revolving doors” as a reason for leniency of state regulators.

10.1093/qje/qju003.abstractZh: 我们发现，由于制度设计和激励机制的差异，监管机构可能会不一致地实施相同的规则，这种行为可能会严重影响监管的有效性。我们研究了美国银行监管机构的监管决策，并采用一种法律确定的轮换政策，将联邦和州监管机构分配给同一家银行，并设定了外部设定的时间间隔。通过比较同一家银行的联邦和州监管机构对银行的监管评级，我们发现联邦监管机构系统性地更为严格，下调监管评级的频率几乎是州监管机构的两倍。州监管机构在一定程度上通过更频繁地提升监管评级来抵消这些下调。在联邦监管机构的管理下，银行的资产质量较差，监管资本比率较高，资产回报率较低。州监管机构相对于联邦监管机构表现出更宽松的态度，这与代价高昂的结果相关，例如更高的破产率和较低的政府援助资金回收率。监管机构行为差异与监管机构对当地经济条件的不同重视程度有关，也在一定程度上与监管资源的差异有关。我们没有发现支持监管机构存在自身利益的证据，其中包括“旋转门”现象作为州监管机构更宽松态度的理由。

abstract.text: We complement the literature on distributive politics by taking a systematic look at regional favoritism in a large and diverse sample of countries and by employing a broad measure that captures the aggregate distributive effect of many different policies. In particular, we use satellite data on nighttime light intensity and information about the birthplaces of the countries’ political leaders. In our panel of 38,427 subnational regions from 126 countries with yearly observations from 1992 to 2009, we find that subnational regions have more intense nighttime light when being the birth region of the current political leader. We argue that this finding provides evidence for regional favoritism. We explore the dynamics and the geographical extent of regional favoritism and show that regional favoritism is most prevalent in countries with weak political institutions and poorly educated citizens. Furthermore, foreign aid inflows and oil rents tend to fuel regional favoritism in weakly institutionalized countries, but not elsewhere.

10.1093/qje/qju004.abstractZh: 我们通过系统研究大量不同国家的地区性偏袒现象，并采用广泛的方法来衡量多种政策对分配效应的综合影响，从而补充了关于分配政治的相关文献。具体而言，我们利用夜间光照强度的卫星数据以及各国政治领袖出生地的信息。在包含126个国家、38,427个次国家级区域的样本中，我们观察到，当某个地区是现任政治领袖的出生地时，该地区的夜间光照强度会更强。我们认为这一发现为地区性偏袒提供了证据。我们进一步探讨了地区性偏袒的动态特征和地理范围，发现这种偏袒在政治制度薄弱且公民受教育程度较低的国家最为普遍。此外，外国援助流入和石油收益往往会在制度不完善的国家中助长地区性偏袒现象，但在其他情况下则不会如此。

abstract.text: We study the effect of public health insurance on labor supply by exploiting a large public health insurance disenrollment. In 2005, approximately 170,000 Tennessee residents abruptly lost Medicaid coverage. Using both across- and within-state variation in exposure to the disenrollment, we estimate large increases in labor supply, primarily along the extensive margin. The increased employment is concentrated among individuals working at least 20 hours a week and receiving private, employer-provided health insurance. We explore the dynamic effects of the disenrollment and find an immediate increase in job search behavior and a steady rise in both employment and health insurance coverage following the disenrollment. Our results are consistent with a significant degree of “employment lock”—workers who are employed primarily to secure private health insurance coverage.

10.1093/qje/qju005.abstractZh: 我们研究了公共健康保险对劳动力供应的影响，通过利用大量公共健康保险退保案例进行研究。2005年，大约17万田纳西州居民突然失去了医疗补助的覆盖。我们分析了退保事件在不同州之间的影响差异，发现劳动力供应显著增加，主要体现在广泛劳动力市场上。增加的就业集中在每周工作至少20小时且接受雇主提供的私人健康保险的人群中。我们还探讨了退保事件的动态影响，发现退保后求职行为立即增加，同时就业率和健康保险覆盖率也持续上升。我们的研究结果与“就业锁定”现象相符——许多工人之所以就业，主要是为了获得私人健康保险覆盖。

abstract.text: International trade can have profound effects on domestic institutions. We examine this proposition in the context of medieval Venice circa 800–1600. Early on, the growth of long-distance trade enriched a broad group of merchants who used their newfound economic muscle to push for constraints on the executive, that is, for the end of a de facto hereditary Doge in 1032 and the establishment of a parliament in 1172. The merchants also pushed for remarkably modern innovations in contracting institutions that facilitated long-distance trade, for example, the colleganza. However, starting in 1297, a small group of particularly wealthy merchants blocked political and economic competition: they made parliamentary participation hereditary and erected barriers to participation in the most lucrative aspects of long-distance trade. Over the next two centuries this led to a fundamental societal shift away from political openness, economic competition, and social mobility and toward political closure, extreme inequality, and social stratification. We document this oligarchization using a unique database on the names of 8,178 parliamentarians and their families’ use of the colleganza in the periods immediately before and after 1297. We then link these families to 6,959 marriages during 1400–1599 to document the use of marriage alliances to monopolize the galley trade. Monopolization led to the rise of extreme inequality, with those who were powerful before 1297 emerging as the undisputed winners.

10.1093/qje/qju006.abstractZh: 国际贸易对国内制度有着深远的影响。我们在大约800至1600年间的中世纪威尼斯背景下探讨了这一命题。早期，远程贸易的发展使一群商人获得了丰厚的财富，他们利用这些新获得的经济力量来推动对行政权力的限制，例如，在1032年结束了事实上的世袭总督制度，并在1172年建立了议会。这些商人还推动了契约制度的现代化创新，以促进远程贸易的发展，例如“colleganza”制度。然而，从1297年开始，一小群特别富有的商人开始阻碍政治和经济竞争：他们将议会的参与权世袭化，并设置了障碍，阻止人们参与最有利可图的远程贸易活动。在接下来的两个世纪里，这导致社会从政治开放、经济竞争和社会流动性转向政治封闭、极端不平等和社会分层。我们通过一个独特的数据库来记录这种寡头化现象，该数据库包含了8,178名议员及其家族在1297年前后使用“colleganza”制度的记录。随后，我们将这些家族与1400至1599年间的6,959起婚姻联系起来，以证明通过婚姻联盟来垄断划船贸易的行为。这种垄断行为导致了极端不平等的加剧，那些在1297年之前就拥有权力的群体成为了无可争议的赢家。

abstract.text: We present new data documenting medieval Europe’s Commercial Revolution using information on the establishment of markets in Germany. We use these data to test whether medieval universities played a causal role in expanding economic activity, examining the foundation of Germany’s first universities after 1386 following the papal schism. We find that the trend rate of market establishment breaks upward in 1386 and this break is greatest where the distance to a university shrank most. There is no differential pre-1386 trend associated with the reduction in distance to a university, and there is no break in trend in 1386 where university proximity did not change. These results are robust to estimating a variety of specifications that address concerns about the endogeneity of university location. Universities provided training in newly rediscovered Roman and canon law; students with legal training served in positions that reduced the uncertainty of trade in the Middle Ages. We argue that training in the law, and the consequent development of legal and administrative institutions, was an important channel linking universities and greater economic activity in medieval Germany.

10.1093/qje/qju007.abstractZh: 我们提供了新的数据，记录了中世纪欧洲的商业革命，这些数据基于德国市场的建立情况。我们利用这些数据来检验中世纪大学是否在扩大经济活动方面发挥了因果作用，具体考察了1386年教皇分裂之后德国首批大学成立的情况。研究发现，市场建立的趋势在1386年出现转折，且这一转折在大学距离缩短最明显的地方最为显著。在1386年之前，大学距离缩短并没有带来明显的趋势变化，而在1386年，即使大学距离没有发生变化，趋势也并未出现转折。这些结果在估计各种模型参数时依然稳健，这些模型考虑了大学位置的内生性问题。大学提供了对罗马法和教会法的培训；具有法律培训背景的学生在贸易中担任重要职位，减少了中世纪贸易中的不确定性。我们认为，法律培训以及随之而来的法律和行政机构的发展，是连接中世纪德国大学与更大规模经济活动的关键渠道。

abstract.text: We use a novel data set of online prices of identical goods sold by four large global retailers in dozens of countries to study good-level real exchange rates and their aggregated behavior. First, in contrast to the prior literature, we demonstrate that the law of one price holds very well within currency unions for tens of thousands of goods sold by each of the retailers, implying good-level real exchange rates often equal to 1. Prices of these same goods exhibit large deviations from the law of one price outside of currency unions, even when the nominal exchange rate is pegged. This clarifies that the common currency per se, and not simply the lack of nominal volatility, is important in reducing cross-country price dispersion. Second, we derive a new decomposition that shows that good-level real exchange rates in our data predominantly reflect differences in prices at the time products are first introduced, as opposed to the component emerging from heterogeneous passthrough or from nominal rigidities during the life of the good. Further, these international relative prices measured at the time of introduction move together with the nominal exchange rate. This stands in sharp contrast to pricing behavior in models where all price rigidity for any given good is due simply to costly price adjustment for that good.

10.1093/qje/qju008.abstractZh: 我们使用了由四大全球零售商在数十个国家销售的相同商品的在线价格数据，来研究商品层面的实际汇率及其整体行为。首先，与以往的研究不同，我们发现，在货币联盟内部，这些零售商销售的数万种商品遵循一价定律，这意味着商品层面的实际汇率通常接近1。而在货币联盟之外，即使名义汇率被固定，这些商品的实际价格仍与一价定律存在较大偏差。这表明，货币的统一本身，而不仅仅是名义汇率的平稳性，对于减少国家间的价格差异至关重要。其次，我们提出了一种新的分解方法，表明我们数据中的商品层面实际汇率主要反映了商品首次推出时的价格差异，而不是由于产品生命周期中的异质性传递或名义刚性所导致的价格差异。此外，这些在商品首次推出时测量的国际相对价格与名义汇率同步变化。这与那些认为任何给定商品的价格刚性仅仅由于价格调整成本过高而导致的模型中的定价行为形成了鲜明对比。

abstract.text: Gender differences in competitiveness have been hypothesized as a potential explanation for gender differences in education and labor market outcomes. We examine the predictive power of a standard laboratory experimental measure of competitiveness for the later important choice of academic track of secondary school students in the Netherlands. Although boys and girls display similar levels of academic ability, boys choose substantially more prestigious academic tracks, where more prestigious tracks are more math- and science-intensive. Our experimental measure shows that boys are also substantially more competitive than girls. We find that competitiveness is strongly positively correlated with choosing more prestigious academic tracks even conditional on academic ability. Most important, we find that the gender difference in competitiveness accounts for a substantial portion (about 20%) of the gender difference in track choice.

10.1093/qje/qju009.abstractZh: 已有研究假设，性别差异在竞争力方面可能解释了教育和劳动力市场结果中的性别差异。本研究考察了一种标准的实验室实验性测量工具对荷兰中学生选择学术道路的预测能力。尽管男孩和女孩在学术能力上表现出相似的水平，但男孩更倾向于选择更为 prestigious的学术道路，而这些道路通常更强调数学和科学的培养。我们的实验结果表明，男孩的竞争力也明显高于女孩。我们发现，即使考虑到学术能力因素，竞争力与选择更为 prestigious的学术道路之间仍存在强烈的正相关关系。最重要的是，我们发现性别差异在竞争力方面的表现，能够解释学术道路选择中性别差异的相当一部分（约20%）。

abstract.text: International trade literature tends to focus heavily on the production side of general equilibrium, leaving us with a number of empirical puzzles. There is, for example, considerably less world trade than predicted by Heckscher-Ohlin-Vanek (HOV) models. Trade among rich countries is higher and trade between rich and poor countries lower than suggested by HOV and other supply-driven theories, and trade-to-GDP ratios are higher in rich countries. Our approach focuses on the relationship between characteristics of goods and services in production and characteristics of preferences. In particular, we find a strong and significant positive correlation of more than 45% between a good’s skilled-labor intensity and its income elasticity, even when accounting for trade costs and cross-country price differences. Exploring the implications of this correlation for empirical trade puzzles, we find that it can reduce HOV’s overprediction of the variance of the net factor content of trade relative to that in the data by about 60%. Since rich countries are relatively skilled-labor abundant, they are relatively specialized in consuming the same goods and services that they are specialized in producing, and so trade more with one another than with poor countries. We also find a positive sector-level correlation between income elasticity and a sector’s tradability, which helps explain the higher trade-to-GDP ratios in high-income relative to low-income countries.

10.1093/qje/qju010.abstractZh: 国际贸易文献往往侧重于一般均衡的生产方面，留下了许多实证难题。例如，世界贸易量远低于Heckscher-Ohlin-Vanek模型所预测的规模。富裕国家之间的贸易量高于HOV模型和其他供给驱动理论所预测的，而富裕国家与贫穷国家之间的贸易量则低于这些理论预测。此外，富裕国家的贸易额占GDP的比例也高于其他国家。我们的研究关注商品和服务生产特征与偏好特征之间的关系。具体来说，我们发现，即使考虑到贸易成本和跨国价格差异，某种商品的技能劳动强度与其收入弹性之间仍存在超过45%的显著正相关关系。通过探讨这种相关性对实证贸易难题的影响，我们发现它可以减少HOV模型对贸易要素含量方差的过度预测约60%。由于富裕国家拥有相对丰富的技能劳动力，它们更倾向于消费自己专门生产的商品和服务，因此与贫穷国家的贸易量相对较大。我们还发现，部门层面的收入弹性与部门的可贸易性之间存在正相关关系，这有助于解释高收入国家相对于低收入国家更高的贸易额占GDP比例。

abstract.text: This study examines the impact on student achievement of implementing a bundle of best practices from high-performing charter schools into low-performing, traditional public schools in Houston, Texas, using a school-level randomized field experiment and quasi-experimental comparisons. The five practices in the bundle are increased instructional time, more effective teachers and administrators, high-dosage tutoring, data-driven instruction, and a culture of high expectations. The findings show that injecting best practices from charter schools into traditional Houston public schools significantly increases student math achievement in treated elementary and secondary schools—by 0.15 to 0.18 standard deviations a year—and has little effect on reading achievement. Similar bundles of practices are found to significantly raise math achievement in analyses for public schools in a field experiment in Denver and program in Chicago.

10.1093/qje/qju011.abstractZh: 本研究通过学校层面的随机实地实验和准实验比较，探讨了将一些来自表现优异的特许学校的最佳实践引入德克萨斯州休斯顿的绩效不佳的传统公立学校对学生学业成绩的影响。这些最佳实践包括增加教学时间、配备更优秀的教师和管理人员、实施高强度的辅导、采用数据驱动的教学方式，以及营造高期望的文化。研究结果表明，将特许学校的优秀实践引入休斯顿的传统公立学校后，小学和中学学生的数学成绩每年提高了0.15至0.18个标准差，而对阅读成绩的影响则较小。在丹佛和芝加哥的实地实验中，类似的实践组合也被发现能够显著提高公立学校的数学成绩。

abstract.text: We introduce the model of asset management developed in Gennaioli, Shleifer, and Vishny (“Money Doctors,” Journal of Finance , forthcoming 2015) into a Solow-style neoclassical growth model with diminishing returns to capital. Savers rely on trusted intermediaries to manage their wealth (claims on capital stock), who can charge fees above costs to trusting investors. In this model, the ratio of financial income to GDP increases with the ratio of aggregate wealth to GDP. Both rise along the convergence path to steady state growth. We examine several further implications of the model for management fees, unit costs of finance, and the consequences of shocks to trust and to the capital stock.

10.1093/qje/qju012.abstractZh: 我们将Gennaioli、Shleifer和Vishny在《金融学杂志》上发表的“金钱医生”模型（即将发表于2015年）引入一个具有资本收益递减的索洛式新古典增长模型。储蓄者依赖可信的中介机构来管理他们的财富（对资本存量的索取权），这些中介机构可以向信任的投资者收取高于成本的费用。在这个模型中，金融收入与GDP的比例随着总财富与GDP的比例的增加而上升。两者都沿着向稳态增长的收敛路径上升。我们进一步探讨了该模型对管理费用、金融单位成本以及信任和资本存量冲击后果的一些影响。

abstract.text: Using 41 million observations on savings for the population of Denmark, we show that the effects of retirement savings policies on wealth accumulation depend on whether they change savings rates by active or passive choice. Subsidies for retirement accounts, which rely on individuals to take an action to raise savings, primarily induce individuals to shift assets from taxable accounts to retirement accounts. We estimate that each $1 of government expenditure on subsidies increases total saving by only 1 cent. In contrast, policies that raise retirement contributions if individuals take no action—such as automatic employer contributions to retirement accounts—increase wealth accumulation substantially. We estimate that approximately 15% of individuals are “active savers” who respond to tax subsidies primarily by shifting assets across accounts; 85% of individuals are “passive savers” who are unresponsive to subsidies but are instead heavily influenced by automatic contributions made on their behalf. Active savers tend to be wealthier and more financially sophisticated. We conclude that automatic contributions are more effective at increasing savings rates than subsidies for three reasons: (i) subsidies induce relatively few individuals to respond, (ii) they generate substantial crowd-out conditional on response, and (iii) they do not increase the savings of passive individuals, who are least prepared for retirement.

10.1093/qje/qju013.abstractZh: 通过对丹麦人口进行4100万次储蓄观测，我们发现退休储蓄政策对财富积累的影响取决于这些政策是通过主动还是被动方式改变储蓄率。针对退休账户的补贴，需要个人主动采取措施来增加储蓄，这类政策主要促使个人将资产从应税账户转移到退休账户。我们估计，政府每支出1美元的补贴，总储蓄仅增加1美分。相比之下，如果个人不采取任何行动，政策会提高退休账户的贡献——例如雇主自动为退休账户做出贡献——这将显著增加财富积累。我们估计，大约15%的个人是“主动储蓄者”，他们主要通过对账户进行资产转移来响应税收补贴；而85%的个人是“被动储蓄者”，他们对补贴没有反应，而是受到自动贡献的强烈影响。主动储蓄者通常更富有且更精通金融知识。我们得出结论，自动贡献在提高储蓄率方面比补贴更有效，原因有三：(i) 补贴促使相对较少的人做出反应；(ii) 在需要做出反应的情况下，补贴会产生显著的挤出效应；(iii) 补贴不会增加被动储蓄者的储蓄，而被动储蓄者往往对退休准备最不足。

abstract.text: In the United States, the average 40-year-old plant employs more than seven times as many workers as the typical plant 5 years or younger. In contrast, surviving plants in India and Mexico exhibit much slower growth, roughly doubling in size over the same age range. The divergence in plant dynamics suggests lower investments by Indian and Mexican plants in process efficiency, quality, and in accessing markets at home and abroad. In simple general equilibrium models, we find that the difference in life cycle dynamics could lower aggregate manufacturing productivity on the order of 25 percent in India and Mexico relative to the United States.

10.1093/qje/qju014.abstractZh: 在美国，平均而言，40岁的工厂雇佣的工人数量是5年或更年轻工厂的七倍多。相比之下，印度和墨西哥的存活工厂的增长速度要慢得多，在同一年龄范围内，它们的规模大约翻了一番。这种工厂动态的差异表明，印度和墨西哥的工厂在工艺效率、质量以及进入国内外市场的能力方面投资较少。在简单的通用均衡模型中，我们发现，生命周期差异可能导致印度和墨西哥的制造业总生产率比美国低约25%。

abstract.text: We consider a model of technological learning under which people “learn through noticing”: they choose which input dimensions to attend to and subsequently learn about from available data. Using this model, we show how people with a great deal of experience may persistently be off the production frontier because they fail to notice important features of the data they possess. We also develop predictions on when these learning failures are likely to occur, as well as on the types of interventions that can help people learn. We test the model’s predictions in a field experiment with seaweed farmers. The survey data reveal that these farmers do not attend to pod size, a particular input dimension. Experimental trials suggest that farmers are particularly far from optimizing this dimension. Furthermore, consistent with the model, we find that simply having access to the experimental data does not induce learning. Instead, behavioral changes occur only after the farmers are presented with summaries that highlight previously unattended-to relationships in the data.

10.1093/qje/qju015.abstractZh: 我们考虑了一个技术学习模型，在该模型中，人们通过“观察学习”：他们选择要关注哪些输入维度，并随后从可用数据中学习相关信息。利用这一模型，我们展示了那些拥有丰富经验的人为何会持续无法达到生产前沿，因为他们未能注意到所掌握数据中的重要特征。我们还对这类学习失败可能发生的时间以及有助于人们学习的干预措施进行了预测。我们在海藻农民的一个实地实验中验证了该模型的预测结果。调查数据表明，这些农民没有关注一个特定的输入维度——藻荚大小。实验结果表明，这些农民在优化这一维度方面存在明显不足。此外，与模型预测一致的是，仅仅拥有实验数据并不能促使他们学习。只有在向农民展示能够突出数据中被忽视的关系的摘要后，才会发生行为上的改变。

abstract.text: We develop a general equilibrium framework to determine the spatial distribution of economic activity on any surface with (nearly) any geography. Combining the gravity structure of trade with labor mobility, we provide conditions for the existence, uniqueness, and stability of a spatial economic equilibrium and derive a simple set of equations that govern the relationship between economic activity and the geography of the surface. We then use the framework to estimate the topography of trade costs, productivities and amenities in the United States. We find that geographic location accounts for at least twenty percent of the spatial variation in U.S. income. Finally, we calculate that the construction of the interstate highway system increased welfare by 1.1 to 1.4 percent, which is substantially larger than its cost.

10.1093/qje/qju016.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个一般均衡框架，用于确定任何具有（几乎）任何地理特征的表面上的经济活动空间分布。通过将贸易的引力结构与劳动力流动性相结合，我们为空间经济均衡的存在、唯一性和稳定性提供了条件，并推导出一组简单的方程，用以描述经济活动与表面地理特征之间的关系。随后，我们利用该框架估算了美国贸易成本、生产效率和便利性的地形特征。研究发现，地理位置至少解释了美国收入空间变异的百分之二十。最后，我们计算出建设州际公路系统使福利增加了1.1%至1.4%，这一增幅远大于其建设成本。

abstract.text: This article provides an axiomatic characterization of quasi-hyperbolic discounting and a more general class of semi-hyperbolic preferences. We impose consistency restrictions directly on the intertemporal trade-offs by relying on what we call “annuity compensations.” Our axiomatization leads naturally to an experimental design that disentangles discounting from the elasticity of intertemporal substitution. In a pilot experiment we use the partial identification approach to estimate bounds for the distributions of discount factors in the subject pool. Consistent with previous studies, we find evidence for both present and future bias.

10.1093/qje/qju017.abstractZh: 本文对准 hyperbolic 贴现以及一类更一般的半 hyperbolic 偏好进行了公理化的描述。我们通过所谓的“年金补偿”直接对跨期权衡施加一致性限制。我们的公理化方法自然引导我们设计实验，以将贴现与跨期替代弹性分离开来。在一项试点实验中，我们采用部分识别方法来估计实验对象中贴现因子分布的界限。与先前的研究一致，我们发现存在当前偏差和未来偏差的证据。

abstract.text: How do aggregate wealth-to-income ratios evolve in the long run and why? We address this question using 1970–2010 national balance sheets recently compiled in the top eight developed economies. For the United States, United Kingdom, Germany, and France, we are able to extend our analysis as far back as 1700. We find in every country a gradual rise` of wealth-income ratios in recent decades, from about 200–300% in 1970 to 400–600% in 2010. In effect, today’s ratios appear to be returning to the high values observed in Europe in the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries (600–700%). This can be explained by a long-run asset price recovery (itself driven by changes in capital policies since the world wars) and by the slowdown of productivity and population growth, in line with the β=sg Harrod-Domar-Solow formula. That is, for a given net saving rate s = 10%, the long-run wealth-income ratio β is about 300% if g = 3% and 600% if g = 1.5%. Our results have implications for capital taxation and regulation and shed new light on the changing nature of wealth, the shape of the production function, and the rise of capital shares.

10.1093/qje/qju018.abstractZh: 从长期来看，财富与收入的比率是如何变化的？为什么会出现这样的变化？我们通过使用1970年至2010年间八个主要发达国家的最新国家资产负债表数据来探讨这个问题。对于美国、英国、德国和法国，我们能够将分析追溯到1700年。我们发现，在每一个国家，近几十年来财富与收入的比率都在逐渐上升，从1970年的约200-300%上升到2010年的400-600%。实际上，今天的比率似乎正在回归到18和19世纪欧洲所观察到的高值（600-700%）。这一现象可以通过长期资产价格回升来解释（这一回升本身是由自世界大战以来的资本政策变化所驱动的），以及生产率和人口增长的放缓，这与β=sg Harrod-Domar-Solow公式相符。也就是说，在净储蓄率s=10%的情况下，如果经济增长率g=3%，长期财富与收入的比率约为300%；如果经济增长率g=1.5%，则约为600%。我们的研究结果对资本税收和监管提出了新的启示，并进一步揭示了财富性质的变化、生产函数的形态以及资本份额的上升。

abstract.text: We investigate the existence and importance of family welfare cultures, where the receipt of a welfare program by one generation causes increased participation in the next generation. Our context is Norway’s disability insurance (DI) system. To overcome the challenge of correlated unobservables across generations, we take advantage of random assignment of judges to DI applicants whose cases are initially denied. Some appeal judges are systematically more lenient, which leads to random variation in the probability a parent will be allowed DI. Using this exogenous variation, we find strong evidence for a causal link across generations: when a parent is allowed DI at the appeal stage, their adult child’s participation over the next five years increases by 6 percentage points. This effect grows over time, rising to 12 percentage points after 10 years. Although these findings are specific to our setting, they highlight that welfare reforms can have long-lasting effects on program participation, since any original effect on the current generation could be reinforced by changing the participation behavior of their children as well. The detailed nature of our data allows us to compare the intergenerational transmission with spillover effects in other networks and to explore mechanisms.

10.1093/qje/qju019.abstractZh: 我们研究了家庭福利文化的存在及其重要性，即一代人获得某项福利计划后，会导致下一代人参与该计划的程度增加。我们的研究背景是挪威的残疾保险制度。为了克服跨代际相关不可观测变量的挑战，我们利用了随机分配法官来审理最初被拒绝的残疾保险申请案例的方法。部分上诉法官在判决时表现出系统性地更宽松的态度，这导致父母获得残疾保险的概率出现随机变化。利用这种外生变化，我们发现跨代际之间存在强烈的因果关系：当父母在上诉阶段获得残疾保险时，其成年子女在接下来的五年中参与该计划的比例会增加6个百分点。这一效应随着时间的推移而增强，在十年后增加到12个百分点。尽管这些发现仅适用于我们的研究环境，但它们表明福利改革可以对项目参与产生长期影响，因为对当前一代人的任何初始影响都可能通过改变其子女的参与行为而得到加强。我们数据的详细性质使我们能够将这些代际传递现象与其他网络中的溢出效应进行比较，并探索相关机制。

abstract.text: This article investigates the role of mass media in times of conflict and state-sponsored mass violence against civilians. We use a unique village-level data set from the Rwandan genocide to estimate the impact of a popular radio station that encouraged violence against the Tutsi minority population. The results show that the broadcasts had a significant effect on participation in killings by both militia groups and ordinary civilians. An estimated 51,000 perpetrators, or approximately 10% of the overall violence, can be attributed to the station. The broadcasts increased militia violence not only directly by influencing behavior in villages with radio reception but also indirectly by increasing participation in neighboring villages. In fact, spillovers are estimated to have caused more militia violence than the direct effects. Thus, the article provides evidence that mass media can affect participation in violence directly due to exposure and indirectly due to social interactions.

10.1093/qje/qju020.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在冲突时期以及国家主导的对平民的大规模暴力行为中，大众媒体的作用。我们利用了卢旺达种族灭绝事件中的独特村级数据集，来估算一家鼓励对图西少数民族实施暴力的广播电台的影响。研究结果表明，这些广播节目对民兵组织和普通平民参与杀戮行为产生了显著影响。估计有51,000名实施暴力者，约占整体暴力事件的10%，这些暴力行为可归因于该广播电台的广播。这些广播节目不仅通过影响有收音机接收能力的村庄中的行为，直接加剧了民兵的暴力行为，还通过促进邻近村庄的参与，间接加剧了暴力行为。实际上，溢出效应导致的暴力行为数量超过了直接效应。因此，本文提供了证据，表明大众媒体可以通过曝光和社交互动，直接影响暴力行为的参与，也可以通过间接方式产生影响。

abstract.text: Rationality leads people to imitate those with similar tastes but different information. But people who imitate common sources develop correlated beliefs, and rationality demands that later social learners take this correlation into account. This implies severe limits to rational imitation. We show that (i) in most natural observation structures besides the canonical single-file case, full rationality dictates that people must “anti-imitate” some of those they observe; and (ii) in every observation structure full rationality dictates that people imitate, on net, at most one person and are imitated by, on net, at most one person, over any set of interconnected players. We also show that in a very broad class of settings, any learning rule in which people regularly do imitate more than one person without anti-imitating others will lead to a positive probability of people converging to confident and wrong long-run beliefs.

10.1093/qje/qju021.abstractZh: 理性使人模仿那些具有相似品味但信息不同的个体。然而，模仿常见行为模式的人会形成相互关联的信念，而理性要求后来的学习者必须考虑这种关联性。这意味着理性模仿存在严重的限制。我们证明：(i)在除典型单文件结构之外的大多数自然观察结构中，完全理性要求人们必须“反模仿”一些他们观察到的个体；(ii)在任何观察结构中，完全理性都意味着人们最多只能模仿一个个体，并且最多只能被一个个体模仿，无论涉及多少相互关联的参与者。我们还表明，在非常广泛的情境下，任何一种学习规则——其中人们经常模仿多个个体而不进行反模仿——都会导致人们趋向于形成自信但错误的长期信念，且这种概率较高。

abstract.text: We use administrative records on the incomes of more than 40 million children and their parents to describe three features of intergenerational mobility in the United States. First, we characterize the joint distribution of parent and child income at the national level. The conditional expectation of child income given parent income is linear in percentile ranks. On average, a 10 percentile increase in parent income is associated with a 3.4 percentile increase in a child’s income. Second, intergenerational mobility varies substantially across areas within the United States. For example, the probability that a child reaches the top quintile of the national income distribution starting from a family in the bottom quintile is 4.4% in Charlotte but 12.9% in San Jose. Third, we explore the factors correlated with upward mobility. High mobility areas have (i) less residential segregation, (ii) less income inequality, (iii) better primary schools, (iv) greater social capital, and (v) greater family stability. Although our descriptive analysis does not identify the causal mechanisms that determine upward mobility, the publicly available statistics on intergenerational mobility developed here can facilitate research on such mechanisms.

10.1093/qje/qju022.abstractZh: 我们利用超过4000万儿童及其父母的收入行政记录，来描述美国代际流动性的三个特征。首先，我们描述了全国范围内父母与子女收入联合分布的情况。给定父母收入时，子女收入的条件期望与收入百分位数呈线性关系。平均而言，父母收入上升10个百分点，子女收入会相应上升3.4个百分点。其次，美国的各地区的代际流动性存在显著差异。例如，从收入最低五分位家庭的子女中，达到全国收入分布最高五分位的概率在夏洛特为4.4%，而在圣何塞则为12.9%。第三，我们探讨了与向上流动相关的因素。高流动性地区具有以下特点：(i) 住宅隔离程度较低；(ii) 收入不平等程度较低；(iii) 小学教育质量较好；(iv) 社会资本较强；(v) 家庭稳定性较高。尽管我们的描述性分析未能确定决定向上流动的机制，但这里提供的关于代际流动性的公开统计数据可以为相关研究提供有用的信息。

abstract.text: We use a lab experiment to explore the factors that predict an individual’s decision to contribute her idea to a group. We find that contribution decisions depend on the interaction of gender and the gender stereotype associated with the decision-making domain: conditional on measured ability, individuals are less willing to contribute ideas in areas that are stereotypically outside of their gender’s domain. Importantly, these decisions are largely driven by self-assessments, rather than fear of discrimination. Individuals are less confident in gender-incongruent areas and are thus less willing to contribute their ideas. Because even very knowledgeable group members undercontribute in gender-incongruent categories, group performance suffers and, ex post, groups have difficulty recognizing who their most talented members are. Our results show that even in an environment where other group members show no bias, women in male-typed areas and men in female-typed areas may be less influential. An intervention that provides feedback about a woman’s (man’s) strength in a male-typed (female-typed) area does not significantly increase the probability that she contributes her ideas to the group. A back-of-the-envelope calculation reveals that a “lean in”–style policy that increases contribution by women would significantly improve group performance in male-typed domains.

10.1093/qje/qju023.abstractZh: 我们通过实验室实验来探讨影响个人决定向团队贡献自己想法因素的因素。研究发现，贡献决策取决于性别与与决策领域相关的性别刻板印象之间的相互作用：在能力得到衡量的情况下，个体在那些被刻板印象认为属于其性别领域之外的领域，不太愿意贡献想法。重要的是，这些决策主要由自我评估驱动，而非对歧视的恐惧。个体在性别不一致的领域缺乏信心，因此也不愿意贡献自己的想法。由于即使是知识非常丰富的团队成员在性别不一致的领域也会贡献较少，团队的绩效也会受到影响，而且事后很难识别出最优秀的成员。我们的结果显示，即使其他团队成员没有偏见，处于男性型领域的女性以及女性型领域的男性可能影响力较小。一项提供关于女性（男性）在男性型（女性型）领域优势的反馈的干预措施，并不会显著增加她们向团队贡献想法的可能性。粗略计算表明，一项鼓励女性更多贡献的“倾斜政策”将显著提升团队在男性型领域的绩效。

abstract.text: This article defines and analyzes a “sparse max” operator, which is a less than fully attentive and rational version of the traditional max operator. The agent builds (as economists do) a simplified model of the world which is sparse, considering only the variables of first-order importance. His stylized model and his resulting choices both derive from constrained optimization. Still, the sparse max remains tractable to compute. Moreover, the induced outcomes reflect basic psychological forces governing limited attention. The sparse max yields a behavioral version of basic chapters of the microeconomics textbook: consumer demand and competitive equilibrium. I obtain a behavioral version of Marshallian and Hicksian demand, Arrow-Debreu competitive equilibrium, the Slutsky matrix, the Edgeworth box, Roy’s identity, and so on. The Slutsky matrix is no longer symmetric: nonsalient prices are associated with anomalously small demand elasticities. Because the consumer exhibits nominal illusion, in the Edgeworth box, the offer curve is a two-dimensional surface rather than a one-dimensional curve. As a result, different aggregate price levels correspond to materially distinct competitive equilibria, in a similar spirit to a Phillips curve. The Arrow-Debreu welfare theorems typically do not hold. This framework provides a way to assess which parts of basic microeconomics are robust, and which are not, to the assumption of perfect maximization.

10.1093/qje/qju024.abstractZh: 本文定义并分析了“稀疏最大值”算子，它是一种低于完全注意力和理性水平的传统最大值算子的版本。作者像经济学家一样构建了一个简化的世界模型，该模型是稀疏的，仅考虑一阶重要的变量。他的简化模型及其产生的选择都源于约束优化。尽管如此，稀疏最大值仍然易于计算。此外，由此产生的结果反映了支配有限注意力的基本心理力量。稀疏最大值产生了微观经济学教科书中的基本章节——消费者需求和竞争均衡的行为版本。我得到了马歇尔需求和希克斯需求的行为版本、阿罗-德布鲁竞争均衡、斯卢特斯基矩阵、埃奇沃斯盒、罗伊恒等式等。斯卢特斯基矩阵不再对称：非显著价格与异常小的需求弹性相关联。由于消费者表现出名义幻觉，在埃奇沃斯盒中，供给曲线是一个二维表面而不是一维曲线。因此，不同的总体价格水平对应着实质上不同的竞争均衡，这与菲利普斯曲线类似。阿罗-德布鲁福利定理通常不成立。这一框架提供了一种方法来评估基本微观经济学中的哪些部分在完全最大化假设下是稳健的，哪些则不是。

abstract.text: This article proposes a welfare criterion for economies in which agents have heterogeneously distorted beliefs. Instead of taking a stand on whose belief is correct, our criterion asserts that an allocation is belief-neutral efficient (inefficient) if it is efficient (inefficient) under any convex combination of agents’ beliefs. Although this criterion gives an incomplete ranking of social allocations, it can identify positive- and negative-sum speculation driven by conflicting beliefs in a broad range of economic environments.

10.1093/qje/qju025.abstractZh: 本文为那些存在异质性扭曲信念的经济体提出了一个福利标准。我们的标准并非判断哪种信念是正确的，而是认为，如果一个分配方案在任何代理人的信念组合下都是有效（或无效）的，那么这个分配方案就是信念中立的、有效的（或无效的）。尽管这一标准无法全面评价各种社会分配方案，但它能够识别在多种经济环境中由相互冲突的信念所驱动的正和负和型投机行为。

abstract.text: We analyze the effect of exposure to international trade on earnings and employment of U.S. workers from 1992 through 2007 by exploiting industry shocks to import competition stemming from China’s spectacular rise as a manufacturing exporter paired with longitudinal data on individual earnings by employer spanning close to two decades. Individuals who in 1991 worked in manufacturing industries that experienced high subsequent import growth garner lower cumulative earnings, face elevated risk of obtaining public disability benefits, and spend less time working for their initial employers, less time in their initial two-digit manufacturing industries, and more time working elsewhere in manufacturing and outside of manufacturing. Earnings losses are larger for individuals with low initial wages, low initial tenure, and low attachment to the labor force. Low-wage workers churn primarily among manufacturing sectors, where they are repeatedly exposed to subsequent trade shocks. High-wage workers are better able to move across employers with minimal earnings losses and are more likely to move out of manufacturing conditional on separation. These findings reveal that import shocks impose substantial labor adjustment costs that are highly unevenly distributed across workers according to their skill levels and conditions of employment in the pre-shock period.

10.1093/qje/qju026.abstractZh: 我们分析了1992年至2007年间，美国工人因接触国际贸易而对收入和就业的影响。研究利用了中国作为制造出口国迅速崛起所带来的进口竞争冲击，并结合了关于个人收入与雇主关系的纵向数据，这些数据涵盖了近二十年的时间。1991年从事制造业且随后进口增长较快的工人，其累计收入较低，获得公共残疾福利的风险较高，他们在初始雇主处的工作时间较短，在最初从事的制造业行业中的工作时间也较短，而在其他制造业或非制造业领域的工作时间则较长。收入损失在初始工资低、初始工作年限短以及与劳动力联系较弱的工人中更为严重。低工资工人主要在制造业部门流动，因为他们不断受到后续贸易冲击的影响。而高工资工人则能够更轻松地在不同雇主之间转移，且离职后更有可能离开制造业领域。这些发现表明，进口冲击给劳动力带来了巨大的调整成本，这些成本在不同工人的技能水平和就业状况上存在明显的不均衡分布。

abstract.text: We investigate how potential tax-driven migrations modify the Mirrlees income tax schedule when two countries play Nash. The social objective is the maximin and preferences are quasi-linear in consumption. Individuals differ both in skills and migration costs, which are continuously distributed. We derive the optimal marginal income tax rates at the equilibrium, extending the Diamond-Saez formula. We show that the level and the slope of the semi-elasticity of migration (on which we lack empirical evidence) are crucial to derive the shape of optimal marginal income tax.

10.1093/qje/qju027.abstractZh: 我们研究了潜在的税收驱动型迁移如何改变Mirrlees所得税制度，当两个国家进行纳什博弈时。社会目标是最大化最小收益，而偏好在消费方面是准线性的。个体在技能和迁移成本上有所不同，这些差异是连续分布的。我们推导出了均衡状态下的最优边际所得税率，并扩展了Diamond-Saez公式。我们表明，迁移的半弹性水平与斜率（我们缺乏相关经验数据）对于确定最优边际所得税率的形状至关重要。

abstract.text: A body of literature suggests that ethnic heterogeneity limits economic growth. This article provides microeconometric evidence on the direct effect of ethnic divisions on productivity. In team production at a plant in Kenya, an upstream worker supplies and distributes flowers to two downstream workers, who assemble them into bunches. The plant uses an essentially random rotation process to assign workers to positions, leading to three types of teams: (i) ethnically homogeneous teams, and teams in which (ii) one or (iii) both downstream workers belong to a tribe in rivalry with the upstream worker’s tribe. I find strong evidence that upstream workers undersupply non-coethnic downstream workers (vertical discrimination) and shift flowers from non-coethnic to coethnic downstream workers (horizontal discrimination), at the cost of lower own pay and total output. A period of ethnic conflict following Kenya’s 2007 election led to a sharp increase in discrimination. In response, the plant began paying the two downstream workers for their combined output (team pay). This led to a modest output reduction in (i) and (iii) teams—as predicted by standard incentive models—but an increase in output in (ii) teams, and overall. Workers’ behavior before conflict, during conflict, and under team pay is predicted by a model of taste-based discrimination. My findings suggest that interethnic rivalries lower allocative efficiency in the private sector, that the economic costs of ethnic diversity vary with the political environment, and that in high-cost environments firms are forced to adopt “second best” policies to limit discrimination distortions.

10.1093/qje/qju028.abstractZh: 大量文献表明，种族差异会限制经济增长。本文提供了关于种族分化对生产力直接影响的小数据经济学证据。在肯尼亚的一家工厂中，上游的工人负责为两名下游的工人提供并分发花朵，后者再将花朵组装成花束。工厂采用一种随机的轮岗机制来分配工人到各个岗位，从而形成三种类型的团队：(i) 种族同质的团队，以及(ii) 一名或两名下游工人属于与上游工人所属部落对立的部落的团队。我发现，上游工人会减少对非同种族下游工人的供应（垂直歧视），并将花朵分配给非同种族的下游工人（水平歧视），而代价是自己的工资和总产出下降。2007年肯尼亚选举后的一段种族冲突时期导致歧视现象加剧。作为应对措施，工厂开始为两名下游工人提供基于他们团队产出的报酬。正如标准激励模型所预测的，这导致(i)和(iii)团队的产出略有下降，但(ii)团队的产出有所增加，整体产出也有所提升。基于 taste-based 歧视模型，可以预测冲突前、冲突期间以及团队报酬制度下工人的行为。我的研究发现表明，种族间的竞争会降低私营部门的资源配置效率，种族多样性的经济成本会随着政治环境的变化而变化，而在高成本环境下，企业被迫采取“次优”政策来限制歧视带来的扭曲。

abstract.text: This article considers a two-sided search market where firms and workers are paired to bargain over a unit surplus. The matching market serves as an endogenous outside option for the agents. The market includes inflexible commitment types who demand a constant portion of any match surplus. The frequency of such types is determined in equilibrium.An equilibrium where there are significant delays in reaching an agreement and where negotiations occasionally break down on the equilibrium path is constructed. Such an equilibrium exists and commitment types affect bargaining dynamics even if the equilibrium frequency of such types is negligible. If the inflows of firms and workers into the market are symmetric, then bargaining involves two-sided reputation building and reputation concerns lead to delays and inefficiency. Access to the market exacerbates bargaining inefficiencies caused by inflexible types. If the inflows of workers and firms are sufficiently asymmetric, then bargaining involves one-sided reputation and commitment types determine the terms of trade.

10.1093/restud/rdt021.abstractZh: 本文研究了一个双边搜索市场，在该市场中，企业和工人被配对以协商剩余单位。匹配市场为参与者提供了一个内生性的外部选择。该市场包括那些要求固定份额剩余单位的刚性承诺类型。这类类型的出现频率在均衡状态下被确定。本文构建了一个均衡状态，在这种状态下，达成协议的延迟显著，且谈判在均衡过程中偶尔会出现中断。即使这类类型的均衡出现频率可以忽略不计，这种均衡仍然存在，并且承诺类型会影响谈判动态。如果企业和工人进入市场的流量是对称的，那么谈判涉及双边声誉的建立，而声誉问题会导致延迟和低效率。进入市场的机会会加剧由刚性承诺类型引起的谈判低效。如果工人和企业的流量足够不对称，那么谈判涉及单边声誉，而承诺类型决定了交易条款。

abstract.text: Entrusting the power to punish to a central authority is a hallmark of civilization, yet informal or horizontal sanctions have attracted more attention of late. We study experimentally a collective action dilemma and test whether subjects choose a formal sanction scheme that costs less than the surplus it makes possible, as predicted by standard economic theory, or instead opt for the use of informal sanctions (IS) or no sanctions. Our subjects choose, and succeed in using, IS surprisingly often, their voting decisions being responsive to the cost of formal sanctions. Adoption by voting enhances the efficiency of both IS and non-deterrent formal sanctions. Results are qualitatively confirmed under several permutations of the experimental design.

10.1093/restud/rdt022.abstractZh: 将惩罚权力委托给中央权威是文明的一个标志，然而，非正式或横向制裁近年来受到了更多关注。我们通过实验研究集体行动困境，并测试受试者是否会选择一种成本低于其带来的收益的正式制裁方案，正如标准经济理论所预测的那样，或者选择使用非正式制裁（IS）或根本不采取制裁。我们的受试者出乎意料地经常选择并使用非正式制裁，他们的投票决策对正式制裁的成本非常敏感。通过投票来采用非正式制裁，能够提升非正式制裁和非威慑性正式制裁的效率。实验结果在实验设计的几种变体中得到了定性确认。

abstract.text: We report laboratory experiments that use new, visually oriented software to explore the dynamics of 3×3 games with intransitive best responses. Each moment, each player is matched against the entire population, here 8 human subjects. A “heat map” offers instantaneous feedback on current profit opportunities. In the continuous slow adjustment treatment, we see distinct cycles in the population mix. The cycle amplitude, frequency and direction are consistent with the standard learning models. Cycles are more erratic and higher frequency in the instantaneous adjustment treatment. Control treatments (using simultaneous matching in discrete time) replicate previous results that exhibit weak or no cycles. Average play is approximated fairly well by Nash equilibrium, and an alternative point prediction, “TASP” (Time Average of the Shapley Polygon), captures some regularities that Nash equilibrium misses.

10.1093/restud/rdt023.abstractZh: 我们报告了实验室实验，这些实验使用新的、以视觉为导向的软件来探索具有非传递最优反应的3×3游戏的动态行为。在每一个时刻，每个玩家都会与整个群体进行匹配，这里共有8名人类受试者。“热图”提供了关于当前盈利机会的即时反馈。在连续缓慢调整的处理中，我们观察到群体组合中存在明显的周期变化。这些周期的变化幅度、频率和方向与标准学习模型一致。而在即时调整的处理中，周期变化更为不规则且频率更高。使用离散时间下的同时匹配控制的实验则复制了先前的研究结果，即没有或仅有较弱的周期变化。平均游戏结果可以相当好地通过纳什均衡来近似描述，而另一种点预测方法“TASP”（Shapley多边形的时间平均值）能够捕捉到纳什均衡未能体现的一些规律性。

abstract.text: This article studies optimal monetary policy when decision-makers in firms choose how much attention they devote to aggregate conditions. When the amount of attention that decision-makers in firms devote to aggregate conditions is exogenous, complete price stabilization is optimal only in response to shocks that cause efficient fluctuations under perfect information. When decision-makers in firms choose how much attention they devote to aggregate conditions, complete price stabilization is optimal also in response to shocks that cause inefficient fluctuations under perfect information. Hence, recognizing that decision-makers in firms can choose how much attention they devote to aggregate conditions has major implications for optimal policy.

10.1093/restud/rdt024.abstractZh: 本文研究了企业在决策者选择对总体状况关注程度时的最优货币政策。当企业决策者对总体状况的关注程度是外生的时，只有在能够引起在完全信息条件下有效波动的冲击下，完全价格稳定才是最优政策。而当企业决策者选择对总体状况关注程度时，即使在完全信息条件下会导致效率不高的波动，完全价格稳定也是最优政策。因此，认识到企业决策者可以选择对总体状况的关注程度，对于最优政策制定具有重要意义。

abstract.text: Taking advantage of unique longitudinal data, we provide the first characterization of what college students believe at the time of entrance about their final major, relate these beliefs to actual major outcomes, and provide an understanding of why students hold the initial beliefs about majors that they do. The data collection and analysis are based directly on a conceptual model in which a student's final major is best viewed as the end result of a learning process. We find that students enter school quite optimistic about obtaining a science degree, but that relatively few students end up graduating with a science degree. The substantial overoptimism about completing a degree in science can be attributed largely to students beginning school with misperceptions about their ability to perform well academically in science.

10.1093/restud/rdt025.abstractZh: 利用独特的纵向数据，我们首次对大学生在入学时对自己最终专业所持有的信念进行了描述性分析，将这些信念与实际的专业选择结果进行了关联，并探讨了学生为何会持有这样的初始信念。数据收集与分析直接基于一个概念模型，该模型将学生的最终专业视为学习过程的终结果。我们发现，学生入学时对于获得科学学位持相当乐观的态度，但最终获得科学学位的学生比例却相对较低。学生对于完成科学学位的过度乐观态度，很大程度上源于他们入学时对自己在科学领域取得良好成绩的能力存在误解。

abstract.text: The growth in labour market participation among women with young children has raised concerns about its implications for child cognitive development. We estimate a model of the cognitive development process of children nested within an otherwise standard model of household behaviour. The household makes labour supply decisions and provides time and money inputs into the child quality production process during the development period. Our empirical results indicate that both parents' time inputs are important for the cognitive development of their children, particularly when the child is young. Money expenditures are less productive in terms of producing child quality. Comparative statics exercises demonstrate that cash transfers to households with children have small impacts on child quality due to the relatively low impact of money investments on child outcomes and the fact that a significant fraction of the transfer is spent on other household consumption and the leisure of the parents.

10.1093/restud/rdt026.abstractZh: 女性在有年幼孩子的家庭中参与劳动力市场的增长引发了人们对其对儿童认知发展影响的担忧。我们构建了一个模型，将儿童认知发展过程纳入一个标准的家庭行为模型中。家庭在发展过程中做出劳动力供给决策，并为儿童的发展提供时间和金钱投入。我们的实证结果表明，父母的时间投入对儿童认知发展非常重要，尤其是在孩子年幼时。金钱支出在提升儿童认知质量方面的作用较小。比较静态分析表明，向有孩子的家庭提供现金转移对儿童认知质量的影响较小，因为金钱投资对儿童结果的影响相对较低，而且相当一部分转移资金被用于其他家庭消费和父母的休闲活动。

abstract.text: This article provides evidence that schools can influence parents' involvement in education, and this has causal effects on pupils' behaviour. Furthermore, it shows how the impact of more involved parents on their children is amplified at the class level by peer group interaction. We build on a large-scale controlled experiment run in a French deprived educational district, where parents of middle-school children were invited to participate in a simple program of parent–school meetings on how to get better involved in their children's education. At the end of the school year, we find that treated families have increased their school-and home-based involvement activities. In turn, pupils of treatment classes have developed more positive behaviour and attitudes in school, notably in terms of truancy and disciplinary sanctions (with effects-size around 15% of a standard deviation). However, test scores did not improve under the intervention. Our results suggest that parents are an input for schooling policies and it is possible to influence important aspects of the schooling process at low cost.

10.1093/restud/rdt027.abstractZh: 本文提供了证据，表明学校能够影响家长对教育的参与程度，这对学生的行为具有因果效应。此外，研究还揭示了更积极参与的家长对孩子的影响在班级层面因同伴群体互动而得到放大。我们的研究基于一项在法国一个贫困教育区进行的大规模对照实验，实验中邀请了初中学生的家长参与一项简单的家长-学校会议计划，旨在帮助他们更好地参与孩子的教育。学年结束时，我们发现接受干预的家庭在学校和家庭层面的参与活动有所增加。相应地，接受干预的班级学生在学校中的行为和行为态度更为积极，尤其是在逃学和纪律处分方面（效果大小约为标准偏差的15%）。然而，干预措施并未提升学生的考试成绩。我们的研究结果表明，家长是学校教育政策的重要参与者，而且可以以较低的成本影响学校教育过程的重要方面。

abstract.text: Job protection and cash benefits are key elements of parental leave (PL) systems. We study how these two policy instruments affect return-to-work and medium-run labour market outcomes of mothers of newborn children. Analysing a series of major PL policy changes in Austria, we find that longer cash benefits lead to a significant delay in return-to-work, particularly so in the period that is job-protected. Prolonged parental leave absence induced by these policy changes does not appear to hurt mothers' labour market outcomes in the medium run. We build a non-stationary model of job search after childbirth to isolate the role of the two policy instruments. The model matches return-to-work and return to same employer profiles under the various factual policy configurations. Counterfactual policy simulations indicate that a system that combines cash with protection dominates other systems in generating time for care immediately after birth while maintaining mothers' medium-run labour market attachment.

10.1093/restud/rdt028.abstractZh: 工作保护和现金福利是育儿假制度中的关键要素。我们研究了这两种政策工具如何影响新生儿母亲重返工作岗位的情况以及劳动力市场的中期表现。通过对奥地利一系列重大育儿假政策变化的分析，我们发现较长的现金福利会导致重返工作岗位的延迟，尤其是在工作受到保护期间。这些政策变化导致的长期育儿假缺席似乎并不会对母亲在劳动力市场中的表现造成负面影响。我们建立了一个非平稳模型来模拟产后求职情况，以分离这两种政策工具的作用。该模型在各种政策配置下匹配了重返工作岗位和回到同一雇主的情况。反事实政策模拟表明，结合现金福利与工作保护制度的体系能够在为产后护理提供时间的同时，保持母亲在劳动力市场中的长期依附性。

abstract.text: We investigate whether two players in a long-run relationship can maintain cooperation when the details of the underlying game are unknown. Specifically, we consider a new class of repeated games with private monitoring, where an unobservable state of the world influences the payoff functions and/or the monitoring structure. Each player privately learns the state over time but cannot observe what the opponent learned. We show that there are robust equilibria in which players eventually obtain payoffs as if the true state were common knowledge and players played a “belief-free” equilibrium. We also provide explicit equilibrium constructions in various economic examples.

10.1093/restud/rdt029.abstractZh: 我们研究在长期关系中，当两个参与者之间的具体博弈细节未知时，他们是否能够保持合作。具体来说，我们考虑了一类带有私人监控的重复博弈，其中不可观测的世界状态会影响收益函数和/或监控结构。每个参与者会随时间秘密地了解状态，但无法观察到对手学到了什么。我们证明了存在稳健的均衡，在这种均衡下，参与者最终获得的收益相当于真实状态为公开知识，并且参与者遵循了“无信念”的均衡策略。我们还通过各种经济案例提供了具体的均衡构造方法。

abstract.text: It is widely believed that rent-sharing reduces the incentives for investment when long term contracts are infeasible because some of the returns to sunk capital are captured by workers. We propose a simple test for the degree of hold-up based on the fraction of capital costs that are deducted from the quasi-rent that determines negotiated wages. We implement the test using a data set that combines Social Security earnings records for workers in the Veneto region of Italy with detailed financial information for employers. We find strong evidence of rent-sharing, with an elasticity of wages with respect to current profitability of the firm of 3-7%, arising mainly from firms in concentrated industries. On the other hand we find little evidence that bargaining lowers the return on investment. Instead, firm-level bargaining appears to split the rents after deducting the full cost of capital.

10.1093/restud/rdt030.abstractZh: 人们普遍认为，当长期合同不可行时，租金共享会降低投资的激励，因为部分沉没资本的收益被工人获取。我们提出了一种基于从准租金中扣除的资本成本比例来测试租金共享程度的简单方法。我们使用一个数据集进行了测试，该数据集结合了意大利威尼托地区工人的社会保障收入记录以及雇主的详细财务信息。我们发现租金共享现象非常明显，企业当前盈利能力的变动对工资的影响率为3-7%，这一现象主要出现在集中行业的企业中。另一方面，我们发现议价行为对降低投资回报的影响很小。相反，企业层面的议价似乎在扣除全部资本成本后，将租金进行了分配。

abstract.text: Do labour markets discriminate against workers with particular ethnic-sounding names? We use non-random sorting into inter-ethnic marriage and salient differences between Sephardic and Ashkenazi surnames to evaluate the causal impact of Sephardic affiliation on wages. Using the 1995 Israeli Census, we estimate the effect of a Sephardic sounding surname on wages.
