This generalizes existing efficiency results in the competitive search literature by simultaneously allowing for nonrival (many-on-one) meetings and private information. (JEL D44, D82)

10.1257/aer.104.10.3288.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们展示了在竞争拍卖模型中，卖方进入的效率。该模型同时考虑了买家和卖家的异质性，这扩展了现有竞争搜索文献中的效率研究结果，因为它同时允许非竞争性（多对一）的匹配和私人信息交流。（JEL D44, D82）

abstract.text: This paper revisits the results of Moskowitz and Vissing-Jørgensen (2002) on returns to entrepreneurial investments in the United States. Following the authors' methodology and new data from the Survey of Consumer Finances, I find that the “private equity premium puzzle” does not survive the period of high public equity returns in the 1990s. The difference between private and public equity returns is positive and large period-by-period between 1999 and 2007. Whereas in the 2008–2010 period, overlapping with the Great Recession, public and private equities performances are substantially closer. I validate these results in the aggregate data going back to the 1960s. (JEL G11, G12, L26)

10.1257/aer.104.10.3297.abstractZh: 本文重新审视了Moskowitz和Vissing-Jørgensen在2002年关于美国创业投资回报的研究结果。根据作者的研究方法以及《消费者金融调查》的新数据，我发现“私募股权溢价之谜”在1990年代公共股权回报较高的时期并不成立。从1999年到2007年期间，私募股权与公共股权回报之间的差异始终为正且幅度较大。而在2008至2010年期间，由于与大衰退时期重合，公共股权和私募股权的表现更为接近。我在涵盖1960年代以来的综合数据中验证了这些结果。（JEL G11, G12, L26）

abstract.text: To combat adverse selection, governments increasingly base payments to health plans and providers on enrollees’ scores from risk-adjustment formulae. In 2004, Medicare began to risk-adjust capitation payments to private Medicare Advantage (MA) plans to reduce selection-driven overpayments. But because the variance of medical costs increases with the predicted mean, incentivizing enrollment of individuals with higher scores can increase the scope for enrolling "overpriced" individuals with costs significantly below the formula's prediction. Indeed, after risk adjustment, MA plans enrolled individuals with higher scores but lower costs conditional on their score. We find no evidence that overpayments were on net reduced.

10.1257/aer.104.10.3335.abstractZh: 为了应对逆向选择问题，政府越来越多地根据风险调整公式得出的患者评分来决定对医疗计划和提供者的支付金额。2004年，医疗保险开始对私人医疗保险附加计划中的按人头付费方式进行风险调整，以减少因选择驱动而导致的过度支付。但由于医疗成本的方差随着平均值的增加而增加，激励高评分患者的注册可能会促使那些成本远低于公式预测值的“高价”患者也被纳入保险范围。事实上，在风险调整之后，医疗保险附加计划确实吸引了高评分但成本较低的患者。我们没有发现过度支付有所减少的证据。

abstract.text: We examine the relationship between concentration and price dispersion using variation induced by a merger in the Canadian mortgage market. Since interest rates are determined through a search and negotiation process, consolidation weakens consumers' bargaining positions. We use reduced-form techniques to estimate the mergers' distributional impact, and show that competition benefits only consumers at the bottom and middle of the transaction price distribution, and that mergers reduce the dispersion of prices. We illustrate that these effects can be explained by the presence of search frictions, and that the average effect of mergers on rates underestimates the increase in market power. (JEL G21, G34, K21, L13, L41)

10.1257/aer.104.10.3365.abstractZh: 我们研究了加拿大抵押贷款市场因合并而产生的价格分散性与集中度之间的关系。由于利率是通过搜索和谈判过程确定的，因此合并会削弱消费者的议价能力。我们使用简化形式的技术来估算合并的分配影响，并发现竞争只对价格分布低端和中端的消费者有利，而合并会降低价格的分散性。我们的研究表明，这些效应可以通过搜索摩擦的存在来解释，而且合并对利率的平均影响低估了市场力量的增加程度。（JEL G21, G34, K21, L13, L41）

abstract.text: We collect a new dataset on capital punishment in the United States and we propose a test of racial bias based upon patterns of sentence reversals. We model the courts as minimizing type I and II errors. If trial courts were unbiased, conditional on defendant's race the error rate should be independent of the victim's race. Instead we uncover 3 and 9 percentage points higher reversal rates in direct appeal and habeas corpus cases, respectively, against minority defendants who killed whites. The pattern for white defendants is opposite but not statistically significant. This bias is confined to Southern states. (JEL J15, K41, K42)

10.1257/aer.104.11.3397.abstractZh: 我们收集了关于美国死刑的新数据集，并提出了一种基于判决撤销模式的种族偏见测试。我们将法院建模为最小化第一类和第二类错误。如果审判法庭是无偏见的，那么在被告的种族条件下，错误率应该与受害者的种族无关。然而，我们发现，在针对杀害白人的少数族裔被告的直接上诉和人身保护令案件中，判决撤销率分别高出3和9个百分点。对于白人被告来说，情况则相反，但这一差异并不具有统计学意义。这种偏见仅限于南方各州。（JEL J15, K41, K42）

abstract.text: A key feature of arbitration is the possibility for conflicting parties to participate in the selection of the arbitrator, the individual who will rule the case. We analyze this problem of the selection of arbitrators from the perspective of implementation theory. In particular, theoretical analyses document problems with veto-rank—a simultaneous procedure commonly used in practice—and develop a new sequential procedure—shortlisting—with better properties. Experimental results are consistent with the theoretical predictions, highlighting both the disadvantages associated with the veto-rank procedure and the advantages associated with the shortlisting procedure. (JEL D71, D72)

10.1257/aer.104.11.3434.abstractZh: 仲裁的一个关键特点是，冲突各方可以参与仲裁员的选拔，即决定案件裁决的个体。我们从实施理论的角度分析了仲裁员选拔的问题。具体而言，理论分析指出了“否决权排名”这一在实践中常用的同时选拔程序存在的问题，并提出了一种新的顺序选拔程序——短名单制，该程序具有更好的性能。实验结果与理论预测一致，凸显了“否决权排名”程序的缺点以及“短名单制”程序的优点。（JEL D71, D72）

abstract.text: We provide conditions under which contingent claim and asset demands are consistent with state independent Expected Utility maximization. The paper focuses on the case of a single commodity and demands are allowed to be functions of probabilities and not just prices and income. We extend prior analyses by deriving three distinct tests for demands to be rationalized by Expected Utility: (i) a contingent claim analogue to the certainty strong axiom of revealed preference, (ii) a characterization of the functional form for demand, and (iii) necessary and sufficient conditions based on the Slutsky matrix. (JEL D01, D11, D81)

10.1257/aer.104.11.3459.abstractZh: 我们提出了条件，使得附条件索赔和资产需求与状态独立的期望效用最大化相一致。本文聚焦于单一商品的情况，并假设需求可以是概率的函数，而不仅仅是价格和收入的函数。我们通过推导三个不同的测试来扩展先前的研究，以验证需求是否符合期望效用：第一，一个与揭示偏好的确定性强公理相对应的附条件索赔类比；第二，对需求功能形式的描述；第三，基于Slutsky矩阵的必要性和充分条件。 (JEL D01, D11, D81)

abstract.text: We consider a growth model in which intergenerational transfers are made via stocks of private and public capital. Private capital is the outcome of individuals' private savings while decisions regarding public capital are made collectively. We hypothesize that private saving choices evolve through individual selection while public saving decisions are the result of group selection. The main result of the paper is that the equilibrium rate of return to private capital is at least 2–3 percent more than the rate of return to public capital. In other words, social choices involving intertemporal trade-offs exhibit much more patience than individual choices do. (JEL D11, D71, D91, H43)

10.1257/aer.104.11.3481.abstractZh: 我们考虑了一个增长模型，其中代际转移是通过私人和公共资本存量来实现的。私人资本是个体私人储蓄的结果，而关于公共资本的决定则是集体做出的。我们假设私人储蓄选择是通过个体选择来演变的，而公共储蓄决策则是群体选择的结果。本文的主要结论是，私人资本的均衡回报率至少比公共资本的回报率高出2-3%。换句话说，涉及跨时期权衡的社会选择比个体选择表现出更多的耐心。（JEL D11, D71, D91, H43）

abstract.text: We survey 561 students from U.S. medical schools shortly after they submit choice rankings over residencies to the National Resident Matching Program. We elicit ( a ) these choice rankings, ( b ) anticipated subjective well-being (SWB) rankings, and ( c ) expected features of the residencies (such as prestige). We find substantial differences between choice and anticipated-SWB rankings in the implied tradeoffs between residency features. In our data, evaluative SWB measures (life satisfaction and Cantril's ladder) imply tradeoffs closer to choice than does affective happiness (even time-integrated), and as close as do multi-measure SWB indices. We discuss implications for using SWB data in applied work.

10.1257/aer.104.11.3498.abstractZh: 我们调查了561名来自美国医学院的学生，这些学生在国家住院医师匹配计划提交住院医师选择排名后不久进行了调查。我们收集了（a）这些选择排名、（b）预期的主观幸福感排名，以及（c）住院医师所期望的特征（如声望）。我们发现，在选择排名与预期主观幸福感排名之间存在显著差异，这些差异体现在住院医师特征之间的权衡上。在我们的数据中，评估性主观幸福感指标（如生活满意度和Cantril的满意度量表）所反映的权衡更接近选择排名，而情感幸福感（即使经过时间整合）所反映的权衡则与之相当接近，多指标主观幸福感指数也是如此。我们讨论了在应用研究中使用主观幸福感数据的相关意义。

abstract.text: We develop a framework where mismatch between vacancies and job seekers across sectors translates into higher unemployment by lowering the aggregate job-finding rate. We use this framework to measure the contribution of mismatch to the recent rise in US unemployment by exploiting two sources of cross-sectional data on vacancies, JOLTS and HWOL. Our calculations indicate that mismatch, across industries and three-digit occupations, explains at most one-third of the total observed increase in the unemployment rate. Occupational mismatch has become especially more severe for college graduates, and in the West of the United States. Geographical mismatch unemployment plays no apparent role. (JEL E24, J22, J24, J41, J63)

10.1257/aer.104.11.3529.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个框架，该框架指出不同行业之间空缺与求职者之间的不匹配会导致整体求职率下降，从而加剧失业问题。我们利用这一框架，通过分析两种关于空缺数据的横截面数据——JOLTS和HWOL，来衡量这种不匹配对美国近期失业率上升的影响。我们的计算表明，不同行业和三位数职业类别中的不匹配现象，最多只能解释失业率总体上升的三分之一。对于大学毕业生而言，职业不匹配现象尤为严重，尤其是在美国的西部地区。而地理上的不匹配对失业率则没有明显影响。（JEL E24, J22, J24, J41, J63）

abstract.text: Hiring inexperienced workers generates information about their abilities. If this information is public, workers obtain its benefits. If workers cannot compensate firms for hiring them, firms will hire too few inexperienced workers. I determine the effects of hiring workers and revealing more information about their abilities through a field experiment in an online marketplace. I hired 952 randomly-selected workers, giving them either detailed or coarse public evaluations. Both hiring workers and providing more detailed evaluations substantially improved workers' subsequent employment outcomes. Under plausible assumptions, the experiment's market-level benefits exceeded its cost, suggesting that some experimental workers had been inefficiently unemployed. (JEL J23, J24, M51)

10.1257/aer.104.11.3565.abstractZh: 雇佣缺乏经验的工人可以获取关于他们能力的信息。如果这些信息被公开，工人就能从中获益。如果工人无法为雇佣他们而向企业支付报酬，企业就会雇佣过少的缺乏经验的工人。我通过在线市场的一个实地实验来研究雇佣工人以及公开更多关于他们能力的信息所带来的影响。我随机选择了952名工人，并给他们提供详细或粗略的公开评价。无论是雇佣工人还是提供更详细的评价，都显著改善了工人后续的就业结果。在合理的假设下，实验带来的市场层面的收益超过了成本，这表明一些实验中的工人实际上是处于低效的失业状态。（JEL J23, J24, M51）

abstract.text: Motivated by empirical evidence I uncover on the dynamics of French firms' exports, I offer a novel theory of trade frictions. Firms export only into markets where they have a contact. They search directly for new trading partners, but also use their existing network of contacts to search remotely for new partners. I characterize the dynamic formation of an international network of exporters in this model. Structurally, I estimate this model on French data and confirm its predictions regarding the distribution of the number of foreign markets accessed by exporters and the geographic distribution of exports. (JEL D85, F11, F14, L24)

10.1257/aer.104.11.3600.abstractZh: 基于我对法国企业出口动态的经验性研究，我提出了一种关于贸易摩擦的新理论。企业只向有联系的市场出口产品。它们直接寻找新的贸易伙伴，同时也利用现有的联系网络来远程寻找新的合作伙伴。我描述了这种模型中国际出口商网络的动态形成过程。在结构上，我利用法国数据对模型进行了验证，并确认了模型关于出口商接触的外国市场数量分布以及出口地理分布方面的预测。（JEL D85, F11, F14, L24）

abstract.text: If workers self-select into industries based upon their relative productivity in different tasks, and comparative advantage is aligned with absolute advantage, then the average efficacy of a sector's workforce will be negatively correlated with its employment share. This might explain the difference in the reported productivity growth of contracting goods and expanding services. Instrumenting with defense expenditures, I find the elasticity of worker efficacy with respect to employment shares is substantially negative, albeit estimated imprecisely. The estimates suggest that the view that goods and services have similar productivity growth rates is a plausible alternative characterization of growth in developed economies. (JEL E23, E24, H56, J24, O41, O47)

10.1257/aer.104.11.3635.abstractZh: 如果工人根据其在不同任务中的相对生产力自行选择进入某些行业，并且比较优势与绝对优势相一致，那么一个行业劳动力的平均效率与其就业份额将呈负相关。这或许可以解释收缩性商品和扩张性服务在报告中的生产率增长差异。通过国防支出进行计量分析，我发现工人效率与就业份额的弹性显著为负，尽管这一估计并不十分精确。这些估计表明，认为商品和服务具有相似生产率增长率的观点，是描述发达经济体增长的一种合理的替代性解释方式。（JEL E23, E24, H56, J24, O41, O47）

abstract.text: Quantitatively, we investigate the allocative and welfare effects of secondary markets for cars. An important source of gains from trade in these markets is the heterogeneity in the willingness to pay for higher-quality (newer) goods, but transaction costs are an impediment to instantaneous trade. Calibration of the model successfully matches several aggregate features of the US and French used-car markets. Counterfactual analyses show that transaction costs have a large effect on volume of trade, allocations, and the primary market. Aggregate effects on consumer surplus and welfare are relatively small, but the effect on lower-valuation households can be large. (JEL D23, L62, L81)

10.1257/aer.104.11.3668.abstractZh: 我们定量研究了汽车二级市场在资源配置和福利效应方面的表现。这些市场交易的一个重要收益来源是人们对高质量（较新）商品的支付意愿存在差异，但交易成本却阻碍了交易的即时进行。模型的校准成功匹配了美国和法国二手车市场的若干总体特征。反事实分析表明，交易成本对交易量、资源配置以及初级市场都有显著影响。对消费者剩余和福利的总体影响相对较小，但对价值较低的家庭的影响可能较大。（JEL D23, L62, L81）

abstract.text: By allowing for an extensive margin in the standard quantity-quality model, we generate new insights into fertility transitions. We test the model on Southern black women affected by a large-scale school construction program. Consistent with our model, women facing improved schooling opportunities for their children were more likely to have at least one child but chose to have smaller families overall. By contrast, women who themselves obtained more schooling due to the program delayed childbearing along both the extensive and intensive margins and entered higher quality occupations, consistent with education raising opportunity costs of child rearing. (JEL I20, J13, J15, J16, J24)

10.1257/aer.104.11.3701.abstractZh: 通过在标准的数量-质量模型中留出较大的边际空间，我们对生育转变有了新的认识。我们在受大规模学校建设计划影响的南方黑人女性身上测试了该模型。与我们的模型一致，那些面临子女教育机会改善的女性更有可能至少生育一个孩子，但总体上选择较小的家庭规模。相比之下，由于该计划而自身获得更多教育机会的女性则推迟了生育时间，无论是在广泛的边际还是密集的边际上，并且进入了更高素质的职业，这与教育提高了抚养孩子的机会成本相一致。（JEL I20, J13, J15, J16, J24）

abstract.text: Hume (1748) challenged the idea that a general claim (e.g., “all swans are white”) can be validated by empirical evidence, no matter how compelling. We examine this issue from the perspective of a tester who must accept or reject the forecasts of a potential expert. If experts can be skeptical about the validity of claims then they can evade rejection strategically. In contrast, if experts are required to conclude that claims backed by sufficient evidence are likely to be true, then they can be tested and rejected. These results provide an economic rationale for claim validation based on incentive problems. (JEL D82)

10.1257/aer.104.11.3725.abstractZh: 休谟在1748年对“一般性的主张（例如‘所有天鹅都是白色的’）无论多么有说服力，都无法通过实证证据来验证”这一观点提出了挑战。我们从测试者的角度来审视这个问题：测试者必须接受或拒绝潜在专家的预测。如果专家能够对主张的有效性持怀疑态度，那么他们就可以策略性地避免被拒绝。相反，如果专家被要求得出基于充分证据的支持性主张很可能是正确的结论，那么这些主张就可以被测试和拒绝。这些结果为基于激励问题的主张验证提供了经济学上的依据。（JEL D82）

abstract.text: In this paper, I offer two ways in which firms can collude: secret monitoring and infrequent coordination. Such collusion is enforceable with intuitive communication protocols. I make my case in the context of a repeated Cournot oligopoly with flexible production, prices that follow a Brownian motion and no monetary side payments, an environment where it has previously been argued that any collusion is impossible. Trade associations can easily facilitate collusion by mediating communication amongst firms. (JEL D21, D43, L12, L13)

10.1257/aer.104.11.3737.abstractZh: 在本文中，我提出了企业勾结的两种方式：秘密监控和不频繁的协调。这种勾结可以通过直观的沟通协议来实施。我以重复博弈的库尔诺寡头垄断模型为背景进行论述，该模型中的生产具有灵活性，价格遵循布朗运动，且不存在货币性支付，而在这样的环境中，人们曾认为任何勾结都是不可能的。行业协会可以通过调解企业之间的沟通来轻松促成勾结。（JEL D21, D43, L12, L13）

abstract.text: This paper reconsiders the traditional approach to human capital measurement in the study of cross-country income differences. Within a broader class of neoclassical human capital aggregators, traditional accounting is found to be a theoretical lower bound on human capital differences across economies. Implementing a generalized accounting empirically illustrates the possibility that capital variation may now account (even fully) for the large income variation between rich and poor countries. These findings reject the constraints on human capital variation that traditional accounting has imposed. (JEL E24, J24)

10.1257/aer.104.11.3752.abstractZh: 本文重新审视了在跨国收入差异研究中衡量人力资本的传统方法。在新古典人力资本理论框架内，传统的会计方法被证明是解释不同经济体间人力资本差异的理论下限。通过实证分析，发现广义会计方法有可能完全解释富裕国家与贫穷国家之间巨大的收入差异。这些发现否定了传统会计方法对人力资本差异的约束。（JEL E24, J24）

abstract.text: A principal allocates an object to one of I agents. Each agent values receiving the object and has private information regarding the value to the principal of giving it to him. There are no monetary transfers, but the principal can check an agent’s information at a cost. A favored-agent mechanism specifies a value v* and an agent i*. If all agents other than i* report values below v*, then i* receives the good and no one is checked. Otherwise, whoever reports the highest value is checked and receives the good if and only if her report is confirmed. All optimal mechanisms are essentially randomizations over optimal favored-agent mechanisms. (JEL D82)

10.1257/aer.104.12.3779.abstractZh: 一位委托人将某物品分配给一位代理人。每位代理人都希望获得该物品，并且拥有关于委托人是否愿意将该物品给予他的私人信息。这里没有货币转移，但委托人可以以一定的成本验证代理人的信息。一种优先代理人机制会指定一个价值v*和一个代理人i*。如果除了i*之外的所有代理人报告的数值都低于v*，那么i*将获得该物品，且无需进行验证。否则，报告最高价值的代理人将被验证，并且只有在她的报告得到确认的情况下才能获得该物品。所有最优机制本质上都是对最优优先代理人机制的随机化处理。（JEL D82）

abstract.text: Ambiguous choice problems which involve three or more outcome values can reveal aspects of ambiguity and ambiguity aversion which cannot be displayed in the classic two-outcome Ellsberg urn problems, and hence are not always captured by models designed to accommodate them. These aspects include Allais-type preferences over purely subjective acts, attitudes toward different sources involving different amounts of ambiguity, and attitudes toward ambiguity at different outcome levels. This paper presents a few such examples, and examines the standard models' predictions and performance in such cases. (JEL D81)

10.1257/aer.104.12.3814.abstractZh: 涉及三个或更多结果值的模糊选择问题能够揭示一些模糊性和模糊厌恶的方面，这些方面在经典的两种结果的Ellsberg urn问题中无法体现，因此并不总是能够被设计用来处理这些问题的模型所捕捉。这些方面包括对纯粹主观行为的Allais型偏好、对不同涉及不同模糊度的来源的态度，以及对不同结果水平下模糊度的态度。本文列举了一些这样的例子，并探讨了标准模型的预测和在这些情况下的表现。（JEL D81）

abstract.text: We estimate an insurer-specific preference function which rationalizes hospital referrals for privately insured births in California. The function is additively separable in: a hospital price paid by the insurer, the distance traveled, and plan- and severity-specific hospital fixed effects (capturing hospital quality). We use an inequality estimator that allows for errors in price and detailed hospital-severity interactions and obtain markedly different results than those from a logit. The estimates indicate that insurers with more capitated physicians are more responsive to price. Capitated plans send patients further to utilize similar quality, lower-priced hospitals; but the cost-quality trade-off does not vary with capitation rates.

10.1257/aer.104.12.3841.abstractZh: 我们估计了一个与保险公司相关的偏好函数，该函数用于解释加利福尼亚州私人保险客户分娩时医院转诊的合理性。该函数在以下三个因素之间是可加分的：保险公司支付的医院费用、旅行距离，以及计划类型和病情严重程度相关的医院固定效应（反映医院质量）。我们采用了一种不等式估计方法，能够处理费用以及医院病情严重程度之间的交互作用误差，并得出了与逻辑模型截然不同的结果。估计结果显示，拥有更多固定费用医生的保险公司对费用更为敏感。固定费用计划会促使患者前往质量相似且价格较低的医院；但成本与质量的权衡并不随固定费用率的变化而变化。

abstract.text: Do lobbyists provide issue-specific information to members of Congress? Or do they provide special interests access to politicians? We present evidence to assess the role of issue expertise versus connections in the US Federal lobbying process and illustrate how both are at work. In support of the connections view, we show that lobbyists follow politicians they were initially connected to when those politicians switch to new committee assignments. In support of the expertise view, we show that there is a group of experts that even politicians of opposite political affiliation listen to. However, we find a more consistent monetary premium for connections than expertise. (JEL D72, D82)

10.1257/aer.104.12.3885.abstractZh: 游说人士是否为国会议员提供特定议题的信息？还是为特殊利益集团提供与政客接触的机会？我们提供了证据来评估在美国联邦游说过程中，议题专业知识与人际关系的作用，并说明了两者是如何同时发挥作用的。在支持人际关系观点的研究中，我们发现游说人士会追随最初与之有联系的政治人物，即使这些政治人物后来被分配到新的委员会。在支持专业知识观点的研究中，我们发现有一群专家，即使是政治立场相反的政治人物也会听取这些专家的意见。然而，我们发现人际关系所带来的金钱回报更为稳定，而非专业知识。（JEL D72, D82）

abstract.text: We make use of a new data resource--merged birth and school records for all children born in Florida from 1992 to 2002--to study the relationship between birth weight and cognitive development. Using singletons as well as twin and sibling fixed effects models, we find that the effects of early health on cognitive development are essentially constant through the school career; that these effects are similar across a wide range of family backgrounds; and that they are invariant to measures of school quality. We conclude that the effects of early health on adult outcomes are therefore set very early.

10.1257/aer.104.12.3921.abstractZh: 我们利用了一项新的数据资源——1992年至2002年间在佛罗里达州出生的所有儿童的合并出生和入学记录——来研究出生体重与认知发展之间的关系。通过单胎、双胞胎和兄弟姐妹固定效应模型的分析，我们发现早期健康状况对认知发展的影响在儿童整个成长过程中基本保持不变；这些影响在不同家庭背景中表现出相似性；并且不受学校质量的影响。因此，我们得出结论，早期健康状况对成人结果的影响在很早期就已经确定下来。

abstract.text: Private equity critics claim that leveraged buyouts bring huge job losses and few gains in operating performance. To evaluate these claims, we construct and analyze a new dataset that covers US buyouts from 1980 to 2005. We track 3,200 target firms and their 150,000 establishments before and after acquisition, comparing to controls defined by industry, size, age, and prior growth. Buyouts lead to modest net job losses but large increases in gross job creation and destruction. Buyouts also bring TFP gains at target firms, mainly through accelerated exit of less productive establishments and greater entry of highly productive ones. (JEL D24, G24, G32, G34, J23, J63, L25)

10.1257/aer.104.12.3956.abstractZh: 私募股权批评者声称，杠杆收购会导致大量就业机会的丧失，而运营绩效的提升却很少。为了评估这些说法，我们构建并分析了一个新的数据集，该数据集涵盖了1980至2005年间美国的收购案例。我们跟踪了3,200家目标企业及其在收购前后的15万家企业，并与按行业、规模、年龄和先前增长情况定义的对照组进行了比较。收购导致就业机会的净损失较为轻微，但总体就业机会的创造和破坏却显著增加。收购还带来了目标企业的技术效率提升，主要是通过加速淘汰效率较低的企业，并引入效率较高的企业来实现的。（JEL D24, G24, G32, G34, J23, J63, L25）

abstract.text: Every year housing markets in the United Kingdom and the United States experience systematic above-trend increases in prices and transactions during the spring and summer (“hot season”) and below-trend falls during the autumn and winter (“cold season”). House price seasonality poses a challenge to existing housing models. We propose a search-and-matching model with thick-market effects. In thick markets, the quality of matches increases, rising buyers' willingness to pay and sellers' desire to transact. A small, deterministic driver of seasonality can be amplified and revealed as deterministic seasonality in transactions and prices, quantitatively mimicking seasonal fluctuations in UK and US markets. (JEL C78, R21, R31)

10.1257/aer.104.12.3991.abstractZh: 每年，英国和美国的住房市场在春季和夏季（“热季”）都会出现系统性地高于趋势的价格和交易增长，而在秋季和冬季则会出现低于趋势的下降。“房价季节性变化”对现有的住房模型提出了挑战。我们提出了一个具有市场厚度的匹配模型。在市场规模较大的市场中，匹配的质量提高，导致买家支付意愿上升，卖家交易意愿增强。一个小的、确定性的季节性因素可以被放大，并表现为交易和价格的确定性季节性变化，从而定量模拟英国和美国市场的季节性波动。（JEL C78, R21, R31）

abstract.text: The volume of new issuances in secondary loan markets fluctuates over time and falls when collateral values fall. We develop a model with adverse selection and reputation that is consistent with such fluctuations. Adverse selection ensures that the volume of trade falls when collateral values fall. Without reputation, the equilibrium has separation, adverse selection is quickly resolved, and trade volume is independent of collateral value. With reputation, the equilibrium has pooling and adverse selection persists over time. The equilibrium is efficient unless collateral values are low and originators' reputational levels are low. We describe policies that can implement efficient outcomes. (JEL D82, G11, G21, G28)

10.1257/aer.104.12.4027.abstractZh: 次级贷款市场中的新发行量随时间波动，当抵押品价值下降时，新发行量也会减少。我们建立了一个包含逆向选择和声誉机制的模型，该模型能够解释这种波动现象。逆向选择机制确保了在抵押品价值下降时交易量会减少。如果没有声誉机制，市场会出现分离现象，逆向选择会迅速得到解决，交易量与抵押品价值无关。而有了声誉机制，市场会出现集中现象，逆向选择会持续存在。除非抵押品价值较低，且发行者的声誉水平较低，否则这种均衡是有效的。我们提出了一些可以实现高效结果的政策建议。（JEL D82, G11, G21, G28）

abstract.text: We conduct the first empirical investigation of common-pool resource users' dynamic and strategic behavior at the micro level using real-world data. Fishermen's strategies in a fully dynamic game account for latent resource dynamics and other players' actions, revealing the profit structure of the fishery. We compare the fishermen's actual and socially optimal exploitation paths under a time-specific vessel allocation policy and find a sizable dynamic externality. Individual fishermen respond to other users by exerting effort above the optimal level early in the season. Congestion is costly instantaneously but is beneficial in the long run because it partially offsets dynamic inefficiencies. (JEL D24, Q21, Q22)

10.1257/aer.104.12.4071.abstractZh: 我们首次利用真实世界的数据，在微观层面上对公共资源使用者的动态与战略行为进行了实证研究。在完全动态博弈中，渔民的策略考虑了潜在的资源动态以及其他参与者的行为，从而揭示了渔业的利润结构。我们比较了在特定时间分配船只政策下，渔民实际采用的捕捞方式与社会最优捕捞方式，发现存在显著的动态外部性。个体渔民在季节初期会付出超过最优水平的努力来应对其他使用者。虽然瞬时拥堵会带来成本，但从长远来看却是有益的，因为它可以部分弥补动态效率的不足。（JEL D24, Q21, Q22）

abstract.text: How large are optimal tariffs? What tariffs would prevail in a worldwide trade war? How costly would a breakdown of international trade policy cooperation be? And what is the scope for future multilateral trade negotiations? I address these and other questions using a unified framework which nests traditional, new trade, and political economy motives for protection. I find that optimal tariffs average 62 percent, world trade war tariffs average 63 percent, the government welfare losses from a breakdown of international trade policy cooperation average 2.9 percent, and the possible government welfare gains from future multilateral trade negotiations average 0.5 percent. (JEL F12, F13, O19)

10.1257/aer.104.12.4104.abstractZh: 最优关税是多少？在全球贸易战中会采取何种关税？国际贸易政策合作的破裂会带来多大的成本？未来多边贸易谈判的潜力又有多大？我通过一个统一的框架来探讨这些问题，该框架整合了传统贸易、新贸易以及政治经济学中的保护动机。我发现，最优关税平均为62%，全球贸易战中的关税平均为63%，国际贸易政策合作破裂导致的政府福利损失平均为2.9%，而未来多边贸易谈判可能带来的政府福利收益平均为0.5%。（JEL F12, F13, O19）

abstract.text: We develop a revealed preference methodology that allows us to explore whether time inconsistencies in household choice are the product of individual preference nonstationarities or the result of individual heterogeneity and renegotiation within the household. An empirical application to household-level microdata highlights that an explicit recognition of the collective nature of household choice enables the observed behavior to be rationalized by a theory that assumes preference stationarity at the individual level. The methodology created in this paper also facilitates the recovery of theory-consistent discount rates for each individual within particular household under study. (JEL E24, F13, F16)

10.1257/aer.104.12.4147.abstractZh: 我们开发了一种揭示偏好方法，可以探讨家庭选择中的时间不一致性是由于个体偏好非平稳性造成的，还是由于个体异质性和家庭内部的重新协商所导致的。通过对家庭层面微观数据的实证分析发现，明确认识到家庭选择的集体性质，可以使观察到的行为被一个假设个体层面偏好平稳性的理论所解释。本文所创建的方法论还有助于为研究中的每个家庭内的个体恢复符合理论的折现率。（JEL E24, F13, F16）

abstract.text: We study collective decisions by time-discounting individuals choosing a common consumption stream. We show that with any heterogeneity in time preferences, utilitarian aggregation necessitates a present bias. In lab experiments three quarters of “social planners” exhibited present biases, and less than two percent were time consistent. Roughly a third of subjects acted as if they were pure utilitarians, and the rest chose as if they also had varying degrees of distributional concerns. (JEL C91, D12, D71, D72)

10.1257/aer.104.12.4184.abstractZh: 我们通过时间折现的方法来研究集体决策，即个体选择共同消费路径的过程。我们发现，无论时间偏好是否存在差异，功利主义聚合都必然导致当前偏好。在实验室实验中，四分之三的“社会规划者”表现出当前偏好，而只有不到2%的人表现出时间一致性。大约三分之一的受试者表现得像纯粹的功利主义者，其余的则表现出不同程度的分配关切。（JEL C91, D12, D71, D72）

abstract.text: This paper uses a unique panel dataset of consumer financial transactions to study how consumers respond to an exogenous unanticipated income shock. Consumption rose significantly after the fiscal policy announcement: during the ten subsequent months, for each $1 received, consumers on average spent $0.80. We find a strong announcement effect—19 percent of the response occurs during the first two-month announcement period via credit cards. Subsequently, consumers switched to debit cards after disbursement before finally increasing spending on credit cards in the later months. Consumers with low liquid assets or with low credit card limit experienced stronger consumption responses. (JEL D12, D14, E21)

10.1257/aer.104.12.4205.abstractZh: 本文利用独特的消费者金融交易面板数据集，研究消费者如何对外部未预期的收入冲击作出反应。在财政政策公告发布后，消费显著上升：在随后的十个月里，每收到1美元的收入，消费者平均支出为0.80美元。我们发现公告效应非常明显——19%的消费者反应发生在公告发布后的前两个月，且主要通过信用卡进行消费。此后，消费者在资金支出后转向使用借记卡，而在后期则更多地使用信用卡进行消费。拥有较低流动资产或信用卡额度有限的消费者，其消费反应更为强烈。（JEL D12, D14, E21）

abstract.text: We show that the risk-shock business cycle model of Fernández-Villaverde et al. (2011) must be recalibrated because it underpredicts the targeted business cycle moments by a factor of three once a time aggregation error is corrected. Recalibrating the corrected model for the benchmark case of Argentina, the peak response and the contribution of interest rate risk shocks to business cycle volatility increase. However, the recalibrated model does worse in capturing the business cycle properties of net exports once an additional error in the computation of net exports is corrected. (JEL E13, E20, E32, E43, F32, F43, O11)

10.1257/aer.104.12.4231.abstractZh: 我们指出，Fernández-Villaverde等人（2011年）提出的风险-冲击商业周期模型需要重新校准，因为一旦修正了时间聚合误差，该模型对目标商业周期时刻的预测偏差高达三倍。针对阿根廷的基准案例重新校准模型后，商业周期波动的峰值响应以及利率风险冲击的贡献显著增加。然而，一旦修正了净出口计算中的额外误差，重新校准后的模型在捕捉净出口的商业周期特性方面表现更差。（JEL E13, E20, E32, E43, F32, F43, O11）

abstract.text: Short-term collateralized debt, private money, is efficient if agents are willing to lend without producing costly information about the collateral backing the debt. When the economy relies on such informationally insensitive debt, firms with low quality collateral can borrow, generating a credit boom and an increase in output. Financial fragility is endogenous; it builds up over time as information about counterparties decays. A crisis occurs when a ( possibly small) shock causes agents to suddenly have incentives to produce information, leading to a decline in output. A social planner would produce more information than private agents but would not always want to eliminate fragility. (JEL D83, E23, E32, E44, G01)

10.1257/aer.104.2.343.abstractZh: 短期抵押债务和私人资金在以下情况下是有效的：当代理人愿意提供贷款而无需提供关于债务抵押品的信息时。当经济依赖于这种信息不敏感债务时，那些拥有低质量抵押品的企业可以借款，从而导致信贷繁荣和产出增加。金融脆弱性是内生性的；随着对手方信息逐渐丧失，脆弱性会随时间逐渐积累。当一次（可能较小的）冲击导致代理人突然有动机去提供信息时，就会发生危机，从而导致产出下降。社会规划者会比私人代理人提供更多信息，但并不总是希望消除脆弱性。（JEL D83, E23, E32, E44, G01）

abstract.text: This article studies the full equilibrium dynamics of an economy with ﬁnancial frictions. Due to highly nonlinear ampliﬁcation effects, the economy is prone to instability and occasionally enters volatile crisis episodes. Endogenous risk, driven by asset illiquidity, persists in crisis even for very low levels of exogenous risk. This phenomenon, which we call the volatility paradox, resolves the Kocherlakota ( 2000) critique. Endogenous leverage determines the distance to crisis. Securitization and derivatives contracts that improve risk sharing may lead to higher leverage and more frequent crises. (JEL E13, E32, E44, E52, G01, G12, G20)

10.1257/aer.104.2.379.abstractZh: 本文研究了一个存在金融摩擦的经济体的完全均衡动态。由于高度非线性的放大效应，该经济体容易陷入不稳定状态，并偶尔会经历动荡的危机。由资产流动性不足引发的内生风险，即使在极低的外生风险水平下也会持续存在。这种现象我们称之为“波动性悖论”，它解决了Kocherlakota（2000年）提出的批评。内生杠杆率决定了危机发生的距离。证券化以及能够改善风险分担的衍生品合约可能会导致更高的杠杆率，并引发更频繁的危机。（JEL E13, E32, E44, E52, G01, G12, G20）

abstract.text: We use producer-level data to evaluate the role of financial frictions in determining total factor productivity (TFP). We study a model of establishment dynamics in which financial frictions reduce TFP through two channels. First, finance frictions distort entry and technology adoption decisions. Second, finance frictions generate dispersion in the returns to capital across existing producers and thus productivity losses from misallocation. Parameterizations of our model consistent with the data imply fairly small losses from misallocation, but potentially sizable losses from inefficiently low levels of entry and technology adoption. (JEL E32, E44, F41, G32, L60, O33, O47)

10.1257/aer.104.2.422.abstractZh: 我们使用生产者层面的数据来评估金融摩擦在决定全要素生产率中的作用。我们研究了一个关于企业设立动态的模型，其中金融摩擦通过两种途径降低全要素生产率。首先，金融摩擦扭曲了企业的进入和技术采纳决策。其次，金融摩擦导致现有生产者的资本回报出现分散，从而导致因资源配置不当而产生的生产率损失。与数据一致的模型参数化结果表明，由于资源配置不当造成的损失相对较小，但由于进入和采纳技术的效率低下，可能会带来相当大的损失。（JEL E32, E44, F41, G32, L60, O33, O47）

abstract.text: This paper proposes an accounting framework that breaks up a country’s gross exports into various value-added components by source and additional double-counted terms. Our parsimonious framework bridges a gap between official trade statistics (in gross value terms) and national accounts (in value-added terms), and integrates all previous measures of vertical specialization and value-added trade in the literature into a unified framework. To illustrate the potential of such a method, we present a number of applications including re-computing revealed comparative advantages and the magnifying impact of multi-stage production on trade costs. (JEL E01, E16, F14, F23, L14)

10.1257/aer.104.2.459.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个会计框架，该框架将一个国家的总出口按来源分解为不同的增值组成部分，并消除重复计算的项。我们的简约框架弥合了官方贸易统计数据（以总价值计算）与国民账户（以增值计算）之间的差距，并将所有先前关于垂直专业化和增值贸易的衡量方法整合到一个统一的框架中。为了说明这种方法的潜力，我们展示了一些应用实例，包括重新计算揭示的比较优势以及多阶段生产对贸易成本的放大影响。（JEL E01、E16、F14、F23、L14）

abstract.text: We build a theoretical model of multi-product firms that highlights how competition across market destinations affects both a firm’s exported product range and product mix. We show how tougher competition in an export market induces a firm to skew its export sales toward its best performing products. We find very strong confirmation of this competitive effect for French exporters across export market destinations. Theoretically, this within-firm change in product mix driven by the trading environment has important repercussions on firm productivity. A calibrated fit to our theoretical model reveals that these productivity effects are potentially quite large. (JEL D21, D24, F13, F14, F41, L11)

10.1257/aer.104.2.495.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个多产品企业的理论模型，该模型揭示了市场定位之间的竞争如何影响企业的出口产品范围和产品组合。我们发现，在出口市场中面临更激烈的竞争时，企业会将其出口销售转向表现最好的产品。我们对法国出口商在不同出口市场中的这一竞争效应进行了深入研究，发现这一结论得到了强有力的支持。从理论上讲，这种由贸易环境驱动的企业内部产品组合变化对企业生产力有着重要影响。根据我们的理论模型进行校准分析，这些生产力效应可能相当显著。（JEL D21, D24, F13, F14, F41, L11）

abstract.text: Nonlinear pricing and taxation complicate economic decisions by creating multiple marginal prices for the same good. This paper provides a framework to uncover consumers’ perceived price of nonlinear price schedules. I exploit price variation at spatial discontinuities in electricity service areas, where households in the same city experience substantially different nonlinear pricing. Using household-level panel data from administrative records, I find strong evidence that consumers respond to average price rather than marginal or expected marginal price. This suboptimizing behavior makes nonlinear pricing unsuccessful in achieving its policy goal of energy conservation and critically changes the welfare implications of nonlinear pricing. (JEL D12, L11, L94, L98, Q41)

10.1257/aer.104.2.537.abstractZh: 非线性定价和税收通过为同一商品设定多个边际价格，使得经济决策变得复杂。本文提供了一个框架，用于揭示消费者对非线性价格表的感知价格。我利用电力服务区域空间不连续点处的价格变化，发现同一城市内的家庭面临截然不同的非线性定价。通过利用行政记录中的家庭层面面板数据，我发现消费者更关注平均价格，而非边际或预期边际价格。这种次优行为使得非线性定价难以实现其节能政策目标，并显著改变了非线性定价的福利影响。（JEL D12, L11, L94, L98, Q41）

abstract.text: This paper explores the nature of fluctuations in world bulk shipping by quantifying the impact of time to build and demand uncertainty on investment and prices. We examine the impact of both construction lags and their lengthening in periods of high investment activity, by constructing a dynamic model of ship entry and exit. A rich dataset of secondhand ship sales allows for a new estimation strategy: resale prices provide direct information on value functions and allow their nonparametric estimation. We find that moving from time-varying to constant to no time to build reduces prices, while significantly increasing both the level and volatility of investment. (JEL G31, L11, L62, L92)

10.1257/aer.104.2.564.abstractZh: 本文通过量化建造时间的不确定性以及需求不确定性对投资和价格的影响，探讨了世界散装航运波动的本质。我们通过构建船舶进入和退出动态模型，研究了建造滞后及其在高投资活动时期延长的影响。丰富的二手船舶销售数据集为新的估计策略提供了可能：转售价格直接反映了价值函数，并允许对其进行非参数估计。我们发现，从时间变化到恒定，再到无建造时间，价格会下降，而投资水平与波动性则会显著上升。（JEL G31, L11, L62, L92）

abstract.text: A single worker allocates her time among different projects which are progressively assigned. When the worker works on too many projects at the same time, the output rate decreases and completion time increases according to a law which we derive. We call this phenomenon “task juggling” and argue that it is pervasive in the workplace. We show that task juggling is a strategic substitute of worker effort. We then present a model where task juggling is the result of lobbying by clients, or coworkers, each seeking to get the worker to apply effort to his project ahead of the others’. (JEL J22, M12, M54)

10.1257/aer.104.2.609.abstractZh: 一名工人将时间分配到不同的项目中，这些项目会依次被分配。当工人同时处理太多项目时，产出率会下降，完成时间也会延长，这一规律是我们推导出来的。我们将这种现象称为“任务调度”，并认为这种现象在工作场所普遍存在。我们指出，任务调度实际上是工人努力的一种策略性替代方式。随后，我们提出了一个模型，其中任务调度是客户或同事通过游说的结果，他们各自试图让工人将更多的努力投入到自己的项目中。（JEL J22, M12, M54）

abstract.text: Using a local randomized experiment that arises from a sharp discontinuity in Disability Insurance (DI) policy in Norway, we provide transparent and credible identification of how financial incentives induce DI recipients to return to work. We find that many DI recipients have considerable capacity to work that can be effectively induced by providing financial work incentives. We further show that providing work incentives to DI recipients may both increase their disposable income and reduce program costs. Our findings also suggest that targeted policies may be the most effective in encouraging DI recipients to return to work.

10.1257/aer.104.2.624.abstractZh: 通过利用挪威残疾保险政策中出现的显著突变所引发的局部随机实验，我们能够清晰地识别出经济激励如何促使残疾保险受益人重返工作岗位。研究发现，许多残疾保险受益人具备相当的工作能力，通过提供经济工作激励措施，可以有效激发他们的工作积极性。此外，我们进一步指出，向残疾保险受益人提供工作激励不仅会增加他们的可支配收入，还能降低保险项目的成本。我们的研究结果还表明，有针对性的政策可能是鼓励残疾保险受益人重返工作岗位的最有效手段。

abstract.text: A buyer wishes to purchase a good from a seller who chooses a sequence of prices over time. Each period the buyer can also exercise an outside option, abandoning their search or moving on to another seller. We show there is a unique equilibrium in which the seller charges a constant price in every period equal to the monopoly price, contravening the Coase conjecture. We then embed the single-seller model into a search framework and show the result provides a foundation for the usual “no haggling” assumption. (JEL C78, D42, D43, L12, L13)

10.1257/aer.104.2.656.abstractZh: 一位买家希望从一位随时间选择一系列价格的卖家处购买商品。在每个时期，买家还可以行使外部选择权，放弃搜索或转向另一位卖家。我们证明了存在一个唯一的均衡状态，在该状态下，卖家在每个时期都收取一个恒定的价格，这个价格等于垄断价格，这违背了科斯的猜想。随后，我们将单一卖家模型嵌入到一个搜索框架中，并表明该结果为通常的“不讨价还价”假设提供了基础。（JEL C78, D42, D43, L12, L13）

abstract.text: Resale price maintenance (RPM), slotting fees, loyalty rebates, and other related vertical practices can allow an incumbent manufacturer to transfer profits to retailers. If these retailers were to accommodate entry, upstream competition could lead to lower industry profits and the breakdown of these profit transfers. Thus, in equilibrium, retailers can internalize the effect of accommodating entry on the incumbent’s profits. Consequently, if entry requires downstream accommodation, entry can be deterred. We discuss policy implications of this aspect of vertical contracting practices. (JEL L14, L22, L25, L42, L81)

10.1257/aer.104.2.672.abstractZh: 转售价格维持（RPM）、时段费、忠诚度返利以及其他相关的纵向经营行为，可以使现有制造商将利润转移给零售商。如果这些零售商愿意接纳新进入者，上游竞争可能会导致行业利润下降，从而破坏这种利润转移。因此，在均衡状态下，零售商可以内部化接纳新进入者对现有制造商利润的影响。因此，如果新进入者需要下游的配合，那么新进入者可能会受到阻碍。我们讨论了这种纵向契约实践方面的政策含义。（JEL L14, L22, L25, L42, L81）

abstract.text: While filtering has long been considered the primary mechanism by which markets supply low-income housing, direct estimates of that process have been absent. This has contributed to doubts about the viability of markets and to misplaced policy. I fill this gap by estimating a “repeat income” model using 1985–2011 panel data. Real annual filtering rates are faster for rental housing (2.5 percent) than owner-occupied (0.5 percent), vary inversely with the income elasticity of demand and house price inflation, and are sensitive to tenure transitions as homes age. For most locations, filtering is robust which lends support for housing voucher programs. (JEL R21, R31, R38)

10.1257/aer.104.2.687.abstractZh: 虽然过滤长期以来被认为是市场提供低收入住房的主要机制，但关于这一过程的直接估计一直缺乏。这导致了人们对市场可行性的质疑，以及错误的政策制定。我通过利用1985至2011年的面板数据，建立了一个“重复收入”模型来填补这一空白。实际年过滤率在租赁住房中更高，为2.5%，而在自住住房中为0.5%。过滤率与需求收入弹性及房价通胀呈反向关系，并且随着房屋老化，过滤率会发生变化。对于大多数地区而言，过滤机制是稳健的，这为住房券计划提供了支持。（JEL R21, R31, R38）

abstract.text: Acemoglu et al. (2008) document that the correlation between income per capita and democracy disappears when including time and country fixed effects. While their results are robust for the full sample, we find evidence for significant but heterogeneous effects of income on democracy: negative for former colonies, but positive for non-colonies. Within the sample of colonies we detect heterogeneous effects related to colonial history and early institutions. The zero mean effect estimated by Acemoglu et al. (2008) is consistent with effects of opposite signs in the different subsamples. Our findings are robust to the use of alternative data and estimation techniques. (JEL D72, O17, O47)

10.1257/aer.104.2.707.abstractZh: Acemoglu等人（2008年）的研究表明，在纳入时间和国家固定效应后，人均收入与民主之间的关系消失了。尽管他们的研究结果适用于整个样本，但我们发现收入对民主的影响存在显著但异质性的特征：对于前殖民地国家而言，这种影响是负面的，而对于非殖民地国家则呈正面趋势。在殖民地样本内部，我们发现了与殖民历史和早期制度相关的异质性影响。Acemoglu等人（2008年）估计的零均值效应与不同子样本中的相反效应一致。我们的研究结果在采用其他数据来源和估计方法时依然保持稳定。（JEL D72, O17, O47）

abstract.text: The stigma associated with long-term unemployment spells could create large inefficiencies in labor markets. While the existing literature points toward large stigma effects, it has proven difficult to estimate causal relationships. Using data from a field experiment, we find that long-term unemployment spells in the past do not matter for employers' hiring decisions, suggesting that subsequent work experience eliminates this negative signal. Nor do employers treat contemporary short-term unemployment spells differently, suggesting that they understand that worker/firm matching takes time. However, employers attach a negative value to contemporary unemployment spells lasting at least nine months, providing evidence of stigma effects. (JEL E24, J23, J64, J71)

10.1257/aer.104.3.1014.abstractZh: 长期失业的污名可能会在劳动力市场中造成巨大的效率低下。尽管现有文献指出长期失业的污名效应较大，但很难准确估计其因果关系。通过一项实地实验的数据分析，我们发现过去长期失业经历对雇主的招聘决策并不重要，这表明后续的工作经验消除了这种负面信号。同时，雇主对当前短期失业经历也没有区别对待，这表明他们明白工人与企业的匹配需要时间。然而，雇主认为持续至少九个月的当前失业经历具有负面价值，这证明了污名效应的存在。（JEL E24, J23, J64, J71）

abstract.text: The existing literature on precautionary saving is based almost entirely on the assumption that the household acts as if it consisted of a single individual decision-taker. In reality saving decisions are typically taken by two-person households. This paper examines the implications of this observation for the existence of precautionary saving, and shows that the assumption that the individual utility functions satisfy the conditions for precautionary saving to exist can imply that the household exhibits precautionary saving, but only under strong assumptions on the type of risk change being considered. (JEL D14, D81)

10.1257/aer.104.3.1040.abstractZh: 现有关于预防性储蓄的文献几乎完全基于这样一个假设：家庭的行为就像是由一个单独的个人决策者所决定的。实际上，储蓄决策通常是由两人家庭共同做出的。本文探讨了这一观察对预防性储蓄存在性的影响，并表明，假设个人效用函数满足预防性储蓄存在的条件，虽然可以意味着家庭会表现出预防性储蓄行为，但这一结论只有在对所考虑的风险类型有严格假设的情况下才能成立。（JEL D14, D81）

abstract.text: This paper experimentally investigates whether money illusion generates substantial nominal inertia. Building on the design of Fehr and Tyran (2001), we find no evidence that agents choose high nominal payoffs over high real payoffs. However, participants do select prices associated with high nominal payoffs within a set of maximum real payoffs as a heuristic to simplify their decision task. The cognitive challenge of this task explains the majority of the magnitude of nominal inertia; money illusion exerts only a second-order effect. The duration of nominal inertia depends primarily on participants' best response functions, not the prevalence of money illusion. (JEL C91, D21, D83, E31, E41, E52, L11)

10.1257/aer.104.3.1047.abstractZh: 本文通过实验研究金钱错觉是否会产生显著的名义惯性。基于Fehr和Tyran（2001）的设计，我们没有发现参与者会选择高名义收益而非高实际收益。然而，参与者确实会在一定实际收益范围内选择与高名义收益相关的最低价格，以此作为简化决策任务的启发式方法。这一任务的认知挑战解释了名义惯性的大部分强度；金钱错觉仅起到次要作用。名义惯性的持续时间主要取决于参与者的最佳反应函数，而非金钱错觉的普遍性。（JEL C91, D21, D83, E31, E41, E52, L11）

abstract.text: The data in Fehr and Tyran (2001) and Petersen and Winn (2014) show that money illusion plays an important role in nominal price adjustment after a fully anticipated negative monetary shock. Money illusion affects subjects' expectations, and causes pronounced nominal inertia after a negative shock but much less inertia after a positive shock. Thus Petersen and Winn (2014) provide a misleading interpretation of both our and their own data. (JEL C92, D83, D84, E31, E32, E52)

10.1257/aer.104.3.1063.abstractZh: Fehr和Tyran（2001）以及Petersen和Winn（2014）的研究数据显示，在预期到负面货币冲击之后，货币幻觉在名义价格调整中起着重要作用。货币幻觉会影响受试者的预期，在负面冲击后会导致明显的名义惯性，而在正面冲击后则导致的惯性要小得多。因此，Petersen和Winn（2014）对他们的数据和我们自己的数据给出了误导性的解释。（JEL C92, D83, D84, E31, E32, E52）

abstract.text: In an article published in the American Economic Review, Jón Steinsson (2008) argues that two sticky price models driven by real shocks can explain the observed persistence, volatility, and hump-shaped impulse response function of the real exchange rate. This comment shows, first, that correcting an error in one of Steinsson's models leads to substantially lower persistence and volatility of the real exchange rate; second, that Steinsson's models cannot match real exchange rate volatility relative to output; and, third, that reasonable variations of the model calibration or specification all lead to lower real exchange rate persistence and volatility (or both). (JEL F41, F44, E52)

10.1257/aer.104.3.1072.abstractZh: 在《美国经济评论》上发表的一篇文章中，Jón Steinsson（2008）提出，两种受实际冲击驱动的粘性价格模型可以解释实际汇率的持续性、波动性和驼峰形脉冲响应函数。该文章首先指出，修正Steinsson模型中一个错误后，实际汇率的持续性和波动性会显著降低；其次，Steinsson的模型无法准确反映实际汇率相对于产出的波动情况；第三，对模型参数进行合理调整后，实际汇率的持续性和波动性都会降低（或两者同时降低）。（JEL F41, F44, E52）

abstract.text: I examine the impact of alternative monetary policy rules on a rational asset price bubble, through the lens of an overlapping generations model with nominal rigidities. A systematic increase in interest rates in response to a growing bubble is shown to enhance the fluctuations in the latter, through its positive effect on bubble growth. The optimal monetary policy seeks to strike a balance between stabilization of the bubble and stabilization of aggregate demand. The paper's main findings call into question the theoretical foundations of the case for “leaning against the wind” monetary policies. (JEL E13, E32, E44, E52, G12)

10.1257/aer.104.3.721.abstractZh: 我通过叠加世代模型的研究，探讨了不同货币政策规则对理性资产价格泡沫的影响，该模型包含名义刚性因素。研究表明，为应对不断扩大的泡沫而系统性提高利率，会通过促进泡沫增长来加剧其波动。最优货币政策应寻求在稳定泡沫与稳定总需求之间取得平衡。本文的主要发现对“逆风而行”的货币政策理论基础提出了质疑。（JEL E13, E32, E44, E52, G12）

abstract.text: We use rich historical data on military procurement to estimate the effects of government spending. We exploit regional variation in military buildups to estimate an “open economy relative multiplier” of approximately 1.5. We develop a framework for interpreting this estimate and relating it to estimates of the standard closed economy aggregate multiplier. The latter is highly sensitive to how strongly aggregate monetary and tax policy “leans against the wind.” Our open economy relative multiplier “differences out” these effects because monetary and tax policies are uniform across the nation. Our evidence indicates that demand shocks can have large effects on output. (JEL E12, E32, E62, F33, H56, H57, R12)

10.1257/aer.104.3.753.abstractZh: 我们利用丰富的军事采购历史数据来估算政府支出的影响。通过利用各地区军事建设的差异，我们估算出“开放经济相对乘数”约为1.5。我们构建了一个框架来解释这一估算结果，并将其与标准封闭经济总乘数的估算结果进行比较。后者对货币和税收政策的“逆风”程度非常敏感。我们的开放经济相对乘数“差异”消除了这些影响，因为货币政策和税收政策在全国范围内是统一的。我们的证据表明，需求冲击对产出有较大的影响。（JEL E12, E32, E62, F33, H56, H57, R12）

abstract.text: We empirically characterize the mechanics of trade adjustment during the Argentine crisis. Though imports collapsed by 70 percent from 2000 to 2002, the entry and exit of firms or products at the country level played a small role. The within-firm churning of imported inputs, however, played a sizeable role. We build a model of trade in intermediate inputs with heterogeneous firms, fixed import costs, and roundabout production. Import demand is non-homothetic and the implications of an import price shock depend on the full distribution of firm-level adjustments. An import price shock generates a significant decline in productivity. (JEL F14, F31, F43, L60, O14, O19)

10.1257/aer.104.3.793.abstractZh: 我们实证分析了阿根廷危机期间贸易调整的机制。尽管从2000年到2002年进口量下降了70%，但企业或产品的进入和退出在国家层面的作用较小。然而，企业内部对进口投入的替换起到了重要作用。我们构建了一个包含异质企业、固定进口成本以及迂回生产的中间投入贸易模型。进口需求是非同质的，进口价格冲击的影响取决于企业层面的调整分布。进口价格冲击会导致生产率的显著下降。（JEL F14, F31, F43, L60, O14, O19）

abstract.text: Food purchases differ substantially across countries. We use detailed household-level data from the United States, France, and the United Kingdom to (i) document these differences; (ii) estimate a demand system for food and nutrients; and (iii) simulate counterfactual choices if households faced prices and nutritional characteristics from other countries. We find that differences in prices and characteristics are important and can explain some difference (e.g., United States–France difference in caloric intake) but generally cannot explain many of the compositional patterns by themselves. Instead, it seems an interaction between the economic environment and differences in preferences is needed to explain cross-country differences. (JEL D12, I12, L11, L66, Q11)

10.1257/aer.104.3.832.abstractZh: 不同国家的食品购买情况存在显著差异。我们利用来自美国、法国和英国的详细家庭层面数据来：(i) 记录这些差异；(ii) 估算食品和营养需求系统；(iii) 模拟如果家庭面临其他国家的价格和营养特征时的选择。我们发现，价格和特征的差异非常重要，可以解释某些差异（例如，美国与法国在热量摄入上的差异），但通常无法单独解释许多组合模式。因此，似乎需要经济环境与偏好差异之间的相互作用来解释跨国差异。(JEL D12, I12, L11, L66, Q11)

abstract.text: We formally characterize predatory pricing in a modern industry-dynamics framework that endogenizes competitive advantage and industry structure. As an illustrative example we focus on learning-by-doing. To disentangle predatory pricing from mere competition for efficiency on a learning curve we decompose the equilibrium pricing condition. We show that forcing firms to ignore the predatory incentives in setting their prices can have a large impact and that this impact stems from eliminating equilibria with predation-like behavior. Along with the predation-like behavior, however, a fair amount of competition for the market is eliminated. (JEL D21, D43, D83, K21, L13, L41)

10.1257/aer.104.3.868.abstractZh: 我们在一个现代产业动态框架内，正式描述了掠夺性定价现象，该框架能够内生出竞争优势和产业结构。作为示例，我们重点关注“边做边学”的现象。为了将掠夺性定价与单纯的学习曲线上的效率竞争区分开来，我们对均衡定价条件进行了分解。我们发现，迫使企业忽略设定价格时的掠夺性动机会产生重大影响，而这种影响源于消除了具有掠夺性行为的均衡状态。然而，与掠夺性行为一同消失的，还有相当程度的市场竞争。（JEL D21, D43, D83, K21, L13, L41）

abstract.text: Geography and social links shape economic interactions. In industries, schools, and markets, the entire network determines outcomes. This paper analyzes a large class of games and obtains a striking result. Equilibria depend on a single network measure: the lowest eigenvalue. This paper is the first to uncover the importance of the lowest eigenvalue to economic and social outcomes. It captures how much the network amplifies agents' actions. The paper combines new tools—potential games, optimization, and spectral graph theory—to solve for all Nash and stable equilibria and applies the results to R&D, crime, and the econometrics of peer effects. (JEL C72, D83, D85, H41, K42, O33, Z13)

10.1257/aer.104.3.898.abstractZh: 地理和社会联系塑造了经济互动。在产业、学校和市场中，整个网络决定了结果。本文分析了一大类博弈，并得出了一个显著的结论：均衡状态取决于一个单一的网络指标——最低特征值。本文首次揭示了最低特征值对经济和社会结果的重要性，它反映了网络对代理人行为的放大程度。本文结合了新的工具——潜在博弈、优化方法和谱图理论，来求解所有纳什均衡和稳定均衡，并将这些结果应用于研发、犯罪以及同伴效应的计量经济学研究。（JEL C72, D83, D85, H41, K42, O33, Z13）

abstract.text: Endowment payouts have become an increasingly important component of universities' revenues in recent decades. We study how universities respond to financial shocks to endowments and thus shed light on a number of existing models of endowment behavior. Endowments actively reduce payouts relative to their stated payout policies following negative, but not positive, shocks. This asymmetric behavior is consistent with “endowment hoarding,” especially among endowments whose current value is close to the benchmark value at the start of the university president's tenure. We also document the effect of negative endowment shocks on university operations, such as personnel cuts. (JEL G35, I22, I23)

10.1257/aer.104.3.931.abstractZh: 近年来，捐赠收入已成为大学收入中越来越重要的组成部分。我们研究了大学如何应对捐赠资金的财务冲击，从而对现有的捐赠行为模型进行了分析。在负面冲击下，捐赠资金会主动减少其支付金额，而不是在正面冲击下如此。这种不对称行为与“捐赠囤积”现象一致，尤其是在大学校长任期开始时，捐赠资金的价值接近基准值的大学中更为明显。我们还研究了负面捐赠冲击对大学运营的影响，例如人员削减。（JEL G35, I22, I23）

abstract.text: In the American South, postbellum economic development may have been restricted in part by white landowners' access to low-wage black labor. This paper examines the impact of the Great Mississippi Flood of 1927 on black out-migration and subsequent agricultural development. Flooded counties experienced an immediate and persistent out-migration of black population. Over time, landowners in flooded counties modernized agricultural production and increased its capital intensity relative to landowners in nearby similar non-flooded counties. Landowners resisted black out-migration, however, benefiting from the status quo system of labor-intensive agricultural production. (JEL J15, J43, N32, N52, N92, Q54, R23)

10.1257/aer.104.3.963.abstractZh: 在美国南部，战后经济发展在一定程度上受到了白人地主获取低薪黑人劳动力的限制。本文探讨了1927年大密西西比洪水对黑人外迁以及随后农业发展的影响。受洪水影响的县出现了黑人人口的立即且持续的外迁现象。随着时间的推移，这些县的地主们改进了农业生产方式，并提高了农业生产的资本投入强度，相比之下，附近未受洪水影响的县的地主则没有这样的改善。然而，地主们仍然抵制黑人外迁，并从中受益，因为他们依赖于劳动密集型农业生产模式。

abstract.text: We study the impact of a public school choice lottery in Charlotte-Mecklenburg schools on college enrollment and degree completion. We find a significant overall increase in college attainment among lottery winners who attend their first choice school. Using rich administrative data on peers, teachers, course offerings and other inputs, we show that the impacts of choice are strongly predicted by gains on several measures of school quality. Gains in attainment are concentrated among girls. Girls respond to attending a better school with higher grades and increases in college-preparatory course-taking, while boys do not.

10.1257/aer.104.3.991.abstractZh: 我们研究了夏洛特-梅克伦堡地区的公立学校选择抽签对大学入学率和学位完成率的影响。研究发现，选择抽签的获胜者进入他们首选学校后，大学教育程度有显著提升。通过丰富的行政数据，我们观察到学校质量在多个方面的提升对大学教育的影响显著。这种提升主要集中在女生身上。女生在就读更好的学校后，成绩提高，大学预备课程的学习也增加，而男生则没有这样的表现。

abstract.text: The converging roles of men and women are among the grandest advances in society and the economy in the last century. These aspects of the grand gender convergence are figurative chapters in a history of gender roles. But what must the “last” chapter contain for there to be equality in the labor market? The answer may come as a surprise. The solution does not (necessarily) have to involve government intervention and it need not make men more responsible in the home (although that wouldn't hurt). But it must involve changes in the labor market, especially how jobs are structured and remunerated to enhance temporal flexibility. The gender gap in pay would be considerably reduced and might vanish altogether if firms did not have an incentive to disproportionately reward individuals who labored long hours and worked particular hours. Such change has taken off in various sectors, such as technology, science, and health, but is less apparent in the corporate, financial, and legal worlds. (JEL J3, J16, J22, J24, J31, J33, N3)

10.1257/aer.104.4.1091.abstractZh: 男女角色的融合是过去一个世纪社会和经济领域最显著的进步之一。这些性别角色融合的方面，实际上是性别角色历史中的篇章。但是，要实现劳动力市场的平等，最后这一章需要包含什么内容呢？答案可能会让人感到意外。解决方案并不一定需要政府干预，也不必让男性承担更多的家庭责任（尽管这也没有坏处）。但必须涉及劳动力市场的变革，尤其是工作结构和薪酬的安排，以提升时间灵活性。如果企业没有动机过度奖励那些长时间工作或特定时间工作的员工，那么性别薪酬差距将会显著缩小，甚至可能完全消失。这样的变革已经在科技、科学和医疗等多个领域取得进展，但在企业、金融和法律领域则表现得不太明显。（JEL J3, J16, J22, J24, J31, J33, N3）

abstract.text: We use broad-based yet detailed data from the economy's goods-producing sectors to investigate firms' ownership of production chains. It does not appear that vertical ownership is primarily used to facilitate transfers of goods along the production chain, as is often presumed: roughly one-half of upstream establishments report no shipments to downstream establishments within the same firm. We propose an alternative explanation for vertical ownership, namely that it promotes efficient intrafirm transfers of intangible inputs. We show evidence consistent with this hypothesis, including the fact that, after a change of ownership, an acquired establishment begins to resemble the acquiring firm along multiple dimensions. (JEL G32, G34, L14, L22, L60, M11)

10.1257/aer.104.4.1120.abstractZh: 我们利用了经济中商品生产部门的广泛而详细的数据，来研究企业对其生产链的所有权情况。结果表明，垂直所有权并不主要用于促进生产链中的商品转移，这与通常的假设不同：大约一半的上游企业表示，它们没有向同一企业内的下游企业发货。我们提出了另一种解释，即垂直所有权有助于促进企业内部无形投入的有效转移。我们发现了与这一假设一致的证据，包括：在所有权变更后，被收购的企业在多个方面开始与收购方相似。（JEL G32, G34, L14, L22, L60, M11）

abstract.text: This paper models growth via on-the-job learning when firms and workers are heterogeneous. It is an overlapping generations model in which young agents match with the old. More efficient assignments lead to faster long-run growth, more inequality, and less turnover in the distribution of human capital. Constant-growth paths are characterized for general functional forms and then, for the Cobb-Douglas case, the transition dynamics are solved analytically when the skill of the young is log-normally distributed and the initial human capital of the old generation is also log-normal. Growth and inequality move together on the transition to the balanced growth path. ( JEL D83, J24, J31, J41)

10.1257/aer.104.4.1149.abstractZh: 本文通过在职学习模型来模拟增长过程，其中企业和工人具有异质性。该模型属于重叠代际模型，年轻个体与老年个体进行匹配。更高效的配置会导致更快的长期增长，同时增加不平等程度并降低人力资本分布的流动性。对于一般的函数形式，可以描述出恒定增长路径；而在Cobb-Douglas模型中，当年轻人的技能呈对数正态分布且老年一代的初始人力资本也呈对数正态分布时，转型动态可以通过解析方法求解。在向平衡增长路径过渡的过程中，增长与不平等程度会共同变化。（JEL D83, J24, J31, J41）

abstract.text: The dynamics of house prices, sales, construction, and population growth in response to city-specific income shocks are characterized for 106 US cities. A dynamic model of search in the housing market in which construction, the entry of buyers, house prices, and sales are determined in equilibrium is then developed. The theory generates dynamics qualitatively consistent with the observations and a version calibrated to match key features of the US housing market offers a substantial quantitative improvement over models without search. In particular, variation in the time it takes to sell induces transaction prices to exhibit serially correlated growth. (JEL D83, R21, R23, R31)

10.1257/aer.104.4.1172.abstractZh: 本研究针对106个美国城市，分析了房价、销售、建筑以及人口增长对城市特定收入冲击的响应动态。随后，作者构建了一个动态模型，该模型描述了住房市场中的搜索过程，其中建筑活动、购房者的进入、房价以及销售情况在均衡状态下得以确定。该理论得出的动态结果与观察结果一致，而经过校准以符合美国住房市场关键特征的模型则显著提升了模型的量化精度。特别是，销售所需时间的变化会导致交易价格呈现序列相关性的增长趋势。（JEL D83, R21, R23, R31）

abstract.text: We present a theory of spatial development. Manufacturing and services firms located in a continuous geographic area choose each period how much to innovate. Firms trade subject to transport costs and technology diffuses spatially. We apply the model to study the evolution of the US economy in the last half-century and find that it can generate the reduction in the manufacturing employment share, the increased spatial concentration of services, the growth in service productivity starting in the mid-1990s, the rise in the dispersion of land rents in the same period, as well as several other spatial and temporal patterns. (JEL J21, L16, L60, L80, O33, R11, R32)

10.1257/aer.104.4.1211.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种空间发展理论。位于连续地理区域内的制造和服务企业会在每个时期选择创新的程度。企业的交易受到运输成本的影响，技术也会在空间上扩散。我们运用该模型研究了过去半个世纪美国经济的演变，发现其能够导致制造业就业比例的下降、服务的空间集中程度增加、从20世纪90年代中期开始服务生产率的提升、同一时期土地租金分散程度的增加，以及其他一些空间和时间上的模式。（JEL J21, L16, L60, L80, O33, R11, R32）

abstract.text: This paper shows that the body of appointed officials that a new democracy inherits from the previous regime is a key determinant of the extent of electoral fraud and clientelistic spending in new democracies. I develop a model that predicts that appointed officials have stronger incentives to influence voters during national level elections because of their career concerns. I test the implications of the model using data from Indonesia's transition to democracy. Both the pattern of alignment of electoral results between village and district levels and the pattern of subsequent turnover of appointed village heads corroborate the predictions of the model. ( JEL D72, H77, H83, O17, O18)

10.1257/aer.104.4.1244.abstractZh: 本文指出，新民主国家从前政权继承下来的任命官员群体，是选举舞弊和裙带式支出的重要决定因素。我提出了一个模型，该模型预测由于职业考量，任命官员在国家级选举中有更强的动机影响选民。我使用印度尼西亚向民主过渡期间的数据来验证该模型的预测结果。村级与区级选举结果的关联模式，以及任命的村长随后更换的模式，都证实了模型的预测结果。（JEL D72, H77, H83, O17, O18）

abstract.text: Procurement contracts are often renegotiated because of changes that are required after their execution. Using highway paving contracts we show that renegotiation imposes significant adaptation costs. Reduced form regressions suggest that bidders respond strategically to contractual incompleteness and that adaptation costs are an important determinant of their bids. A structural empirical model compares adaptation costs to bidder markups and shows that adaptation costs account for 7.5–14 percent of the winning bid. Markups from private information and market power, the focus of much of the auctions literature, are much smaller by comparison. Implications for government procurement are discussed. (JEL D44, D82, D86, H57, L13, L74, R42)

10.1257/aer.104.4.1288.abstractZh: 采购合同在执行后由于需要做出调整而经常被重新谈判。通过高速公路铺路合同的案例，我们发现重新谈判会带来显著的适应成本。简化形式的回归分析表明，投标者对合同的不完整性会采取策略性反应，而适应成本则是决定其投标价格的重要因素。一个结构性的实证模型将适应成本与投标者的加价进行了比较，结果显示适应成本占中标价格的7.5%至14%。相比之下，由于私人信息和市场力量的影响而产生的加价要小得多，后者是许多拍卖文献关注的重点。本文还讨论了这对政府采购的影响。（JEL D44, D82, D86, H57, L13, L74, R42）

abstract.text: We investigate whether physicians' financial incentives influence health care supply, technology diffusion, and resulting patient outcomes. In 1997, Medicare consolidated the geographic regions across which it adjusts physician payments, generating area-specific price shocks. Areas with higher payment shocks experience significant increases in health care supply. On average, a 2 percent increase in payment rates leads to a 3 percent increase in care provision. Elective procedures such as cataract surgery respond much more strongly than less discretionary services. Non-radiologists expand their provision of MRIs, suggesting effects on technology adoption. We estimate economically small health impacts, albeit with limited precision.

10.1257/aer.104.4.1320.abstractZh: 我们研究了医生的经济激励是否会影响医疗保健的供应、技术的传播以及由此带来的患者治疗效果。1997年，医疗保险对支付医生的地理区域进行了整合，导致各地区支付标准的差异。支付标准较高的地区，医疗保健的供应显著增加。平均而言，支付率每提高2%，医疗服务量就会增加3%。像白内障手术这样的选择性手术，其反应比那些不太需要自主决定的服务更为强烈。非放射科医生增加了MRI服务的提供，这表明他们对技术采用产生了影响。我们从经济角度估计，这些影响虽然规模较小，但精确度有限。

abstract.text: We propose a model of cycles of conflict and distrust. Overlapping generations of agents from two groups sequentially play coordination games under incomplete information about whether the other side consists of bad types who always take bad actions. Good actions may be misperceived as bad and information about past actions is limited. Conflict spirals start as a result of misperceptions but also contain the seeds of their own dissolution: Bayesian agents eventually conclude that the spiral likely started by mistake, and is thus uninformative of the opposing group's type. The agents then experiment with a good action, restarting the cycle. (JEL D72, D74, D83, Z13)

10.1257/aer.104.4.1350.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个关于冲突与不信任循环的模型。来自两个群体的代理们依次在不完全信息的情况下进行协调博弈，他们无法得知对方是否总是采取不良行为。良好的行为可能被误解为不良行为，且关于过去行为的信息有限。冲突的升级源于误解，但同时也包含了自我消解的种子：贝叶斯代理最终会认为这种升级可能是无意的，因此无法反映对方群体的类型。代理们随后会尝试采取良好的行为，从而重新开始这一循环。（JEL D72, D74, D83, Z13）

abstract.text: Many new technologies display long adoption lags, and this is often interpreted as evidence of frictions inconsistent with the standard neoclassical model. We study the diffusion of the tractor in American agriculture between 1910 and 1960—a well-known case of slow diffusion—and show that the speed of adoption was consistent with the predictions of a simple neoclassical growth model. The reason for the slow rate of diffusion was that tractor quality kept improving over this period and, more importantly, that only when wages increased did it become relatively unprofitable to operate the alternative, labor-intensive, horse technology. (JEL L62, N51, N52, N71, N72, O33, Q11)

10.1257/aer.104.4.1368.abstractZh: 许多新技术在采用过程中存在较长的滞后期，这常被解释为与标准新古典模型不符的摩擦现象的证据。我们研究了1910年至1960年间拖拉机在美国农业中的普及情况——这是一个典型的缓慢普及案例——并发现其采用速度符合简单新古典增长模型的预测。普及速度缓慢的原因在于，在这段时间内拖拉机的性能不断改善，更重要的是，只有当工资上升时，使用劳动密集型、依赖马匹的替代技术才变得相对不经济。（JEL L62, N51, N52, N71, N72, O33, Q11）

abstract.text: The cross-sectional dispersion of firm-level investment rates is procyclical. This makes investment rates different from productivity, output, and employment growth, which have countercyclical dispersions. A calibrated heterogeneous-firm business cycle model with nonconvex capital adjustment costs and countercyclical dispersion of firm-level productivity shocks replicates these facts and produces a correlation between investment dispersion and aggregate output of 0.53, close to 0.45 in the data. We find that small shocks to the dispersion of productivity, which in the model constitutes firm risk, suffice to generate the mildly procyclical investment dispersion in the data but do not produce serious business cycles. (JEL D42, D92, E32, G31, G32)

10.1257/aer.104.4.1392.abstractZh: 企业层面投资率的横截面分布具有顺周期性。这使得投资率与生产率、产出和就业增长的不同，后者具有反周期性分布。一个经过校准的异质企业商业周期模型，该模型具有非凸的资本调整成本以及企业层面生产率冲击的反周期性分布，能够再现这些现象，并发现投资分布与总产出之间的相关性为0.53，接近数据中的0.45。我们发现，生产率分布的微小冲击，在模型中构成企业风险，足以产生数据中轻微的顺周期性投资分布，但不会导致严重的商业周期波动。（JEL D42, D92, E32, G31, G32）

abstract.text: Imperfect information about product attributes inhibits efficiency in many choice settings, but can be overcome by providing simple, low-cost information. We use a randomized control trial to test the effect of high-frequency information about residential electricity usage on the price elasticity of demand. Informed households are three standard deviations more responsive to temporary price increases, an effect that is not attributable to price salience. Conservation extends beyond pricing events in the short and medium run, providing evidence of habit formation and implying that the intervention leads to greenhouse gas abatement. Survey evidence suggests that information facilitates learning. (JEL D12, D83, L11, L94, Q41, Q54)

10.1257/aer.104.4.1417.abstractZh: 关于产品属性的不完全信息在许多选择情境中会阻碍效率，但可以通过提供简单、低成本的信息来克服这一问题。我们采用随机对照试验来测试关于居民用电使用的高频信息对需求价格弹性的影响。知情的家庭对临时价格上涨的反应比没有信息的情况高出三个标准差，这一效应并非由价格显著性所导致。在短期和中期，节约行为不仅限于价格变动期间，这证明了习惯的形成，并暗示这种干预措施能够导致温室气体减排。调查结果表明，信息有助于学习。（JEL D12, D83, L11, L94, Q41, Q54）

abstract.text: Beaudry and Portier (2006) propose an identification scheme to study the effects of news shocks about future productivity in vector error correction models (VECMs). This comment shows that, when applied to their VECMs with more than two variables, the identification scheme does not have a unique solution. The problem arises from a particular interplay of cointegration assumptions and long-run restrictions. (JEL E32, E44, G12, G14)

10.1257/aer.104.4.1439.abstractZh: Beaudry和Portier在2006年提出了一个识别方案，用于研究关于未来生产力的新闻冲击对向量误差修正模型（VECMs）的影响。该评论指出，当该识别方案应用于包含两个以上变量的VECMs时，并不存在一个唯一的解决方案。这个问题源于协整假设与长期限制之间的特定相互作用。（JEL E32, E44, G12, G14）

abstract.text: Chang and Kim (2007) develop an incomplete asset markets model incorporating discrete labor supply and idiosyncratic labor productivity. Their results resolve long-standing puzzles for business cycle models. Specifically, they produce a low correlation between aggregate hours worked and labor productivity (0.23) and a labor wedge with 76 percent the volatility of output. I show that these results arise from errors in their computational method. I resolve their model using a corrected method and find a strong, positive correlation between hours and productivity (0.80). Fluctuations in the labor wedge decrease to 24 percent of those in output. (JEL D31, E32, J22, J24, J31)

10.1257/aer.104.4.1446.abstractZh: 张和金在2007年提出了一个不完整的资产市场模型，该模型考虑了离散的劳动力供应和特定的劳动生产率。他们的研究结果解决了商业周期模型中长期存在的难题。具体来说，他们发现总工作小时数与劳动生产率之间的相关性较低，为0.23；同时，劳动力成本波动的波动性约为产出波动的76%。我指出这些结果源于他们的计算方法中的错误。通过使用修正后的方法，我发现工作小时数与劳动生产率之间存在强烈的正相关关系，相关系数为0.80。劳动力成本波动的幅度降低到产出波动的24%。（JEL D31, E32, J22, J24, J31）

abstract.text: Takahashi (2014) has uncovered coding errors in our paper, Chang and Kim (2007)—henceforth, CK. We acknowledge and are embarrassed by these mistakes. We are grateful to Takahashi for uncovering them. While the correction decreases the volatility of the labor market wedge, we find that the main message of CK remains valid: the measured labor market wedge arises endogenously in an economy with incomplete capital markets and indivisible labor supply. For example, our model accounts for 18 percent of the volatility in the labor market wedge in the data; it was 43 percent in CK. (JEL D31, E32, J22, J24, J31)

10.1257/aer.104.4.1461.abstractZh: Takahashi在2014年发现我们的论文中存在编码错误，即Chang和Kim在2007年的研究——以下简称CK。我们承认并为此感到尴尬。我们感谢Takahashi发现了这些错误。虽然修正后劳动市场楔形的波动性有所降低，但我们发现CK的主要观点仍然成立：在资本市场不完善且劳动力供应不可分割的经济体中，所测量的劳动市场楔形是内生产生的。例如，我们的模型解释了数据中劳动市场楔形波动性的18%；而在CK研究中这一比例为43%。（JEL D31, E32, J22, J24, J31）

abstract.text: The Nobel Foundation asks that the Nobel lecture cover the work for which the Prize is awarded. The announcement of this year's Prize cites empirical work in asset pricing. I interpret this to include work on efficient capital markets and work on developing and testing asset pricing models—the two pillars, or perhaps more descriptive, the Siamese twins of asset pricing. I start with efficient markets and then move on to asset pricing models.

10.1257/aer.104.6.1467.abstractZh: 诺贝尔基金会要求诺贝尔演讲应涵盖授予该奖项所依据的研究工作。今年获奖项的公告提到了资产定价方面的实证研究。我认为这些研究包括关于有效资本市场的研究，以及开发并测试资产定价模型的工作——这两者是资产定价的两大支柱，或者更确切地说，是资产定价的“连体双胞胎”。我先从有效市场理论开始，然后转向资产定价模型的研究。

abstract.text: Robert J. Shiller delivered his Prize Lecture on 8 December 2013 at Aula Magna, Stockholm University.

10.1257/aer.104.6.1486.abstractZh: 罗伯特·J·希勒于2013年12月8日在斯德哥尔摩大学的大礼堂发表了他的获奖演讲。

abstract.text: Revealed preference theory offers a criterion for decision-making quality: if decisions are high quality then there exists a utility function the choices maximize. We conduct a large-scale experiment to test for consistency with utility maximization. Consistency scores vary markedly within and across socioeconomic groups. In particular, consistency is strongly related to wealth: A standard deviation increase in consistency is associated with 15–19 percent more household wealth. This association is quantitatively robust to conditioning on correlates of unobserved constraints, preferences, and beliefs. Consistency with utility maximization under laboratory conditions thus captures decision-making ability that applies across domains and influences important real-world outcomes. (JEL D12, D14, D81, D83, D91, G11)

10.1257/aer.104.6.1518.abstractZh: 揭示的偏好理论为决策质量提供了一个标准：如果决策质量高，那么存在一个效用函数，该选择能够最大化效用。我们开展了一项大规模实验，以测试其与效用最大化的一致性。一致性得分在社会经济群体内部和不同群体之间存在显著差异。特别是，一致性与财富密切相关：一致性标准差每增加一个标准差，家庭财富就会增加15-19%。这种关联在考虑未观察到的约束、偏好和信念的相关因素后仍然具有定量上的稳健性。因此，在实验室条件下，与效用最大化的一致性反映了适用于不同领域的决策能力，并影响着重要的现实世界结果。（JEL D12, D14, D81, D83, D91, G11）

abstract.text: We develop and estimate an equilibrium job search model of worker careers, allowing for human capital accumulation, employer heterogeneity, and individual-level shocks. Wage growth is decomposed into contributions of human capital and job search, within and between jobs. Human capital accumulation is largest for highly educated workers. The contribution from job search to wage growth, both within and between jobs, declines over the first ten years of a career—the “job-shopping” phase of a working life—after which workers settle into high-quality jobs using outside offers to generate gradual wage increases, thus reaping the benefits from competition between employers. (JEL J24, J31, J63, J64)

10.1257/aer.104.6.1551.abstractZh: 我们开发并估计了一个均衡的求职者生涯模型，该模型考虑了人力资本积累、雇主异质性以及个体层面的冲击。工资增长被分解为人力资本贡献和求职贡献，无论是在同一职位之间还是在不同职位之间。受过高等教育的工人人力资本积累最为显著。求职对工资增长的贡献，在职业生涯的前十年——即工作生涯中的“跳槽”阶段——会逐渐下降。之后，工人会利用外部提供的机会进入高质量的工作岗位，从而实现工资的逐步增长，从而从雇主之间的竞争中获得收益。（JEL J24, J31, J63, J64）

abstract.text: We employ data that match the population of Danish workers to the universe of private-sector Danish firms, with product-level trade flows by origin- and destination-countries. We document new stylized facts about offshoring and instrument for offshoring and exporting. Within job spells, offshoring increases (decreases) the high-skilled ( low-skilled) wage; exporting increases the wages of all skill-types; the net wage-effect of trade varies substantially within the same skill-type; conditional on skill, the wage-effect of offshoring varies across task characteristics. We estimate the overall effects of offshoring on workers' present and future income streams by constructing pre- offshoring-shock worker-cohorts and tracking them over time. (JEL F14, F16, J24, J31, L24)

10.1257/aer.104.6.1597.abstractZh: 我们使用的数据将丹麦工人的人口与丹麦私营部门的公司进行了匹配，并记录了按来源国和目的地国划分的产品级贸易流动。我们发现了关于离岸外包的新现象，以及离岸外包和出口的工具。在工作的不同阶段，离岸外包会增加（减少）高技能和低技能的工资；出口则会增加所有技能类型的工资；同一技能类型内的贸易对工资的净影响差异很大；在技能条件相同的情况下，离岸外包对工资的影响会因任务特征的不同而有所差异。我们通过构建离岸外包前的工人群体，并随时间跟踪他们，来估算离岸外包对工人当前和未来收入流的整体影响。（JEL F14, F16, J24, J31, L24）

abstract.text: We study the effect of US food aid on conflict in recipient countries. Our analysis exploits time variation in food aid shipments due to changes in US wheat production and cross-sectional variation in a country's tendency to receive any US food aid. According to our estimates, an increase in US food aid increases the incidence and duration of civil conflicts, but has no robust effect on interstate conflicts or the onset of civil conflicts. We also provide suggestive evidence that the effects are most pronounced in countries with a recent history of civil conflict. (JEL D74, F35, O17, O19, Q11, Q18)

10.1257/aer.104.6.1630.abstractZh: 我们研究了美国食品援助对受援国冲突的影响。我们的分析利用了美国小麦产量变化导致的食品援助运输时间变化，以及一个国家接受美国食品援助的倾向的横向差异。根据我们的估计，美国食品援助的增加会增加民事冲突的发生频率和持续时间，但对州际冲突或民事冲突的爆发没有显著影响。我们还提供了一些有启发性的证据，表明这些影响在最近有民事冲突历史的国家中最为明显。（JEL D74, F35, O17, O19, Q11, Q18）

abstract.text: We study the determinants of differences in farm size across countries and their impact on agricultural and aggregate productivity using a quantitative sectoral model featuring a distribution of farms. Measured aggregate factors (capital, land, economy-wide productivity) account for one-quarter of the observed differences in farm size and productivity. Policies and institutions that misallocate resources across farms have the potential to account for the remaining differences. Exploiting within-country variation in crop-specific price distortions and their correlation with farm size, we construct a cross-country measure of farm-size distortions which together with aggregate factors accounts for one-half of the cross-country differences in size and productivity. (JEL D24, J24, J43, L11, O13, Q12, Q18)

10.1257/aer.104.6.1667.abstractZh: 我们研究了各国农场规模差异的决定因素，以及这些因素对农业及整体生产力的影响。通过采用一个包含农场分布的定量部门模型进行分析，我们发现，被观测到的农场规模与生产力差异中，有四分之一是由总体因素（如资本、土地、经济整体生产力）所决定的。而未能有效分配资源到各个农场的政策与制度，则可能是造成剩余差异的原因。通过利用各国不同作物价格扭曲情况及其与农场规模之间的相关性，我们构建了一个跨国性的农场规模扭曲指标。这一指标与总体因素一起，共同解释了跨国范围内农场规模与生产力差异的半数原因。（JEL D24, J24, J43, L11, O13, Q12, Q18）

abstract.text: This paper estimates the response of investment to changes in uncertainty using data on oil drilling in Texas and the expected volatility of the future price of oil. Using a dynamic model of firms' investment problem, I find that: (i) the response of drilling activity to changes in price volatility has a magnitude consistent with the optimal response prescribed by theory, (ii) the cost of failing to respond to volatility shocks is economically significant, and (iii) implied volatility data derived from futures options prices yields a better fit to firms' investment behavior than backward-looking volatility measures such as GARCH. (JEL C58, D92, G13, G31, L71, Q31)

10.1257/aer.104.6.1698.abstractZh: 本文利用德克萨斯州石油钻探的数据以及未来石油价格预期波动性的数据，估计了投资对不确定性变化的响应。通过构建企业投资问题的动态模型，我们发现：(i) 钻探活动对价格波动性变化的响应幅度与理论所预测的最优响应一致；(ii) 未能应对波动性冲击的成本在经济上是显著的；(iii) 从期货期权价格中得出的隐含波动性数据，比诸如GARCH这样的回顾性波动性指标更能准确反映企业的投资行为。(JEL C58, D92, G13, G31, L71, Q31)

abstract.text: We study the Lagos and Wright (2005) model of monetary exchange in the laboratory. With a finite population of sufficiently patient agents, this model has a unique monetary equilibrium and a continuum of non-monetary gift exchange equilibria, some of which Pareto dominate the monetary equilibrium. We find that subjects avoid the gift exchange equilibria in favor of the monetary equilibrium. We also study versions of the model without money where all equilibria involve non-monetary gift exchange. We find that welfare is higher in the model with money than without money, suggesting that money plays a role as an efficiency enhancing coordination device. ( JEL C92, D12, E40, Z13)

10.1257/aer.104.6.1735.abstractZh: 我们研究了Lagos和Wright（2005）在实验室中提出的货币交换模型。在有限数量且足够耐心的参与者群体中，该模型存在独特的货币均衡状态，以及一系列非货币礼物交换的均衡状态，其中一些均衡状态在帕累托意义上优于货币均衡状态。我们发现，参与者会避免这些非货币礼物交换的均衡状态，而选择货币均衡。我们还研究了没有货币参与的模型版本，在这些模型中，所有均衡状态都涉及非货币礼物交换。研究发现，有货币参与的模型中的福利水平高于没有货币参与的模型，这表明货币作为一种效率提升的协调机制发挥着重要作用。（JEL C92, D12, E40, Z13）

abstract.text: Causal estimates of the benefits of increased schooling using US state schooling laws as instruments typically rely on specifications which assume common trends across states in the factors affecting different birth cohorts. Differential changes across states during this period, such as relative school quality improvements, suggest that this assumption may fail to hold. Across a number of outcomes including wages, unemployment, and divorce, we find that statistically significant causal estimates become insignificant and, in many instances, wrong-signed when allowing year of birth effects to vary across regions. (JEL H75, I21, I28, J24, N31, N32)

10.1257/aer.104.6.1777.abstractZh: 使用美国各州的学校教育法规作为工具，对增加教育年限所带来的收益的因果估计通常依赖于这样的假设：各州在影响不同出生群体的因素上存在共同的趋势。然而，在此期间各州之间的变化差异，例如学校质量的相对改善，表明这一假设可能并不成立。在包括工资、失业率和离婚率在内的多个指标上，我们发现，当允许出生年份的影响因地区而异时，统计上显著的因果估计会变得不显著，并且在许多情况下，其符号也会出错。（JEL H75, I21, I28, J24, N31, N32）

abstract.text: The endowment effect, the tendency to value possessions more than non-possessions, is a well-known departure from rational choice and has been replicated in numerous settings. We investigate the universality of the endowment effect, its evolutionary significance, and its dependence on environmental factors. We experimentally test for the endowment effect in an isolated and evolutionarily relevant population of hunter-gatherers, the Hadza Bushmen of Northern Tanzania. We find that Hadza living in isolated regions do not display the endowment effect, while Hadza living in a geographic region with increased exposure to modern society and markets do display the endowment effect. (JEL C93, D12, O15)
