10.1257/aer.104.6.1793.abstractZh: 禀赋效应，即倾向于更重视财产而非非财产物品的倾向，是一种与理性选择相悖的现象，并且已在多种环境中得到验证。我们研究了禀赋效应的普遍性、其进化意义以及其对环境因素的依赖性。我们通过实验在坦桑尼亚北部的狩猎采集者——哈扎布什人中进行测试，这些人群在进化上具有一定的相关性。研究发现，生活在偏远地区的哈扎布什人并未表现出禀赋效应，而生活在接触现代社会和市场较多的地区的哈扎布什人则表现出这种效应。（JEL C93, D12, O15）

abstract.text: This paper investigates the effect of early exposure to neighborhood crime on subsequent criminal behavior of youth exploiting a unique natural experiment between 1986 and 1998 when refugee immigrants to Denmark were assigned to neighborhoods quasi-randomly. We find strong evidence that the share of young people convicted for crimes, in particular violent crimes, in the neighborhood increases convictions of male assignees later in life. No such effects are found for other measures of neighborhood crime including the rate of committed crimes. Our findings suggest social interaction as a key channel through which neighborhood crime is linked to individual criminal behavior. (JEL J13, J15, K42, R23, Z13)

10.1257/aer.104.6.1806.abstractZh: 本文通过1986至1998年间对丹麦难民移民进行准随机分配的独特自然实验，研究了早期接触社区犯罪对青少年后续犯罪行为的影响。研究发现，社区中因犯罪被定罪的比例，尤其是暴力犯罪的定罪率，会显著增加被分配到该社区的男性青少年在日后犯罪的可能性。而对于其他社区犯罪指标，如犯罪率，则未发现类似的效应。我们的研究结果表明，社会互动是社区犯罪与个体犯罪行为之间联系的关键渠道。（JEL J13, J15, K42, R23, Z13）

abstract.text: We estimate the causal effect of a large development program on conflict in the Philippines through a regression discontinuity design that exploits an arbitrary poverty threshold used to assign eligibility for the program. We find that barely eligible municipalities experienced a large increase in conflict casualties compared to barely ineligible ones. This increase is mostly due to insurgent-initiated incidents in the early stages of program preparation. Our results are consistent with the hypothesis that insurgents try to sabotage the program because its success would weaken their support in the population. (JEL D74, F35, I32, I38, O15, O17, O18, O19)

10.1257/aer.104.6.1833.abstractZh: 我们通过回归不连续设计来估计一项大型发展计划对菲律宾冲突的因果效应，该设计利用了用于确定计划适用资格的任意贫困门槛。我们发现，几乎符合资格条件的市镇与几乎不符合资格条件的市镇相比，冲突伤亡人数大幅增加。这种增加主要源于计划筹备初期由叛乱分子引发的事件。我们的结果与以下假设一致：叛乱分子试图破坏该计划，因为该计划的成功会削弱他们在民众中的支持基础。（JEL D74, F35, I32, I38, O15, O17, O18, O19）

abstract.text: Demichelis and Weibull (2008) show that adding lexicographic lying costs to coordination games with cheap talk yields a sharp prediction: only the efficient outcome is evolutionarily stable. I show that this result is caused by the discontinuity of preferences rather than by small lying costs per se. Finally, I discuss why discontinuity may not be an appealing assumption in evolutionary models. (JEL C72, C73, Z13)

10.1257/aer.104.6.1857.abstractZh: Demichelis和Weibull在2008年的研究中指出，在包含廉价说辞的协调博弈中，如果增加谎言的代价，那么只有高效的结果才会具有进化稳定性。我们发现，这一结果是由偏好不连续性引起的，而非由于每次谎言的代价本身很小。最后，我探讨了为什么在进化模型中，不连续性可能不是一个理想的假设。（JEL C72, C73, Z13）

abstract.text: We develop a dynamic equilibrium model of asset markets with adverse selection. There exists a unique equilibrium in which better quality assets trade at higher prices but with a lower price-dividend ratio in less liquid markets. Sellers of high-quality assets signal quality by accepting a lower trading probability. We show how the distribution of sellers' private information affects an asset's price and liquidity, how a change in that distribution can cause a fire sale and a flight to quality, and how asset purchase and subsidy programs may raise prices and liquidity and reverse the flight to quality. (JEL D82, G12)

10.1257/aer.104.7.1875.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个具有逆向选择问题的资产市场动态均衡模型。存在一个唯一的均衡状态，在这种状态下，质量更好的资产以更高的价格交易，但在流动性较低的市场中，价格与收益的比率较低。高质量资产的卖方通过接受较低的交易概率来表明其质量。我们展示了卖方私人信息的分布如何影响资产的价格和流动性，这种分布的变化如何导致抢购和优质资产的热销，以及资产购买和补贴计划如何可能提高价格和流动性，并逆转优质资产的热销现象。（JEL D82, G12）

abstract.text: We describe findings from the first large-scale cluster randomized controlled trial in a developing country that evaluates the uptake of a health-protecting technology, insecticide-treated bednets (ITNs), through micro-consumer loans, as compared to free distribution and control conditions. Despite a relatively high price, 52 percent of sample households purchased ITNs, highlighting the role of liquidity constraints in explaining earlier low adoption rates. We find mixed evidence of improvements in malaria indices. We interpret the results and their implications within the debate about cost sharing, sustainability and liquidity constraints in public health initiatives in developing countries.

10.1257/aer.104.7.1909.abstractZh: 我们描述了在发展中国家进行的首次大规模集群随机对照试验的结果。该试验评估了通过微型消费者贷款推广防虫蚊帐这一健康保护技术的情况，并与免费分发和对照组进行了比较。尽管蚊帐价格相对较高，仍有52%的样本家庭购买了蚊帐，这表明流动性限制在解释早期较低的采用率方面起到了重要作用。我们发现疟疾指数有所改善，但证据并不一致。我们将这些结果及其含义与关于发展中国家公共卫生项目中的成本分担、可持续性和流动性限制问题的讨论相结合进行解读。

abstract.text: Large exporters are simultaneously large importers. We show that this pattern is key to understanding low aggregate exchange rate pass-through as well as the variation in pass-through across exporters. We develop a theoretical framework with variable markups and imported inputs, which predicts that firms with high import shares and high market shares have low exchange rate pass-through. We test and quantify the theoretical mechanism using Belgian firm-product-level data on imports and exports. Small nonimporting firms have nearly complete pass-through, while large import-intensive exporters have pass-through around 50 percent, with the marginal cost and markup channels contributing roughly equally. (JEL D24, F14, F31, L60)

10.1257/aer.104.7.1942.abstractZh: 大型出口商同时也是大型进口商。我们发现，这种模式对于理解汇率传递的低度以及不同出口商之间传递程度的变化至关重要。我们建立了一个理论框架，该框架考虑了可变加价和进口投入，并预测拥有高进口份额和高市场份额的企业，其汇率传递程度较低。我们使用比利时企业进出口数据对这一理论机制进行了实证检验和量化分析。小型非进口型企业几乎完全经历了汇率传递，而大型进口密集型出口商的汇率传递程度约为50%，其中边际成本和加价渠道的贡献大致相当。（JEL D24, F14, F31, L60）

abstract.text: Do intellectual property rights influence multinationals' manufacturing location decisions? My theoretical model indicates that countries with strong patent laws attract multinational activity, but only in sectors with relatively long product life cycles. By contrast, firms with short life-cycle technologies are insensitive, because offshore imitation is less likely to succeed before obsolescence. I document strong empirical regularities consistent with the model using a panel dataset on the global operations of US-based multinational firms and a new measure of product obsolescence. Moreover, my identification strategy allows me to isolate the causal effect of patent laws on multinational activity. (JEL D92, F23, K11, L60, O34, R32)

10.1257/aer.104.7.1979.abstractZh: 知识产权是否会影响跨国公司的制造地点决策？我的理论模型表明，拥有强大专利法的国家能够吸引跨国公司的活动，但这仅适用于产品生命周期相对较长的行业。相比之下，那些技术生命周期较短的公司则对此不敏感，因为在技术过时之前，海外仿制的成功率较低。我通过使用关于美国跨国公司全球运营的数据集以及新的产品过时度量方法，发现了与模型一致的强烈实证规律。此外，我的识别策略使我能够分离出专利法对跨国公司活动的因果效应。（JEL D92, F23, K11, L60, O34, R32）

abstract.text: We study a uniform-price auction where k identical common-value objects are allocated amongst z > k bidders who have imperfect signals about the state of the world. The common valuation is determined jointly by the state and an action that is chosen after winning an object. In large auctions, there are symmetric equilibria where the auction price aggregates no information. Moreover, market statistics other than price (e.g., the amount of rationing or the bid distribution) contain extra information about the state. In contrast, in standard large auctions without actions, the price aggregates all relevant information. (JEL D44, D82, D83)

10.1257/aer.104.7.2014.abstractZh: 我们研究了一种统一价格拍卖机制，其中k个相同的共同价值物品被分配给z > k个具有不完全信息的竞买人。共同价值是由状态以及赢得物品后所采取的行动共同决定的。在大型拍卖中，存在对称均衡，此时拍卖价格并未汇总所有信息。此外，除了价格之外的市场统计数据（例如，配给量或竞买分布）包含了关于状态的额外信息。相比之下，在没有行动的标准大型拍卖中，价格汇总了所有相关信息。（JEL D44, D82, D83）

abstract.text: We estimate peer effects in paid paternity leave in Norway using a regression discontinuity design. Coworkers and brothers are 11 and 15 percentage points, respectively, more likely to take paternity leave if their peer was exogenously induced to take up leave. The most likely mechanism is information transmission, including increased knowledge of how an employer will react. The estimated peer effect snowballs over time, as the first peer interacts with a second peer, the second peer with a third, and so on. This leads to long-run participation rates which are substantially higher than would otherwise be expected. (JEL J13, J16, J18, K31, M52, Z13)

10.1257/aer.104.7.2049.abstractZh: 我们使用回归不连续设计来估计挪威带薪陪产假中的同伴效应。如果同伴被人为地诱导去休陪产假，同事和兄弟们分别有11%和15%的可能性也会选择休陪产假。最可能的机制是信息传递，包括增加对雇主反应方式的了解。随着时间推移，同伴效应会逐渐增强，因为第一个同伴与第二个同伴互动，第二个同伴与第三个同伴互动，以此类推。这导致长期参与率远高于预期水平。（JEL J13, J16, J18, K31, M52, Z13）

abstract.text: We develop a model with partial insurance against idiosyncratic wage shocks to quantify risk sharing. Closed-form solutions are obtained for equilibrium allocations and for moments of the joint distribution of consumption, hours, and wages. We prove identification and demonstrate how labor supply data are informative about risk sharing. The model, estimated with US data over the period 1967–2006, implies that (i) 39 percent of permanent wage shocks pass through to consumption; (ii ) the share of wage risk insured increased until the early 1980s; and (iii) preference heterogeneity is important in accounting for observed dispersion in consumption and hours. (JEL E21, E23, E31, E52)

10.1257/aer.104.7.2075.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个包含部分保险机制的模型，以量化风险分担。该模型能够给出均衡分配以及消费、工作时间和工资联合分布各阶矩的封闭形式解。我们证明了模型的识别性，并展示了劳动供给数据在描述风险分担方面的信息价值。该模型基于1967至2006年的美国数据进行估计，结果表明：(i) 39%的永久性工资冲击会传递到消费中；(ii) 保险覆盖的工资风险比例在20世纪80年代初之前有所上升；(iii) 偏好异质性在解释消费和工作时间上的差异中起着重要作用。(JEL E21, E23, E31, E52)

abstract.text: Many of the facts about the extensive margin of trade—which firms export, and how many products are sent to how many destinations— are consistent with a surprisingly large class of trade models because of the sparse nature of trade data. We propose a statistical model to account for sparsity, formalizing the assignment of trade shipments to country, product, and firm categories as balls falling into bins. The balls-and-bins model quantitatively reproduces the pattern of zero product- and firm-level trade flows across export destinations, and the frequency of multiproduct, multidestination exporters. In contrast, balls-and-bins overpredicts the fraction of exporting firms. ( JEL F11, F14)

10.1257/aer.104.7.2127.abstractZh: 关于贸易的广泛边际的许多事实——即企业出口的产品以及这些产品被送往多少个目的地——与一大类贸易模型是一致的，因为贸易数据本身具有稀疏性。我们提出了一个统计模型来解释这种稀疏性，将贸易货物的分配过程形式化为球落入箱中的过程。这种球与箱模型能够定量地再现出口目的地之间产品和企业层面贸易流量为零的情况，以及多产品、多目的地出口企业的出现频率。相比之下，球与箱模型对出口企业的比例预测过高。（JEL F11, F14）

abstract.text: This paper exploits a sharp reduction in patient cost sharing at age 70 in Japan, using a regression discontinuity design to examine its effect on utilization, health, and financial risk arising from out-of-pocket expenditures. Due to the national policy, cost sharing is 60–80 percent lower at age 70 than at age 69. I find that both outpatient and inpatient care are price sensitive among the elderly. While I find little impact on mortality and other health outcomes, the results show that reduced cost sharing is associated with lower out-of-pocket expenditures, especially at the right tail of the distribution. (JEL G22, I11, I12, I13, I18, J14)

10.1257/aer.104.7.2152.abstractZh: 本文利用回归连续设计，研究了日本在70岁时患者费用分担的显著减少现象，以及这一现象对就医需求、健康状况以及因自付费用而产生的财务风险的影响。由于国家政策的原因，70岁时的费用分担比69岁时低60%至80%。研究发现，老年人在门诊和住院护理方面的需求对价格较为敏感。虽然对死亡率和其他健康结果的影响较小，但结果表明，费用分担的减少与自付费用的增加之间存在关联，尤其是在收入分布较高的群体。 (JEL G22, I11, I12, I13, I18, J14)

abstract.text: A law issued to combat political corruption and Mafia infiltration of city councils in Italy has resulted in episodes of large, unanticipated, temporary contractions in local public spending. Using these episodes as instruments, we estimate the output multiplier of spending cuts at provincial level—controlling for national monetary and fiscal policy, and holding the tax burden of local residents constant—to be 1.5. Assuming that lagged spending is exogenous to current output brings the estimate of the overall multiplier up to 1.9. These results suggest that local spending adjustment may be quite consequential for local activity. (JEL D72, E62, H71, K42)

10.1257/aer.104.7.2185.abstractZh: 一项旨在打击政治腐败和黑手党渗透至意大利市议会的法律，导致了地方公共支出出现大规模、出乎意料的临时缩减。利用这些事件作为工具，我们估计省级层面的支出削减的产出乘数——在控制国家货币和财政政策的情况下，并保持当地居民税收负担不变——为1.5。假设滞后支出是当前产出之外的因素，这一估计值上升至1.9。这些结果表明，地方支出的调整可能对当地经济活动产生重大影响。（JEL D72, E62, H71, K42）

abstract.text: We posit that household decision-making over fertility is characterized by moral hazard since most contraception can only be perfectly observed by the woman. Using an experiment in Zambia that varied whether women were given access to contraceptives alone or with their husbands, we find that women given access with their husbands were 19 percent less likely to seek family planning services, 25 percent less likely to use concealable contraception, and 27 percent more likely to give birth. However, women given access to contraception alone report a lower subjective well-being, suggesting a psychosocial cost of making contraceptives more concealable. (JEL C78, D12, D82, I31, J13, J16, O15)

10.1257/aer.104.7.2210.abstractZh: 我们认为，家庭在生育决策上的行为具有道德风险，因为大多数避孕措施只能由女性本人完全了解。在赞比亚进行的一项实验中，我们改变了女性获得避孕措施的方式，有的女性可以单独使用避孕措施，有的则需要与丈夫共同使用。结果发现，与单独使用避孕措施的女性相比，与丈夫共同使用避孕措施的女性寻求计划生育服务的可能性降低了19%，使用可隐藏避孕措施的可能性降低了25%，而生育的可能性则增加了27%。然而，单独使用避孕措施的女性的主观幸福感较低，这表明让避孕措施更加隐蔽会带来一定的心理社会成本。（JEL C78, D12, D82, I31, J13, J16, O15）

abstract.text: This paper analyzes the effects on voting behavior of information disseminated over the Internet. We address endogeneity in Internet availability by exploiting regional and technological peculiarities of the preexisting voice telephony network that hindered the roll-out of fixed-line infrastructure for high-speed Internet. We find negative effects of Internet availability on voter turnout, which we relate to a crowding-out of TV consumption and increased entertainment consumption. We find no evidence that the Internet systematically benefits specific parties, suggesting ideological self-segregation in online information consumption. Robustness tests, including placebo estimations from the pre-Internet period, support a causal interpretation of our results. (JEL D12, D72, L82, L86)

10.1257/aer.104.7.2238.abstractZh: 本文分析了通过互联网传播的信息对投票行为的影响。我们通过利用原有语音电话网络的区域性和技术特性来探讨互联网可用性的内生性问题，这些特性曾阻碍了固定线路基础设施的铺设，进而影响了高速互联网的普及。研究发现，互联网可用性对选民投票率存在负面影响，这可能与电视消费的增加以及娱乐消费的增加有关。我们没有发现互联网系统性地有利于特定政党，这表明在线信息消费中存在意识形态上的自我隔离现象。包括互联网出现前的时期作为对照组的安慰剂估计在内的稳健性测试，支持了我们的因果解释。（JEL D12, D72, L82, L86）

abstract.text: During the last three decades government debt has increased in most developed countries. During the same period we have also observed a significant liberalization of international financial markets. We propose a multicountry model with incomplete markets and show that governments may choose higher levels of debt when financial markets become internationally integrated. We also show that public debt increases with the volatility of uninsurable income (idiosyncratic risk). To the extent that the increase in income inequality observed in some industrialized countries has been associated with higher idiosyncratic risk, the paper suggests another potential mechanism for the rise in public debt. (JEL D31, E62, F65, H63)

10.1257/aer.104.8.2267.abstractZh: 在过去的三十年中，大多数发达国家的政府债务有所增加。在同一时期，我们观察到国际金融市场出现了显著的自由化。我们提出了一个多国模型，该模型考虑了不完全市场的情况，并表明当金融市场实现国际一体化时，政府可能会选择更高的债务水平。我们还发现，不可保险收入的波动性（特异性风险）越大，公共债务就会增加。鉴于一些工业化国家观察到的收入不平等加剧与更高的特异性风险有关，本文提出了公共债务上升的另一种潜在机制。（JEL D31, E62, F65, H63）

abstract.text: We define the empirical content of an economic theory as the least restrictive observationally equivalent theory. We show that the empirical content of a theory is captured by a certain kind of axiomatization, with axioms that are universal negations of conjunctions of atomic formulae. (JEL B41, D01, D11)

10.1257/aer.104.8.2303.abstractZh: 我们将经济理论的实证内容定义为在观察上最不限制性的等价理论。我们表明，一个理论的实证内容可以通过某种类型的公理化来表述，其中的公理是原子公式合取的普遍否定形式。（JEL B41, D01, D11）

abstract.text: The newsworthiness of an event is partly determined by how unusual it is and this paper investigates the business cycle implications of this fact. Signals that are more likely to be observed after unusual events may increase both uncertainty and disagreement among agents. In a simple business cycle model, such signals can explain why we observe (i) occasional large changes in macroeconomic aggregate variables without a correspondingly large change in underlying fundamentals, (ii) persistent periods of high macroeconomic volatility and, (iii) a positive correlation between absolute changes in macrovariables and the cross-sectional dispersion of survey expectations. (JEL D81, D82, D84, E23, E31, E32)

10.1257/aer.104.8.2320.abstractZh: 一个事件的新闻价值部分取决于其异常程度，本文探讨了这一事实对商业周期的影响。在异常事件之后更有可能被观察到的信号可能会增加代理人的不确定性和分歧。在一个简单的商业周期模型中，这样的信号可以解释为什么我们会观察到：（i）宏观经济总量变量偶尔出现巨大变化，而基本因素却没有相应的大幅变化；（ii）持续的高宏观经济波动性时期；（iii）宏观经济变量的绝对变化与调查预期的横截面分散度之间存在正相关性。（JEL D81, D82, D84, E23, E31, E32）

abstract.text: This paper studies a New Keynesian business cycle model with agents who are averse to ambiguity (Knightian uncertainty). Shocks to confidence about future TFP are modeled as changes in ambiguity. To assess the size of those shocks, our estimation uses not only data on standard macro variables, but also incorporates the dispersion of survey forecasts about growth as a measure of confidence. Our main result is that TFP and confidence shocks together can explain roughly two thirds of business cycle frequency movements in the major macro aggregates. Confidence shocks account for about 70 percent of this variation. (JEL D81, D84, E12, E32)

10.1257/aer.104.8.2368.abstractZh: 本文研究了一个新凯恩斯主义商业周期模型，其中的主体对不确定性持厌恶态度。对未来技术效率的信心冲击被建模为不确定性的变化。为了评估这些冲击的幅度，我们的估计不仅使用了标准宏观经济变量的数据，还考虑了关于增长的调查预测分布的离散度作为信心的衡量指标。我们的主要结论是，技术效率与信心冲击共同可以解释主要宏观经济指标中大约三分之二的商业周期波动。信心冲击占这种波动的约70%。（JEL D81, D84, E12, E32）

abstract.text: We examine a dynamic model of voluntary disclosure of multiple pieces of private information. In our model, a manager of a firm who may learn multiple signals over time interacts with a competitive capital market and maximizes payoffs that increase in both period prices. We show (perhaps surprisingly) that in equilibrium later disclosures are interpreted more favorably even though the time the manager obtains the signals is independent of the value of the firm. We also provide sufficient conditions for the equilibrium to be in threshold strategies. (JEL D21, D82, G32, L25)

10.1257/aer.104.8.2400.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个关于自愿披露多份私人信息的动态模型。在我们的模型中，一家公司的管理者可能会随着时间学习到多种信号，并且会与竞争性的资本市场进行互动，以最大化随着时期价格变化的收益。我们指出（或许令人惊讶的是），在均衡状态下，后来的披露会被更积极地解读，尽管管理者获取信号的时间与公司的价值无关。我们还提供了使均衡处于阈值策略的充分条件。（JEL D21, D82, G32, L25）

abstract.text: Firms' incentives to manufacture biased user reviews impede review usefulness. We examine the differences in reviews for a given hotel between two sites: Expedia.com (only a customer can post a review) and TripAdvisor.com (anyone can post). We argue that the net gains from promotional reviewing are highest for independent hotels with single-unit owners and lowest for branded chain hotels with multiunit owners. We demonstrate that the hotel neighbors of hotels with a high incentive to fake have more negative reviews on TripAdvisor relative to Expedia; hotels with a high incentive to fake have more positive reviews on TripAdvisor relative to Expedia. (JEL L15, L83, M31)

10.1257/aer.104.8.2421.abstractZh: 企业制造有偏见的用户评价的行为会阻碍评价的有效性。我们研究了同一家酒店在两家网站上的评价差异：Expedia.com（只有顾客可以发布评价）和TripAdvisor.com（任何人都可以发布评价）。我们认为，对于由单一业主经营的独立酒店来说，通过宣传性评价获得的净收益最高；而对于由多个业主经营的品牌连锁酒店来说，这种收益则最低。我们的研究还表明，在TripAdvisor上，那些有较高动机伪造评价的酒店，其负面评价数量相对于Expedia而言更多；而在TripAdvisor上，这些酒店的正面评价数量相对于Expedia而言更多。（JEL L15, L83, M31）

abstract.text: We show that isolated capital cities are robustly associated with greater levels of corruption across US states, in line with the view that this isolation reduces accountability. We then provide direct evidence that the spatial distribution of population relative to the capital affects different accountability mechanisms: newspapers cover state politics more when readers are closer to the capital, voters who live far from the capital are less knowledgeable and interested in state politics, and they turn out less in state elections. We also find that isolated capitals are associated with more money in state-level campaigns, and worse public good provision. (JEL D72, D73, H41, H83, K42, R23)

10.1257/aer.104.8.2456.abstractZh: 我们表明，与美国观点一致，孤立的首都城市与更高水平的腐败之间存在稳健关联，因为这种孤立会降低问责性。随后，我们提供了直接证据，表明人口相对于首都的地理分布会影响不同的问责机制：当读者距离首都较近时，报纸会更多地报道州政治新闻；而居住在首都偏远地区的选民则对州政治了解较少，兴趣也较低，他们在州选举中的投票率也较低。我们还发现，孤立的首都城市与更多的州级竞选资金相关，且公共物品的提供质量较差。（JEL D72, D73, H41, H83, K42, R23）

abstract.text: When regulated firms are offered compensation to prevent them from relocating, efficiency requires that payments be distributed across firms so as to equalize marginal relocation probabilities, weighted by the damage caused by relocation. We formalize this fundamental economic logic and apply it to analyzing compensation rules proposed under the EU Emissions Trading Scheme, where emission permits are allocated free of charge to carbon-intensive and trade-exposed industries. We show that this practice results in substantial overcompensation for given carbon leakage risk. Efficient permit allocation reduces the aggregate risk of job loss by more than half without increasing aggregate compensation. (JEL H23, Q52, Q53, Q54, Q58)

10.1257/aer.104.8.2482.abstractZh: 当被监管的公司被提供补偿以防止其搬迁时，效率要求补偿应在不同公司之间分配，以均衡边际搬迁概率，并根据搬迁造成的损害进行加权。我们将这一基本经济逻辑形式化，并将其应用于分析欧盟排放交易计划下提出的补偿规则。在该计划中，排放许可免费分配给碳密集型产业和易受贸易影响的行业。我们表明，这种做法在一定的碳泄漏风险下会导致严重的过度补偿。有效的许可分配可以在不增加总补偿的情况下，将失业的总风险降低一半以上。（JEL H23, Q52, Q53, Q54, Q58）

abstract.text: This paper documents the pervasiveness of job polarization in 16 Western European countries over the period 1993–2010. It then develops and estimates a framework to explain job polarization using routine-biased technological change and offshoring. This model can explain much of both total job polarization and the split into within-industry and between-industry components. (JEL J21, J23, J24, M55, O33)

10.1257/aer.104.8.2509.abstractZh: 本文记录了1993年至2010年间16个西欧国家中就业两极分化的普遍现象。随后，本文提出并估算了一个框架，以解释就业两极分化现象，该框架考虑了常规性技术变革和离岸外包的影响。该模型能够解释就业两极分化的总体情况，以及其行业内和行业间差异的成因。（JEL J21, J23, J24, M55, O33）

abstract.text: Using new data on real estate listings, we provide new evidence that foreclosures have a causal effect on nearby house prices and disentangle the effect into two sources: competition and disamenities. We identify the causal effect by showing that sellers respond to new REO listings in the exact week of listing, not a week before and not a week after. We disentangle competition and disamenity effects by examining the spillover effect across various stages of the foreclosure process. We find that competition effects are important in all areas, but only find evidence for disamenity effects in high density, low price neighborhoods. (JEL R31)

10.1257/aer.104.8.2527.abstractZh: 通过利用新的房地产房源数据，我们提供了新的证据，表明止赎行为对附近房价有因果影响，并将这种影响分解为两个因素：竞争效应和居住不便性。我们通过研究结果显示，卖家会在房源挂牌的同一周做出反应，而不是在之前或之后的一周。我们通过分析止赎过程各个阶段的溢出效应，将竞争效应和居住不便性效应区分开来。我们发现，竞争效应在所有地区都很重要，而居住不便性效应则主要出现在人口密度高、房价低的社区中。（JEL R31）

abstract.text: A significant policy concern about the emerging plaintiff legal funding industry is that loans will undermine settlement. When the plaintiff has private information about damages, we find that the optimal ( plaintiff-funder) loan induces all plaintiff types to make the same demand, resulting in full settlement; implementation may entail a very high repayment amount. Plaintiffs' attorneys with contingent-fee compensation benefit from such financing, as it eliminates trial costs. When the defendant has private information about his likelihood of being found liable, we find that the likelihood of settlement is unaffected. In both settings the defendant's incentive for care-taking is unaffected. (JEL D82, K41, L84)

10.1257/aer.104.8.2552.abstractZh: 关于新兴的原告法律融资行业，一个重要的政策问题是，贷款可能会破坏和解进程。当原告拥有关于损害赔偿的私人信息时，我们发现最优的贷款安排会促使所有类型的原告提出相同的索赔要求，从而实现完全和解；但实施这种贷款可能会带来非常高的还款金额。拥有附带费用补偿的原告律师可以从这种融资中受益，因为这样可以免除审判成本。而当被告拥有关于自己可能被认定负有责任的私人信息时，我们发现和解的可能性不会受到影响。在这两种情况下，被告的谨慎行为动机也不会受到影响。（JEL D82, K41, L84）

abstract.text: Administrative data from a large and diverse community college are used to examine if underrepresented minority students benefit from taking courses with underrepresented minority instructors. To identify racial interactions, we estimate models that include both student and classroom fixed effects and focus on students with limited choice in courses. We find that the performance gap in terms of class dropout rates and grade performance between white and underrepresented minority students falls by 20 to 50 percent when taught by an underrepresented minority instructor. We also find these interactions affect longer-term outcomes such as subsequent course selection, retention, and degree completion. (JEL I23, J15, J44)

10.1257/aer.104.8.2567.abstractZh: 我们利用一所大型且多元化的社区学院的管理数据，研究代表性不足的少数族裔学生是否从由代表性不足的少数族裔教师授课的课程中受益。为了识别种族间的互动关系，我们构建了包含学生和课堂固定效应的模型，并重点关注在课程选择上受限的学生。研究发现，当由代表性不足的少数族裔教师授课时，白人与代表性不足的少数族裔学生之间的辍学率和成绩差距会减少20%到50%。我们还发现，这种互动关系会影响学生后续的课程选择、留校率和学位完成率等长期结果。（JEL I23, J15, J44）

abstract.text: Are teachers' impacts on students' test scores (value-added) a good measure of their quality? One reason this question has sparked debate is disagreement about whether value-added (VA) measures provide unbiased estimates of teachers' causal impacts on student achievement. We test for bias in VA using previously unobserved parent characteristics and a quasi-experimental design based on changes in teaching staff. Using school district and tax records for more than one million children, we find that VA models which control for a student's prior test scores provide unbiased forecasts of teachers' impacts on student achievement. (JEL H75, I21, J24, J45)

10.1257/aer.104.9.2593.abstractZh: 教师对学生考试成绩的影响（价值增值）是否是衡量其质量的一个好指标？这个问题引发争论的一个原因是，对于价值增值指标是否能提供教师对学生学业成就的因果影响的无偏估计存在分歧。我们通过使用之前未观察到的家长特征以及基于教师变动的准实验设计来检验价值增值的偏差。利用超过一百万儿童所在学区和税务记录，我们发现，能够控制学生先前考试成绩的价值增值模型能够提供教师对学生学业成就影响的无偏预测。（JEL H75, I21, J24, J45）

abstract.text: Are teachers' impacts on students' test scores (value-added) a good measure of their quality? This question has sparked debate partly because of a lack of evidence on whether high value-added (VA) teachers improve students' long-term outcomes. Using school district and tax records for more than one million children, we find that students assigned to high-VA teachers are more likely to attend college, earn higher salaries, and are less likely to have children as teenagers. Replacing a teacher whose VA is in the bottom 5 percent with an average teacher would increase the present value of students' lifetime income by approximately $250,000 per classroom. (JEL H75, I21, J24, J45)

10.1257/aer.104.9.2633.abstractZh: 教师对学生考试成绩的影响（价值增值）是否是衡量其质量的好方法？这个问题引发了争议，部分原因是缺乏证据来证明高价值增值的教师能够改善学生的长期表现。通过利用超过一百万名儿童的学区及税务记录，我们发现被分配到高价值增值教师的班级的学生更有可能上大学、获得更高的薪水，并且在青少年时期生育孩子的可能性也较低。如果用一名价值增值处于最低5%的教师替换一名普通教师，每间教室学生终身收入的现值将增加约25万美元。（JEL H75, I21, J24, J45）

abstract.text: Though risk aversion and the elasticity of intertemporal substitution have been the subjects of careful scrutiny, the long-run risks literature as well as the broader literature using recursive utility to address asset pricing puzzles has ignored the full implications of their parameter specifications. Recursive utility implies that the temporal resolution of risk matters and a quantitative assessment thereof should be part of the calibration process. This paper gives a sense of the magnitudes of implied timing premia. Its objective is to inject temporal resolution of risk into the discussion of the quantitative properties of long-run risks and related models. (JEL D81, G11, G12)

10.1257/aer.104.9.2680.abstractZh: 尽管风险厌恶和跨时替代弹性一直是学者们仔细研究的主题，但关于长期风险的研究以及使用递归效用来解决资产定价难题的更广泛研究，都忽略了这些参数规格的全部含义。递归效用意味着风险的时间分辨率非常重要，对其进行定量评估应该是校准过程的一部分。本文旨在揭示隐含的时间溢价的大小。其目标是将风险的时间分辨率引入对长期风险及相关模型定量特性的讨论中。（JEL D81, G11, G12）

abstract.text: This paper proposes foundations and a methodology for survey-based tracking of well-being. First, we develop a theory in which utility depends on "fundamental aspects" of well-being, measurable with surveys. Second, drawing from psychologists, philosophers, and economists, we compile a comprehensive list of such aspects. Third, we demonstrate our proposed method for estimating the aspects' relative marginal utilities-a necessary input for constructing an individual-level well-being index-by asking ~4,600 U.S. survey respondents to state their preference between pairs of aspect bundles. We estimate high relative marginal utilities for aspects related to family, health, security, values, freedom, happiness, and life satisfaction.

10.1257/aer.104.9.2698.abstractZh: 本文提出了基于调查来追踪幸福感的基础和方法论。首先，我们发展了一种理论，其中效用取决于可以通过调查测量的“基本方面”。其次，借鉴心理学家、哲学家和经济学家的观点，我们编制了一份全面的方面清单。第三，我们通过让约4,600名美国调查受访者对一系列方面进行偏好排序，来演示我们提出的方法——这种方法用于估算这些方面的相对边际效用，这是构建个体层面幸福感指数的必要输入。我们发现，与家庭、健康、安全、价值观、自由、幸福感和生活满意度相关的方面具有较高的相对边际效用。

abstract.text: We reevaluate the role of human capital in determining the wealth of nations. We use standard human capital theory to estimate stocks of human capital and allow the quality of human capital to vary across countries. Our model can explain differences in schooling and earnings profiles and, consequently, estimates of Mincerian rates of return across countries. We find that effective human capital per worker varies substantially across countries. Cross-country differences in Total Factor Productivity (TFP) are significantly smaller than found in previous studies. Our model implies that output per worker is highly responsive to changes in TFP and demographic variables.

10.1257/aer.104.9.2736.abstractZh: 我们重新评估了人力资本在决定国家财富中的作用。我们使用标准的人力资本理论来估算人力资本存量，并允许人力资本的质量在不同国家之间存在差异。我们的模型能够解释教育水平和收入状况的差异，因此也能够解释各国之间Mincer回归系数估计值的差异。我们发现，每个工人的有效人力资本在不同国家之间存在显著差异。各国全要素生产率（TFP）的差异比以往研究发现的要小得多。我们的模型表明，每个工人的产出对TFP和人口统计变量的变化反应非常敏感。

abstract.text: Public transit accounts for 1 percent of US passenger miles traveled but attracts strong public support. Using a simple choice model, we predict that transit riders are likely to be individuals who commute along routes with severe roadway delays. These individuals' choices thus have high marginal impacts on congestion. We test this prediction with data from a strike in 2003 by Los Angeles transit workers. Estimating a regression discontinuity design, we find that average highway delay increases 47 percent when transit service ceases. We find that the net benefits of transit systems appear to be much larger than previously believed. (JEL H76, J52, L92, R41)

10.1257/aer.104.9.2763.abstractZh: 公共交通在美国的客运里程中占比仅为1%，但却获得了广泛的公众支持。通过简单的选择模型预测，乘坐公共交通的人往往是在道路拥堵严重的路线上通勤的个体。因此，这些个体的选择对交通拥堵的影响较大。我们通过2003年洛杉矶公交工人罢工的数据来验证这一预测。采用回归不连续设计进行估计后发现，当公共交通服务停止时，平均高速公路延误增加了47%。我们发现，公共交通系统的净效益比之前认为的要大得多。（JEL H76, J52, L92, R41）

abstract.text: We analyze whether midlevel managers in securitized finance were aware of a large-scale housing bubble and a looming crisis in 2004–2006 using their personal home transaction data. We find that the average person in our sample neither timed the market nor were cautious in their home transactions, and did not exhibit awareness of problems in overall housing markets. Certain groups of securitization agents were particularly aggressive in increasing their exposure to housing during this period, suggesting the need to expand the incentives-based view of the crisis to incorporate a role for beliefs. (JEL D14, D83, E32, E44, G01, G21, R31)

10.1257/aer.104.9.2797.abstractZh: 我们分析了在2004-2006年期间，证券化金融领域的中层管理人员是否意识到大规模的房地产泡沫以及即将到来的危机，这是通过他们个人的房屋交易数据来进行的。我们发现，样本中的大多数人既没有及时预测市场走势，也没有在房屋交易中保持谨慎，也没有表现出对整体房地产市场问题的认识。在这一时期，某些证券化代理人特别热衷于增加他们对房地产市场的投资，这表明需要扩展基于激励的危机分析框架，以纳入信念在危机中的作用。（JEL D14, D83, E32, E44, G01, G21, R31）

abstract.text: We investigate whether homeowners respond strategically to news of mortgage modification programs. We exploit plausibly exogenous variation in modification policy induced by settlement of US state government lawsuits against Countrywide Financial Corporation, which agreed to offer modifications to seriously delinquent borrowers. Using a difference-in-differences framework, we find that Countrywide's monthly delinquency rate increased more than 0.54 percentage points—a 10 percent relative increase—immediately after the settlement's announcement. The estimated increase in default rates is largest among borrowers least likely to default otherwise. These results suggest that strategic behavior should be an important consideration in designing mortgage modification programs. (JEL D14, G21, K22, R31)

10.1257/aer.104.9.2830.abstractZh: 我们研究了房主是否会对抵押贷款调整计划的新闻采取策略性反应。我们利用美国州政府针对Countrywide金融公司的诉讼结果所引发的调整政策的合理外生变化，该公司在同意为严重逾期还款的借款人提供调整方案。通过差异-差异框架的分析，我们发现Countrywide的月度逾期率在和解协议宣布后立即增加了0.54个百分点，即相对增加了10%。违约率的上升幅度在那些最不可能违约的借款人中最为明显。这些结果表明，在设计抵押贷款调整计划时，策略性行为应该是一个重要的考虑因素。（JEL D14, G21, K22, R31）

abstract.text: We study the Markov equilibria of a model of free riding in which n infinitely lived agents choose between private consumption and irreversible contributions to a durable public good. We show that the set of equilibrium steady states converges to a unique point as depreciation converges to zero. For any level of depreciation, moreover, the highest steady state converges to the efficient level as agents become increasingly patient. These results are in contrast to the case with reversible investments, where a continuum of inefficient equilibrium steady states exists for any level of depreciation, discount factor, and size of population. (JEL D11, H41)

10.1257/aer.104.9.2858.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个自由搭便车模型的马尔可夫均衡，其中n个无限寿命的代理人需要在私人消费和不可逆地贡献于一个持久性公共物品之间做出选择。我们表明，随着折旧的减少趋近于零，均衡稳态的集合会收敛到一个唯一的点。此外，对于任何折旧水平，随着代理人变得更加耐心，最高的稳态会收敛到有效水平。这些结果与可逆投资的情况相反，在可逆投资的情况下，对于任何折旧水平、折现因子和人口规模，都存在一系列低效的均衡稳态。（JEL D11, H41）

abstract.text: We measure the pass-through of emissions costs to electricity prices. We perform both reduced-form and structural estimations based on optimal bidding in this market. Using rich micro-level data, we estimate the channels affecting pass-through in a flexible manner, with minimal functional form assumptions. Contrary to many studies in the general pass-through literature, we find that emissions costs are almost fully passed through to electricity prices. Since electricity is traded through high-frequency auctions for highly inelastic demand, firms have weak incentives to adjust markups after the cost shock. Furthermore, the costs of price adjustment are small. (JEL D44, L11, L94, L98, Q52, Q54)

10.1257/aer.104.9.2872.abstractZh: 我们测量了排放成本对电力价格的影响传递情况。我们基于该市场中的最优出价行为，进行了简化形式和结构性估计。利用丰富的微观数据，我们以灵活的方式估计影响成本传递的渠道，且对功能形式假设的要求极低。与许多关于成本传递的一般研究不同，我们发现排放成本几乎完全传递到了电力价格中。由于电力通过高频拍卖交易，且需求具有高度非弹性，企业在成本冲击后调整价格加成的能力较弱。此外，价格调整的成本也很低。（JEL D44, L11, L94, L98, Q52, Q54）

abstract.text: Insurers have the reputation of being bad payers who nitpick whenever an opportunity arises. However, this nitpicking activity has a positive impact on their auditing strategy since auditing may prove profitable when claims are not fraudulent. We show that reducing the indemnity payments of audited claims induces a lower fraud rate at equilibrium and that some degree of nitpicking is socially optimal when insurance fraud is a concern. Its remains optimal even if it induces adverse effects on policyholders' moral standards. (JEL D86, G22, K12, K42)

10.1257/aer.104.9.2900.abstractZh: 保险公司素有挑剔的不良支付者之称，每当有机会时就会进行挑剔行为。然而，这种挑剔行为对他们的审计策略具有积极影响，因为当索赔并非欺诈时，审计可能会带来收益。我们的研究表明，减少已审计索赔的赔偿金额可以在均衡状态下降低欺诈率，而当面临保险欺诈问题时，一定程度的挑剔行为在社会上是最优的。即使这种挑剔行为会对保单持有人的道德标准产生负面影响，它仍然是最优的。（JEL D86, G22, K12, K42）

abstract.text: This paper presents a sequential search model where consumers look for several products from multiproduct firms. Multiproduct search can significantly influence firms' pricing decisions. For example, it can make market prices decrease with search costs. Possible applications of the model are also discussed. (JEL D11, D43, D83)

10.1257/aer.104.9.2918.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个序贯搜索模型，其中消费者从多家产品公司中寻找多种产品。多产品搜索会显著影响公司的定价决策。例如，搜索成本可能导致市场价格下降。该模型可能的应用也被讨论。 (JEL D11, D43, D83)

abstract.text: Subsidized health insurance markets use diagnosis-based risk adjustment to induce insurers to offer an equitable benefit to individuals of varying expected cost. I demonstrate that technological change after risk adjustment calibration-new drug entry and the onset of generic competition-made certain diagnoses profitable or unprofitable in Medicare Part D. I then exploit variation in diagnoses' profitability driven by technological change to show insurers designed more favorable benefits for drugs that treat profitable diagnoses as compared to unprofitable diagnoses. In the presence of technological change, risk adjustment may not fully neutralize insurers' incentives to select through benefit designs.

10.1257/pol.20140171.abstractZh: 补贴型健康保险市场采用基于诊断的风险调整机制，以促使保险公司为预期成本不同的个体提供公平的福利。我证明了风险调整校准后的技术变革——新药的引入以及仿制药竞争的兴起——使得某些诊断在Medicare Part D中变得有利可图或无利可图。接着，我利用技术变革导致的诊断盈利能力的差异，表明保险公司为治疗有利可图的诊断提供的药物福利比针对无利可图的诊断更为优惠。在技术变革的背景下，风险调整可能无法完全抵消保险公司通过福利设计来选择特定产品的动机。

abstract.text: I use the Medicare Part D prescription drug insurance market to examine the dynamics of firm interaction with consumers on an insurance exchange. Enrollment data show that consumers face switching frictions leading to inertia in plan choice, and a regression discontinuity design indicates initial defaults have persistent effects. In the absence of commitment to future prices, theory predicts firms respond to inertia by raising prices on existing enrollees, while introducing cheaper alternative plans. The complete set of enrollment and price data from 2006 through 2010 confirms this prediction: older plans have approximately 10 percent higher premiums than comparable new plans. (JEL G22, I13, I18, L11, L65)

10.1257/pol.6.1.38.abstractZh: 我利用Medicare Part D处方药保险市场来研究公司与消费者在保险交易所互动的动态。注册数据显示，消费者面临转换障碍，导致计划选择上的惯性现象，而回归不连续设计表明初始的默认行为具有持久影响。在缺乏对未来价格的承诺的情况下，理论预测公司会针对惯性现象提高现有注册用户的费用，同时引入更便宜的替代计划。2006年至2010年的完整注册和价格数据证实了这一预测：较旧的计划比类似的新计划高出约10%的保费。（JEL G22, I13, I18, L11, L65）

abstract.text: The detailed analysis of these 10 case studies together with the rest of the analytical text highlight the realities of P4P programs and their potential impact on the performance of health systems in a diversity of settings. This book provides critical insights into the experience to date with P4P and how this tool may be better leveraged to improve health system performance and accountability.

10.1787/9789264224568-en.abstractZh: 对这10个案例研究的详细分析，以及其余分析内容的综合，揭示了P4P项目的实际情况及其在不同环境下对卫生系统绩效的潜在影响。本书提供了对P4P项目迄今为止经验的深刻见解，并探讨了如何更好地利用这一工具来提高卫生系统的绩效和问责制。

abstract.text: A major factor weighing down the long-term finances of state and local governments is the obligation to fund retiree benefits. While state and local government pension obligations have been analyzed in great detail, much less attention has been paid to the costs of the other major retiree benefit provided by these governments: retiree health insurance. The first portion of the paper uses the information contained in the annual actuarial reports for public retiree health plans to reverse engineer the cash flows underlying the liabilities given in the report. Obtaining the cash flows allows us to construct liability estimates which are consistent across governments in terms of the discount rate, actuarial method and assumptions concerning medical cost inflation and mortality. We find that the total unfunded accrued liability of state and local governments for the provision of retiree health care exceeds $1 trillion, or about ⅓ of total state and local government revenue. Relative to pension obligations discounted at the same rate, we find that unfunded retiree health care liabilities are ½ the size of unfunded pension obligations. We also find that using assumptions concerning the growth in health care costs that are arguably more realistic than those employed by most states actually reduces the size of the liability in most cases. Pushing in the opposite direction, we find that using plausibly more realistic mortality assumptions increases the size of liability. The second portion of the paper places retiree health care obligations into context by examining the budget pressures associated with retiree health on a continuing, largely pay-as-you go basis. We find that much of the projected increase in retiree health obligations as a share of revenue is the result of health care cost growth. On average, states could put their retiree health obligations into long-run fiscal balance by contributing an additional ¾ percent of total revenue toward the benefit each year. There is, however, wide variation across the states, with the majority of states requiring little in the way of additional financing, but some states requiring a significantly larger increase.

10.3386/w19779.abstractZh: 影响州和地方政府长期财务状况的一个重要因素是为退休人员福利提供资金的责任。虽然对州和地方政府养老金义务的详细分析已经很多，但对这些政府提供的另一项主要退休人员福利——退休人员健康保险的成本却鲜有关注。本文的第一部分利用公共退休人员健康计划的年度精算报告中的信息，逆向推导出报告中所述的负债的现金流。通过获取这些现金流，我们可以构建出在折现率、精算方法以及关于医疗费用通胀和死亡率的假设方面与不同政府一致的负债估算。我们发现，州和地方政府在提供退休人员医疗保健方面的未融资应计负债总额超过1万亿美元，约占州和地方政府总收入的⅓。与以相同比率折现的养老金义务相比，我们发现未融资的退休人员医疗保健负债仅为未融资养老金义务的½。我们还发现，使用比大多数州实际采用的更为现实的医疗费用增长假设，可以在大多数情况下减少负债的规模。相反地，使用更为现实的死亡率假设则会增加负债的规模。本文的第二部分通过考察与退休人员健康相关的预算压力，将退休人员医疗保健义务置于更广泛的背景下进行讨论。我们发现，退休人员健康义务在收入中的比例预计增加，很大程度上是由于医疗费用的增长所致。平均而言，各州可以通过将每年额外增加总收入的¾用于支付退休人员福利，来将其健康义务纳入长期财政平衡中。然而，各州之间存在很大差异，大多数州对额外融资的需求很小，而有些州则需要大幅增加资金投入。

abstract.text: This paper provides an analysis of the role of prices in determining food purchases and nutrition using very detailed transaction-level observations for a large, nationally-representative sample of US consumers over the period 2002-2007. Using product- specific nutritional information, we develop a new method of partitioning the product space into relevant nutritional clusters that define a set of nutritionally-bundled goods, which parsimoniously characterize consumer choice sets. We then estimate a large utility-derived demand system over this joint product-nutrient space that allows us to calculate price and expenditure elasticities. Using our structural demand estimates, we simulate the role of product taxes on soda, sugar-sweetened beverages, packaged meals, and snacks, and nutrient taxes on fat, salt, and sugar. We find that a 20% nutrient tax has a significantly larger impact on nutrition than an equivalent product tax, due to the fact that these are broader-based taxes. However, the costs of these taxes in terms of consumer utility are not higher. A sugar tax in particular is a powerful tool to induce healthier nutritive bundles among consumers.

10.3386/w19781.abstractZh: 本文通过分析2002至2007年间美国消费者大规模、具有全国代表性的样本数据，从交易层面详细观察价格在决定食品购买和营养摄入中的作用。利用具体的产品营养信息，我们提出了一种将产品空间划分为相关营养集群的新方法，这些集群定义了营养组合商品，从而简洁地描述了消费者的选择行为。随后，我们基于这一产品-营养联合空间，估算了一个大型效用需求系统，从而能够计算价格和支出的弹性。通过我们的结构需求估算结果，我们模拟了针对苏打水、含糖饮料、包装餐食和零食的产品税，以及针对脂肪、盐和糖的营养税的影响。研究发现，20%的营养税对营养的影响比同等程度的产品税更为显著，因为这类税收的覆盖范围更广。然而，这些税收对消费者效用的影响并不更大。特别是糖税是一种有效的工具，能够促使消费者选择更健康的营养组合。

abstract.text: Most health insurance uses cost-sharing to reduce excess utilization. Supplemental insurance can blunt the impact of this cost-sharing, increasing utilization and exerting a negative externality on the primary insurer. This paper estimates the effect of private Medigap supplemental insurance on public Medicare spending using Medigap premium discontinuities in local medical markets that span state boundaries. Using administrative data on the universe of Medicare beneficiaries, we estimate that Medigap increases an individual’s Medicare spending by 22.2%. We calculate that a 15% tax on Medigap premiums generates savings of $12.9 billion annually, with a standard error of $4.9 billion.

10.3386/w19787.abstractZh: 大多数健康保险都采用费用分摊的方式来减少过度使用。补充保险可能会削弱这种费用分摊的效果，从而增加医疗服务的使用量，并对主要保险提供商产生负面外部性。本文通过分析跨越州界的当地医疗市场中Medigap补充保险保费的变化，估算了这种保险对公共Medicare支出的影响。利用关于Medicare受益人的行政数据，我们估计Medigap补充保险会使个人的Medicare支出增加22.2%。我们计算发现，对Medigap保费征收15%的税每年可节省129亿美元，标准误差为49亿美元。

abstract.text: While time out of work normally decreases subsequent employment, Social Security Disability Insurance (DI) may improve the health of disabled individuals and increase their ability to work. In this paper, I examine the employment of individuals who lost DI eligibility after the 1996 removal of drug and alcohol addictions as qualifying conditions. Approximately one-fifth started earning at levels that would have disqualified them for DI, an employment response that is large relative to their work histories. This response is largest for those who had received DI for 2.5-3 years, when it is 50% larger than for those who had received DI for less than one year and 30% larger than for those who had received DI for six years. A similar relationship between time on DI and the employment response is found among those whose primary disability was an addiction, mental disorder, or musculoskeletal condition, but not those with chronic conditions like heart or liver disease. The results suggest that a period of public assistance can maximize the employment of some disabled individuals.

10.3386/w19793.abstractZh: 虽然失业通常会导致后续就业能力的下降，但社会保障残疾保险可能有助于改善残疾人士的健康状况，并提高他们的就业能力。本文研究了在1996年取消药物与酒精成瘾作为资格条件的后，失去残疾保险资格的人士的就业情况。大约五分之一的受助者开始获得足以使其失去残疾保险资格的收入，这一就业反应相对于他们的工作经历来说相当显著。对于那些已经获得残疾保险2.5至3年的人来说，这种反应最为明显，其幅度比那些获得残疾保险不到一年的人高出50%，比那些获得残疾保险6年的人高出30%。在那些主要残疾原因是成瘾、精神障碍或肌肉骨骼疾病的人群中，也发现了与残疾保险时长相关的就业反应，但在患有慢性疾病如心脏病或肝病的人群中则没有这种关系。结果表明，一段公共援助期可以最大化某些残疾人士的就业能力。

abstract.text: We formally model direct to consumer advertising (DTCA) of prescription drugs and examine factors that determine a pharmaceutical firm's DTCA strategy. We highlight how the profitability of DTCA varies with the characteristics of the condition that the advertised drug treats, the incidence of the condition, and the signal value of symptoms, and risk factors. We account for the potential information benefits from DTCA as well as its potential to persuade consumers. From a welfare perspective there can be too much or too little private investment in advertising. Welfare is more likely to increase when the population is uninsured.

10.3386/w19794.abstractZh: 我们正式对处方药的直接面向消费者广告进行了建模，并研究了决定制药公司直接面向消费者广告策略的因素。我们指出，直接面向消费者广告的盈利能力随着所宣传药物所治疗的疾病特征、该疾病的发病率以及症状的信号价值和风险因素而变化。我们考虑了直接面向消费者广告可能带来的信息收益，以及其说服消费者的潜力。从福利的角度来看，私人对广告的投资可能过多或过少。当人群没有保险时，福利更有可能增加。

abstract.text: This paper explores the impact of the introduction of the widely viewed MTV show 16 and Pregnant on teen childbearing. The reality TV show follows the lives of pregnant teenagers during the final months of their pregnancy and early months of motherhood. We match Vital Statistics birth data to Nielson television ratings data to investigate whether exposure to the show had an impact on teen childbearing rates. We implement an instrumental variables (IV) strategy using local area MTV ratings data from a pre-period to predict local area 16 and Pregnant ratings. We also introduce event study methods, utilizing the specific timing of the show’s introduction to identify a causal effect. The results of this analysis imply that the introduction of this MTV show led to a 4.3 percent reduction in teen births in the 18 months following its initial airing. This accounts for 24 percent of the overall decline in teen births in the United States during that period. We supplement these findings with an examination of data from Google Trends and Twitter, which suggest that this show led to increased interest in contraceptive use and abortion, as captured by internet search and tweeting behavior.

10.3386/w19795.abstractZh: 本文探讨了广受关注的MTV节目《16 and Pregnant》对青少年生育行为的影响。该真人秀节目记录了怀孕青少年在妊娠最后几个月及成为母亲后的最初几个月的生活。我们通过将人口统计的出生数据与尼尔森电视收视率数据进行匹配，以研究该节目对青少年生育率的影响。我们采用了工具变量策略，利用节目播出前的当地MTV收视率数据来预测《16 and Pregnant》播出后的收视率。同时，我们采用了事件研究法，通过节目播出的具体时间来确定其因果效应。分析结果表明，该MTV节目的推出导致该节目首次播出后的18个月内，青少年出生率下降了4.3%。这一比例占同期美国青少年出生率整体下降的24%。我们还通过谷歌趋势和Twitter的数据进一步验证了这些发现，数据显示该节目引发了人们对避孕方法和堕胎的兴趣增加，这些变化可以通过互联网搜索和推文行为来体现。

abstract.text: The US health care sector is large and growing - health care spending in 2011 amounted to $2.7 trillion and 18% of GDP. Approximately half of health care output is allocated via markets. In this paper, we analyze the industrial organization literature on health care markets focusing on the impact of competition on price, quality and treatment decisions for health care providers and health insurers. We conclude with a discussion of research opportunities for industrial organization economists, including opportunities created by the US Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act.

10.3386/w19800.abstractZh: 美国的医疗保健行业规模庞大且持续增长——2011年医疗保健支出达到2.7万亿美元，占GDP的18%。大约一半的医疗保健产出是通过市场分配的。在本文中，我们分析了关于医疗保健市场的产业组织文献，重点关注竞争对医疗保健提供者和健康保险公司价格、质量和治疗决策的影响。最后，我们讨论了产业组织经济学家的研究机会，包括《美国患者保护与平价医疗法案》所带来的机会。

abstract.text: Certificate of Need Laws (CON), state laws requiring providers to obtain licenses before adopting healthcare technology, have been controversial. The effect of CON on technology supply has not been well established. In part this is because analyses have focused on state-level supply effects, which may reflect either the consequence of CON regulation on supply or the cause for its adoption or retention. Instead, we focus on the cross-border effects of CON. We compare the number and location of magnetic resonance imaging providers in counties that border states with a different regulatory regime to: 1) counties in the interior of states, 2) counties on state borders with the same regulatory regime on both sides, and 3) counties on borders with different regulatory regimes, but with a large river on the border. We find there are 6.4 fewer MRIs per million people in regulated counties that border counties in unregulated states than in unregulated counties that border regulated counties. This statistically significant finding that regulatory spillover can be sizable should be accounted for in future research on state-based health technology regulation. In addition, it suggests state experiences may not accurately predict the effects of CON if it were implemented nationally.

10.3386/w19801.abstractZh: 需求认证法（CON）作为要求医疗服务提供者在使用医疗技术前获得许可的州法律，一直存在争议。CON对技术供应影响的研究尚未得到充分证实。部分原因是分析主要集中在州级供应效应上，这可能反映了CON法规对供应的影响，或是其采用或保留的原因。因此，我们重点关注CON的跨境效应。我们比较了与不同监管体制的州接壤的县中磁共振成像提供者的数量和位置，以及那些与同一监管体制的州接壤的县、以及边界上存在不同监管体制但拥有大河的县的磁共振成像提供者的数量和位置。研究发现，与未受监管的州接壤的受监管县的磁共振成像提供量每百万人口比与受监管县接壤的未受监管县少6.4例。这一具有统计学意义的发现表明，监管溢出效应可能相当显著，未来关于州级医疗技术监管的研究应考虑到这一点。此外，这一发现还表明，如果CON在全国范围内实施，各州的经验可能无法准确预测其效果。

abstract.text: Public attention has focused on how the launch of the national health exchanges could impact the types of risks who initially enroll and thereby affect future premiums and enrollment. We introduce simple dynamics into a standard model of insurance under adverse selection to show that such "initial conditions" can indeed matter. When firms are price-takers, the market can converge to a Pareto-inferior "bad" equilibrium if there are at least three equilibria, which we suggest has empirical support. Strategic pricing eliminates Pareto dominated equilibria but requires common knowledge of preference and risk distributions. Changing the fine on non-participants from a fixed amount to a fraction of equilibrium prices increases the range of initial conditions consistent with reaching the "good" equilibrium while reducing the "badness" of the bad equilibrium -- all without increasing the fine value in the good equilibrium. Allowing insurers to quickly change prices can encourage them to experiment with strategic pricing if market fundamentals are not perfectly known, increasing the chance of reaching the good equilibrium independently from initial conditions.

10.3386/w19835.abstractZh: 公众的关注点在于，全国健康交易所的启动可能会如何影响最初参与的人群所面临的风险类型，进而影响到未来的保费和参与人数。我们在一个存在逆向选择的保险标准模型中引入了一个简单的动态机制，以表明这样的“初始条件”确实具有重要意义。当企业只是价格接受者时，如果市场存在至少三个均衡点，市场可能会收敛到一个帕累托劣的“不良”均衡状态，我们认为这一点有实证支持。战略性定价可以消除帕累托占优的均衡状态，但需要对偏好和风险分布有共同的认识。将非参与者的罚款从固定金额改为均衡价格的一部分，可以增加达到“良好”均衡的初始条件范围，同时降低不良均衡的“恶劣性”——而无需增加良好均衡中的罚款金额。允许保险公司快速调整价格，可以在市场基本信息不完全已知的情况下，促使他们尝试战略性定价，从而增加达到良好均衡的机会，而不受初始条件的限制。

abstract.text: We examine the effect of alcohol exposure in utero on child academic achievement. As well as studying the effect of any alcohol exposure, we investigate the effect of the dose, pattern, and duration of exposure. We use a genetic variant in the maternal alcohol-metabolism gene ADH1B as an instrument for alcohol exposure, whilst controlling for the child's genotype on the same variant. We show that the instrument is unrelated to an extensive range of maternal and paternal characteristics and behaviours. OLS regressions suggest an ambiguous association between alcohol exposure in utero and children's academic attainment, but there is a strong social gradient in maternal drinking, with mothers in higher socio-economic groups more likely to drink. In stark contrast to the OLS, the IV estimates show negative effects of prenatal alcohol exposure on child educational attainment. These results are very robust to an extensive set of model specifications. In addition, we show that that the effects are solely driven by the maternal genotype, with no impact of the child's genotype.

10.3386/w19839.abstractZh: 我们研究了子宫内酒精暴露对儿童学业成绩的影响。除了研究任何酒精暴露的影响外，我们还探讨了暴露的剂量、模式和持续时间的影响。我们使用母系酒精代谢基因ADH1B中的遗传变异作为酒精暴露的指标，同时控制儿童的基因型对同一变异的影响。我们发现，这一指标与多种母系和父系特征及行为无关。OLS回归分析表明，子宫内酒精暴露与儿童学业成绩之间存在不确定的关联，但母亲饮酒情况存在明显的社会梯度，社会经济地位较高的母亲更有可能饮酒。与OLS分析结果相反，固定效应估计显示，产前酒精暴露对儿童教育成就有负面影响。这些结果在多种模型设定下仍然非常稳健。此外，我们发现这些影响完全由母亲基因型驱动，儿童的基因型没有影响。

abstract.text: Despite the fundamental role of deterrence in justifying a system of medical malpractice law, surprisingly little evidence has been put forth to date bearing on the relationship between medical liability forces on the one hand and medical errors and health care quality on the other. In this paper, we estimate this relationship using clinically validated measures of health care treatment quality constructed with data from the 1979 to 2005 National Hospital Discharge Surveys and the 1987 to 2008 Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System records. Drawing upon traditional, remedy-centric tort reforms--e.g., damage caps--we estimate that the current liability system plays at most a modest role in inducing higher levels of health care quality. We contend that this limited independent role for medical liability may be a reflection upon the structural nature of the present system of liability rules, which largely hold physicians to standards determined according to industry customs. We find evidence suggesting, however, that physician practices may respond more significantly upon a substantive alteration of this system altogether--i.e., upon a change in the clinical standards to which physicians are held in the first instance. The literature to date has largely failed to appreciate the substantive nature of liability rules and may thus be drawing limited inferences based solely on our experiences to date with damage-caps and related reforms.

10.3386/w19841.abstractZh: 尽管威慑在证明医疗过失法律体系的合理性方面起着基础性作用，但迄今为止，关于医疗责任与医疗错误及医疗质量之间关系的证据却很少。在本文中，我们利用1979年至2005年的全国医院出院调查数据以及1987年至2008年的行为风险因素监测系统的数据，通过临床验证的医疗治疗质量指标来估计这种关系。基于传统的以赔偿为中心的侵权改革措施——例如损害限额制度，我们估计当前的责任体系最多只能起到适度提高医疗质量的作用。我们认为，医疗责任的这种有限独立作用可能反映了现行责任规则体系的结构性特点，这些规则主要依据行业惯例来约束医生的行为。然而，我们发现，如果彻底改变这一体系，即改变医生最初所遵循的临床标准，医生的实践可能会产生更显著的反应。迄今为止的文献大多未能充分认识到责任规则的实质性特征，因此仅基于我们目前对损害限额及相关改革措施的经验，得出的结论可能有限。

abstract.text: The apparently unrelenting growth in the GDP-share of health spending (SHS) has been a perennial issue of policy concern. Does an equilibrium limit exist? The issue has been left open in recent dynamic models which take income growth and population aging as given. We view these variables as endogenously determined within an overlapping-generations, human-capital-based endogenous-growth model, where a representative parent makes all life-cycle consumption and investment decisions and life and health protection are subject to diminishing returns. Our prototype model, allowing for both quantity and quality of life as desired goods, yields equilibrium upper bounds for SHS. Our calibrated simulations also account for observed trends in reproductive choices, population aging, life expectancy, and economic growth. The analysis offers new insights about factors that drive long-term trends in aging and health spending and establishes a direct relation between health investments at young age and the equilibrium, steady-state rate of economic growth.

10.3386/w19856.abstractZh: 健康支出在GDP中的比例似乎持续增长，这一问题是政策关注的热点之一。是否存在一个均衡限制？在那些将收入增长和人口老龄化视为既定条件的动态模型中，这个问题尚未得到解答。我们认为，这些变量是在一个重叠世代、以人力资本为基础的内生增长模型中内生决定的，其中一位代表性父母负责所有的生命周期消费和投资决策，而生命和健康保护则受到收益递减的影响。我们的原型模型允许将生活质量与数量作为期望的商品，从而为健康支出提供了均衡上限。我们的校准模拟还考虑了生殖选择、人口老龄化、预期寿命和经济增长等观察到的趋势。该分析为理解驱动老龄化和健康支出长期趋势的因素提供了新的见解，并建立了年轻时期的健康投资与均衡、稳定经济增长率之间的直接关系。

abstract.text: A large literature has documented significant public health benefits associated with the minimum legal drinking age in the United States, particularly because of the resulting effects on motor vehicle accidents. These benefits form the primary basis for continued efforts to restrict youth access to alcohol. It is important to keep in mind, though, that policymakers have a wide variety of alcohol-control options available to them, and understanding how these policies may complement or substitute for one another can improve policy making moving forward. Towards this end, we propose that investigating the causal effects of the minimum legal drinking age in New South Wales, Australia provides a particularly informative case study, because Australian states are among the world leaders in their efforts against drunk driving. Using an age-based regression-discontinuity design applied to restricted-use data from several sources, we find no evidence that legal access to alcohol has effects on motor vehicle accidents of any type in New South Wales, despite having large effects on drinking and on hospitalizations due to alcohol abuse.

10.3386/w19857.abstractZh: 大量文献记录了美国设定最低法定饮酒年龄对公共健康的显著益处，尤其是对机动车事故的影响。这些益处是持续限制青少年接触酒精的主要依据。然而，需要记住的是，政策制定者拥有多种酒精控制方案可供选择，了解这些政策如何互补或替代可以有助于未来的政策制定。为此，我们建议研究澳大利亚新南威尔士州设定最低法定饮酒年龄的因果效应，因为该州在预防酒驾方面处于世界领先地位。通过采用基于年龄的回归不连续设计，并利用来自多个来源的限制性数据，我们发现，尽管法定饮酒年龄对饮酒量和因酒精滥用导致的住院率有显著影响，但在新南威尔士州，它并未对各类机动车事故产生任何影响。

abstract.text: There is growing concern that improving the academic skills of disadvantaged youth is too difficult and costly, so policymakers should instead focus either on vocationally oriented instruction for teens or else on early childhood education. Yet this conclusion may be premature given that so few previous interventions have targeted a potential fundamental barrier to school success: "mismatch" between what schools deliver and the needs of disadvantaged youth who have fallen behind in their academic or non-academic development. This paper reports on a randomized controlled trial of a two-pronged intervention that provides disadvantaged youth with non-academic supports that try to teach youth social-cognitive skills based on the principles of cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), and intensive individualized academic remediation. The study sample consists of 106 male 9th and 10th graders in a public high school on the south side of Chicago, of whom 95% are black and 99% are free or reduced price lunch eligible. Participation increased math test scores by 0.65 of a control group standard deviation (SD) and 0.48 SD in the national distribution, increased math grades by 0.67 SD, and seems to have increased expected graduation rates by 14 percentage points (46%). While some questions remain about the intervention, given these effects and a cost per participant of around $4,400 (with a range of $3,000 to $6,000), this intervention seems to yield larger gains in adolescent outcomes per dollar spent than many other intervention strategies.

10.3386/w19862.abstractZh: 人们越来越担心，提升弱势青少年的学术能力既困难又昂贵，因此政策制定者应该将重点放在针对青少年的职业导向教育上，或者早期儿童教育上。然而，这一结论可能还为时过早，因为迄今为止很少有干预措施针对学校教育内容与弱势青少年需求之间的“不匹配”这一潜在根本障碍。本文报道了一项随机对照试验，该试验采用双管齐下的干预措施，为弱势青少年提供非学术支持，同时尝试根据认知行为疗法原则教授他们社交认知技能，并进行个性化的学术辅导。研究对象为芝加哥南部一所公立高中的106名9年级和10年级男生，其中95%为黑人，99%有资格享受免费或减价午餐。该干预措施使学生的数学测试成绩提高了0.65个对照组标准差，全国范围内提高了0.48个标准差，数学成绩提高了0.67个标准差，并且似乎使预期毕业率提高了14个百分点（46%）。尽管关于该干预措施仍有一些疑问，但鉴于这些效果以及每名参与者的成本约为4,400美元（范围在3,000至6,000美元之间），该干预措施在每投入一美元所能带来的青少年成果上，似乎比其他许多干预策略更为有效。

abstract.text: Background. In 2005, Uruguay instituted a nationwide tobacco control campaign that has resulted in a substantial decline in nationwide smoking rates. We sought to determine the quantitative contributions of each of the major tobacco control measures adopted by the Uruguayan government. We focused sharply on smoking cessation by pregnant women and on the effect of quitting smoking during pregnancy on birth weight. Data. We analyzed a nationwide registry of all pregnancies in Uruguay during 2007-2012, supplemented by data on cigarette prices and various governmental policies. Methods. We estimated linear probability models of quitting smoking in the third trimester as well as linear models of the effect of quitting on birth weight. Our explanatory variables included maternal characteristics, provider-level and national-level policy interventions, and real price. In our models of quitting smoking, we used taxes as an instrument to address price endogeneity. In our models of birth weight, we used tobacco control policies as instruments to address the endogeneity of smoking cessation. Results. During 2007-2012, the proportion of pregnant women who had quit smoking by their third trimester increased markedly from 15 to 42 percent. Each of the major non-price tobacco control measures - including programs to treat nicotine dependence at health centers, banning of advertising nationwide, rotating warnings with pictograms on each pack, restriction of brands to a single presentation, and an increase in the size of pictograms to 80% of the front and back of each pack - was separately associated with a significant increase in the rate of quitting. During 2007-2009, tobacco manufacturers responded to tax increases and non-price policies by moderating their pretax prices. Quitting smoking by the third trimester increased birth weight by an estimated 163 grams. Conclusion. Uruguay's nationwide tobacco control campaign led to a substantial increase in the likelihood that a pregnant smoker would quit by her third trimester. Each of the major tobacco control measures adopted by the government had a measurable impact on the rate of quitting and thus on neonatal health.

10.3386/w19878.abstractZh:
背景。2005年，乌拉圭启动了全国性的烟草控制运动，导致全国吸烟率显著下降。我们旨在确定乌拉圭政府采取的各项主要烟草控制措施对吸烟率的量化影响。我们特别关注孕妇戒烟情况，以及孕期戒烟对出生体重的影响。

数据。我们分析了2007-2012年间乌拉圭所有妊娠案例的全国登记数据，并补充了关于香烟价格和各种政府政策的信息。

方法。我们建立了线性概率模型来估计妊娠第三期戒烟的情况，以及戒烟对出生体重的影响。我们的解释变量包括母亲特征、医疗服务提供者的政策干预以及实际价格。在戒烟模型中，我们使用税收作为工具变量来处理价格内生性问题。在出生体重模型中，我们使用烟草控制政策作为工具变量来处理戒烟内生性问题。

结果。2007-2012年间，妊娠第三期前已戒烟的孕妇比例从15%显著增加到42%。各项主要的非价格烟草控制措施——包括在治疗中心治疗尼古丁依赖症、全国范围内禁止广告、每包烟上轮换警告标志、限制品牌单一呈现，以及将警告标志大小增加到每包前后各占80%——分别显著提高了戒烟率。2007-2009年间，烟草制造商对税收增加和非价格政策作出反应，调整了税前价格。在妊娠第三期戒烟的情况下，婴儿的出生体重预计会增加163克。结论：乌拉圭全国性的烟草控制运动显著提高了孕妇在妊娠第三期戒烟的可能性。政府采取的各项主要烟草控制措施对戒烟率产生了可测量的影响，进而对新生儿健康产生了积极影响。

abstract.text: Job loss in the United States is associated with long-term reductions in income and long-term increases in mortality rates. This paper examines the short- to medium-term changes in health, health care access, and health care utilization after job loss that lead to these long-term effects. Using a sample with more than 9800 individual job losses and longitudinal data on a wide variety of health-related measures and outcomes, we show that job loss results in worse self-reported health, including mental health, but is not associated with statistically significant increases in a variety of specific chronic conditions. Among the full sample of workers, we see reductions in insurance coverage, but little evidence of reductions in health care utilization after job loss. Among the subset of displaced workers for whom the lost job was their primary source of insurance we do see reductions in doctor's visits and prescription drug usage. These results suggest that access to health insurance and care may be an important part of the health effects of job loss for some workers. The pattern of results is also consistent with a significant role for stress in generating long-term health consequences after job loss.

10.3386/w19884.abstractZh: 美国的失业与长期收入减少和死亡率上升有关。本文探讨了失业后短期内健康状况、医疗保健获取情况及医疗利用情况的变化，这些变化导致了这些长期影响。通过研究超过9800起个人失业事件，并结合各种健康相关指标和结果，我们发现失业会导致自我报告的健康状况恶化，包括心理健康问题，但并未导致多种特定慢性疾病的显著增加。在全体工人中，我们观察到保险覆盖范围的减少，但失业后医疗利用情况的减少幅度很小。在那些因失业而失去主要保险来源的失业者中，我们确实看到了医生就诊次数和处方药使用量的减少。这些结果表明，对于某些工人来说，获得医疗保险和医疗服务可能是失业对健康影响的重要因素之一。研究结果还表明，压力在失业后产生长期健康后果中起着重要作用。

abstract.text: Background. In Spain's "MIR" system of allocating residency training positions, medical school graduates are ranked according to their performance on a national exam and then sequentially choose from the remaining available training slots. We studied how changes in the MIR system might address the inadequate supply of practitioners of family and community medicine in that country. Data. Our data included: a registry of the actual residency positions chosen by medical school graduates in the 2012 MIR cycle; a 2012 post-MIR survey in which graduates made counterfactual choices as to what they would have chosen but for their position in the national rankings; and a 2011 survey of the relative importance of specialty attributes among final-year medical students in the same cohort. Methods. We modeled the MIR system as a one-sided matching mechanism based priority rankings, also called "serial dictatorship." Within this model, we developed a framework for evaluating the tradeoff between the efficiency gains from increasing the supply of practitioners of family and community medicine and the equity-related benefits of permitting the most talented medical students to make their specialty choices first. We then applied our framework to real data on medical school graduates' specialty choices during 2012 MIR cycle. Our empirical analysis, based on the multinomial logit model with random coefficients, took account of the endogeneity of choice sets induced by the MIR scheme. We then used the parameter estimates to simulate various alternative public policies, including random ranking of candidates, restrictions on the supply of training positions, and policies designed to upgrade medical school graduates' valuations of a career in family and community medicine. Results: Both random ranking and restrictions in supply resulted in a relatively small efficiency gains from training more productive medical school graduates in family and community medicine, but at the same time a substantial equity losses. Improvements in two key attributes of family and community medicine - professional prestige and the proportion of income from private practice - resulted in substantial gains in both equity and efficiency. Conclusions: Policies designed to increase the prestige and remuneration of practitioners of family and community medicine have the potential to be more efficient and equitable than other alternatives.

10.3386/w19896.abstractZh: 背景。在西班牙的“MIR” residency培训分配系统中，医学院毕业生根据在全国考试中的表现进行排序，然后依次选择剩余的培训名额。我们研究了MIR系统的变化如何解决该国家庭和社区医学领域医生供应不足的问题。数据包括：2012年MIR周期中医学院毕业生实际选择的 residency 名额登记数据；2012年MIR后的调查，其中毕业生模拟了如果不受全国排名限制的话，他们会选择哪些培训名额；以及2011年对同届医学生中专业属性相对重要性的调查。方法。我们将MIR系统建模为一个基于优先排序的单边匹配机制，也称为“串行独裁”。在这个模型中，我们开发了一个框架来评估增加家庭和社区医学领域医生供应所带来的效率提升与允许最有才华的医学生优先选择专业之间的公平性问题。然后，我们将该框架应用于2012年MIR周期中医学院毕业生专业选择的真实数据。我们的实证分析基于带有随机系数的多项式逻辑模型，考虑了由MIR方案引起的选择集内生性问题。接着，我们使用参数估计来模拟各种替代公共政策，包括随机排名候选人、限制培训名额供应以及旨在提升医学院毕业生对家庭和社区医学职业价值的政策。结果：无论是随机排名还是供应限制，都导致通过培训更具生产力的医学院毕业生从事家庭与社区医学工作所带来的效率提升相对较小，但同时也导致了显著的公平损失。家庭与社区医学两个关键属性的改善——专业声望以及从私人执业中获得的收入比例——带来了公平与效率方面的显著提升。结论：旨在提高家庭与社区医学从业者声望和报酬的政策，比其他替代方案更有可能实现更高的效率和公平性。

abstract.text: This paper constructs and estimates a dynamic model of the evolution of health for those over the age of 50 and then embeds that model of health dynamics in a structural, econometric model of retirement and saving. The health model traces the effects of smoking, obesity, alcohol consumption, depression and other proclivities on medical conditions, including hypertension, diabetes, cancer, lung disease, heart problems, stroke, psychiatric problems and arthritis. These in turn influence an overall index of health status based on self-reported health, work limitations and ADLs, which is used to classify the population into good, fair, poor or terrible health. Compared to a situation where the entire population is in good health, the current health status of the population reduces the retirement age of the entire population by an average of about one year. While poor health or terrible health have a great impact on the disutility of work and thus on retirement, fair health as opposed to good health has a relatively minor effect. Smoking depresses full-time work effort by up to 3.5 percentage points by those in the early sixties, reducing the average retirement age by four to five months. Effects of trends in health care and health policies on retirement are also analyzed. Including detailed measurement of health dynamics in a retirement model improves understanding of the effects of health on retirement. It does not, however, influence estimates of the marginal effects of economic incentives on retirement.

10.3386/w19902.abstractZh: 本文构建并估计了一个关于50岁以上人群健康演变的动态模型，并将该健康动态模型嵌入到一个关于退休和储蓄的结构性计量经济模型中。健康模型追踪了吸烟、肥胖、饮酒、抑郁以及其他行为对医疗状况的影响，包括高血压、糖尿病、癌症、肺部疾病、心脏问题、中风、精神问题以及关节炎等。这些因素反过来又影响基于自我报告的健康状况、工作限制以及日常生活活动能力的整体健康指数，该指数用于将人群分为健康良好、一般、不健康或非常不健康三类。与整体人群健康良好的情况相比，当前人群的健康状况会使整个群体的退休年龄平均推迟约一年。虽然健康状况不佳或非常糟糕会对工作满意度产生重大影响，从而影响退休时间，但健康状况一般对退休时间的影响相对较小。吸烟会使60岁出头的人的全职工作积极性降低多达3.5个百分点，从而使平均退休年龄推迟四到五个月。本文还分析了医疗保健和卫生政策趋势对退休时间的影响。在退休模型中包含详细的健康动态测量数据，有助于更好地理解健康对退休时间的影响。然而，这并不会影响对经济激励对退休时间边际效应的估计。

abstract.text: Community rating regulations equalize the insurance premiums faced by the healthy and the unhealthy. Intended reductions in the unhealthy's premiums can be undone, however, if the healthy forgo coverage. The severity of this adverse selection problem hinges largely on how health care costs are distributed across market participants. Theoretically, I show that Medicaid expansions can combat adverse selection by removing high cost individuals from the relevant risk pool. Empirically, I find that private coverage rates improved significantly in community rated markets when states expanded Medicaid's coverage of relatively unhealthy adults. The effects of Medicaid expansions and community rating regulations are fundamentally linked.

10.3386/w19904.abstractZh: 社区评级规定使得健康人群和不健康人群面临的保险费用趋于平等。然而，如果健康人群选择放弃保险覆盖，那么不健康人群原本期望降低的保险费用反而可能不再实现。这种逆向选择问题的严重程度在很大程度上取决于医疗成本在市场参与者之间的分配情况。理论上，我指出，医疗补助计划的扩展可以通过将高成本个体排除在相关风险池之外来对抗逆向选择问题。实证研究表明，当各州扩大医疗补助对相对不健康成年人的覆盖范围时，私人保险覆盖率显著提高。医疗补助计划的扩展与社区评级规定之间存在着本质上的联系。

abstract.text: In this work we combine wage data from Social Security working histories and health information available in the Survey of Health and Retirement in Europe to explore the link between health, financial incentives and retirement in Spain. Our results show that individuals in worse health quintiles are, indeed, the more responsive to financial incentives as they prove to be less likely to retire when incentives to continue working increase.

10.3386/w19913.abstractZh: 在这项研究中，我们结合了社会保障工作历史中的工资数据以及欧洲健康与退休调查中的健康信息，来探讨西班牙健康、经济激励与退休之间的关系。研究结果表明，健康状况较差的人群确实对经济激励更为敏感，因为当继续工作的激励增加时，他们更不愿意退休。

abstract.text: We propose a new method for using validation data to correct self-reported weight and height in surveys that do not measure respondents. The standard correction in prior research regresses actual measures on reported values using an external validation dataset, and then uses the estimated coefficients to predict actual measures in the primary dataset. This approach requires the strong assumption that the expectations of measured weight and height conditional on the reported values are the same in both datasets. In contrast, we use percentile ranks rather than levels of reported weight and height. Our approach requires the weaker assumption that the conditional expectations of actual measures are increasing in reported values in both samples. This makes our correction more robust to differences in measurement error across surveys as long as both surveys represent the same population. We examine three nationally representative datasets and find that misreporting appears to be sensitive to differences in survey context. When we compare predicted BMI distributions using the two validation approaches, we find that the standard correction is affected by differences in misreporting while our correction is not. Finally, we present several examples that demonstrate the potential importance of our correction for future econometric analyses and estimates of obesity rates.

10.3386/w19928.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种新方法，利用验证数据来修正那些未测量受访者的体重和身高的调查中的自我报告数据。以往的研究中，标准的修正方法是通过外部验证数据集将实际测量数据与报告值进行回归分析，然后使用估计的系数来预测主要数据集中的实际测量数据。这种方法需要一个强假设，即基于报告值的条件下的体重和身高期望在两个数据集中是相同的。相比之下，我们采用百分位数等级而不是报告体重和身高的具体数值。我们的方法需要一个较弱的假设，即两个样本中的实际测量数据的条件期望随着报告值的增加而增加。这使得我们的修正方法更能抵抗不同调查中的测量误差差异，只要两个调查所代表的人群是相同的。我们检验了三个具有全国代表性的数据集，发现误报似乎对调查环境的差异很敏感。当我们使用这两种验证方法比较预测的BMI分布时，我们发现标准修正方法受到误报差异的影响，而我们的修正方法则不受影响。最后，我们提供了几个例子，说明我们的修正方法对未来计量经济学分析和肥胖率估计的潜在重要性。

abstract.text: Little is known about whether breastfeeding may prevent disabilities throughout childhood. We evaluate the effects of breastfeeding on child disability using data from the National Survey of Family Growth merged to the National Health Interview Survey for a large nationally representative sample of children aged 1 to 18 years from the U.S. including over 3,000 siblings who are discordant on breastfeeding status/duration. We focus on a mother fixed effect model that compares siblings in order to account for family-level unobservable confounders and employ multiple specifications including a dynamic model that accounts for disability status of the prior child. Breastfeeding the child for a longer duration is associated with a lower risk of child disability, by about 0.2 percentage-points per month of breastfeeding. This effect is only observed on the intensive margin among breastfed children, as any breastfeeding has no effect on the extensive margin. We conclude that very short breastfeeding durations are unlikely to have an effect on reducing disability risk.

10.3386/w19940.abstractZh: 关于母乳喂养是否能预防儿童时期的残疾，目前了解甚少。我们利用《全国家庭成长调查》与《全国健康访谈调查》的数据，对母乳喂养对儿童残疾的影响进行了评估。该研究涵盖了美国1至18岁儿童的全国代表性样本，涉及超过3,000名在母乳喂养时间和持续时间上存在差异的兄弟姐妹。我们采用了一个固定效应模型来比较兄弟姐妹之间的差异，以考虑家庭层面的不可观测混杂因素，并采用了多种模型设定，包括一个动态模型，以考虑前胎的残疾状况。研究发现，母乳喂养时间越长，儿童残疾的风险越低，每月母乳喂养时间每增加0.2个百分点，残疾风险就降低约0.2个百分点。这一效应仅在母乳喂养儿童中观察到，因为任何母乳喂养对广泛残疾风险都没有影响。我们得出结论，非常短的母乳喂养时间不太可能降低残疾风险。

abstract.text: We study the effect of outdoor air pollution on the productivity of indoor workers at a pear-packing factory. We focus on fine particulate matter (PM2.5), a harmful pollutant that easily penetrates indoor settings. We find that an increase in PM2.5 outdoors leads to a statistically and economically significant decrease in packing speeds inside the factory, with effects arising at levels well below current air quality standards. In contrast, we find little effect of PM2.5 on hours worked or the decision to work, and little effect of pollutants that do not travel indoors, such as ozone. This effect of outdoor pollution on the productivity of indoor workers suggests a thus far overlooked consequence of pollution. Back-of-the-envelope calculations suggest that nationwide reductions in PM2.5 from 1999 to 2008 generated $19.5 billion in labor cost savings, which is roughly one-third of the total welfare benefits associated with this change.

10.3386/w19944.abstractZh: 我们研究了室外空气污染对包装工厂内工人生产效率的影响。重点关注细颗粒物（PM2.5），这是一种容易进入室内环境的有害污染物。研究发现，室外PM2.5浓度的增加会导致工厂内包装速度出现统计学上和经济上显著的下降，且这种影响在远低于当前空气质量标准的水平下就已经显现。相比之下，PM2.5对工作时间或工作意愿的影响较小，对于不进入室内的污染物，如臭氧，其影响同样较小。室外污染对室内工人生产效率的影响表明，污染还存在一个被忽视的后果。初步计算显示，1999年至2008年间，全国范围内PM2.5浓度的降低为经济带来了195亿美元的成本节约，这一节约金额大约相当于该变化所带来的总福利收益的三分之一。

abstract.text: We examine whether obtaining prescription drug insurance through the Medicare Part D program affected hospital admissions, expenditures associated with those admissions, and mortality. We use a large, geographically diverse sample of Medicare beneficiaries and exploit the natural experiment of Medicare Part D to obtain estimates of the effect of prescription drug insurance on hospitalizations and mortality. Results indicate that obtaining prescription drug insurance through Medicare Part D was associated with an 8% decrease in the number of hospital admissions, a 7% decrease in Medicare expenditures, and a 12% decrease in total resource use. Gaining prescription drug insurance through Medicare Part D was not significantly associated with mortality.

10.3386/w19948.abstractZh: 我们研究了通过Medicare Part D计划获得处方药保险是否会影响医院住院次数、与这些住院相关的支出以及死亡率。我们使用了一个规模庞大且地理分布广泛的Medicare受益人样本，并利用Medicare Part D的自然实验来估算处方药保险对住院次数和死亡率的影响。结果表明，通过Medicare Part D获得处方药保险与住院次数减少8%、Medicare支出减少7%以及总资源使用减少12%相关。而通过Medicare Part D获得处方药保险与死亡率之间没有显著关联。

abstract.text: We estimate the current impact of Medicare on medical expenditure risk and financial strain. At age 65, out-of-pocket expenditures drop by 33% at the mean and 53% among the top 5% of spenders. The fraction of the population with out- of-pocket medical expenditures above income drops by more than half. Medical- related financial strain, such as problems paying bills, is dramatically reduced. Using a stylized expected utility framework, the gain from reducing out-of-pocket expenditures alone accounts for 18% of the social costs of financing Medicare. This calculation ignores the benefits of reduced financial strain and direct health improvements due to Medicare.

10.3386/w19954.abstractZh: 我们估算了医疗保险对医疗支出风险和财务压力的当前影响。在65岁时，自付支出平均减少了33%，在支出最高的5%人群中这一比例达到了53%。自付医疗支出超过收入的人口比例减少了超过一半。与医疗相关的财务压力，如支付账单的问题，也显著减少。利用预期效用框架进行计算，仅减少自付支出所带来的收益就占医疗保险融资社会成本的18%。这一计算忽略了因医疗保险而减少财务压力以及直接改善健康状况所带来的好处。

abstract.text: We develop a model of the efficiency of medical testing based on rates of negative CT scans for pulmonary embolism. The model is estimated using a 20% sample of Medicare claims from 2000- 2009. We document enormous across-doctor heterogeneity in testing decisions conditional on patient risk and show it explains the negative relationship between physicians' testing frequencies and test yields. Physicians in high spending regions test more low-risk patients. Under calibration assumptions, 84% of doctors test even when costs exceed expected benefits. Furthermore, doctors do not apply observables to target testing to the highest risk patients, substantially reducing simulated test yields.

10.3386/w19956.abstractZh: 我们基于肺栓塞CT扫描阴性的发生率，开发了一个医学检测效率模型。该模型基于2000至2009年间Medicare索赔数据的20%样本进行估计。我们发现，在患者风险条件下，不同医生在检测决策上存在巨大差异，这一差异解释了医生检测频率与检测效果之间的负相关关系。在支出较高的地区，医生更倾向于对低风险患者进行检测。在校准假设下，84%的医生即使在成本超过预期收益的情况下仍会进行检测。此外，医生并未将可观测指标应用于对高风险患者的检测，这大大降低了模拟检测效果。

abstract.text: Large differences in fertility between women with high and low levels of education suggest that schooling may have a direct impact on knowledge and use of contraception. We investigate this issue using information on women in Mexico. In order to identify the causal effect of schooling, we exploit temporal and geographic variation in the number of lower secondary schools built following the extension of compulsory education in Mexico from 6th to 9th grade in 1993. We show that raising females' schooling beyond 6th grade increases their knowledge of contraception during their reproductive years and increases their propensity to use contraception at sexual debut. This indicates that the impact of schooling on women's wellbeing extends beyond improved labor market outcomes and includes greater autonomy over their fertility.
