10.3386/w19961.abstractZh: 教育程度高低不同的女性之间在生育率上存在显著差异，这表明教育可能对避孕知识的掌握和使用有直接影响。我们利用墨西哥女性的数据来研究这一问题。为了确定教育的因果效应，我们分析了1993年墨西哥义务教育从6年级扩展到9年级后，各级中等学校数量的时间和地理变化。研究发现，让女性接受超过6年级的教育，能够提升她们在生育期间的避孕知识水平，并增加她们在首次性行为时选择避孕措施的倾向。这表明，教育对女性福祉的影响不仅限于改善劳动力市场状况，还包括增强她们对生育的自主权。

abstract.text: This paper develops and estimates a model with multiple schooling choices that identifies the causal effect of different levels of schooling on health, health-related behaviors, and labor market outcomes. We develop an approach that is a halfway house between a reduced form treatment effect model and a fully formulated dynamic discrete choice model. It is computationally tractable and identifies the causal effects of educational choices at different margins. We estimate distributions of responses to education and find evidence for substantial heterogeneity in unobserved variables on which agents make choices. The estimated treatment effects of education are decomposed into the direct benefits of attaining a given level of schooling and indirect benefits from the option to continue on to further schooling. Continuation values are an important component of our estimated treatment effects. While the estimated causal effects of education are substantial for most outcomes, we also estimate a quantitatively important effect of unobservables on outcomes. Both cognitive and socioemotional factors contribute to shaping educational choices and labor market and health outcomes. We improve on LATE by identifying the groups affected by variations in the instruments. We find benefits of cognition on most outcomes apart from its effect on schooling attainment. The benefits of socioemotional skills on outcomes beyond their effects on schooling attainment are less precisely estimated.

10.3386/w19971.abstractZh: 本文开发并估计了一个包含多种教育选择模型的框架，用以识别不同教育水平对健康、健康相关行为以及劳动力市场结果的影响。我们提出了一种介于简化形式的处理效应模型和完全制定的动态离散选择模型之间的方法。该模型在计算上可行，能够识别不同边际上教育选择的因果效应。我们对教育响应的分布进行了估计，并发现未观测变量在代理人选择过程中存在显著的异质性。教育处理的估计效应被分解为获得特定教育水平的直接收益以及继续接受更高层次教育的间接收益。继续教育的价值是我们估计处理效应中的一个重要组成部分。虽然教育对大多数结果的因果效应是显著的，但我们也估计到未观测变量对结果有重要的定量影响。认知和社会情感因素都对教育选择以及劳动力市场和健康结果的形成起着重要作用。我们通过识别受工具变量变化影响的群体，改进了LATE模型。我们发现认知对大多数结果都有积极影响，除了其对教育成就的影响之外。社会情感技能对结果的积极影响虽然难以精确估计，但同样对结果有积极影响。

abstract.text: Governments contract with private firms to provide a wide range of services. While a large body of previous work has estimated the effects of that contracting, surprisingly little has investigated how those effects vary with the generosity of the contract. In this paper we examine this issue in the Medicare Advantage (MA) program, through which the federal government contracts with private insurers to coordinate and finance health care for more than 15 million Medicare recipients. To do this, we exploit a substantial policy-induced increase in MA reimbursement in metropolitan areas with a population of 250 thousand or more relative to MSAs just below this threshold. Our results demonstrate that the additional reimbursement leads more private firms to enter this market and to an increase in the share of Medicare recipients enrolled in MA plans. Our findings also reveal that only about one-fifth of the additional reimbursement is passed through to consumers in the form of better coverage. A somewhat larger share accrues to private insurers in the form of higher profits and we find suggestive evidence of a large impact on advertising expenditures. Our results have implications for a key feature of the Affordable Care Act that will reduce reimbursement to MA plans by $156 billion from 2013 to 2022.

10.3386/w19989.abstractZh: 政府与私人企业合作，提供各种服务。虽然之前有大量研究评估了这种合作的影响，但令人惊讶的是，很少有研究探讨这些影响如何随着合同条件的不同而发生变化。本文通过研究Medicare Advantage计划来探讨这一问题。该计划由联邦政府与私人保险公司合作，为超过1500万Medicare受益人协调和提供医疗保健服务。研究发现，在人口达到25万或以上的大都市地区，与低于这一门槛的小都市相比，政策导致的Medicare Advantage报销金额显著增加。研究结果表明，额外的报销金额促使更多私人企业进入这一市场，并增加了参加Medicare Advantage计划的受益人数量。此外，研究发现，仅有约五分之一的额外报销金额以更好的服务形式传递给消费者，而更大的一部分则转化为私人保险公司的利润，并且有证据表明这对广告支出产生了显著影响。这些研究结果对于《平价医疗法案》的一个关键特征具有启示意义，该法案将在2013年至2022年间将Medicare Advantage计划的报销金额减少1560亿美元。

abstract.text: It has been long recognized that cash plays a critical role in fueling street crime due to its liquidity and transactional anonymity. In poor neighborhoods where street offenses are concentrated, a significant source of circulating cash stems from public assistance or welfare payments. In the 1990s, the Federal government mandated individual states to convert the delivery of their welfare benefits from paper checks to an Electronic Benefit Transfer (EBT) system, whereby recipients received and expended their funds through debit cards. In this paper, we examine whether the reduction in the circulation of cash on the streets associated with EBT implementation had an effect on crime. To address this question, we exploit the variation in the timing of the EBT implementation across Missouri counties. Our results indicate that the EBT program had a negative and significant effect on the overall crime rate as well as burglary, assault, and larceny. According to our point estimates, the overall crime rate decreased by 9.8 percent in response to the EBT program. We also find a negative effect on arrests, especially those associated with non-drug offenses. EBT implementation had no effect on rape, a crime that is unlikely to be motivated by the acquisition of cash. Interestingly, the significant drop in crime in the United States over several decades has coincided with a period of steady decline in the proportion of financial transactions involving cash. In that sense, our findings serve as a fresh contribution to the important debate surrounding the factors underpinning the great American crime decline.

10.3386/w19996.abstractZh: 长期以来，人们已经认识到现金在助长街头犯罪方面起着关键作用，这得益于其流动性和交易的无形性。在街头犯罪较为集中的贫困社区，流通中的现金主要来源于公共援助或福利支付。20世纪90年代，联邦政府要求各州将福利金的支付方式从纸质支票改为电子福利转账系统，受益人通过借记卡接收和支出资金。本文探讨了与电子福利转账实施相关的现金流通减少是否对犯罪产生了影响。为了解答这个问题，我们利用了密苏里州各县电子福利转账实施时间的差异。研究结果表明，电子福利转账计划对整体犯罪率以及入室盗窃、袭击和盗窃犯罪产生了显著的负面影响。根据我们的点估计，由于电子福利转账计划的实施，整体犯罪率下降了9.8%。我们还发现，该计划对逮捕数量产生了负面影响，尤其是与非毒品犯罪相关的逮捕。电子福利转账的实施对强奸犯罪没有影响，因为强奸犯罪不太可能是由现金获取所驱动的。有趣的是，美国几十年来犯罪率的显著下降与涉及现金的金融交易比例稳步下降的时期相吻合。从这个意义上说，我们的研究结果为关于美国犯罪率下降背后因素的重要讨论提供了新的见解。

abstract.text: This paper develops and implements a statistical methodology to account for the equilibrium effects (aka adverse selection) in design of risk adjustment formula in health insurance markets. Our setting is modeled on the situation in Medicare and the new state Exchanges where individuals sort themselves between a discrete set of plan types (here, two). Our "Silver" and "Gold" plans have fixed characteristics, as in the well-known research on selection and efficiency by Einav and Finkelstein (EF). We build on the EF model in several respects, including by showing that risk adjustment can be used to achieve the premiums that will lead to efficient sorting. The target risk adjustment weights can be found by use of constrained regressions, where the constraints in the estimation are conditions on premiums that should be satisfied in equilibrium. We illustrate implementation of the method with data from seven years of the Medical Expenditure Panel Survey.

10.3386/w19998.abstractZh: 本文开发并实施了一种统计方法，用于解释健康保险市场风险调整公式设计中存在的均衡效应（即逆向选择问题）。我们的模型基于Medicare和新州交易所的情况，其中个体在两种计划类型之间选择。我们的“银牌”和“金牌”计划具有固定的特征，这与Einav和Finkelstein关于选择和效率的研究结果一致。我们在多个方面借鉴了EF模型，包括证明风险调整可以用来实现能够引导有效选择的保费。目标风险调整权重可以通过约束回归法来确定，其中估计中的约束条件是指均衡状态下应满足的保费条件。我们通过七年医疗支出调查的数据来说明该方法的实施效果。

abstract.text: In a complex economy, production is vertical and crosses jurisdictional lines. Goods are often produced by a global or national firm upstream and improved or distributed by local firms downstream. In this context, heightened products liability may have unintended consequences for consumer safety. Conventional wisdom holds that an increase in tort liability on the upstream firm will encourage that firm to improve safety for consumers. However, in the real-world, policy actions in a single jurisdiction may not be significant enough to influence the behavior of an upstream firm that produces for many jurisdictions. Even worse, if liability is shared between upstream and downstream firms, higher upstream liability may decrease the liability of the downstream distributor and encourage it to behave more recklessly. In this manner, higher upstream liability may perversely increase the sales of a risky good. We demonstrate this phenomenon in the context of the pharmaceutical market. We show that higher products liability on upstream pharmaceutical manufacturers reduces the liability faced by downstream doctors, who respond by prescribing more drugs than before.

10.3386/w20005.abstractZh: 在复杂的经济体系中，生产是垂直的，并且跨越了不同的管辖范围。商品通常由全球性或国家级企业在上游环节生产，然后由本地企业负责改进或分销。在这种情况下，产品责任的增加可能会对消费者安全产生意想不到的影响。传统观点认为，增加上游企业的侵权责任会促使这些企业提高消费者的安全水平。然而，在现实世界中，单一司法管辖区的政策行动可能不足以影响为多个司法管辖区生产产品的上游企业的行为。更糟糕的是，如果侵权责任由上游和下游企业共同承担，那么较高的上游侵权责任可能会降低下游分销商的责任，从而促使后者更加鲁莽地行事。这样一来，较高的上游侵权责任可能会反过来增加高风险产品的销量。我们在制药市场的背景下证明了这一现象。我们发现，上游制药企业较高的产品责任会降低下游医生所面临的责任，而下游医生则会因此开出更多的药物。

abstract.text: We examine the impact of loss of U.S. patent exclusivity (LOE) on the prices and utilization of specialty drugs between 2001 and 2007. We limit our empirical cohort to drugs commonly used to treat cancer and base our analyses on nationally representative data from IMS Health. We begin by describing the average number of manufacturers entering specialty drugs following LOE. We observe the number of manufacturers entering the production of newly generic specialty drugs ranges between two and five per molecule in the years following LOE, which is generally less than that observed historically for non-specialty drugs. However, the existence of time-varying and unobservable contract manufacturing practices complicates the definition of "manufacturers" entering this market. We use pooled time series methods to examine whether the neoclassical relationship between price declines and volume increases upon LOE holds among these drugs. First, we examine the extent to which estimated prices of these drug undergoing LOE fall with generic entry. Second, we estimate reduced form random effects models of utilization subsequent to LOE. We observe substantial price erosion after generic entry; average monthly price declines appear to be larger among physician-administered drugs (38-46.4%) compared to oral drugs (25-26%). Additionally, we find average prices for drugs produced by branded manufacturers rise and prices for drugs produced by generic manufacturers fall upon LOE. The latter effect is particularly large among oral drugs. In pooled models, volume appears to increase following generic entry, but this result appears to be largely driven by oral drugs. We discuss second-best welfare consequences of these results.

10.3386/w20016.abstractZh: 我们研究了美国专利独占权丧失对2001年至2007年间特殊药品价格和使用情况的影响。我们的实证样本仅限于常用于治疗癌症的药品，分析数据来源于IMS Health的全国代表性数据。首先，我们描述了在专利独占权丧失后进入特殊药品市场的制造商数量。观察到在专利独占权丧失后的几年里，每种类药品有2到5家制造商进入新仿制特殊药品的生产领域，这一数量通常低于非特殊药品的历史水平。然而，由于合同制造实践的时变性和不可观测性，对“制造商”的定义变得复杂。我们使用汇总时间序列方法来检验新古典理论中关于专利独占权丧失后药品价格下降与销量上升之间的关系是否适用于这些药品。首先，我们考察了在专利独占权丧失后，这些药品的价格下降程度以及仿制药进入市场后的销量变化。其次，我们建立了关于专利独占权丧失后药品使用的简化随机效应模型。研究发现，在仿制药进入市场后，药品价格出现了显著下降；与口服药物相比，医生使用的药品平均每月价格下降幅度更大，为38-46.4%，而口服药物的价格下降幅度为25-26%。此外，我们发现，在专利独占权丧失后，由品牌制造商生产的药品价格上升，而由仿制药制造商生产的药品价格下降，这一效应在口服药物中尤为明显。在汇总模型中，仿制药进入市场后销量似乎有所增加，但这一结果主要由口服药物驱动。我们还讨论了这些结果带来的次优福利后果。

abstract.text: To test how practice interruptions affect worker productivity, we estimate how temporal breaks affect surgeons' performance of coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG). Using a sample of 188 surgeons who performed 56,315 CABG procedures in Pennsylvania between 2006 and 2010, we find that a surgeon's additional day away from the operating room raised patients' inpatient mortality risk by up to 0.067 percentage points (2.4% relative effect) but reduced total hospitalization costs by up to 0.59 percentage points. In analyses of 93 high-volume surgeons treating 9,853 patients admitted via an emergency department, where temporal distance effects are most plausibly exogenous, an additional day away raised mortality risk by 0.398 percentage points (11.4% relative effect) but reduced cost by up to 1.396 percentage points. These estimates imply a cost per life-year saved ranging from $7,871 to $18,500, rendering additional treatment intensity within surgery cost-effective at conventional cutoffs. Our findings are consistent with the hypothesis that after returning from temporal breaks surgeons may be less likely to recognize and address life-threatening complications, in turn reducing resource use. This form of human capital loss would explain the decrease in worker productivity and the simultaneous reduction in input use.

10.3386/w20017.abstractZh: 为了测试实践中断如何影响工人生产力，我们研究了时间中断对外科医生进行冠状动脉旁路移植手术（CABG）表现的影响。我们选取了2006年至2010年间在宾夕法尼亚州进行56,315例CABG手术的188名外科医生作为样本。研究发现，外科医生从手术室离开一天，患者的住院死亡风险会增加0.067个百分点（相对效应为2.4%），但总住院成本则降低0.59个百分点。在对93名高手术量外科医生进行的研究中，这些医生处理了9,853名通过急诊部门入院的患者。在这种情况下，时间距离效应被认为是最外生的因素。研究发现，外科医生离开一天会导致死亡风险增加0.398个百分点（相对效应为11.4%），但成本降低幅度可达1.396个百分点。这些估计表明，每节省一年的生命，成本从7,871美元到18,500美元不等，因此在常规标准下，增加治疗强度是具有成本效益的。我们的研究结果与以下假设一致：从时间中断中恢复后，外科医生可能不太容易识别和处理危及生命的并发症，从而减少了资源的使用。这种形式的人力资本损失可以解释工人生产力的下降以及投入使用的同时减少。

abstract.text: Under the Affordable Care Act, between six and eleven million workers would increase their disposable income by cutting their weekly work hours. About half of them would primarily do so by making themselves eligible for the ACA's federal assistance with health insurance premiums and out-of-pocket health costs, despite the fact that subsidized workers are not able to pay health premiums with pre-tax dollars. The remainder would do so primarily by relieving their employers from penalties, or the threat of penalties, pursuant to the ACA's employer mandate. Women, especially those who are not married, are more likely than men to have their short-term financial reward to full-time work eliminated by the ACA. Additional workers, beyond the six to eleven million, could increase their disposable income by using reduced hours to climb one of the "cliffs" that are part of the ACA's mapping from household income to federal assistance.

10.3386/w20020.abstractZh: 根据《平价医疗法案》，有600万到1100万工人通过减少每周工作时间来增加可支配收入。其中约一半的工人主要是通过获得《平价医疗法案》提供的联邦健康保险补贴和自付医疗费用补助来实现这一目的，尽管这些受补贴的工人无法用税前资金来支付健康保险费用。其余的工人则主要是通过免除雇主的罚款或减轻罚款威胁来实现这一目的，这是《平价医疗法案》规定的雇主义务的一部分。女性，尤其是未婚女性，比男性更容易因《平价医疗法案》而失去长期工作的经济回报。除了这600万到1100万工人之外，还有更多的工人可以通过减少工作时间来跨越《平价医疗法案》规定的从家庭收入到联邦援助的“悬崖”，从而增加可支配收入。

abstract.text: There are two types of selection models in the health economics literature. One focuses on choice between a fixed set of contracts. Consumers with greater demand for medical care services prefer contracts with more generous reimbursement, resulting in a suboptimal proportion of consumers in such contracts in equilibrium. In extreme cases more generous contracts may disappear (the "death spiral"). In the other model insurers tailor the contracts they offer consumers to attract profitable consumers. An equilibrium may or may not exist in such models, but if it exists it is not first best. The Medicare Advantage program offers an opportunity to study these models empirically, although unlike the models in the economics literature there is a regulator with various tools to address selection. One such tool is risk adjustment, or making budget neutral transfers among insurers using observable characteristics of enrollees that predict spending. Medicare drastically changed its risk adjustment program starting in 2004 and made a number of other changes to reduce selection as well. Previous work has argued that the changes worsened selection. We show, using a much larger data set, that this was not the case, but that some inherent selection may remain.

10.3386/w20021.abstractZh: 在健康经济学文献中，存在两种类型的选择模型。一种模型关注于在固定的一组合同中做出选择。对医疗服务需求较高的消费者更倾向于选择报销金额较高的合同，这会导致在均衡状态下这类合同的消费者比例低于最优水平。在极端情况下，较为优厚的合同可能会消失（即“死亡螺旋”现象）。另一种模型则要求保险公司根据消费者的需求定制合同以吸引盈利客户。这类模型中的均衡可能存在，也可能不存在，但如果存在均衡，那也不是最优解。Medicare Advantage计划为实证研究这些模型提供了机会，不过与经济学文献中的模型不同，该计划有监管机构可以使用各种工具来应对选择问题。其中一种工具就是风险调整，即通过利用可观测的特征来预测支出，在保险公司之间进行预算中立的转移支付。自2004年起，Medicare对其风险调整计划进行了重大改革，并进行了其他多项改革以减少选择问题。先前的研究认为这些改革加剧了选择问题。我们通过更大的数据集发现，情况并非如此，但仍然存在一定的选择问题。

abstract.text: Accountable Care Organizations (ACOs) are new organizations created by the Affordable Care Act to encourage more efficient, integrated care delivery. To promote efficiency, ACOs sign contracts under which they keep a fraction of the savings from keeping costs below target provided they also maintain quality levels. To promote integration and facilitate measurement, ACOs are required to have at least 5,000 enrollees and so must coordinate across many providers. We calibrate a model of optimal ACO incentives using proprietary performance measures from a large insurer. Our key finding is that free-riding is a severe problem and causes optimal incentive payments to exceed cost savings unless ACOs simultaneously achieve extremely large efficiency gains. This implies that successful ACOs will likely rely on motivational strategies that amplify the effects of under-powered incentives. These motivational strategies raise important questions about the limits of ACOs as a policy for promoting more efficient, integrated care.

10.3386/w20034.abstractZh: 可问责护理组织（ACOs）是根据《平价医疗法案》设立的新组织，旨在促进更高效、更整合的医疗服务提供。为了提升效率，ACOs需签订合同，在将成本控制在目标范围内时，仅保留部分节省下来的费用，同时仍需保持服务质量。为了促进整合并促进评估，ACOs必须拥有至少5,000名患者，因此必须协调多个医疗服务提供者。我们基于一家大型保险公司的专有绩效指标，对最优ACO激励机制进行了建模。我们的主要发现是，搭便车行为是一个严重的问题，除非ACOs同时实现巨大的效率提升，否则最优激励支付将超过成本节省。这意味着成功的ACOs可能会依赖能够放大弱激励效果的激励策略。这些激励策略引发了关于ACO作为促进更高效、更整合医疗服务的政策所面临的限制的重要问题。

abstract.text: Doctors and hospitals in the United States serve patients covered by many types of insurance. This overlap in the supply of health care services means that changes in the prices paid or the volume of services demanded by one group of patients may affect other patient groups. This paper examines how marginal shifts in the demand for services among the adult population under 65 (specifically, factors that affect the uninsurance rate) affect use in the Medicare population. I provide a simple theoretical framework for understanding how changes in the demand for care among adults under 65 may affect Medicare spending. I then examine how two demand factors-recent coverage eligibility changes for parents and the firm size composition of employment-affect insurance coverage among adults under 65 and how these factors affect per beneficiary Medicare spending. Factors that contribute to reductions in uninsurance rates are associated with contemporaneous decreases in per beneficiary Medicare spending, particularly in high variation Medicare services. Reductions in the demand for medical services among adults below age 65 are not associated with reductions in the total quantity of physician services supplied. The increased Medicare utilization that accompanies lower demand among those under 65 has few, if any, benefits for Medicare patients.

10.3386/w20045.abstractZh: 美国的医生和医院为多种保险覆盖的患者提供服务。这种医疗服务供应的重叠意味着，某一类患者支付的价格或服务需求量的变化可能会影响其他患者群体。本文探讨了65岁以下成年人中对服务需求的边际变化（特别是影响未参保率的因素）如何影响Medicare参保人群的使用情况。我提供了一个简单的理论框架，以理解65岁以下成年人中对护理需求的变化如何影响Medicare的支出。接着，我研究了两个需求因素——父母最近获得保险资格的变化以及就业结构的公司规模——如何影响65岁以下成年人的保险覆盖情况，以及这些因素如何影响每位受益人的Medicare支出。导致未参保率下降的因素通常与每位受益人的Medicare支出减少相关，尤其是在Medicare服务需求波动较大的情况下。65岁以下成年人中对医疗服务需求的减少与医生服务总量的减少无关。65岁以下人群需求下降所带来的Medicare使用增加，对Medicare患者几乎没有好处。

abstract.text: A large and growing number of adults are covered by public insurance, and the Affordable Care Act is predicted to dramatically increase public coverage over the next several years. This study evaluates how such large increases in public coverage affect provider behavior and patient wait times by analyzing a common type of primary care: dental services. We find that when states add dental benefit to adult Medicaid coverage, dentists' participation in Medicaid increases and dentists see more publicly insured patients without decreasing the number of visits provided to privately insured patients. Dentists increase the total number of visits they supply each week while only modestly increasing the amount of time they spend working. They achieve this primarily by making greater use of dental hygienists. As a result, dentists' income increases. Wait times increase modestly, with the largest increases in wait times observed in states with restrictive scope of practice laws governing dental hygienists. These changes are most pronounced among dentists who practice in poor areas where Medicaid coverage is greatest.

10.3386/w20053.abstractZh: 越来越多的成年人享有公共保险，预计《平价医疗法案》将在未来几年内大幅扩大公共保险覆盖范围。本研究通过分析一种常见的初级医疗服务——牙科服务，来评估公共保险覆盖范围的扩大对医疗服务提供者行为以及患者等待时间的影响。研究发现，当各州将牙科服务纳入成人医疗补助覆盖范围时，牙医参与医疗补助的比例增加，同时接受公共保险服务的患者数量增加，而向私人保险客户提供的服务数量并未减少。牙医每周提供的服务次数增加，但工作时间的增加幅度较小。他们主要通过更多地利用牙科保健员来实现这一目标。因此，牙医的收入有所增加，但患者等待时间略有增加，尤其是在那些对牙科保健员执业范围有严格限制的法律实施较多的州，这种影响更为明显。这些变化在那些医疗补助覆盖范围最广泛的贫困地区的牙医中最为显著。

abstract.text: The fear and hatred of others who are different has economic consequences because such feelings are likely to translate into discrimination in labor, credit, housing, and other markets. The implications range from earnings inequality to intergenerational mobility. Using German data from various years between 1996 and 2010, we analyze the determinants of racist and xenophobic feelings towards foreigners in general, and against specific groups such as Italians and Turks. We also analyze racist and anti-Semitic feelings towards German citizens who differ in ethnicity (Aussiedler from Eastern Europe) or in religion (German Jews). Individuals' perceived (or actual) economic well-being is negatively related to the strength of these feelings. Education, and having contact with foreigners mitigate racist, anti-Semitic and xenophobic feelings. People who live in states which had provided above-median support of the Nazi party in the 1928 elections have stronger anti-Semitic feelings today. The results are not gender-driven. They are not an artifact of economic conditions triggering feelings about job priority for German males, and they are not fully driven by fears about foreigners taking away jobs. The results of the paper are consistent with the model of Glaeser (2005) on hate, and with that of Akerlof and Kranton (2000, 2005) on identity in the utility function.

10.3386/w20059.abstractZh: 对异己的恐惧和憎恨会产生经济后果，因为这些情绪很可能转化为劳动力、信贷、住房及其他市场的歧视行为。其影响范围涵盖收入不平等到代际流动性等方面。本研究利用1996年至2010年间的德国数据，分析了针对外国人的种族主义和仇外情绪的决定因素，同时探讨了针对特定群体（如意大利人和土耳其人）的情绪变化。我们还分析了针对具有不同种族背景（如来自东欧的德国移民）或宗教背景（如德国犹太人）的德国公民的种族主义和反犹太情绪。个体感知到的（或实际存在的）经济福祉与这些情绪的强度呈负相关。教育程度以及与外国人接触可以降低种族主义、反犹太主义和仇外情绪。在1928年选举中纳粹党获得超过平均水平支持的国家，如今其民众的反犹太情绪更为强烈。这些结果并非由性别因素驱动，也不是经济条件引发德国男性对就业优先权的考虑，更不是完全由对外国人抢走工作的担忧所驱动。本文的研究结果与Glaeser（2005）关于仇恨的模型以及Akerlof和Kranton（2000、2005）关于效用函数中身份认同的模型相一致。

abstract.text: We provide a theoretical and empirical analysis of the link between financial and real health care markets. This link is important as financial returns drive investment in medical research and development (R&D), which in turn, affects real spending growth. We document a “medical innovation premium” of 4-6% annually for equity returns of firms in the health care sector. We interpret this premium as compensating investors for government-induced profit risk, and we provide supportive evidence for this hypothesis through company filings and abnormal return patterns surrounding threats of government intervention. We quantify the implications of the premium for the growth in real health care spending by calibrating our model to match historical trends, predicting the share of GDP devoted to health care to be 32% in the long run. Policies that had removed government risk would have led to more than a doubling of medical R&D and would have increased the current share of health care spending by more than 3% of GDP.

10.3386/w20075.abstractZh: 我们提供了关于金融与实体医疗保健市场之间联系的理论与实证分析。这种联系非常重要，因为金融回报驱动了医疗研究与开发的投资，而后者又影响着实体支出的增长。我们发现，医疗保健行业上市公司的股权回报每年可获得4-6%的“医疗创新溢价”。我们将这一溢价解释为对投资者因政府干预带来的利润风险所做出的补偿，并通过公司公告以及政府干预威胁相关的异常回报模式为这一假设提供了支持性证据。我们通过校准模型以匹配历史趋势，预测长期内医疗保健支出占GDP的比例将达到32%。如果消除了政府风险的政策得以实施，医疗研究与开发的投资将增加一倍以上，而当前医疗保健支出占GDP的比例也将增加超过3%。

abstract.text: 21 states and the District of Columbia currently have laws that permit marijuana use for medical purposes, often termed medical marijuana laws (MMLs). We tested the effects of MMLs adopted in seven states between 2004 and 2011 on adolescent and adult marijuana, alcohol, and hard drug use. We employed a restricted-access version of the National Survey on Drug Use and Health (NSDUH) micro-level data with geographic identifiers. For those 21 and older, we found that MMLs led to a relative increase in the probability of marijuana use of 16 percent, an increase in marijuana use frequency of 12-17 percent, and an increase in the probability of marijuana abuse/dependence of 15-27 percent. For those 12-20 years old, we found a relative increase in marijuana use initiation of 5-6 percent. Among those aged 21 or above, MMLs increased the frequency of binge drinking by 6-9 percent, but MMLs did not affect drinking behavior among those 12-20 years old. MMLs had no discernible impact on hard drug use in either age group. Taken together, MML implementation increases marijuana use mainly among those over 21, where there is also a spillover effect of increased binge drinking, but there is no evidence of spillovers to other substance use.

10.3386/w20085.abstractZh: 目前有21个州和哥伦比亚特区拥有允许将大麻用于医疗目的的法律，这些法律通常被称为医用大麻法律。我们研究了2004年至2011年间在7个州实施的医用大麻法律对青少年和成人大麻、酒精及硬性毒品使用的影响。我们使用了带有地理识别信息的全国药物使用与健康调查的微数据，并采用限制访问的方式进行分析。研究发现，对于21岁及以上的人群，医用大麻法律使大麻使用的概率增加了16%，大麻使用频率增加了12-17%，大麻滥用/依赖的概率增加了15-27%。对于12-20岁的人群，大麻使用的起始频率增加了5-6%。在21岁及以上的人群中，医用大麻法律使酗酒的频率增加了6-9%，但并未影响12-20岁人群的饮酒行为。无论哪个年龄段，医用大麻法律对硬性毒品的使用都没有明显影响。总体而言，医用大麻法律的实施主要增加了21岁以上人群的大麻使用量，同时也会引发酗酒现象的加剧，但并未发现对其他物质使用的溢出效应。

abstract.text: This study examines the effect of chain store entry on drug quality and prices in the retail pharmacy market in Hyderabad, India. In contrast to prevailing mom-and-pop pharmacies, chains exploit scale economies to offer high-quality drugs at lower cost. With a unique data set and a natural experiment methodology, we show that chain entry leads to a relative 5 percent improvement in drug quality and a 2 percent decrease in prices at incumbent retailers. These changes do not depend on the socioeconomic status of consumers, suggesting that chain entry improves consumer welfare throughout the market. Despite the likely role of asymmetric information in this market, we show that consumers partially infer these quality improvements. Our findings suggest that in markets with asymmetric information, organizational technologies such as chains may play an important role translating greater demand into higher quality.

10.3386/w20091.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了连锁药店进入印度海得拉巴零售药店市场对药品质量和价格的影响。与传统的个体药店相比，连锁药店通过规模经济优势以更低的成本提供高质量的药品。通过独特的数据集和自然实验方法，我们发现连锁药店的进入使现有零售药店的药品质量提高了5%，价格降低了2%。这些变化并不取决于消费者的社会经济地位，这表明连锁药店的进入提升了整个市场的消费者福利。尽管该市场可能存在信息不对称的问题，但我们发现消费者能够部分感知到这些质量的提升。我们的研究结果表明，在信息不对称的市场中，像连锁药店这样的组织技术可以在将更大的需求转化为更高质量方面发挥重要作用。

abstract.text: In this paper we estimate the causal income elasticity of smoking participation, cessation, and cigarette demand conditional upon participation. Using an instrumental variables (IV) estimation strategy we find that smoking appears to be a normal good among low-income adults: higher instrumented income is associated with an increase in the number of cigarettes consumed and a decrease in smoking cessation. The magnitude and direction of the changes in the income coefficients from our OLS to IV estimates are consistent with the hypothesis that correlational estimates between income and smoking related outcomes are biased by unobservable characteristics that differentiate higher income smokers from lower income smokers.

10.3386/w20097.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们估计了吸烟参与、戒烟以及香烟需求在参与条件下的因果收入弹性。通过工具变量（IV）估计策略，我们发现吸烟在低收入成年人中似乎是一种正常商品：较高的工具变量收入与香烟消费量的增加以及戒烟率的下降相关。从OLS估计到IV估计，收入系数的变化幅度和方向与以下假设一致：收入与吸烟相关结果之间的相关性估计受到不可观测特征的偏差影响，这些特征使得高收入吸烟者与低收入吸烟者之间存在差异。

abstract.text: We estimate the long-run impact of cash transfers to poor families on children's longevity, educational attainment, nutritional status, and income in adulthood. To do so, we collected individual-level administrative records of applicants to the Mothers' Pension program--the first government-sponsored welfare program in the US (1911-1935) --and matched them to census, WWII and death records. Male children of accepted applicants lived one year longer than those of rejected mothers. Male children of accepted mothers received one-third more years of schooling, were less likely to be underweight, and had higher income in adulthood than children of rejected mothers.

10.3386/w20103.abstractZh: 我们估算了向贫困家庭提供现金转移对儿童寿命、教育水平、营养状况以及成年后的收入的长远影响。为此，我们收集了美国首个政府资助的福利项目——母亲养老金计划的个人级行政记录，并将其与人口普查、二战及死亡记录进行匹配。被批准的申请者所生的男孩比被拒绝的母亲的孩子们多活一年。被批准的母亲所生的男孩接受教育的时间多出三分之一，体重不足的可能性更低，且成年后的收入也高于被拒绝母亲所生的男孩。

abstract.text: This study provides plausibly causal estimates of the effect of public insurance coverage on the employment of non-elderly, non-disabled adults without dependent children ("childless adults"). We use regression discontinuity and propensity score matching difference-in-differences methods to take advantage of the sudden imposition of an enrollment cap, comparing the labor supply of enrollees to eligible applicants on a waitlist. We find enrollment into public insurance leads to sizable and statistically meaningful reductions in employment up to at least 9 quarters later, with an estimated size of from 2 to 10 percentage points depending upon the model used.

10.3386/w20111.abstractZh: 本研究提供了关于公共保险覆盖对非老年、非残疾且没有受抚养子女的人（“无子女成年人”）就业影响的合理因果估计。我们采用回归不连续法以及倾向得分匹配差异-差异方法，利用公共保险参保资格限制的突然实施，将参保者与等待名单上的符合条件申请者之间的劳动力供给进行比较。研究发现，参保后至少9个季度内，就业率显著下降，下降幅度根据所使用的模型不同，估计在2%到10%之间。

abstract.text: Theory suggests that adverse life events--such as unemployment or health shocks--can result in food insecurity, which has increased substantially in the U.S. over the past decade alongside the obesity epidemic. We test this proposition by estimating the effects of a specific and salient mental health event--maternal depression during the postpartum year--on child and family food insecurity. Using data from the Early Childhood Longitudinal Study--Birth Cohort, we estimate the effects of maternal depression on food insecurity using both single- and two-stage models, and explore potential buffering effects of relevant public assistance programs and supports. We find that moderate to severe maternal depression increases the likelihood that children and households experience any food insecurity--by between 50 and 80%, depending on the measure of food insecurity. We also find that maternal depression increases the likelihood of reliance on the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program; Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children; Medicaid; and the Temporary Assistance to Needy Families program, suggesting that these programs play a buffering role.

10.3386/w20113.abstractZh: 理论表明，诸如失业或健康危机等不利生活事件可能导致食物不安全，而在过去十年中，这种情况在美国因肥胖症的蔓延而显著加剧。我们通过估计一个特定且显著的心理健康事件——产后一年的母亲抑郁——对儿童和家庭食物不安全的影响来验证这一假设。利用《早期儿童纵向研究——出生队列》的数据，我们使用单阶段和两阶段模型来估计母亲抑郁对食物不安全的影响，并探讨相关公共援助计划和支持的潜在缓冲作用。研究发现，中度至重度母亲抑郁会增加儿童和家庭经历食物不安全的可能性，这一比例根据食物不安全的衡量标准不同，介于50%到80%之间。此外，研究还发现，母亲抑郁增加了依赖补充营养援助计划、妇女、婴儿和儿童补充营养计划、医疗补助以及临时援助计划的可能性，这表明这些计划起到了缓冲作用。

abstract.text: Meta-regression estimates of the value of a statistical life (VSL) controlling for publication selection bias yield bias-corrected estimates of VSL that are higher for labor market studies using the more recent Census of Fatal Occupational Injuries (CFOI) data. These results are borne out by the findings for four meta-analysis data sets and different formulations of the variable used to capture publication bias effects. Meta-regression estimates for a large sample of VSL estimates consisting only of results of labor market studies using the CFOI fatality data indicate publication selection bias effects that are not statistically significant in either fixed effects or random effects models with clustered standard errors. The confidence intervals of the publication bias-corrected estimates of the value of a statistical life sometimes include the sample mean estimates and always include the values that are currently used by government agencies.

10.3386/w20116.abstractZh: 通过元回归分析，在控制发表选择偏差的情况下，对统计生命价值进行估计，使用较新的《致命职业伤害普查》数据进行的劳动力市场研究得出的偏差校正后的统计生命价值估计值更高。这些结果得到了四个元分析数据集的研究结果的支持，并且不同公式用于捕捉发表偏差的影响也证实了这一点。对于大量仅使用《致命职业伤害普查》数据得出的劳动力市场研究结果的统计生命价值估计值进行元回归分析，发现发表选择偏差的影响在固定效应模型和随机效应模型中并不显著，且标准误差存在聚集现象。对统计生命价值进行偏差校正后的估计值的置信区间有时会包含样本均值估计值，并且总是包含政府机构目前使用的数值。

abstract.text: Childhood obesity has reached epidemic proportions in the U.S., with now almost a third of children ages 2-19 deemed overweight or obese. In this study, we leverage recent findings from behavioral economics to explore new approaches to tackling one aspect of childhood obesity: food choice and consumption. Using a field experiment where we include more than 1,500 children, we report several key insights. First, we find that individual incentives can have large influences: in the control, only 17% of children prefer the healthy snack, whereas the introduction of small incentives increases take-up of the healthy snack to roughly 75%, more than a four-fold increase. There is some evidence that the effects continue after the treatment period, consistent with a model of habit formation. Second, we find little evidence that the framing of incentives (loss versus gain) matters. While incentives work, we find that educational messaging alone has little influence on food choice. Yet, we do observe an important interaction effect between messaging and incentives: together they provide an important influence on food choice. For policymakers, our findings show the power of using incentives to combat childhood obesity. For academics, our approach opens up an interesting combination of theory and experiment that can lead to a better understanding of theories that explain healthy decisions and what incentives can influence them.

10.3386/w20132.abstractZh: 在美国，儿童肥胖问题已经达到了流行病的程度，目前几乎有三分之一的2至19岁儿童被认定为超重或肥胖。在这项研究中，我们借鉴了行为经济学的最新研究成果，探索了应对儿童肥胖的一个方面：食物选择和消费。通过一项包含1500多名儿童的实地实验，我们得出了几个关键发现。首先，我们发现个体激励因素可以产生巨大影响：在对照组中，只有17%的儿童选择健康零食，而引入小激励措施后，健康零食的选用率上升到了约75%，增加了四倍多。有一些证据表明，这种影响在干预期之后仍然持续，这与习惯形成的模型相符。其次，我们发现激励方式的差异（损失与收益）对选择的影响不大。虽然激励措施有效，但我们发现单纯的教育信息对食物选择的影响很小。不过，我们确实观察到信息传达与激励措施之间的相互作用：两者共同对食物选择产生了重要影响。对于政策制定者来说，我们的发现展示了利用激励措施来对抗儿童肥胖的力量。对于学者而言，我们的研究方法结合了理论和实验，有助于更好地理解解释健康决策的理论，以及哪些激励措施能够影响这些决策。

abstract.text: First-year insurer participation in the Health Insurance Marketplaces (HIMs) established by the Affordable Care Act is limited in many areas of the country. There are 3.9 participants, on (population-weighted) average, in the 395 ratings areas spanning the 34 states with federally facilitated marketplaces (FFMs). Using data on the plans offered in the FFMs, together with predicted market shares for HIM participants (estimated using 2011 insurer-state market shares in the individual insurance market), we study the impact of competition on premiums. We exploit variation in ratings-area-level competition induced by UnitedHealthcare's decision not to participate in any of the FFMs. We estimate that the second-lowest-price silver premium (which is directly linked to federal subsidies) would have decreased by 5.4 percent, on average, had UnitedHealthcare participated. If all insurers active in each state's individual insurance market in 2011 had participated in all ratings areas in that state's HIM, we estimate this key premium would be 11.1% lower and 2014 federal subsidies would be reduced by $1.7 billion.

10.3386/w20140.abstractZh: 根据《平价医疗法案》设立的医疗保险市场中的第一年保险公司的参与在国家的许多地区都受到限制。在拥有联邦协助市场的34个州中，有3.9家保险公司参与了395个评级区域的市场活动（按人口加权计算）。通过收集这些市场提供的计划数据，并结合对医疗保险市场参与者的市场份额的预测（基于2011年保险公司与州在个人保险市场中的市场份额数据），我们研究了竞争对保费的影响。我们发现，由于联合健康保险公司决定不参与任何联邦协助市场，导致各评级区域之间的竞争出现了差异。我们估计，如果联合健康保险公司参与了这些市场，最低价白银保险产品的保费平均将下降5.4%。如果2011年每个州个人保险市场中的所有保险公司都参与了该州医疗保险市场中的所有评级区域，我们预计这一关键保费将降低11.1%，而2014年的联邦补贴将减少17亿美元。

abstract.text: The first major insurance expansion of the Affordable Care Act – a provision requiring insurers to allow dependents to remain on parents’ health insurance until turning 26 – took effect in September 2010. We estimate this mandate’s impacts on numerous outcomes related to health care access, preventive care utilization, risky behaviors, and self-assessed health. We estimate difference-in-differences models with 23-25 year olds as the treatment group and 27-29 year olds as the control group. For the full sample, the dependent coverage provision increased the probabilities of having health insurance, a primary care doctor, and excellent self-assessed health, while reducing body mass index. However, the mandate also increased risky drinking and did not lead to any significant increases in preventive care utilization. Subsample analyses reveal particularly large gains for men and college graduates.

10.3386/w20148.abstractZh: 《平价医疗法案》中第一项重要的保险扩展条款要求保险公司允许受抚养人在年满26岁之前继续享受父母的医疗保险。该条款于2010年9月生效。我们估算了这一条款对与医疗保健获取、预防性护理利用、危险行为以及自我评估健康状况相关的多个结果的影响。我们采用差异-差异模型进行估算，将23-25岁的群体作为实验组，27-29岁的群体作为对照组。对于整个样本，受抚养人保险覆盖条款增加了拥有医疗保险、获得初级医生服务以及拥有良好自我评估健康状况的概率，同时降低了体重指数。然而，该条款也增加了危险饮酒行为，并未显著增加预防性护理的利用。子样本分析显示，男性以及大学毕业生受益尤为明显。

abstract.text: Using Eurobarometer data, we document large variation across European countries in education gradients in income, self-reported health, life satisfaction, obesity, smoking and drinking. While this variation has been documented previously, the reasons why the effect of education on income, health and health behaviors varies is not well understood. We build on previous literature documenting that cohorts graduating in bad times have lower wages and poorer health for many years after graduation, compared to those graduating in good times. We investigate whether more educated individuals suffer smaller income and health losses as a result of poor labor market conditions upon labor market entry. We confirm that a higher unemployment rate at graduation is associated with lower income, lower life satisfaction, greater obesity, more smoking and drinking later in life. Further, education plays a protective role for these outcomes, especially when unemployment rates are high: the losses associated with poor labor market outcomes are substantially lower for more educated individuals. Variation in unemployment rates upon graduation can potentially explain a large fraction of the variance in gradients across different countries.

10.3386/w20156.abstractZh: 利用欧洲晴雨表数据，我们发现欧洲各国在收入、自我报告的健康状况、生活满意度、肥胖、吸烟和饮酒方面的教育梯度存在巨大差异。虽然这种差异之前已有记录，但教育对收入、健康和健康行为的影响差异的原因尚不清楚。我们基于先前的研究，发现那些在困难时期毕业的群体，在毕业后多年内收入较低，健康状况也较差，与那些在良好时期毕业的群体相比。我们进一步研究，受教育程度较高的个体是否因劳动力市场的不良状况而在进入劳动力市场后遭受较小的收入和健康损失。研究证实，毕业时较高的失业率与较低的收入、较低的生活满意度、更高的肥胖率、更多的吸烟和饮酒行为相关。此外，教育对这些结果具有保护作用，尤其是在失业率较高的情况下：受教育程度较高的个体因劳动力市场不良状况而遭受的损失要小得多。毕业时失业率的变化可能解释了不同国家之间这些梯度差异的很大一部分。

abstract.text: This paper explores the effects of public health insurance expansions on hospitals' decisions to adopt medical technology. Specifically, we test whether the expansion of Medicaid eligibility for pregnant women during the 1980s and 1990s affects hospitals' decisions to adopt neonatal intensive care units (NICUs). While the Medicaid expansion provided new insurance to a substantial number of pregnant women, prior literature also finds that some newly insured women would otherwise have been covered by more generously reimbursed private sources. This leads to a theoretically ambiguous net effect of Medicaid expansion on a hospital's incentive to invest in technology. Using American Hospital Association data, we find that on average, Medicaid expansion has no statistically significant effect on NICU adoption. However, we find that in geographic areas where more of the newly Medicaid-insured may have come from the privately insured population, Medicaid expansion slows NICU adoption. This holds true particularly when Medicaid payment rates are very low relative to private payment rates. This finding is consistent with prior evidence on reduced NICU adoption from increased managed-care penetration. We conclude by providing suggestive evidence on the health impacts of this deceleration of NICU diffusion, and by discussing the policy implications of our work for insurance expansions associated with the Affordable Care Act.

10.3386/w20159.abstractZh: 本文探讨了公共健康保险扩展对医院采用医疗技术决策的影响。具体而言，我们测试了20世纪80年代和90年代孕妇医疗补助资格扩展是否会影响医院采用新生儿重症监护室（NICUs）的决策。虽然医疗补助扩展为大量孕妇提供了新的保险保障，但先前的研究也发现，一些新参保的孕妇原本可以由收费更高的私人保险来源覆盖。这导致医疗补助扩展对医院投资技术的动机产生了理论上不确定的净效应。利用美国医院协会的数据，我们发现平均而言，医疗补助扩展对NICU的采用没有统计学上的显著影响。然而，我们发现，在那些新参保者主要来自私人保险人群的地区，医疗补助扩展会减缓NICU的采用。这一点在医疗补助支付率远低于私人支付率的情况下尤为明显。这一发现与先前关于管理式医疗普及导致NICU采用减少的证据一致。最后，我们提出了关于这种NICU采用减缓对健康影响的建议性观点，并讨论了我们的研究结果对于与《平价医疗法案》相关的保险扩展的政策意义。

abstract.text: Whether government transfer programs increase the human capital of low-income children is a question of first-order policy importance. Such policies might help poor children if their parents are credit constrained, and so under-invest in their human capital. But it is also possible that whatever causes parents to have low incomes might also directly influence children's development, in which case transfer programs need not improve poor children's long-term life chances. While several recent influential studies suggest anti-poverty programs have larger human capital effects per dollar spent than do even the best educational interventions, identification is a challenge because most transfer programs are entitlements. We overcome that problem by studying the effects on children of a generous transfer program that is heavily rationed--means-tested housing assistance. We take advantage of a randomized housing voucher lottery in Chicago in 1997, for which 82,607 people applied, and use administrative data on schooling, arrests, and health to track children's outcomes over 14 years. We focus on families living in unsubsidized private housing at baseline, for whom voucher receipt generates large changes in both housing and non-housing consumption. Estimated effects are mostly statistically insignificant and always much smaller than those from recent studies of cash transfers, and are smaller on a per dollar basis than the best educational interventions.

10.3386/w20164.abstractZh: 政府转移支付项目是否能够提高低收入儿童的人力资本，是一个具有首要政策重要性的问题。如果这些儿童的父母面临信贷限制，无法对其人力资本进行充分投资，那么此类政策或许能够帮助他们。但也可能存在这样一种情况：导致父母收入较低的原因也会直接影响儿童的发展，在这种情况下，转移支付项目未必能改善贫困儿童的长远生活机会。尽管一些近期的研究表明，反贫困项目每投入一美元所带来的人力资本效应，甚至超过了最优质的教育干预措施，但这一结论的确定却颇具挑战性，因为大多数转移支付项目都属于福利性补贴。我们通过研究一项实施严格配额的慷慨转移支付项目对儿童的影响来克服这一难题——该项目是住房援助。我们利用了1997年芝加哥的一项随机住房券抽奖活动，共有82,607人参与申请，并利用关于教育、逮捕和健康的行政数据来追踪儿童在14年内的发展情况。我们重点关注那些在基线时居住在无补贴私人住房中的家庭，这些家庭在收到住房券后，住房和非住房消费都发生了显著变化。估计出的效果大多在统计上并不显著，且始终远小于最近关于现金转移的研究结果，从每美元投入的角度来看，其效果也低于最优质的教育干预措施。

abstract.text: This paper tests whether in utero conditions affect long-run developmental outcomes using the 1918 influenza pandemic in Taiwan as a natural experiment. Combining several historical and current datasets, we find that cohorts in utero during the pandemic are shorter as children/adolescents and less educated compared to other birth cohorts. We also find that they are more likely to have serious health problems including kidney disease, circulatory and respiratory problems, and diabetes in old age. Despite possible positive selection on health outcomes due to high infant mortality rates during this period (18 percent), our paper finds a strong negative impact of in utero exposure to influenza.

10.3386/w20166.abstractZh: 本文通过1918年台湾流感大流行这一自然实验，探讨子宫内环境是否会影响长期发展结果。结合多个历史与当前的数据集，我们发现，在流感大流行期间出生的儿童/青少年身材较矮小，受教育程度也较低。此外，他们更有可能出现严重的健康问题，包括肾脏疾病、循环系统和呼吸系统问题以及老年时期的糖尿病。尽管这一时期婴儿死亡率高达18%，可能对健康结果产生积极影响，但我们的研究结果表明，子宫内暴露于流感对健康有显著的负面影响。

abstract.text: We review the existing literature about the effects of the Medicaid program. We first describe the program's structure and how it has changed over time. We then discuss findings on coverage, crowd out, take-up and health. Finally, we look at effects of the program on non-health outcomes such as welfare use and labor supply, marriage and fertility, and savings.

10.3386/w20169.abstractZh: 我们回顾了关于医疗补助计划影响的现有文献。首先，我们描述了该计划的结构以及其随时间的变化情况。接着，我们讨论了关于覆盖范围、挤出效应、接受率以及健康方面的研究结果。最后，我们探讨了该计划对非健康结果的影响，例如福利使用、劳动力供应、婚姻和生育状况以及储蓄情况。

abstract.text: In a field experiment in Uganda, a free distribution of three health products lowers subsequent demand relative to a sale distribution. This contrasts with work on insecticide-treated bed nets, highlighting the importance of product characteristics in determining pricing policy. We put forward a model to illustrate the potential tension between two of these important factors, learning and anchoring, and then test this model with three products selected specifically for their variation in the scope for learning. We find the rank order of percentage change of shifts in demand matches theoretical predictions, although the differences are not statistically significant, and only two of three pairwise comparisons match when the reductions are specified in percent terms. These results highlight the importance of understanding pricing policy with respect to product, market, and household characteristics.

10.3386/w20170.abstractZh: 在乌干达的一项实地实验中，免费分发三种健康产品后，后续需求相较于销售分发时有所下降。这与关于杀虫剂处理蚊帐的研究结果不同，凸显了产品特性在定价政策中的重要性。我们提出了一个模型，以说明这两个重要因素——学习和锚定——之间的潜在冲突，并通过三种特定产品进行了测试，这些产品在学习机会方面具有差异。我们发现，需求变化的百分比顺序与理论预测一致，尽管差异在统计上并不显著，且只有两次成对比较的结果与理论预测一致，这些比较是在百分比形式下进行的。这些结果强调了理解定价政策时需要考虑产品、市场和家庭特征的重要性。

abstract.text: Public health insurance programs comprise a large share of federal and state government expenditures. Although a sizable literature analyzes the effects of these programs on health care utilization and health outcomes, little prior work has examined the long-term effects and resultant health improvements on important outcomes, such as educational attainment. We contribute to filling this gap in the literature by examining the effects of the public insurance expansions among children in the 1980s and 1990s on their future educational attainment. Our findings indicate that expanding health insurance coverage for low-income children increases the rate of high school completion and college completion. These estimates are robust to only using federal Medicaid expansions, and mostly are due to expansions that occur when the children are older (i.e., not newborns). We present suggestive evidence that better health is one of the mechanisms driving our results by showing that Medicaid eligibility when young translates into better teen health. Overall, our results indicate that the long-run benefits of public health insurance are substantial.

10.3386/w20178.abstractZh: 公共健康保险计划占联邦和州政府支出的很大比例。尽管有大量文献分析了这些计划对医疗利用和健康结果的影响，但很少有研究探讨其长期效应以及对重要结果（如教育成就）的改善。我们通过研究20世纪80年代和90年代公共保险扩展对儿童未来教育成就的影响，来填补这一文献空白。研究发现，为低收入儿童扩大健康保险覆盖范围可以提高高中毕业率和大学毕业率。这些结果在仅使用联邦医疗补助扩展的情况下仍然成立，并且主要是由于在儿童年龄较大时（即非新生儿时期）进行的扩展所带来的效果。我们有证据表明，更好的健康状况是驱动这些结果的一个机制，因为表明在年轻时获得医疗补助资格会转化为更好的青少年健康状况。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，公共健康保险的长期效益是显著的。

abstract.text: Research in behavioral economics suggests that certain circumstances, such as large numbers of complex options or revisiting prior choices, can lead to decision errors. This paper explores the enrollment decisions of Medicare beneficiaries in the Medicare Advantage (MA) program. During the time period we study (2007-2010), private fee-for-service (PFFS) plans offered enhanced benefits beyond those of traditional Medicare (TM) without any restrictions on physician networks or additional cost, making TM a dominated choice relative to PFFS. Yet more than three quarters of Medicare beneficiaries remained in TM during our study period. We explore two possible explanations for this behavior: status quo bias and choice overload. Our results suggest that status quo bias plays an important role; the rate of MA enrollment was significantly higher among new Medicare beneficiaries than among incumbents. Our results also provide some evidence of choice overload; while the MA enrollment rate did not decline with an increase in the number of plans, among incumbent beneficiaries it failed to increase. Our results illustrate the importance of the choice environment that is in place when enrollees first enter the Medicare program.

10.3386/w20181.abstractZh: 行为经济学的研究表明，某些情况，如大量复杂的选择或重新考虑之前的决策，可能导致决策错误。本文探讨了Medicare受益人选择Medicare Advantage（MA）计划的注册行为。在我们研究的时期（2007-2010年），私人付费服务计划提供了比传统Medicare更丰富的福利，且没有任何对医生网络的限制或额外成本，这使得传统Medicare成为相对占优的选择。然而，在我们的研究期间，超过四分之三的Medicare受益人仍然选择留在传统Medicare计划中。我们探讨了两种可能的解释：现状偏见和选择过载。我们的研究结果表明，现状偏见起着重要作用；新加入Medicare的受益人的MA注册率显著高于现有受益人。研究结果还提供了一些选择过载的证据；虽然MA的注册率并未随着计划数量的增加而下降，但在现有受益人中，注册率并未上升。我们的研究结果说明了当受益人首次进入Medicare计划时，选择环境的重要性。

abstract.text: We study the coverage impacts of a 65-percent health insurance premium subsidy which targeted employer-insured workers who lost their jobs between September 2008 and May 2010. Our research represents the first econometric analysis of the American Recovery and Reinvestment Act (ARRA) COBRA subsidy and contributes to a better understanding of consumer responses to government subsidized private health insurance and discussions surrounding Affordable Care Act (ACA) policies. Using data from the Survey of Income and Program Participation (SIPP) and a difference-in-differences estimation strategy, we find that the subsidy is associated with a substantial increase in own-name employer coverage among the targeted group. We estimate a -0.38 to -0.27 price elasticity of demand for health insurance, depending on the specification. This suggests that consumers are somewhat more price sensitive than previously thought, although there are caveats to generalizing from past settings to individuals affected by ACA subsidies. We also find that part of the increase in subsidized coverage was offset by a decrease in unsubsidized non-group insurance.

10.3386/w20196.abstractZh: 我们研究了2008年9月至2010年5月期间失业的雇主保险员工在65%的医疗保险保费补贴下的覆盖影响。我们的研究首次对《美国复苏与再投资法案》中的COBRA补贴进行了计量经济学分析，有助于更好地理解消费者对政府补贴的私人健康保险的反应，以及围绕《平价医疗法案》政策的讨论。通过《收入与计划参与调查》的数据和差异-差异估计方法，我们发现该补贴显著增加了目标群体中的个人雇主保险覆盖。我们估计了医疗保险需求的价格弹性为-0.38至-0.27，具体数值取决于模型设定。这表明消费者对价格的变化比之前认为的更为敏感，不过从过去的情况推广到受ACA补贴影响的个体存在局限性。我们还发现，补贴覆盖的增加部分被未补贴的非团体保险减少所抵消。

abstract.text: The Affordable Care Act of 2010 expanded coverage to young adults by allowing them to remain on their parent's private health insurance until they turn 26 years old. While there is evidence on insurance effects, we know very little about use of general or specific forms of medical care. We study the implications of the expansion for the use of inpatient hospitalizations. Given the prevalence of mental health needs for young adults, we also specifically study mental health related inpatient care. We find evidence that compared to those aged 27-29 years, treated young adults aged 19-25 years increased their inpatient visits by 3.5 percent. Visits related to mental illness increased 9.0 percent. The prevalence of uninsurance among hospitalized young adults decreased by 12.5 percent; however, it does not appear that the intensity of inpatient treatment changed despite the change in reimbursement composition of patients.

10.3386/w20202.abstractZh: 2010年的《平价医疗法案》通过允许年轻人在年满26岁之前继续享受父母的私人健康保险，从而扩大了他们的医疗保障范围。尽管有关于保险影响的证据，但我们对普通或特定形式的医疗服务的使用情况知之甚少。我们研究了这一政策对住院治疗使用的影响。鉴于年轻人在心理健康方面的需求普遍存在，我们还特别研究了与心理健康相关的住院治疗情况。研究发现，与27-29岁的年轻人相比，19-25岁的年轻人在住院次数上增加了3.5%。与精神疾病相关的住院次数增加了9.0%。在住院的年轻人中，无保险的比例下降了12.5%；然而，尽管患者的报销结构发生了变化，但住院治疗的强度似乎并没有改变。

abstract.text: In the Medicare Advantage (MA) market, private health insurers compete to offer plans with the most attractive premium and benefit package. Medicare provides a subsidy, based on a "benchmark payment rate", for each Medicare beneficiary a plan enrolls. We investigate how this subsidy, the primary policy lever in the market, affects the equilibrium premiums and benefits of MA plans. We exploit variation in benchmark payment rates within plans over time, coming from rebasing years where benchmark changes differed across areas in ways that were plausibly exogenous, to determine empirically how plan premiums and benefit generosity respond to changes in benchmarks. We find that premiums do not respond to changes in the benchmark payment rate on average but that insurers do pass through a portion of the benchmark increase by increasing plan benefit generosity. We argue that the way premium information is communicated to consumers influences the way in which plans pass through subsidy dollars and can account for the empirical results. More specifically, institutional features make it difficult for consumers to observe a large component of the plan premium, leading to a lack of demand response to premium reductions below the premium charged by traditional Medicare (the fee-for-service Part B premium). When demand does not respond to lower premiums, plans have an incentive to pass-through cost subsidies to consumers via more generous benefits that consumers may not value at cost, creating an inefficiently high level of benefit generosity. Our results provide evidence that a lack of premium transparency in the MA market may distort the combination of premium levels and benefit generosity offered in equilibrium, resulting in some degree of inefficiently high benefits. We conclude by discussing changes to the choice environment that would increase premium transparency and potentially soften the premium rigidities we find.

10.3386/w20208.abstractZh: 在Medicare Advantage市场中，私人健康保险公司竞相提供具有最吸引力的保费和福利套餐。Medicare根据“基准支付率”为每位参保的Medicare受益人提供补贴。我们研究了这一补贴——市场中的主要政策工具——如何影响Medicare Advantage计划的均衡保费和福利水平。我们利用计划内部基准支付率随时间的变化，这些变化源于基准调整年份的不同，而这些变化可能是外生因素导致的，以此来实证分析计划保费和福利水平如何响应基准的变化。我们发现，平均而言，保费并不对基准支付率的变化作出反应，但保险公司确实通过将计划福利水平提高来传递部分基准增加的成本。我们认为，向消费者传达保费信息的方式会影响计划如何分配补贴资金，这可以解释这些实证结果。更具体地说，制度特征使得消费者难以观察到计划保费的大部分，导致他们对低于传统Medicare收费标准的保费降低缺乏反应。当需求对较低保费没有反应时，计划有动机通过更优厚的福利来传递成本补贴给消费者，而这些福利可能并非消费者所重视的。我们的研究结果表明，Medicare Advantage市场中缺乏保费透明度可能会扭曲均衡状态下保费水平与福利水平之间的组合，从而导致某些情况下福利水平过高。最后，我们讨论了能够增加保费透明度的选择环境变化，这些变化有可能减轻我们发现的保费刚性问题。

abstract.text: Prior research has shown that exogenous shocks to the demand for medical products spur additional product development. These studies do not distinguish between breakthrough products and those that largely duplicate the performance of existing products. In this paper, we use a novel data set to explore the impact of the introduction of Medicare Part D on the development of new biotechnology products. We find that the law spurred development of products targeting illnesses that affect the elderly, but most of this effect is concentrated among products aimed at diseases that already have multiple existing treatments. Moreover, we find no increase in products targeting orphan disease or those receiving either fast track or priority review status from the FDA. This suggests that marginal changes in demand may have little effect on the development of products with large welfare benefits.

10.3386/w20212.abstractZh: 先前的研究表明，医疗产品需求的外部冲击会促进产品的进一步开发。但这些研究并未区分突破性产品与那些主要复制现有产品性能的产品的区别。在本文中，我们使用了一个新的数据集来探讨《医疗保险法案》第D部分的实施对新型生物技术产品开发的影响。我们发现，该法律促进了针对老年人常见疾病的产品的开发，但这一效应主要集中在那些已有多种治疗方法的疾病上。此外，我们并未发现针对孤儿病的产品或获得FDA快速通道或优先审评资格的产品数量有所增加。这表明，需求的微小变化可能对具有巨大福利效益的产品的开发影响甚微。

abstract.text: Reforms introduced by the Affordable Care and Patient Protection Act (ACA) build new sources of coverage around employment-based health insurance. But what if firms find it cheaper to have their employees obtain insurance from these sources, even after accounting for penalties (for non-provision of insurance) and employee bonuses (to ensure the shift is cost neutral for them)? State and local governments (SLGs) have strong incentives to consider the economics of such “divestment”; many have large unfunded benefits liabilities. We investigated whether SLGs would save under two scenarios: (1) shifting all employees and under-65-retirees to alternative sources of coverage; (2) shifting only employees whose household incomes indicate they would be eligible for federally subsidized coverage and all under-65-retirees. Full divestment would cost SLGs more than they currently pay, due primarily to penalty costs. Selective divestment could save SLGs nearly $129 billion over 10 years at the expense of the federal government.

10.3386/w20222.abstractZh: 《平价医疗法案》和《患者保护法案》所引入的改革，为基于就业的医疗保险建立了新的覆盖范围。但如果企业发现让员工从这些渠道获取保险更便宜，即使考虑到不提供保险的罚款以及为确保成本对它们而言为零而提供的员工奖金，情况又会如何呢？州和地方政府有强烈的动机考虑这种“退出”方案的经济效益；许多地方的福利责任巨大且未得到资金支持。我们研究了在两种情况下，州和地方政府是否会节省成本：(1)将所有员工和65岁以下的退休人员转向其他保险来源；(2)仅将那些家庭收入表明有资格获得联邦补贴保险的员工以及所有65岁以下的退休人员转向其他保险来源。完全退出保险将让州和地方政府付出比目前更高的成本，主要是由于罚款费用。选择性退出保险则可以在10年内为州和地方政府节省近1290亿美元，而代价是向联邦政府支付费用。

abstract.text: This paper provides estimates of the changes in premiums, average or expected out of pocket payments, and the sum of premiums and out of pocket payments (total expected price) for a sample of consumers who bought individual insurance in 2010 to 2012, comparing total expected prices before the Affordable Care Act with estimates of total expected prices if they were to purchase silver or bronze coverage after reform, before the effects of any premium subsidies. We provide comparisons for purchasers of self only coverage in California and in 23 states with minimal prior state premium regulation before the ACA now using federally managed exchanges. Using data from the Current Population Survey, we find that the average prices increased by 14 to 28 percent, with similar changes in California and the federal exchange states; we attribute the increase primarily to higher premiums in exchanges associated with insurer expectations of a higher risk population being enrolled. The increase in total expected price is similar for age-gender population subgroups except for a larger than average increases for older women. A welfare calculation of the change in risk premium associated with moving from coverage that prevailed before reform to bronze or silver coverage finds small changes.

10.3386/w20223.abstractZh: 本文对2010年至2012年间购买个人保险的消费者在保费、平均或预期自付金额以及保费与自付金额之和（总预期价格）方面的变化进行了估算。比较了《平价医疗法案》实施前的总预期价格与改革后购买银级或铜级保险的总预期价格，同时不考虑任何保费补贴的影响。我们对比了加利福尼亚州以及23个在《平价医疗法案》实施前保费监管较少的州中，仅购买个人保险消费者的情况。根据《当前人口调查》的数据，我们发现平均价格上升了14%至28%，加利福尼亚州和联邦交易所所在州的增幅相似；这一增长主要归因于交易所中更高的保费，这与保险公司对高风险人群的预期有关。总预期价格的上升在年龄和性别的细分人群中表现相似，但老年女性的增幅高于平均水平。对于从改革前普遍存在的保险方式转变为银级或铜级保险所带来的风险保费变化进行福利计算后，发现变化幅度较小。

abstract.text: We present a simple graphical framework to illustrate the potential welfare gains from a “top-up” health insurance policy requiring patients to pay the incremental price for more expensive treatment options. We apply this framework to breast cancer treatments, where lumpectomy with radiation therapy is more expensive than mastectomy but generates similar average health benefits. We estimate the relative demand for lumpectomy using variation in distance to the nearest radiation facility, and estimate that the “top-up” policy increases social welfare by $700-2,500 per patient relative to two common alternatives. We briefly discuss additional tradeoffs that arise from an ex-ante perspective.

10.3386/w20226.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个简单的图形框架，用以说明“追加支付”医疗保险政策的潜在福利收益。该政策要求患者为更昂贵的治疗选择支付额外的费用。我们将这一框架应用于乳腺癌治疗领域，发现接受放疗的肿块切除术比乳房切除术成本更高，但平均健康收益相当。我们通过分析患者到最近的放疗设施的距离变化，估算了肿块切除术的相对需求。结果表明，与两种常见替代方案相比，“追加支付”政策可使每位患者的社会福利增加700至2,500美元。我们还简要讨论了从事前角度产生的其他权衡因素。

abstract.text: Despite the high levels of marital disruption in the United States, and substantial reliance on family-based health insurance, little research is available on the consequences of marital disruption for insurance coverage among men, women, and children. We address this shortfall by examining patterns of coverage surrounding marital disruption. We find large differences in coverage across marital status groups in the cross-section. In longitudinal analyses that focus on within-person change, we find small overall coverage changes but large changes in type of coverage following marital disruption. Both men and women show increases in private coverage in their own names, but offsetting decreases in dependent coverage tend to be larger. Dependent coverage for children also declines after marital dissolution, even though children are still likely to be eligible for that coverage. Children and, to a lesser extent, women show increases in public coverage around the time of divorce or separation. The most vulnerable group appears to be lower-educated women with children because the increases in private, own-name, and public insurance are not large enough to offset the large decrease in dependent coverage. As the United States implements federal health reform, it is critical that we understand the ways in which life course events--specifically, marital disruption--shape the dynamic patterns of coverage.

10.3386/w20233.abstractZh: 尽管美国的婚姻破裂现象较为普遍，且人们普遍依赖家庭式健康保险，但关于婚姻破裂对男性、女性和儿童保险覆盖影响的实证研究却很少。我们通过研究婚姻破裂期间的保险覆盖情况来弥补这一空白。研究发现，不同婚姻状况群体之间的保险覆盖存在显著差异。在关注个体内部变化的纵向分析中，我们发现整体保险覆盖变化不大，但婚姻破裂后保险类型的变化却很大。无论是男性还是女性， 자신의名字作为被保险人所拥有的私人保险都有所增加，但作为被抚养人的保险则出现了较大的减少。儿童的被抚养人保险在婚姻破裂后也有所下降，尽管儿童仍然有资格享受这种保险。在离婚或分居期间，儿童和女性似乎会获得更多的公共保险。最脆弱的群体似乎是拥有孩子的低教育水平女性，因为她们在私人保险、自身名字保险以及公共保险方面的增加不足以抵消被抚养人保险的大幅减少。随着美国实施联邦健康改革，了解生命历程中的事件——特别是婚姻破裂——如何塑造保险覆盖的动态模式至关重要。

abstract.text: Traditional economic models of criminal behavior have straightforward predictions: raising the expected cost of crime via apprehension probabilities or punishments decreases crime. I test the effect of harsher punishments on deterring driving under the influence (DUI). In this setting, punishments are determined by strict rules on Blood Alcohol Content (BAC) and previous offenses. Regression discontinuity derived estimates suggest that having a BAC above the DUI threshold reduces recidivism by up to 2 percentage points (17 percent). Likewise having a BAC over the aggravated DUI threshold reduces recidivism by an additional percentage point (9 percent). The results suggest that recent recommendations to lower the BAC limit to .05 would save relatively few lives, while increasing marginal punishments and sanctions monotonically along the BAC distribution would more effectively deter the drunk drivers most likely to be involved in fatal crashes.

10.3386/w20243.abstractZh: 传统的犯罪行为经济模型有着明确的预测：通过提高逮捕概率或惩罚力度来提升犯罪行为的预期成本，能够有效降低犯罪率。本文探讨了更严厉的惩罚对遏制酒后驾车行为的影响。在这一情境下，惩罚标准由血液酒精含量严格规定以及之前的犯罪记录决定。回归不连续法得出的估计结果显示，血液酒精含量超过酒后驾车警戒线时，再犯率可降低高达2个百分点（17%）。同样，当血液酒精含量超过严重酒后驾车警戒线时，再犯率可再降低1个百分点（9%）。研究结果表明，近期提出的将血液酒精含量限制降至0.05的建议，能够挽救相对较少的生命；而提高边际惩罚力度并沿血液酒精含量分布范围逐步加强制裁措施，将更有效地阻止那些最有可能导致致命事故的酒驾行为。

abstract.text: Investment in water purification technologies led to large mortality declines by helping eradicate typhoid fever and other waterborne diseases. This paper seeks to understand how these technologies affected human capital formation. We use typhoid fatality rates during early life as a proxy for water quality. To carry out the analysis, city-level data are merged with a unique dataset linking individuals between the 1900 and 1940 censuses. Parametric and semi-parametric estimates suggest that eradicating early-life exposure to typhoid fever would have increased earnings in later life by 1% and increased educational attainment by one month. Instrumenting for typhoid fever using the typhoid rates from cities that lie upstream produces similar results. A simple cost-benefit analysis indicates that the increase in earnings from eradicating typhoid fever was more than sufficient to offset the costs of eradication.

10.3386/w20279.abstractZh: 对水净化技术的投资通过帮助根除伤寒和其他水传播疾病，导致了大规模死亡率的下降。本文旨在探讨这些技术如何影响人力资本的形成。我们将生命早期时期的伤寒死亡率作为水质的替代指标。为了进行分析，我们将城市级别的数据与1900年至1940年人口普查中个人信息的独特数据集进行了整合。参数估计和半参数估计表明，消除生命早期接触伤寒的情况，将使后期的生活收入增加1%，教育水平提高一个月。使用上游城市的伤寒发病率进行建模后，也得到了类似的结果。简单的成本效益分析表明，通过消除伤寒所带来的收入增加，足以抵消根除该疾病的成本。

abstract.text: Most governments in the world including the United States prohibit prostitution. Given these types of laws rarely change and are fairly uniform across regions, our knowledge about the impact of decriminalizing sex work is largely conjectural. We exploit the fact that a Rhode Island District Court judge unexpectedly decriminalized indoor prostitution in 2003 to provide the first causal estimates of the impact of decriminalization on the composition of the sex market, rape offenses, and sexually transmitted infection outcomes. Not surprisingly, we find that decriminalization increased the size of the indoor market. However, we also find that decriminalization caused both forcible rape offenses and gonorrhea incidence to decline for the overall population. Our synthetic control model finds 824 fewer reported rape offenses (31 percent decrease) and 1,035 fewer cases of female gonorrhea (39 percent decrease) from 2004 to 2009.

10.3386/w20281.abstractZh: 世界上大多数政府，包括美国，都禁止卖淫行为。鉴于这类法律很少发生变化，且在不同地区具有相当的一致性，我们对性工作非刑事化影响的认识仍然停留在推测阶段。我们利用罗德岛地方法院法官在2003年意外地将室内卖淫非刑事化这一事实，首次对性工作非刑事化对性市场结构、强奸犯罪以及性传播感染结果的影响进行了因果分析。不出所料，我们发现非刑事化增加了室内市场的规模。然而，我们也发现，非刑事化导致整体人口的强奸犯罪率和淋病发病率有所下降。我们的综合控制模型显示，从2004年到2009年，报告的强奸犯罪减少了824起（减少了31%），女性淋病病例减少了1,035例（减少了39%）。

abstract.text: Brand and generic drug manufacturers frequently settle patent litigation on terms that include a payment to the generic manufacturer along with a specified date at which the generic would enter the market. The Federal Trade Commission contends that these agreements extend the brand's market exclusivity and amount to anticompetitive divisions of the market. The parties involved defend the settlements as normal business agreements that reduce business risk associated with litigation. The anticompetitive hypothesis implies brand stock prices should rise with announcement of the settlement. We classify 68 brand-generic settlements from 1993 to the present into those with and without an indication of a "reverse payment" from the brand to the generic, and conduct an event study of the announcement of the patent settlements on the stock price of the brand. For settlements with an indication of a reverse payment, brand stock prices rise on average 6% at the announcement. A "control group" of brand-generic settlements without indication of a reverse payment had no significant effect on the brands' stock prices. Our results support the hypothesis that settlements with a reverse payment increase the expected profits of the brand manufacturer and are anticompetitive.

10.3386/w20292.abstractZh: 品牌药和仿制药制造商经常通过专利诉讼达成和解，其中通常包括向仿制药制造商支付一定金额，并规定一个具体日期让仿制药进入市场。联邦贸易委员会认为，这类协议延长了品牌的市场独占权，属于反竞争的市场分割行为。相关方则将这些和解协议视为正常的商业协议，有助于降低诉讼带来的商业风险。反竞争假设认为，一旦宣布和解协议，品牌股票价格应会上升。我们对1993年至今的68起品牌与仿制药之间的和解协议进行了分类，其中一些协议中有“反向支付”的条款，另一些则没有。随后，我们对专利和解协议的公告对品牌股票价格的影响进行了事件研究分析。对于存在“反向支付”条款的解除协议，品牌股票价格在公告时平均上涨6%。而没有任何“反向支付”条款的对照组品牌与仿制药之间的和解协议，对品牌股票价格没有显著影响。我们的研究结果支持了以下假设：带有“反向支付”条款的解除协议会增加品牌制造商的预期利润，属于反竞争行为。

abstract.text: We study the long-run effects of Russia's anti-alcohol campaign, which dramatically altered the relative supply of hard and light alcohol in the late 1980s. We find that this policy shifted young men's long-run preferences from hard to light alcohol decades later and we estimate the age at which consumers form their tastes. We show that the large beer market expansion in the late 1990s had similar effects on young consumers' tastes, while older consumers' tastes remained largely unchanged. We then link these long-run changes in alcohol consumption patterns to changes in male mortality. The shift from hard to light alcohol reduced incidences of binge drinking substantially, leading to fewer alcohol- related deaths. We conclude that the resulting large cohort differences in current alcohol consumption shares explain a significant part of the recent decrease in male mortality. Simulations suggest that mortality will continue to decrease by another 23% over the next twenty years due to persistent changes in consumer tastes. Program impact evaluations that focus only on contemporaneous effects can therefore severely underestimate the total effect of such public policies that change preferences for goods.

10.3386/w20298.abstractZh: 我们研究了俄罗斯反酒精运动在1980年代末对酒精饮料供需关系长期影响的研究。研究发现，这一政策使得年轻男性的长期偏好从硬酒精转向了软酒精，并且我们估算了消费者形成偏好时的年龄。研究表明，1990年代末啤酒市场的巨大扩张对年轻消费者的偏好产生了类似的影响，而年长消费者的偏好则基本保持不变。我们将这些酒精消费模式的长期变化与男性死亡率的变化联系起来。从硬酒精转向软酒精显著减少了酗酒现象，从而减少了与酒精相关的死亡人数。我们得出结论，当前酒精消费比例的巨大群体差异解释了近期男性死亡率下降的重要原因。模拟结果显示，由于消费者偏好的持续变化，未来二十年内死亡率还将继续下降23%。因此，仅关注当前影响的政策评估可能会严重低估此类公共政策对消费者偏好改变的总体影响。

abstract.text: The premise of this article is that an understanding of psychology and other social science disciplines can inform the effectiveness of the economic tools traditionally deployed in carrying out the functions of government, which include remedying market failures, redistributing income, and collecting tax revenue. An understanding of psychology can also lead to the development of different policy tools that better motivate desired behavior change or that are more cost-effective than traditional policy tools. The article outlines a framework for thinking about the psychology of behavior change in the context of market failures. It then describes the research on the effects of a variety of interventions rooted in an understanding of psychology that have policy-relevant applications. The article concludes by discussing how an understanding of psychology can also inform the use and design of traditional policy tools for behavior change, such as financial incentives.

10.3386/w20318.abstractZh: 本文的出发点是，对心理学及其他社会科学学科的理解能够提升传统经济工具在履行政府职能方面的有效性，这些职能包括弥补市场失灵、重新分配收入以及征收税收。对心理学的理解还可以促使人们开发出能够更有效地激励期望的行为改变或比传统政策工具更具成本效益的不同政策工具。文章概述了一个思考市场失灵背景下行为改变心理学的框架，随后描述了基于心理学理解而设计的各种干预措施的研究，这些研究具有政策相关性。最后，文章讨论了如何通过理解心理学来指导传统行为改变政策工具的使用与设计，例如财政激励措施。

abstract.text: We investigate the predictive power of survey-elicited time preferences using a representative sample of US residents. In regressions controlling for demographics and risk preferences, we show that the discount factor elicited from choice experiments using multiple price lists and real payments predicts various health, energy, and financial outcomes, including overall self-reported health, smoking, drinking, car fuel efficiency, and credit card balance. We allow for time-inconsistent preferences and find that the long-run and present bias discount factors (δ and β) are each significantly associated in the expected direction with several of these outcomes. Finally, we explore alternate measures of time preference. Elicited discount factors are correlated with several such measures, including self-reported willpower. A multiple proxies approach using these alternate measures shows that our estimated associations between the time-consistent discount factor and health, energy, and financial outcomes may be conservative.

10.3386/w20320.abstractZh: 我们研究了通过调查获得的时间偏好预测能力，样本为美国居民。在控制人口统计和风险偏好的回归分析中，我们发现，通过多种价格列表和实际支付方式选择实验得出的折扣因子能够预测多种健康、能源和财务方面的结果，包括总体自我报告的健康状况、吸烟习惯、饮酒行为、汽车燃油效率以及信用卡余额等。我们考虑了时间不一致偏好，发现长期和当前偏好的折扣因子（δ和β）与这些结果之间存在显著的预期关联。最后，我们探讨了时间偏好的其他衡量方式。通过多种替代衡量方式得出的折扣因子与自我报告的意志力等指标存在相关性。使用这些替代衡量方式的多元代理方法表明，我们估计的时间一致折扣因子与健康、能源和财务结果之间的关联可能较为保守。

abstract.text: Non-adherence in health care results when a patient does not initiate or continue care that a provider has recommended. Previous research identifies non-adherence as a major source of waste in US health care, totaling approximately 2.3% of GDP, and have proposed a plethora of interventions to raise adherence. However, health economics provides little explicit analyses of the important dynamic demand behavior that drives non-adherence, and it is often casually attributed to uninformed patients. We argue that whereas providers may be more informed about the population-wide effects of treatments, patients are more informed about the individual specific value of treatment. We interpret a patient’s decision to adhere to a treatment regime as an optimal stopping problem in which patients learn the value of a treatment through treatment experience. We derive strong positive and normative implications resulting from interpreting non-adherence as an optimal stopping problem. Our positive analysis derives an “adherence survival function,” depicting the share of patients still on treatment as a function of time, and predicts how various observable factors alter adherence. Our normative analysis derives the efficiency effects of non-adherence and the conditions under which adherence is too high or low. We consider the efficiency implications of this analysis for common adherence interventions. We argue that personalized medicine is intimately linked to adherence issues. It replaces the learning through treatment experience with a diagnostic test, and thereby speeds up the leaning process and cuts over-adherence and raises underadherence. We assess the quantitative implications of our analysis by calibrating the degree of over- and under-adherence for one of the largest US drug categories, cholesterol-reducing drugs. Contrary to frequent normative claims of under-adherence, our estimates suggest the efficiency loss from overadherence is over 80% larger than from under-adherence, even though only 43% of patients fully adhere.

10.3386/w20330.abstractZh: 在医疗保健领域，患者不启动或继续接受医疗服务提供方所推荐的治疗，就会导致不依从现象。先前的研究指出，不依从是美国医疗保健中浪费的主要来源，占总GDP的约2.3%，并提出了大量干预措施以提高依从性。然而，健康经济学对导致不依从的重要动态需求行为分析较少，且通常将其归因于患者缺乏信息。我们认为，虽然医疗服务提供者可能更了解治疗对整体人群的影响，但患者更了解治疗的个体价值。我们将患者决定遵循治疗方案的行为视为一个最优停止问题，患者通过治疗经验来学习治疗的价值。将不依从行为解读为最优停止问题，可以得出一些积极的结论和规范性的启示。我们的积极分析得出了一个“依从性生存函数”，描述了随时间推移仍继续接受治疗的患者比例，并预测了各种可观察因素如何改变依从性。我们的规范性分析揭示了不依从行为的效率效应，以及哪些情况下依从性过高或过低。我们还考虑了这一分析对常见依从性干预措施的效率影响。我们认为，个性化医疗与依从性问题密切相关。它用诊断测试取代了通过治疗经验学习的方式，从而加快了学习过程，减少了过度依从性，并提高了低依从性。我们通过校准美国最大药物类别之一——降胆固醇药物的过度依从性和低依从性程度，来评估我们分析的定量意义。与常见的规范性说法相反，我们的估计表明，过度依从性导致的效率损失比缺乏依从性导致的效率损失还要大80%以上，尽管只有43%的患者完全遵循治疗方案。

abstract.text: While at least a dozen state legislatures in the United States have recently considered bills to allow the consumption of marijuana for medicinal purposes, the federal government is intensifying its efforts to close medical marijuana dispensaries. Federal officials contend that the legalization of medical marijuana encourages teenagers to use marijuana and have targeted dispensaries operating within 1,000 feet of schools, parks and playgrounds. Using data from the national and state Youth Risk Behavior Surveys, the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth 1997 and the Treatment Episode Data Set, we estimate the relationship between medical marijuana laws and marijuana use. Our results are not consistent with the hypothesis that legalization leads to increased use of marijuana by teenagers.

10.3386/w20332.abstractZh: 在美国，至少有十几个州立法机构最近审议了允许将大麻用于医疗目的的法案。与此同时，联邦政府正在加大力度关闭医用大麻诊所。联邦官员认为，医用大麻的合法化会促使青少年使用大麻，因此他们特别关注那些位于学校、公园和游乐场1000英尺范围内的诊所。通过利用全国性和州级青少年风险行为调查数据、1997年青少年纵向调查以及治疗事件数据集，我们研究了医用大麻法律与大麻使用之间的关系。我们的研究结果并不支持“合法化会导致青少年使用大麻增加”这一假设。

abstract.text: Families in constrained economic circumstances resulting from economic shocks face difficult choices regarding how best to spend their diminished resources. As families strive to preserve their living standards, decisions regarding health care use and its allocation among family members may become more discretionary and complex. Using two-year panel data from the Medical Expenditure Panel Survey for 2004 to 2011, we examine how the intra-family allocation of health care spending responds to realized and anticipated changes in family economic status. We focus on the share of total family health care spending allocated to children, and measure realized economic shocks based on changes in the family's income, employment, and health insurance status. We account for anticipated economic shocks by differentiating families by whether they are observed prior to, at the onset of, or during the Great Recession, or in the post-recession period. Our findings suggest that both types of economic shocks affect the share of family health care spending allocated to children, with findings more pronounced for single-mother families. We also find that realized economic shocks have a greater impact on children's spending share than the anticipated change in economic status associated with the Great Recession and its recovery.

10.3386/w20348.abstractZh: 由于经济冲击导致的经济困境，家庭在如何最有效地使用有限的资源方面面临艰难的选择。当家庭努力维持生活水平时，关于医疗保健使用及其在家庭成员之间的分配的决策可能会变得更加自主且复杂。我们利用2004年至2011年的医疗支出面板调查两年期数据，研究家庭内部医疗保健支出的分配如何响应家庭经济状况的现实变化及预期变化。我们重点关注家庭总医疗保健支出中分配给儿童的份额，并根据家庭收入、就业状况及健康保险状况的变化来衡量实际发生的经济冲击。我们通过区分家庭是在大衰退之前、大衰退期间还是大衰退之后，以及在大衰退后的时期，来考虑预期的经济冲击。我们的研究发现表明，这两种类型的经济冲击都会影响家庭医疗保健支出中分配给儿童的份额，其中单亲家庭的影响更为显著。我们还发现，实际发生的经济冲击对儿童支出份额的影响大于与大衰退及其恢复相关的预期经济状况变化。

abstract.text: In many markets, including the new U.S. Exchanges, health insurance plans are paid by risk-adjusted capitation, in some markets combined with reinsurance and other payment mechanisms. This paper proposes three metrics for analyzing the insurer incentives embedded in these complex payment systems. We discuss fit, power and balance, each of which addresses a distinct market failure in health insurance. We implement these metrics in a study of Exchange payment systems with data similar to that used to develop the Exchange risk adjustment scheme and quantify the empirical tradeoffs among the metrics. We show that an essential tradeoff arises between the goals of limiting costs and limiting cream skimming because risk adjustment, which is aimed at discouraging cream-skimming, is in fact tied to costs. We find that a simple reinsurance system scores better on fit, power and balance than the risk adjustment scheme in use in the Exchanges.

10.3386/w20359.abstractZh: 在许多市场中，包括新的美国交易所，健康保险计划的支付方式是基于风险调整后的按人头付费模式，在某些市场中则结合了再保险和其他支付机制。本文提出了三种指标，用于分析这些复杂支付体系中保险公司所面临的激励问题。我们分别讨论了“适应性”、“影响力”和“平衡性”这三个指标，每个指标都针对健康保险领域存在的不同市场失灵问题。我们在一项针对交易所支付系统的研究中应用了这些指标，所使用的数据类似于用于开发交易所风险调整机制的数据，并量化了这些指标之间的实证权衡。我们发现，在限制成本和防止保费抽成之间存在着重要的权衡关系，因为旨在抑制保费抽出的风险调整机制实际上与成本密切相关。研究还表明，简单的再保险系统在“适应性”、“影响力”和“平衡性”这三个指标上的表现优于当前交易所使用的风险调整机制。

abstract.text: It is well known that exposure to lead has numerous adverse effects on behavior and development. Using data on two cohorts of children from the NLSY, this paper investigates the effect of early childhood lead exposure on behavior problems from childhood through early adulthood. I find large negative consequences of early childhood lead exposure, in the form of an unfolding series of adverse behavioral outcomes: behavior problems as a child, pregnancy and aggression as a teen, and criminal behavior as a young adult. At the levels of lead that were the norm in United States until the late 1980s, estimated elasticities of these behaviors with respect to lead range between 0.1 and 1.0.

10.3386/w20366.abstractZh: 众所周知，接触铅会对行为和发展产生诸多不良影响。本文利用NLSY研究的两个儿童队列的数据，探讨了儿童早期接触铅对从童年到成年早期行为问题的影响。研究发现，儿童早期接触铅会带来严重的负面后果，表现为一系列不良行为：儿童时期的行为问题、青少年时期的怀孕和攻击行为，以及成年早期的犯罪行为。在20世纪80年代末之前，美国普遍存在的铅含量水平下，这些行为与铅之间的弹性估计值在0.1到1.0之间。

abstract.text: The events of 9/11 released a million tons of toxic dust into lower Manhattan, an unparalleled environmental disaster. It is puzzling then that the literature has shown little effect of fetal exposure to the dust. However, inference is complicated by pre-existing differences between the affected mothers and other NYC mothers as well as heterogeneity in effects on boys and girls. Using all births in utero on 9/11 in NYC and comparing them to their siblings, we show that residence in the affected area increased prematurity, low birth weight, and admission to the NICU after birth, especially for boys.

10.3386/w20368.abstractZh: 9月11日的事件向下曼哈顿地区释放了百万吨有毒粉尘，造成了前所未有的环境灾难。然而，相关文献显示，胎儿接触这些粉尘的影响却很小，这令人困惑。不过，这一结论因受影响母亲与其他纽约市母亲之间的先天差异以及不同性别儿童所受影响的差异而变得复杂。通过对9月11日当天在纽约市出生的所有胎儿与其兄弟姐妹进行比较，我们发现，居住在受影响地区会导致早产、低出生体重，以及婴儿出生后需要入住新生儿重症监护室的情况增加，尤其是在男孩中更为明显。

abstract.text: Measuring the overall impact of public health insurance receipt is important in an era of increased access to publicly-provided and subsidized insurance. Although government expansion of health insurance to older workers leads to labor supply reductions for recipients, there may be spillover effects on the labor supply of uncovered spouses.
